etymology.historical_story: DBP marks izin as an Arabic borrowing, corresponding to Arabic idhn, meaning permission. Malay incorporates this borrowed base into its own productive grammar: izin becomes izinkan and mengizinkan. The resulting verb covers permission from people and, figuratively, opportunities allowed by time or circumstances. This illustrates how a borrowed noun becomes part of an ordinary Malay word family. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=izin).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 izin＝许可；meng-…-kan 把它变成动作：mengizinkan＝给予许可。

etymology.historical_story: The root hantu supplies the image of a ghost, while the verbal formation menghantui turns that image toward persistent disturbance. Malay dictionaries explicitly recognize its figurative application to thoughts and feelings. A frightening event can therefore linger like an unwelcome presence without any claim about spirits. This is a semantic explanation, not a dated account of the word's first appearance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 hantu“鬼”：回忆像鬼影一样赶不走，便是 menghantui“纠缠、困扰”。

morphology.formula: meN- + gerakkan → menggerakkan; 完整构词：meN- + gerak + -kan → menggerakkan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留 gerakkan，它是已含 -kan 的直接词基；最终词根是 gerak。meN- 在 g 前变为 meng-，原来的 g 保留；完整结构为 meN-...-kan。双写 kk 来自 gerak 与 -kan 的接合，常读 /ʔ.k/。

senses.zh_definition: 使身体、物体或机械部件移动、摇动或改变位置；驱动。

senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan sesuatu bergerak, bergoyang atau beralih tempat.

senses.ms_definition: Mengaktifkan orang, organisasi atau kegiatan supaya bertindak dan berkembang.
senses.nuances: 常见于行政、社会服务及经济报道。可以表示实际调派人员，也可表示推动某项事业。

etymology.historical_story: Menggerakkan illustrates a productive Malay way of expressing causation: gerak supplies movement, while the surrounding morphology makes someone cause that movement. Its dictionary meanings also connect physical motion with organized action and inner motivation. A machine, a community, and a person's interest can therefore all be pictured as being set in motion. [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=menggerakkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 gerak“动”：bergerak 是“自己动”，menggerakkan 是“让它动”；人、机器、兴趣都能被带动。

etymology.historical_story: Mangsa is borrowed from Sanskrit māṃsa, meaning flesh or meat. Its Malay meanings connect the animal taken as food with the wider idea of someone subjected to harm. The semantic link is memorable: what a predator takes becomes a model for describing exploitation. Adding -nya identifies the predator, perpetrator, or event from the surrounding context. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mangsa#Malay).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mang-sa-nya 配上“老虎盯住它的猎物”的画面：mangsa 是猎物，-nya 是“它的”；换成骗子，便是“他的受害者”。

senses.zh_definition: 操舵；控制船只等交通工具的行进方向。

senses.ms_definition: Mengawal kemudi atau arah pergerakan kapal, perahu atau kenderaan.
senses.nuances: 强调控制方向。马来西亚日常说“开车”通常用 memandu kereta；mengemudi 尤其适合船只、掌舵与航行语境。此处马来语释义为综合编写，并非 DBP 逐字引文；DBP 的 [bergilir 检索结果](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=bergilir) 可见轮流掌舵的用法，[kemudi 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kemudi+) 列有相关派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 引领；掌握组织、事业或事务的发展方向。

senses.ms_definition: Memimpin atau mengendalikan sesuatu organisasi, usaha atau urusan dengan menentukan haluannya.
senses.nuances: 由掌舵引申为领导，常见于演说、评论和机构报道；带有引领方向的形象色彩。较直接的中性表达包括 memimpin 和 mengendalikan。参见 DBP [memandu 检索结果中的 pilot 释义](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=memandu)，其中列有 mengemudi。

etymology.historical_story: Mengemudi is transparently formed from kemudi, a rudder, with the active prefix meN-. Steering supplies a useful image for leadership: someone responsible for an organization determines its course as a helmsman directs a vessel. This is a semantic connection, not evidence for a particular ancient borrowing or an independently established date of origin. Source: [DBP, kemudi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kemudi+).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 kemudi“舵”：meN- 接上后 k 脱落，成为 mengemudi“掌舵”；掌握船的方向，也就能联想到引领组织。

morphology.pattern_note: 借词整体作为词根，无马来语词缀。依 DBP 标注 météor，两处 e 均读 /e/，不是 /ə/；IPA 按 me.te.or 标示，syllables 保留输入包的 null。hujan meteor、jejak meteor 属于合成表达。

word_family.gloss: 流星轨迹或尾迹，属合成表达

senses.zh_definition: 流星；流星体高速进入大气层时产生的短暂发光现象，在天空中常呈一道亮痕。
senses.en_definition: The brief luminous phenomenon produced when a meteoroid enters the atmosphere, commonly seen as a streak of light.
senses.ms_definition: Tahi bintang; fenomena cahaya singkat yang terhasil apabila meteoroid memasuki atmosfera.
senses.nuances: DBP 的简释为 tahi bintang，马来文定义在此加上科学说明。严格区分 meteoroid＝在太空中运行的小天体、meteor＝进入大气时的发光现象、meteorit＝落到地面的残存实体。流星并非恒星坠落。参见 [DBP：meteor](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=meteor) 及 [NASA：术语定义](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20200000049/downloads/20200000049.pdf?attachment=true)。

etymology.historical_story: Meteor belongs to an international scientific vocabulary whose history reaches Greek meteōros, meaning high in the air. European forms developed through Latin and French before the English word emerged. The older category covered atmospheric phenomena broadly; modern astronomy gives meteor a narrower meaning. Malay also retains the familiar expression tahi bintang. See [Merriam-Webster's word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/meteor) and [DBP's Malay entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=meteor).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meteor 记成天空中“一闪”的光；再用三站图串联：太空 meteoroid → 空中发光 meteor → 落地残块 meteorit。

senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 所列的刑罚相关义。正式表达“判处绞刑”通常用 menjatuhkan hukuman gantung；menggantung 指执行动作，二者不可混淆。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menggantung)

etymology.historical_story: Menggantung is formed within Malay from gantung and the active prefix meN-. Its meanings connect physical suspension with matters left pending, permissions temporarily suspended, and sporting careers brought to an end. These uses provide a memorable semantic network, although they do not establish the historical order in which the meanings developed. DBP records both everyday and figurative uses. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menggantung)

etymology.historical_story: Moore enters Malay texts as a retained foreign name, rather than through Malay affixation. A notable technological association comes from Gordon Moore, whose 1965 article predicted increasing numbers of components on integrated circuits. His surname became attached to Moore's law. This explains one familiar expression, but does not identify every person or place called Moore. [Intel historical account](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/history/virtual-vault/articles/moores-law.html)

etymology.historical_story: Malay misa is traced to Portuguese missa, ultimately from Latin missa. Its distant history contains a memorable shift: language associated with dismissal or sending came to name the Eucharistic celebration itself. The Malay word preserves this international Christian vocabulary as a compact, indivisible loanword. [Malay borrowing](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/misa); [liturgical history](https://www.liturgia.pt/dicionario/dici_ver.php?cod_dici=264).

etymology.historical_story: Mendatangkan shows how Malay builds new meanings from datang, 'come'. With meN- and -kan, an arrival becomes something an agent brings about. The same construction can describe bringing experts into a university or bringing benefits to a community. Physical movement and abstract consequences thus share one productive grammatical pattern rather than requiring unrelated verbs.

etymology.historical_story: Malone is an English form of the Irish surname Ó Maoileoin, conventionally understood as descendant of a devotee of Saint John. Irish naming traditions preserved such religious affiliations within family names. When the surname appears in Malay writing, it normally identifies a person or family rather than contributing a new Malay lexical meaning. [Placenames Database of Ireland](https://www.logainm.ie/en/themes/106)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听作“马隆”，想到名牌上的姓氏 Malone；认人名，不把它硬拆成普通词义。

etymology.historical_story: Misai is a Tamil loanword, adapted from mīcai, meaning moustache. DBP-published research identifies it among Tamil words integrated into Malay pronunciation. Its everyday familiarity illustrates how language contact reaches intimate parts of ordinary life, including descriptions of the face. Modern Malay treats misai as a whole base and can add ber- to describe someone wearing a moustache. [DBP linguistic study](https://dev.dbp.my/index.php/jurnalbahasa/ms/article/download/3911/4255/29373)

etymology.historical_story: Membangkitkan is built from bangkit, with meN- and causative -kan. The dictionary records a striking semantic range: waking a sleeper, raising the dead, lifting an object, and stirring feelings. A useful learning interpretation links these meanings through making something rise or become active; this is a mnemonic connection, rather than a documented chronology of their development. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=membangkitkan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bangkit 是“起来”，-kan 是“让它起来”：让人醒来、让斗志起来、让议题浮出来，都是 membangkitkan。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接以 k 开头的本族词根时，k 通常脱落，鼻音实现为 ng /ŋ/；-kan 表示使成某种状态。输入包将本词误标为词根，此处校正为 kosong，参见 [DBP 词族资料](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=kosong)。

senses.zh_definition: 清空；移走某容器或空间内的东西，使其不再装有或存有任何东西。
senses.en_definition: To empty something by removing its contents.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu bekas atau ruang kosong dengan mengeluarkan isinya.
senses.nuances: 通常为及物动词，宾语是被清空的容器或空间；强调变为空的结果，不一定涉及清洗。此处与下义是对 DBP 核心义的教学性细分，马来文释义为规范化转述，参见 [DBP：mengosongkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengosongkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 腾空或撤离房屋、场所；离任或放弃席位，使其无人占用或担任。
senses.en_definition: To vacate premises, a position, or a seat, leaving it unoccupied.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan tempat, jawatan atau kerusi tidak lagi diduduki atau disandang.
senses.nuances: 用于房屋时，可指搬离并交还场所；用于职位或议席时，强调出现空缺，具体原因须由上下文说明，不能一律译成主动辞职。

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates a productive Malay way of turning a state into an action. Kosong describes emptiness; the surrounding affixes express causing that state. DBP records uses involving both places and positions. The same construction therefore connects emptying a container with vacating an office: something previously occupied or filled becomes available again. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengosongkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 kosong（空）：meN-…-kan 把“空”变成“使它空”——清空、腾空。

morphology.pattern_note: 依词包保留 memadai 为独立基底；传统构词分析为 meN- + pada（足够）+ -i，p 脱落，meN- 实现为 mem-。词尾 a.i 分属两音节。下列词族以 pada 为共同基础。参见[DBP 词族资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=memadai)。

senses.zh_definition: 数量、程度或条件足以满足某项需要或要求；足够、足以。
senses.en_definition: To be sufficient to meet a need, requirement, or purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Mencukupi, dapat mengisi atau memenuhi kehendak, peraturan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 通常作状态性谓语，表示达到所需门槛，不保证优良或充裕。常用 sudah memadai、tidak memadai、memadai untuk；日常交流中 cukup 更简洁。它可以表示“这样就够了”，不必然带有勉强应付的贬义。

collocations.en: be insufficient to cover the costs

etymology.historical_story: Traditional Malay lexicography places memadai in the family of pada meaning enough or satisfied, distinct from the familiar preposition pada. Its relatives include berpada-pada, expressing moderation, and memadakan, treating something as sufficient. This family links practical sufficiency with restraint: having enough and avoiding excess share a lexical foundation. See the [DBP word-family listing](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=memadai).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 me-ma-da-i 当成四格刻度：水量一达到所需刻度，就 memadai——够了，不必装满。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按输入保留 maksudkan，实际最终词根为 maksud。-kan 是动词后缀，-nya 在此是附着代词，可指前述事物、话语或人；它不是新的派生词缀。ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/。无 meN- 的形式可用于特定句法结构，也常见于口语省略；不能据表面形式统一判为正式主动句。

senses.zh_definition: 意指前述的人、事物或意思；将其作为所表达的对象。具体所指由上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: To mean or refer to the previously mentioned person, thing, or meaning.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan orang, perkara atau pengertian yang telah disebut sebagai sesuatu yang dirujuk atau hendak disampaikan.
senses.nuances: 这是 maksudkan 加代词 -nya 的组合分析，不是已核实的独立 DBP 词头。DBP 收录 memaksudkan；本字段的马来语释义为据此编写的说明，不冒充官方逐字定义。正式主动陈述可使用 memaksudkannya，或改写为 yang saya maksudkan，须依句法选择。参见 [DBP：memaksudkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=memaksudkan)。下列为自然组合示例，频率未经验证。

senses.zh_definition: 对自己所说的话是认真的，确实抱有该意图；常用于强调诚意或否认只是开玩笑。
senses.en_definition: To sincerely intend what one has said; to mean it.
senses.ms_definition: Benar-benar berniat seperti yang dinyatakan dan bersungguh-sungguh dengan kata-kata tersebut.
senses.nuances: 这是在具体语境中形成的强调用法，不另称 DBP 独立义项。“Saya maksudkannya” 可对应英语 I mean it，但日常马来语也常直接说 Saya serius 或 Saya betul-betul ikhlas，具体取决于强调认真还是诚意。不能把 maksudkannya 解释为“理解它”；后者通常用 memahaminya。

collocations.zh: 并非真心那样说；并无那个意思

etymology.historical_story: The base maksud is an Arabic loan associated with intention and purpose, already recorded as such in an [early English–Malay vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/78/A_vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages%3B_%28IA_anr0813.0002.001.umich.edu%29.pdf). Malay builds further forms with its own morphology: -kan forms the verbal base here, while attached -nya points back to a referent. The complete expression thus combines a borrowed base with Malay grammatical resources.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: maksud＝意思，-kan＝动词构形，-nya＝前面提到的它／他／她：把三段串起来记成“我指的就是那个”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 tunjuk；资料包把派生词误标为词根。meN- 接以 t 开头的本族词根时，t 通常被鼻音 n 替代；词末 k 在常见马来西亚读音中实现为 [ʔ]。词族关系见 [PRPM：tunjuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tunjuk)。

senses.en_definition: In menunjuk perasaan, to demonstrate or protest publicly.

etymology.historical_story: Menunjuk belongs to the Malay tunjuk family, which links pointing, guidance, and display. Its initial t disappears when the active prefix meN- supplies a nasal consonant, producing menunjuk. The same family includes petunjuk, a clue or guide, and penunjuk, an indicator. This network makes a simple pointing gesture a useful bridge to several abstract meanings.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 tunjuk 的 t 被前缀带来的 n 替换：meN- + tunjuk → menunjuk；伸手一指，就是“指向”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 perang（战争），不是 memerang（水獭）。meN- 遇词首 p 时，p 脱落并发生唇音鼻化，形成 mem-；-i 构成指向受事的及物动词。此处 circumfix 表示前后缀组合。[DBP 词族资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=berperang)

etymology.historical_story: The key to memerangi is perang, meaning war. Malay builds a transitive verb by combining this base with meN- and -i, with the initial p disappearing during nasal substitution. The dictionary records both armed opposition and combating harmful things. This pairing helps explain why the same verb fits accounts of warfare and campaigns against corruption or poverty.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 perang＝战争：meN- + perang + -i，把某人或某种弊害当作作战对象。别把它误拆成 memerang（水獭）加 -i。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是后附强调小品词，不是改变词类的派生后缀；接合时词干不变。数据包的 ماچم 仅表示 macam，未包含 -lah；音节字段按数据包保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 说得好像……似的；仿佛……一样，常以反讽语气否定或质疑后面的说法。
senses.en_definition: As if; used emphatically, often to challenge or sarcastically reject an implied claim.
senses.ms_definition: Seolah-olah atau seakan-akan, dengan penegasan yang sering menyatakan sindiran atau ketidakpercayaan terhadap sesuatu anggapan.
senses.nuances: 本词常引出带反讽的分句，例如 macamlah dia tahu，实际暗示“他哪里知道”。反讽来自语境、语调与 -lah 的强调，并非 macam 本身必然带贬义。这里的 conjunction 按引出比较分句的功能标注；完整形式的释义为组合分析。[DBP：比较词 macam](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/12/23/16890/)

senses.zh_definition: 就像……一样；引出名词性比较对象，并加强相似的感觉。

senses.ms_definition: Seperti atau serupa dengan seseorang atau sesuatu, dengan penegasan pada persamaan tersebut.

etymology.historical_story: Macam links the ideas of kind, appearance, and likeness: things of a similar kind can be described as looking or behaving alike. Adding -lah brings the speaker's emphasis into that comparison. In Malaysian conversation, tone can turn an ordinary likeness into a sharp “as if,” so the social meaning extends beyond the literal comparison.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: macam＝“像”，加 -lah 后听语气：平声可表“真像”，挑眉说则常是“说得好像……似的”。

驱赶；驱逐的行为或过程

senses.zh_definition: 赶着牲畜等朝指定地点移动；赶集、驱赶入某处。
senses.en_definition: To drive or herd animals towards a particular place.
senses.ms_definition: Mengarahkan binatang seperti kerbau atau lembu supaya bergerak ke sesuatu tempat; menggiring.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，强调引导动物朝某个目的地移动，不一定是把动物赶走，也不必然涉及伤害。后面常接动物名称及方向补语。参见[DBP：halau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=halau)。

senses.zh_definition: 赶走；迫使人、动物或害虫离开某处。
senses.en_definition: To drive away or force someone or something to leave a place.
senses.ms_definition: Menyuruh atau menyebabkan seseorang atau sesuatu pergi atau keluar dari sesuatu tempat secara paksa; mengusir.
senses.nuances: 强调使对象离开，可用于人、动物和昆虫。对人使用时往往带有强硬、拒绝或羞辱意味，强度通常高于普通的 meminta seseorang beredar。

kat 对应表示位置的 di。
ni 对应 ini。
口语中也常省略 meN-，用 halau；此句保留完整词形 menghalau。

messages.ms_spoken: Aku tengah menghalau lalat kat meja makan ni.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 对人说 Saya akan menghalau awak 带有强烈驱逐意味。需要礼貌请人离开时，可说 Maaf, boleh beredar dari sini?，即“不好意思，可以请您离开这里吗？”
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于驱赶蚊蝇或赶牲畜通常自然；用于客人、长辈或顾客时容易伤面子。只有确实要表达强制离开、驱逐或指责此类行为时，才宜对人使用。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 对人说 Saya akan menghalau awak 带有强烈驱逐意味。需要礼貌请人离开时，可说 Maaf, boleh beredar dari sini?，即“不好意思，可以请您离开这里吗？”
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 用于驱赶蚊蝇或赶牲畜通常自然；用于客人、长辈或顾客时容易伤面子。只有确实要表达强制离开、驱逐或指责此类行为时，才宜对人使用。

etymology.historical_story: Menghalau is transparently formed from halau with the active verb prefix meN-. Its two dictionary senses preserve a useful contrast: a herder directs animals towards a destination, while someone chasing pests makes them leave. Both involve controlling movement. The agricultural scene therefore explains the word more reliably than an invented story about its remote origin. See [DBP’s entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=halau).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 halau 的 ha 想成赶动物时喊的“哈！”，再看方向：进圈是赶进去，离开是赶走；meng- 表示主动做这个动作。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接以 /t/ 开头的 tatap 时，鼻音实现为 /n/，词根首音 /t/ 脱落。资料包中的 atap 是误析；atap 意为“屋顶”。正确词根见 [DBP：tatap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tatap)。

senses.zh_definition: 仔细端详；专注查看，以看清或理解对象。
senses.en_definition: To examine visually with close attention.
senses.ms_definition: Memerhatikan dengan teliti atau memandang dengan sungguh-sungguh.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，直接接所观察的对象。比 melihat 更强调注意力，但并不自动表示敌意，也不等于正式检查或审计。[DBP：menatap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=menatap)

senses.zh_definition: 凝视；目光持续停留在某人或某物上。
senses.en_definition: To gaze steadily at someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Memandang, merenung atau merenungi seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 与第一义相近，此处侧重目光停留，可表达深思、爱意、惊讶或其他情绪。它本身不必然具有英语 stare 所带的不礼貌意味。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Para peserta menatap gambar yang dipaparkan pada skrin sebelum memberikan ulasan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 与会者仔细观看屏幕上展示的图片后，再发表意见。
dual_scenarios.en: The participants studied the picture displayed on the screen before offering their comments.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dari tadi kau menatap gambar tu je. Rindu dia ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sejak tadi awak hanya menatap gambar itu. Adakah awak merinduinya?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你从刚才就一直盯着那张照片看。想他了啊？
dual_scenarios.en: You've been gazing at that photo all this time. Missing them?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
je 对应 sahaja，突出“一直只做这件事”。
句末 ke 构成口语疑问。
menatap 本身较有描写色彩，可自然用于带感情或打趣的谈话。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dari tadi kau menatap gambar tu je. Gambar siapa?
messages.ms_standard: Sejak tadi awak hanya menatap gambar itu. Gambar siapakah itu?
messages.zh: 你从刚才就一直看那张照片。谁的照片啊？

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Gambar arwah nenek aku. Dah lama aku tak tengok album ni.
messages.ms_standard: Itu gambar arwah nenek saya. Sudah lama saya tidak melihat album ini.
messages.zh: 我已故奶奶的照片。我好久没翻这本相册了。
messages.en: It's my late grandmother. I haven't looked through this album in a long time.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述观察行为时语体中性偏书面；要求别人长时间直视自己，可能显得强势。对长辈或不熟悉的人，宜依场合自然保持目光接触。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合文学叙述、人物描写和专注观看的场景。若强调冒犯性的盯视，须结合 tajam、tanpa berkelip 等具体描写，不能仅凭 menatap 判定态度。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述观察行为时语体中性偏书面；要求别人长时间直视自己，可能显得强势。对长辈或不熟悉的人，宜依场合自然保持目光接触。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合文学叙述、人物描写和专注观看的场景。若强调冒犯性的盯视，须结合 tajam、tanpa berkelip 等具体描写，不能仅凭 menatap 判定态度。

etymology.historical_story: Menatap is formed from tatap through a regular Malay nasal-prefix process: the initial t disappears after meN-. The same root produces tatapan, a gaze, and bertatapan, exchanging looks. These related forms give writers a compact vocabulary for attentive looking and emotional encounters. The apparent sequence atap inside menatap is not the root meaning roof.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tatap 的两个 t 像两道定住的视线；加 meN- 后首个 t 被鼻音替换，成为 menatap：“把目光定住”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + merta → merta；serta + merta → serta-merta（固定组合）
morphology.pattern_note: 不拆成 me- + rta。现代标准语表示“立即”时使用完整的 serta-merta；其中的 merta 不作为自由副词单独使用。is_root 表示此处不再作同步派生分析，不表示它可独立成词使用。Jawi 原资料缺失，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 仅在固定表达 serta-merta 中表示“立即；当即；毫不拖延地”。
senses.en_definition: Immediately; without delay, occurring in the fixed expression serta-merta.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan serta-merta: pada ketika itu juga, tanpa berlengah.
senses.nuances: 词类标注针对完整表达 serta-merta 的副词功能。不要写成 Dia datang merta；应写 Dia datang serta-merta。标准拼写使用连字符。[DBP：serta 下的 serta-merta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=290992&keyword=serta)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Peraturan baharu itu berkuat kuasa serta-merta selepas diumumkan oleh pihak pengurusan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该项新规定在管理层宣布后立即生效。
dual_scenarios.en: The new rule takes effect immediately upon its announcement by management.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah tukar kata laluan serta-merta lepas dapat mesej pelik tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah menukar kata laluan serta-merta selepas menerima mesej yang mencurigakan itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我一收到那条可疑信息，就马上改了密码。
dual_scenarios.en: I changed my password as soon as I got that suspicious message.
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah；lepas 对应 selepas。
tu 对应 itu。
口语中仍保留完整的 serta-merta，不缩成 merta。
在轻松谈话中，也常用 terus 或 terus sahaja 表达类似的即时反应。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tukar kata laluan lepas dapat mesej pelik tu?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah menukar kata laluan selepas menerima mesej yang mencurigakan itu?
messages.zh: 收到那条可疑信息之后，你改密码了吗？
messages.en: Did you change your password after getting that suspicious message?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku tukar serta-merta. Aku nak semak tetapan akaun sekali.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah menukarnya serta-merta. Saya juga mahu menyemak tetapan akaun.
messages.zh: 改了，我当时马上就改了。我还想顺便检查一下账号设置。
messages.en: Yes, I changed it straight away. I also want to check my account settings.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: serta-merta 强调立即执行，在工作指令中语气较强。向同事请求时可说 Mohon tindakan serta-merta，并明确所需行动。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合即时反应、紧急行动及规定生效等语境。普通请求若无需强调紧迫性，可用 segera；避免在标准句中单独使用 merta。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: serta-merta 强调立即执行，在工作指令中语气较强。向同事请求时可说 Mohon tindakan serta-merta，并明确所需行动。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合即时反应、紧急行动及规定生效等语境。普通请求若无需强调紧迫性，可用 segera；避免在标准句中单独使用 merta。

etymology.historical_story: Modern Malaysian Malay preserves merta chiefly within serta-merta, a fixed expression for immediate action. Its two parts should be learned together rather than treated as freely interchangeable words. Official notices use the expression to mark immediate effect, while conversation uses it for an instant response. The available evidence does not establish a secure separate borrowing history for merta.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serta-merta 整块记成“说完就做，立即行动”；看到 merta，就把前面的 serta- 一起想起来。

morphology.formula: Muhammad → Mohd（书写缩略，无马来语词缀）
morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语词法层面作为不可再用词缀拆分的姓名缩写处理，is_root 不表示它是历史词根。通常写作 Mohd 或 Mohd.，按完整名字读出；音节、IPA 和爪夷文展示的是展开为 Muhammad 时的形式，具体读法依本人姓名。

word_family.gloss: 常见的完整姓名形式；不是派生词
同一姓名的另一缩写形式；不是派生词

senses.zh_definition: 马来西亚男性姓名中 Muhammad 等姓名形式的常见书写缩写，规范大小写通常为 Mohd 或 Mohd.。
senses.en_definition: A conventional written abbreviation of Muhammad and related spelling forms in Malaysian male personal names.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan nama khas Muhammad yang lazim digunakan dalam nama lelaki; dibaca mengikut bentuk penuh nama berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词缩写，不是普通名词、称号或姓氏标记。noun 在本模式中涵盖专有名词；搭配栏所列为姓名组合示例。不能仅凭 Mohd 擅自确定某人的完整登记拼写。DBP 说明这类缩写通常按全名读出：[DBP：姓名缩写与读法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Muhd+)。不同拼写形式参见：[马来西亚国立大学：马来姓名著录](https://www.ukm.my/e-catalogers/nama_melayu.php)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报

spoken_features: kat 对应方位或范围表达，此处标准语用 dalam。
tu 对应 itu。
句末 kan 用于请求确认。
Mohd 是书写缩写，朗读姓名时通常展开。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Nama dia kat senarai tu Mohd Azlan, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Nama beliau dalam senarai itu ialah Mohd Azlan, bukan?
messages.zh: 名单上他的名字是 Mohd Azlan，对吧？

messages.ms_standard: Ya, gunakan ejaan itu dahulu. Nanti kita bertanya kepada beliau tentang bentuk nama yang ingin digunakan pada sijil.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼本人时，优先采用其介绍自己的名字；正式场合可配 Encik 或适用的职衔。Mohd 本身不表达社会等级或敬意。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 填写证书、合同或人员名单时，应核对本人提供的姓名拼写，包括是否带句点。不要自行把 Mohd 改成 Muhammad、Mohamad 或其他形式，也不要把姓名缩写当作可随意取笑的口语词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称呼本人时，优先采用其介绍自己的名字；正式场合可配 Encik 或适用的职衔。Mohd 本身不表达社会等级或敬意。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 填写证书、合同或人员名单时，应核对本人提供的姓名拼写，包括是否带句点。不要自行把 Mohd 改成 Muhammad、Mohamad 或其他形式，也不要把姓名缩写当作可随意取笑的口语词。

etymology.historical_story: Mohd is a written shortening of the Arabic personal name Muhammad, familiar in Malay naming practice. Its compressed spelling does not require a compressed pronunciation: DBP advises reading such abbreviations as the full name. Malaysian library guidance also groups several spellings and abbreviations under Muhammad while preserving the form appearing in the source being catalogued.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Mohd，想到“名字在纸上缩短，读出来通常展开”；不要逐个念 M-O-H-D。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 l 前采用 me-，l 保留；后缀 -i 前的 a 保留，a 与 i 分属两个音节。此处将主动前缀与后缀的组合归入 circumfix。DBP 将 melukai 列于 luka 词族：[DBP：luka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=luka)。

senses.zh_definition: 使人、动物或身体部位出现伤口；弄伤。
senses.en_definition: To cause a wound to a person, animal, or part of the body.
senses.ms_definition: Mendatangkan luka pada seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 是及物动词，直接宾语是受伤者或受伤部位；可表示故意或意外造成伤口。luka 表示伤口或受伤状态，melukai 强调造成该结果。两义依据：[DBP：melukai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=melukai)。

senses.zh_definition: 言语或行为伤害他人的感情，使其难过或受到情感创伤。
senses.en_definition: To hurt someone's feelings or cause emotional pain.
senses.ms_definition: Menyakiti hati atau perasaan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 常与 hati、perasaan 连用；melukakan 也可表达此义。比起一般的“不赞同”，本词强调对方受到情感伤害。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kenyataan yang melukai perasaan pihak lain perlu dielakkan dalam komunikasi profesional.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在专业沟通中，应避免发表伤害他人感情的言论。
dual_scenarios.en: Statements that hurt others' feelings should be avoided in professional communication.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Maaf ya, saya tak nak melukai hati awak.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Maaf, saya tidak mahu melukai hati awak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 对不起啊，我不想伤你的心。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm sorry. I don't want to hurt your feelings.
spoken_features: tak 对应 tidak。
nak 对应 mahu。
ya 用于缓和语气。
melukai 在此类表达中略带郑重、真诚的语气，日常也常说 sakitkan hati。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Maaf ya, saya tak nak melukai hati awak. Saya ingat gurau je tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Maaf, saya tidak mahu melukai hati awak. Saya menyangka kata-kata saya tadi hanyalah gurauan.
messages.zh: 对不起啊，我不想伤你的心。我刚才以为只是开个玩笑。
messages.en: I'm sorry. I don't want to hurt your feelings. I thought I was just joking earlier.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Saya faham, tapi gurauan tu memang buat saya sedih. Lepas ni jangan ulang lagi, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Saya faham, tetapi gurauan itu memang membuat saya sedih. Selepas ini, jangan mengulanginya lagi.
messages.zh: 我明白，但那个玩笑确实让我很难过。以后别再这样了，好吗？
messages.en: I understand, but that joke really upset me. Please don't do it again, okay?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论情感伤害时语气较重。用 Saya bimbang kata-kata itu boleh melukai perasaannya 表达顾虑，比直接指责对方更缓和。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于身体伤害描述、道歉和认真讨论感受。道歉后可具体承认造成伤害的言行；以 gurau sahaja 为由要求对方忽略感受，容易削弱歉意。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论情感伤害时语气较重。用 Saya bimbang kata-kata itu boleh melukai perasaannya 表达顾虑，比直接指责对方更缓和。

etymology.historical_story: Melukai builds directly on luka, a word for a wound or a wounded condition. Malay dictionary examples move naturally from injured skin to an injured heart. This connection also appears in a proverb recorded under luka: reconciliation may remove the wound, yet leave its scar. Physical healing becomes an image for the lasting effects of conflict.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: luka＝伤口；me-…-i＝使对象受到这种伤：melukai tangan 伤手，melukai hati 伤心。

morphology.pattern_note: 元音起首的 aktif 接 meN- 时，前缀变为 meng-，原词保留；-kan 表示使成为某种状态。root_word 沿用数据包的直接基础形式 aktifkan；更深层词根为 aktif。

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu aktif atau membolehkannya mula berfungsi.

etymology.historical_story: The story of mengaktifkan is one of grammatical adaptation. Malay takes aktif and surrounds it with its own productive verb morphology, expressing the idea of making something active. The dictionary illustrates this through reviving an almost inactive political party. Account activation applies the same meaning to a newer setting: something previously inactive becomes usable.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 认出 aktif＝active，再把 meN-…-kan 想成“使它变得……”：mengaktifkan＝让它动起来、启用它。

morphology.pattern_note: temu 接 meN- 时，词首 t 脱落，由鼻音 n 替代；-i 构成及物动词，-mu 是表示第二人称受事的附着代词，此处按字段归为 suffix。root_word 是数据包中的直接基础形式，深层词根为 temu。headword.jawi 保留数据包原值，但该拼写仅对应 menemui，未写出 -mu；按其拼接可写作 منموءيمو。

senses.zh_definition: 找到你；发现你的所在，尤指经过寻找之后。
senses.en_definition: To find you or discover your whereabouts, especially after searching.
senses.ms_definition: Menjumpai atau mendapati kamu, khususnya setelah mencari.
senses.nuances: 需要寻找、失散或发现行踪等上下文才能明确理解为“找到你”。DBP 也记录 menemui 与 menemukan 在寻找、发现语境中的意义重叠。[DBP：menemui 与 menemukan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menemui)

etymology.historical_story: Menemuimu is a compact example of Malay building meaning around a verb. Temu supplies the idea of meeting; meN- and -i form menemui; attached -mu identifies the person addressed as its object. The result suits personal letters and literary dialogue, where a single written word can express the intimate phrase 'to meet you'.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 menemui＝见到，再认 -mu＝你：menemui + mu → 见到你。mu 只说明对象，不说明时态。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在以 l 开头的词基前实现为 me-；保留词基首辅音 l，不插入鼻音，也不删除 l。

etymology.historical_story: Melamar is transparently formed from lamar with the active prefix meN-. Its dictionary meanings connect two important requests: asking someone to marry and applying for employment. The related noun lamaran likewise covers a marriage proposal and an application. These established parallels offer a useful learning connection without establishing which meaning developed first. [DBP: melamar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=melamar), [DBP: lamaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lamaran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 me-la-mar 想成三拍「提—请—求」：对象是恋人，就是求婚；对象是 pekerjaan 或 jawatan，就是求职。

morphology.formula: menjawab + -nya → menjawabnya；完整分析：meN- + jawab + -nya → menjawabnya
morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包保留直接基础 menjawab；更深层词根为 jawab。meN- 在 j 前采用 men-，j 保留。-nya 在此是附着于动词的代词，不是派生后缀；suffix 是本模板中的近似分类。资料包的 Jawi منجواب 仅对应 menjawab，未包含 -nya，不能视为完整词形的核定拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 回答或回复前文提到的问题、来信或某个人；具体对象由附着代词 -nya 的指代决定。
senses.en_definition: To answer or respond to a previously mentioned question, message, or person.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan jawapan atau balasan kepada pertanyaan, surat atau pihak yang telah disebut, dengan rujukan -nya ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 不是独立的新词义，而是 menjawab 加上对象代词 -nya；不表示“他的答案”，后者通常是 jawapannya。它本身不标示过去时，也不必然带顶嘴意味。释义为根据 menjawab 与 -nya 合成的说明，并非 DBP 对完整词形的独立引文。[DBP：jawab 及其派生词](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Makna.aspx?kid=230465)

etymology.historical_story: Menjawabnya illustrates how Malay builds a complete expression around a verb. Menjawab supplies the action of answering, while attached -nya points back to an understood referent. Its story is grammatical rather than that of a separate inherited headword: a familiar verb gains a compact reference that readers recover from the preceding sentence. [DBP spelling guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 menjawab，想到“回答”；再听到 nya，回头找“答谁、答哪一个”：menjawabnya＝回答前面提到的对象。

etymology.historical_story: Menghubungkan is a transparent Malay formation built on hubung, the base shared by words for connection and relationship. The prefix marks an active verb, while the suffix helps express bringing things into connection. Its dictionary senses range from joining physical objects to relating ideas and bringing people together, giving learners one useful image across several contexts. [DBP：hubung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hubung)

morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入包的直接基底 menyayangi；更深层词根为 sayang。meN- 接 s 起首词根时，s 脱落并出现 ny /ɲ/。-mu 是后附人称代词，不是派生词缀，在此表示宾语“你”。输入包的 مڽايڠي 仅对应 menyayangi；完整 menyayangimu 应补写 -mu 为 مڽايڠيمو。

senses.zh_definition: 爱你；疼爱你；珍惜你。表示对受话者怀有爱意或关怀，主语由句子另行确定。

senses.ms_definition: Berasa sayang akan kamu; mengasihi atau mencintai kamu.
senses.nuances: 可用于伴侣、亲子及其他亲密关系，并不专指爱情。-mu 表示“你”，不表示“我”，因此本词本身不确定施事者。较完整的 menyayangimu 常见于书信、歌词或郑重表白；日常交谈常说 sayang awak。基词义参见 [DBP：menyayangi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=menyayangi)；连写规则参见 [DBP：人称附着形式](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+terima)。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowed origin. The affectionate base sayang becomes the verb menyayangi, and attached -mu identifies the person receiving that affection. DBP explicitly gives menyayangimu as an example of joined spelling, helping explain why a phrase equivalent to love you appears as one written word. [Source: DBP language advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+terima).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 sayang“爱”，再抓住尾巴 mu“你”：menyayangi + mu，就是“爱你”；谁爱你，要看主语。

etymology.historical_story: Malay Musa corresponds to Arabic Mūsā, the Qur'anic name of the prophet called Moses in English. This religious association provides a cultural background for its use as a personal name. A modern bearer, however, is identified by context rather than automatically representing the prophet, and the name has no productive Malay affixes. See [Quranic Arabic Corpus](https://corpus.quran.com/concept.jsp?id=musa).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Musa＝穆萨；看到 Nabi Musa，就切换到宗教人物“摩西”。普通朋友 Musa，英文仍叫 Musa。

etymology.historical_story: Mayday entered international radio vocabulary through an English rendering of French m'aider, meaning 'help me' within a longer expression. Its recognizable sound became a distress signal shared across language boundaries. Malay reporting retains this international form when describing emergencies at sea or in the air. The spelling has no connection with the month of May. [FAA account](https://www.faa.gov/sites/faa.gov/files/JulAug2023_0.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 MAYDAY 的两拍声音记成连续响起的求救警报：听到它，就想到“严重遇险，立即援助”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包保留直接基底 menolong；更底层词根是 tolong。meN- 遇词根首音 /t/，以 /n/ 替代 /t/，形成 menolong；-nya 是第三人称宾语附着语，不标性别。输入爪夷文只覆盖 menolong，此处补上 ڽ，形成全词拼写。

senses.ms_definition: Membantu orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya dengan tenaga, wang, fikiran atau bantuan lain.
senses.nuances: -nya 在这里是 menolong 的宾语，不是所有格；不区分男性与女性，也不表示已经完成。词根 tolong 及 menolong 的义项依据：[DBP：tolong](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tolong)。

etymology.historical_story: Menolongnya illustrates Malay word-building rather than a separate borrowed word. Tolong supplies the idea of help; meN- forms the active verb, changing the initial t to n; and -nya identifies the person helped. The same helping vocabulary extends into pertolongan and penolong, connecting an action, the assistance provided, and the person who provides it.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三步记：tolong＝帮忙；meN- + tolong → menolong＝帮助；再接 -nya＝帮助他或她。这里的 -nya 不是“他的”。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词记忆，无马来语词缀。索引保留输入小写，实际书写通常为 Martha。姓名读音依本人及来源语言而定，现有材料不足以指定统一的马来语音标。

senses.nuances: 这是人名，不是意为“女士”或“女主人”的现代马来语普通名词；这些意义属于其词源背景。没有上下文不能确定它指哪位人物，也不能据姓名推断国籍或宗教。以下为称呼和姓名组合示例，不是固定词汇搭配。姓名来源参见 [爱荷华大学：Martha](https://bam.sites.uiowa.edu/hello/martha)。

etymology.historical_story: Martha ultimately comes from an Aramaic name associated with the meaning lady or mistress. It entered Greek biblical tradition as Martha, the name of the sister of Mary and Lazarus, and spread through Christian naming traditions. In Malay writing it functions as a personal name, without acquiring that ancient meaning as an everyday noun. [Source: University of Iowa](https://bam.sites.uiowa.edu/hello/martha).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Martha 与熟悉的中文音译“玛莎”配对；它是在叫一个人的名字，词源中的“女士”不是它在现代马来语里的通用释义。

etymology.historical_story: The international term monitor goes back to Latin monitor, someone who warns or advises, from monere, to warn. Its technological meanings preserve that central image: an instrument watches a condition and draws attention to changes. Malay uses the word for both monitoring equipment and computer displays. [Merriam-Webster: monitor](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/monitor)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place menyusul under the base susul. Its meanings connect physical following with later arrival, subsequent events, and continued correspondence. Picture someone joining a travelling group after it has departed: the same sequence helps explain why information, announcements, or another letter can also menyusul. This is a semantic illustration, not a documented origin story. [DBP: susul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=susul)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 susul 是“随后跟上”；加 meN- 时 s 让位给 ny：meN- + susul → menyusul。人跟上，消息也能随后来。

senses.nuances: 及物动词，后接所准备的事物。日常马来西亚马来语中，准备食物或材料也常用 menyediakan 或 menyiapkan。[DBP：mempersiapkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mempersiapkan)

senses.zh_definition: 把某项工作做完，使其达到完成状态。
senses.en_definition: To finish or complete a task or piece of work.
senses.ms_definition: Menyudahkan atau menyelesaikan sesuatu pekerjaan.
senses.nuances: 此义着重完成结果；在现代日常和职场用语中，menyiapkan 或 menyelesaikan 往往更直接自然。

senses.zh_definition: 使人、团队或事物具备执行任务、应对情况所需的条件；使做好准备。
senses.en_definition: To make someone or something ready or properly equipped for a task or situation.
senses.ms_definition: Melengkapkan atau mengemaskan sesuatu untuk tujuan tertentu; mengusahakan supaya bersiap.
senses.nuances: 常见结构是 mempersiapkan diri untuk… 或 mempersiapkan seseorang bagi menghadapi…。重点是建立应对能力或完备条件，不一定表示任务本身已经完成。

senses.zh_definition: 筹拟、制定或着手形成计划、法规等。
senses.en_definition: To develop, formulate, or draw up something such as a plan or law.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusahakan, membentuk atau membuat sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 用于抽象成果的筹制。具体行文可根据对象选用 merangka、menggubal 或 menyediakan，以更明确地区分拟订、立法起草和一般准备。

etymology.historical_story: The word grows from siap, the everyday idea of being ready or finished. Malay dictionaries connect its family with both practical preparations and older narrative usage: equipment is readied, work completed, and people equipped for action. The longer form mempersiapkan carries that readiness into a transitive verb, making someone or something ready. [DBP：siap 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=siap)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 siap＝准备好；mempersiapkan 就是“让人或东西 siap 起来”。

senses.zh_definition: Mirakuru：《绿箭侠》及其衍生作品中能使人获得超常能力的虚构血清名称，属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: Mirakuru: a fictional serum that grants extraordinary physical abilities in Arrow and related works.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi serum rekaan yang memberikan kebolehan fizikal luar biasa dalam siri Arrow dan karya berkaitannya.
senses.nuances: 本义项依据作品语境编写，马来语释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。目前无法核实其作为正式马来语普通词的收录资格，因此不标为 official。专名通常写作 Mirakuru。日语ミラクル（mirakuru）意为“奇迹”，不能据此认定马来语也有同样的普通词义。6061 仅沿用输入排名，其语料范围不明。下列搭配及例句为教学编写，不代表已验证的高频搭配。专名依据：[DC《Arrow Season 2.5 #9》](https://www.dc.com/comics/arrow-season-2-5-2014/arrow-season-2-5-9)。

etymology.historical_story: Mirakuru 对应日语片假名ミラクル，是英语 miracle（奇迹）的日语借词形式。日本辞书列有这一词义及英语来源；英语原词的辅音组合在日语形式中以音节化方式呈现。《绿箭侠》相关作品另将 Mirakuru 用作赋予角色超常能力的虚构物质名称。这说明它可以作为作品专名出现在马来语讨论中，但不能证明它已成为正式马来语普通词。来源：[小学馆辞书释义](https://kotobank.jp/word/みらくる-3219454)、[DC 作品介绍](https://www.dc.com/comics/arrow-season-2-5-2014/arrow-season-2-5-9)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mirakuru 与英语 miracle（奇迹）联想：在《绿箭侠》中，它是制造超常能力的血清名称；整词记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: 这里沿用数据包的直接基底 menyembunyikan；底层词根是 sembunyi。meN- + sembunyi + -kan → menyembunyikan，词首 s 脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/。-nya 是附着于词尾的第三人称代词，此处通常充当宾语，指他、她或它，不表示过去时。数据包的 Jawi 仅对应 menyembunyikan；完整词形应加 ڽ，写作 مڽمبوڽيکنڽ。

word_family.gloss: 把某人或某物藏起来；隐瞒

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的人或物藏起来，使其不被看见或发现。
senses.en_definition: To hide the previously mentioned person or thing from view or discovery.
senses.ms_definition: Melindungkan atau menyorokkan orang atau benda yang telah disebut supaya tidak kelihatan atau ditemukan.
senses.nuances: -nya 的指代须由上下文确定，不区分性别，也不自行标明数量。这里是及物动词加代词宾语；表示自己躲起来通常用 bersembunyi。基本义依据 [DBP：sembunyi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sembunyi)，此处马来语释义针对完整词形作了改写。

collocations.zh: 把它藏起来，不让别人发现

senses.zh_definition: 隐瞒前文提到的事情、信息或感受，不让别人知道或察觉。
senses.en_definition: To conceal previously mentioned information, circumstances, or feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Merahsiakan perkara atau maklumat yang telah disebut, atau tidak memperlihatkan perasaan tersebut kepada orang lain.
senses.nuances: 可指有意不透露事实，也可指不流露情绪；是否带有欺骗意味取决于语境。menyembunyikannya 强调主动隐瞒，不能一概替换为表示保存或保管的 menyimpannya。

etymology.historical_story: This form shows Malay building a precise message through morphology: sembunyi supplies the idea of hiding, menyembunyikan makes hiding something explicit, and -nya identifies an already mentioned object. The same verb covers concealed belongings and unspoken feelings, linking physical invisibility with secrecy in social life. These paired meanings are documented by [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sembunyi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 sembunyi＝藏：menyembunyikan＝把东西藏起来，再加 -nya＝把它／他／她藏起来。

senses.en_definition: To indicate, express, or make something evident.
senses.ms_definition: Menyatakan atau menunjukkan sesuatu; menjelaskan.
senses.nuances: 强调某种现象所显示的信息，常接 bahawa 从句；不必涉及人为发出的信号。四个义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menandakan)区分。

senses.zh_definition: 成为某事的标志、信号或征兆；意味着。
senses.en_definition: To serve as a sign, signal, or indication of something.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi tanda atau isyarat yang memberikan alamat tentang sesuatu keadaan atau kejadian.
senses.nuances: 强调作为标志的功能，可指仪式、事件或行为；例如某个活动标志着计划开始。对沉默、表情等行为的解释仍须结合语境。

senses.zh_definition: 用标记或信号告知；给某物作标记以便识别。
senses.en_definition: To communicate by signs or mark something for identification.
senses.ms_definition: Memberitahu dengan menggunakan tanda atau isyarat, atau membubuh tanda supaya sesuatu diketahui.
senses.nuances: 这是主动标示的动作，常见结构为 menandakan + 对象 + dengan + 标记方式；与 menandai、menanda 的部分用法重叠。

senses.zh_definition: 以证据表明或证实某事。
senses.en_definition: To demonstrate or establish something through evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Membuktikan sesuatu dengan adanya bukti atau tanda.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》另列此证实义；现代明确表达“证明”时通常使用 membuktikan。以下搭配用于说明该义，不作高频断言。

etymology.historical_story: Menandakan is transparently built from tanda, meaning a mark or sign. Its dictionary meanings connect physical marking with signalling, indicating, and demonstrating. A useful semantic reconstruction imagines a visible mark first helping someone recognise an object, then helping them recognise an otherwise unseen situation. This is an explanatory pathway, rather than a dated claim about the word’s first appearance. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menandakan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 tanda＝标记：menandakan 就是“给出标记”，进而记成“标示、表明、意味着”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按外来人名整词记忆，不拆成马来语词根和词缀。标准书写通常为 Monica；所列 IPA 是马来语适应读法示意，其中 c 读 /k/，实际读音以本人为准。

etymology.historical_story: Monica belongs to an international naming tradition rather than Malay affixation. A famous early bearer was Augustine's mother; scholarship notes the spelling Monnica in manuscripts of his Confessions. The name's origin remains uncertain. Its historical associations should therefore be distinguished from a securely established literal meaning. [Cambridge: Monnica](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/new-blackfriars/article/abs/monnica-my-mother/25412EAC65182CD26ED29CF2C3F0940A) [Infopédia: Mónica](https://www.infopedia.pt/dicionarios/antroponimia/M%C3%B3nica)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“莫—妮—卡”三拍连接 mo-ni-ka；把它记作人的名字，书写时首字母大写。此联想不代表词源或固定读音。

etymology.historical_story: Two separate histories meet in this spelling. DBP records milo in an Indonesian colonial-school expression. The beverage Milo has a different story: Nestlé's account credits Thomas Mayne with developing the chocolate malt powder in Australia in 1934 and connects its name with the ancient athlete Milo of Croton. Neither history should be used to explain the other. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=milo)；[MILO history](https://www.milo.com.my/the-milo-story)

etymology.historical_story: Meluangkan belongs to the Malay family built on luang, which denotes empty space, availability, or opportunity. Its meaning links physical room with available time: making room in a place becomes making room in a schedule. This is a semantic explanation, rather than a dated account of its first appearance. Reference: [DBP PRPM: luang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=luang).

etymology.historical_story: The base waris is an Arabic loan associated with heirs and inheritance. Malay builds mewarisi from this base using its own verbal morphology. The resulting verb reaches beyond inherited property: a child can inherit a parent's appearance, while a community can inherit artistic traditions. These meanings connect material inheritance with continuity between generations. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=28648&keyword=mewariskan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 waris「继承人」：继承人接过东西就是 mewarisi；把东西传出去则是 mewariskan。

etymology.historical_story: Memujuk is formed from pujuk, a root associated with appealing words that soften another person's feelings. DBP records the root in dictionary definitions and traditional pantun, placing persuasion alongside affectionate appeal. Its connection with merajuk is especially memorable: one person withdraws emotionally, and another tries to restore warmth through gentle words. This cultural pairing illustrates usage rather than proving a particular ancient origin. [DBP: pujuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pujuk).

etymology.historical_story: Mendekat illustrates a productive Malay formation rather than a borrowed whole word: the verbal prefix meN- combines with dekat, meaning near. Its dictionary senses connect physical movement, approaching events, and attempts at friendship. The same image of shrinking distance therefore helps speakers describe space, time, and human relationships without changing the basic root. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mendekat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dekat 是“近”，meN- 让它动起来：mendekat＝变近、走近。人走近、时间临近、关系拉近，都围绕“距离缩短”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay connects physical purity with moral goodness through murni. DBP illustrates the word with both precious stones and noble aspirations, showing how one adjective can describe material authenticity and an uncorrupted heart. This semantic bridge helps explain familiar expressions such as nilai murni. The available evidence does not establish a specific earlier donor language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 murni 与 niat murni 一起记：心里没有杂念，就是“纯洁、善良”。这是语义联想，不是词源拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 目前仅确认人名 Mira 的用例，按独立专名处理，无可确认的马来语派生词族。音标为该人名的一种常见读法，具体读音以本人为准；输入缺失的音节与爪夷文字段保留 null。

senses.ms_definition: Mira ialah nama khas perempuan yang ditemukan dalam penerbitan bahasa Melayu; takrif kata umum bagi ejaan mira belum dapat disahkan.

etymology.historical_story: Mira appears as a girl's name in a Malay novel published by Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka. That establishes a literary use, but does not establish a Malay common noun or a particular name origin. Without evidence identifying the intended bearer or source language, assigning this entry a specific etymology would be speculative. [DBP: Mira](https://jendeladbp.my/ujana/mira/)

morphology.formula: menutup + -i → menutupi；完整构词：meN- + tutup + -i → menutupi
morphology.pattern_note: 以输入包的直接基底 menutup 分析，添加后缀 -i；进一步追溯至 tutup 时，meN- 在词首 /t/ 前表现为 men-，原词首 /t/ 脱落。后缀 -i 可突出覆盖对象或反复、涉及多个对象的动作。

senses.zh_definition: 关闭或盖上多个对象，或反复进行关闭、盖上的动作。
senses.en_definition: To close or cover multiple objects, or to do so repeatedly.
senses.ms_definition: Banyak yang ditutup; berkali-kali menutup.
senses.nuances: 这是《Kamus Dewan》列出的义项，但现代日常语境往往直接用 menutup，并由宾语或时间词表达复数、反复。不能据此认为所有 menutupi 都包含“反复”的意思。义项依据：[DBP：menutupi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menutupi)。

senses.zh_definition: 覆盖、遮住或遮护某个表面、部位或物体，使其不外露或受到保护。
senses.en_definition: To cover, conceal from view, or provide a protective covering for something.
senses.ms_definition: Memberi bertutup; melindungi.
senses.nuances: 强调物体或表面被覆盖，可由人、布料、头发、云层等作主语。与 menutup pintu 的“关门”相比，更容易形成“某物覆盖某处”的画面。

senses.zh_definition: 掩盖、隐瞒事实、过失或真实感受，使他人不知情。
senses.en_definition: To conceal or keep facts, faults, or feelings from becoming known.
senses.ms_definition: Melindungi sesuatu supaya tidak diketahui orang; merahsiakan.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法。宾语为 kesalahan、penyelewengan 等时通常带有负面评价；宾语为 perasaan 或 kesedihan 时可仅表示隐藏私人感受。

etymology.historical_story: Menutupi belongs to the Malay family built on tutup, the base associated with closing and covering. Its prefix marks an active verb, while -i helps focus the action on what is covered. The dictionary records both physical covering and figurative concealment, making a hidden face a useful parallel for a hidden truth.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tutup“关、盖”：menutup 是关上，menutupi 把注意力带到“被遮住的地方”，从遮脸联想到掩盖真相。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 j 前采用 men- 形式；词根首字母 j 保留。词尾 k 在常见马来西亚标准读音中实现为 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 抵达、踏足或到访某地。

senses.nuances: 此义见《Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua》；表示持续追踪时，menjejaki 也很常用。注意与表示踏足某地的义项区分。依据：[DBP PRPM：menjejak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=menjejak)。

etymology.historical_story: Menjejak is transparently formed from jejak, meaning a footprint or trace, with the active prefix meN-. Its dictionary meanings connect physical contact with arrival: a foot touches the ground, and a traveller sets foot in a destination. Tracking introduces another connection with traces. This is a semantic illustration, rather than a documented chronology of how the meanings developed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jejak 想成地上的脚印：menjejak 可以是脚踩上去、人踏足某地，也可以是循着踪迹追查。

morphology.pattern_note: 词首 t 在 meN- 后发生鼻音替代：t 被 n 取代，meN- 实现为 men-；tubuh 的末尾 h 保留。输入包误将派生词列为词根，此处依据 DBP 词族关系改为 tubuh。

word_family.gloss: 成立；创立这一过程或事件

senses.zh_definition: 成立、创立或组建组织、协会、委员会、公司等。
senses.en_definition: To establish, found, or constitute an organization or organized body.
senses.ms_definition: Mendirikan persatuan atau membentuk jawatankuasa dan badan seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 及物主动动词，突出使一个组织成立，宾语通常为社团、委员会、政党、公司或队伍。马来语释义依据 DBP 释义整理，并非逐字引文。menubuhkan jawatankuasa 指组建委员会，不表示建造其办公场所。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menubuhkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 设立、创办某种机构或公共设施，使其成为实际存在并可运作的实体。
senses.en_definition: To bring an institution or facility into existence.
senses.ms_definition: Mewujudkan atau mengadakan institusi dan kemudahan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 此义强调机构或设施的设立，不专指施工。设立图书馆可用 menubuhkan perpustakaan；强调建造馆舍时通常用 membina bangunan perpustakaan。DBP 的相关例证包括设立图书馆及公共会堂。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menubuhkan)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 用于成立组织或设立机构。它本身不表示已完成注册或取得许可；描述提议时可用 bercadang untuk menubuhkan，描述已完成的成立事件时可用 telah menubuhkan。

etymology.historical_story: Menubuhkan belongs to the Malay family of tubuh, meaning body. A useful conceptual connection is that an organization becomes a functioning body with members and a shared purpose. The dictionary lists menubuhkan alongside penubuhan and pertubuhan. This explains the modern word family without inventing a historical borrowing story: the verb establishes, penubuhan names the establishment, and pertubuhan names the organization. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menubuhkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tubuh 是“身体”；给组织一个能运作的“身躯”，就是 menubuhkan——把它成立起来。

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词 mill 的一般现在时第三人称单数形式：研磨，或用铣床加工；用于 mills around/about 时表示漫无目的地走动。
senses.en_definition: Third-person singular present of English mill: grinds material or machines it with a milling tool; with around or about, moves about without a clear purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, bentuk kata kerja mill bagi subjek orang ketiga tunggal dalam kala kini, dengan makna mengisar, memesin, atau mundar-mandir apabila digunakan bersama around atau about.
senses.nuances: 这是英语屈折形式，不是马来语动词派生形式。缺少原始语境，无法判定输入词形实际属于名词、动词还是专名。以下搭配列出马来语对应表达。英语动词义项参见 [Collins Dictionary: mill](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/mill)。

etymology.historical_story: English mill descends from Old English mylen, ultimately connected with Latin words for a mill and grinding. Its meanings encompass grain-grinding establishments, grinding equipment, and factories processing materials such as paper or steel. Mills commonly adds the English ending -s. This history concerns the English word; it does not establish a Malay borrowing. [Source: Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/mill).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 mill 想成正在研磨的机器；mills 末尾加 /z/。翻成马来语时，按对象选择 kilang 或 alat pengisar。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借用，不拆成马来语词根与词缀；英语读音为单音节，双写 ll 不表示两个音节。所列 IPA 为英语来源读音。未列未经核实的马来语派生词。

etymology.historical_story: English mall has an unexpected sporting background. Its history runs through pall-mall, a European game in which players struck a ball with a mallet. An alley used for the game became known as a mall; later, the word described a fashionable public promenade. In the twentieth century, it extended to shopping complexes. Malaysian usage draws on this English shopping sense. [Merriam-Webster word history](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/mall).

morphology.formula: melindungi + -mu → melindungimu；内部构词：meN- + lindung + -i → melindungi
morphology.pattern_note: 资料包的root_word是直接基词melindungi，更深层词根是lindung。meN-在l前实现为me-，保留l；-mu是表示宾语“你”的后附代词，并非派生后缀，此处按字段归入suffix。所给Jawi仅对应melindungi，缺少-mu。

senses.zh_definition: 遮护你，使你不被看见或不直接受到雨水、阳光等外物影响。
senses.en_definition: To screen or shelter you from view or physical exposure.
senses.ms_definition: Menutupi atau menaungi kamu agar tidak kelihatan atau tidak terkena hujan, panas dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调具体遮挡；主语可以是树木、屋顶或其他遮蔽物。-mu表示受遮护的人“你”，不表示“你的”。马来语释义为依据所给DBP义项编写的释义，并非逐字引文。

senses.ms_definition: Menjaga keselamatan kamu atau membela kamu daripada ancaman, kecederaan atau layanan yang tidak adil.

etymology.historical_story: This form shows how Malay combines a verb with a compact personal pronoun. Melindungi supplies the protective action, while -mu identifies the person protected. In songs and affectionate writing, that compact ending helps create a direct, intimate voice. Its attachment follows established Malay spelling practice. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: The structure brings together suruh, the action of directing someone, and -ku, the shortened form of aku. Malay therefore identifies the person receiving the instruction within the written verb. The nasal sound in menyuruh belongs to verb formation; it does not change who gives or receives the order. [DBP pronoun guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bukumu).

senses.nuances: 强调材料破裂，不要求使用剪刀。日常马来西亚口语也常用koyakkan。释义依据[PRPM robek](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=robek)改写。

senses.zh_definition: 使内心受到强烈伤害；令人心碎。
senses.en_definition: To cause intense emotional pain.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan seseorang berasa amat sedih atau terluka perasaannya.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法，常与hati或jantung搭配，语气强烈，适合文学或情感描写。

senses.en_definition: To breach a barrier or defence; in sports reporting, to beat the goal.
senses.ms_definition: Menembusi halangan atau pertahanan; dalam sukan, membolosi gawang lawan.
senses.nuances: 具有鲜明画面感，常见于体育报道；并非指真的撕坏球门。

etymology.historical_story: Malay forms this verb from robek by adding the active prefix meN-, realized here as me-. Its dictionary meanings connect torn material with emotional injury and a breached goal. These uses share an image of something giving way, although that connection alone does not establish their historical order. [Kamus Dewan via PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=robek).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住robek“破了”，加me-变成“把它撕破”；纸被撕开、防线被撕开，画面相通。

senses.zh_definition: 珍珠：由某些贝类在体内形成、具有光泽、可作饰品的珠状珍宝。
senses.en_definition: A lustrous pearl formed within certain molluscs and valued as a gem.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis permata yang diperoleh daripada tiram tertentu.
senses.nuances: 可指天然或养殖珍珠；若需区分，应加限定词。珍珠是生物形成的宝石材料，不是普通石珠。量词通常用 sebutir。参见 [DBP：mutiara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mutiara)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻极其珍贵、值得珍惜的人或事物，尤其指富有价值的思想、言语或精神财富。
senses.en_definition: A person or thing of exceptional value, especially a treasured thought, saying, or spiritual gift.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, sesuatu yang sangat berharga.
senses.nuances: 带赞美、文学或修辞色彩，不单纯表示价格昂贵。mutiara kata 是马来西亚常见的智慧语录表达。参见 [DBP：mutiara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mutiara)及 [DBP：mutiara kata](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mutiara+kata)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran tersebut menampilkan barang kemas yang diperbuat daripada emas dan mutiara.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览展出以黄金和珍珠制成的首饰。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition features jewellery made from gold and pearls.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Cantiknya rantai mutiara tu! Kau nak pakai esok ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Cantiknya rantai mutiara itu! Adakah kamu hendak memakainya esok?

spoken_features: tu 对应 itu。
nak 对应 hendak。
句末 ke 构成口语是非问句。

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Rantai mutiara tu kau nak pakai masa majlis esok ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu hendak memakai rantai mutiara itu semasa majlis esok?

messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah memilih pakaian yang sesuai. Saya akan memakai rantai ini sahaja.
messages.zh: 对呀，我已经挑好搭配的衣服了，就戴这条吧。
messages.en: Yes, I've picked an outfit to go with it. I'll wear this one.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称赞首饰可说 Cantiknya rantai mutiara puan，语气自然得体。mutiara hati 带亲昵或文学色彩，适合亲人、爱人或抒情文字。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合珠宝、礼物、文学和赞美语境。对普通同事或初识者直接称呼 mutiara hati，容易显得过分亲密；商务说明宜使用具体、可核实的珍珠种类名称。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称赞首饰可说 Cantiknya rantai mutiara puan，语气自然得体。mutiara hati 带亲昵或文学色彩，适合亲人、爱人或抒情文字。

etymology.historical_story: A specialist loanword dictionary traces mutiara to Sanskrit muktāhāra, meaning a pearl necklace. Its history connects the Malay word with an older vocabulary of precious ornaments. Modern Malay also uses the pearl as an image of exceptional worth: something valuable can be called mutiara even when no physical jewel is involved. [SEAlang: Loan-Words in Indonesian and Malay](https://sealang.net/indonesia/lwim.old/htm/m.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mutiara 和 tiara（冠饰）联想在一起：想象冠饰上镶着一颗珍珠。只是记忆联想，不是现代构词关系。

morphology.pattern_note: 词包的 root_word 与 root_jawi 保留原始检索值；实际构词词根是 susun（سوسون）。meN- 接以 s 开头的本族词根时，通常变为 meny-，词根首音 s 脱落；ny 表示单一鼻音 /ɲ/。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=319148&keyword=menyusun)

word_family.gloss: 整理、安排或编纂的过程

senses.zh_definition: 把物品一层层叠放，或按一定次序排放。
senses.en_definition: To stack objects in layers or arrange them in an orderly sequence.
senses.ms_definition: Meletakkan berlapis-lapis atau mengatur barang supaya beraturan.
senses.nuances: 强调物品之间形成层次、行列或顺序，并非单纯把物品放到某处；具体排列方式由语境决定。

senses.zh_definition: 有条理地安排事务、规划步骤或制定计划。
senses.en_definition: To organize activities or formulate a plan in a systematic way.
senses.ms_definition: Mengatur sesuatu dengan baik atau merencanakan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 宾语通常是计划、日程、策略或工作安排。menyusun semula 表示重新安排或重组。

senses.zh_definition: 整理、编排文字或资料，形成文章、报告、词典等作品。
senses.en_definition: To compile, compose, or organize written material into a coherent work.
senses.ms_definition: Mengatur karangan atau menggubah sesuatu bahan tulisan.
senses.nuances: 侧重材料的选择、顺序和结构；编纂者不一定是全部原始内容的作者。正式出版物中的 penyusun 常指编者或编纂者。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Jawatankuasa sedang menyusun jadual pelaksanaan projek berdasarkan keutamaan yang telah dipersetujui.
dual_scenarios.zh: 委员会正在根据已商定的优先事项编排项目实施日程。
dual_scenarios.en: The committee is drawing up the project implementation schedule based on the agreed priorities.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku tengah menyusun buku kat rak ni, kejap lagi aku turun.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sedang menyusun buku di rak ini. Sebentar lagi saya akan turun.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我正在这边的书架整理书，等一下就下去。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm sorting the books on this shelf. I'll come down in a minute.
spoken_features: tengah 在口语中表示动作正在进行，对应 sedang。
kat 对应地点介词 di，ni 对应 ini。
aku 用于熟人之间；kejap 对应 sekejap 或 sebentar。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah siap ke? Aku nak gerak dah.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah bersedia? Saya sudah hendak bertolak.
messages.zh: 你准备好了没？我都要出发了。
messages.en: Are you ready? I'm about to leave.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kejap ya, aku tengah menyusun buku kat rak ni. Tinggal sikit je.
messages.ms_standard: Tunggu sebentar, ya. Saya sedang menyusun buku di rak ini. Hanya sedikit lagi yang belum selesai.
messages.zh: 等一下啊，我正在这边的书架整理书，剩一点点了。
messages.en: Give me a minute. I'm sorting the books on this shelf. I'm almost done.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请别人整理物品时，可说 Tolong susun buku ini 或 Boleh bantu saya menyusun buku ini?；与上司或客户交流时，用适当称呼并保留请求语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于家庭整理、活动筹备和正式规划。口语及祈使句常用 susun；正式主动陈述句通常使用 menyusun。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请别人整理物品时，可说 Tolong susun buku ini 或 Boleh bantu saya menyusun buku ini?；与上司或客户交流时，用适当称呼并保留请求语气。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于家庭整理、活动筹备和正式规划。口语及祈使句常用 susun；正式主动陈述句通常使用 menyusun。

etymology.historical_story: The root susun belongs to an old Austronesian vocabulary of layers and ordered placement. Comparative evidence connects it with reconstructed Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *susun and related forms describing stacks, tiers, and rows. Modern Malay preserves that concrete image while also applying menyusun to schedules, strategies, reports, and dictionaries. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-w_s.htm)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 su-sun 的两个音节想成上下叠好的两层书；加上 meN-，就是动手把东西排好。

morphology.pattern_note: memegang 是词包给出的直接构词基底，更深层词根为 pegang。meN- 接 pegang 时变为 mem-，词根首音 p 脱落。-nya 是附着代词，此处通常作宾语，表示他、她、它或前文所指对象，并非所有格。词包 Jawi 只写了 memegang；含 -nya 的完整形式为 ممݢڠڽ。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=memegang)

senses.zh_definition: 用手拿着、握住、抓住或扣住前文所指的人或物。
senses.en_definition: To hold, grasp, or seize the person or thing previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Memaut atau menggenggam orang atau benda yang dirujuk oleh -nya dengan tangan.
senses.nuances: -nya 的指代必须由上下文确定，不能固定译成“他的”。本义通常只是拿着或握住；指抓捕某人时，需要相应语境。

senses.zh_definition: 持有、携带或使用前文所指的物品，如证件、金钱或武器。
senses.en_definition: To possess, carry, or use the item previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai, membawa atau menggunakan sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 不一定表示物品此刻握在手里。以下搭配展示基底 memegang 的用法；物品已在前文明确时，可用 memegangnya 回指。

senses.zh_definition: 掌管前文所指的事务，或担任前文所指的职位、职务或角色。
senses.en_definition: To manage the responsibility or hold the office or role previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Menguasai atau mengurus sesuatu, atau menjawat jawatan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 这是由实体握持延伸出的抽象用法。memegangnya 可回指明确的职位或管理职责，但不能脱离上下文直接理解为“任职”。

senses.zh_definition: 遵守或执行前文所指的命令、规定或准则。
senses.en_definition: To observe or carry out the order, rule, or guideline previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Melaksanakan atau mematuhi perintah atau aturan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 属于 memegang 的词典义项；现代普通表达中，mematuhi peraturan 或 melaksanakan perintah 往往更直接。-nya 在此回指规定或命令。

senses.zh_definition: 坚守前文所指的承诺、传统或信念，或把某种说法视为可信依据。
senses.en_definition: To uphold the promise, tradition, or belief previously mentioned, or accept a statement as trustworthy.
senses.ms_definition: Berpegang teguh pada sesuatu atau menerimanya sebagai perkara yang boleh dipercayai.
senses.nuances: 与承诺搭配时强调守信；与传统、信念搭配时强调坚持；涉及他人的话时强调可信度，而非用手握持。

senses.zh_definition: 在民间信仰或叙事情境中，指鬼怪等附身于前文所指的人。
senses.en_definition: Of a spirit, to possess the person previously mentioned in a supernatural narrative.
senses.ms_definition: Memasuki tubuh orang yang dirujuk, berkenaan hantu atau makhluk halus; merasuk.
senses.nuances: 这是特定信仰和叙事中的用法；孤立的 memegangnya 通常不会优先理解为“附身”，必须有明确的鬼怪语境。

collocations.en: a ghost possesses him or her
a spirit possesses him or her

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sampel kaca itu telah diserahkan kepada juruteknik, yang memegangnya dengan kedua-dua belah tangan sebelum meletakkannya di atas meja pemeriksaan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 玻璃样品已交给技术员；技术员用双手拿着样品，随后将其放在检验台上。
dual_scenarios.en: The glass sample was handed to the technician, who held it with both hands before placing it on the inspection table.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah memegangnya dengan dua tangan, tapi pasu ni licinlah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah memegang pasu itu dengan kedua-dua belah tangan, tetapi permukaannya licin.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经用两只手拿着了，可这花瓶好滑啊。
dual_scenarios.en: I've got it in both hands, but this vase is slippery.
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah，ni 对应 ini。
句末 lah 加强对情况的说明。
口语更常直接说 pegang；保留 memegangnya 可用于较完整的聊天表达。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Pasu ni licin. Kau dah pegang elok-elok ke?
messages.ms_standard: Pasu ini licin. Adakah kamu sudah memegangnya dengan baik?
messages.zh: 这花瓶很滑，你拿稳了吗？
messages.en: This vase is slippery. Have you got a good grip on it?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku memegangnya dengan dua tangan ni. Kau buka pintu je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah memegangnya dengan kedua-dua belah tangan. Kamu hanya perlu membuka pintu.
messages.zh: 拿稳了，我两只手拿着呢。你帮忙开门就行。
messages.en: Yes, I've got it in both hands. Just open the door for me.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请求别人帮拿东西可说 Boleh tolong pegang ini sebentar?。对不熟悉的人说明身体接触时，应清楚表达对象与目的，避免仅用含糊的 -nya。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 拿物品、承担职责和信守承诺都可使用相关义项。涉及握手、扶人或触碰身体时，应尊重对方意愿；与陌生人交流时，明确说出所指对象通常更清楚。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请求别人帮拿东西可说 Boleh tolong pegang ini sebentar?。对不熟悉的人说明身体接触时，应清楚表达对象与目的，避免仅用含糊的 -nya。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 拿物品、承担职责和信守承诺都可使用相关义项。涉及握手、扶人或触碰身体时，应尊重对方意愿；与陌生人交流时，明确说出所指对象通常更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: Memegangnya combines the verb memegang with the attached pronoun -nya. Its lexical foundation is pegang, meaning to grasp or hold. Malay extends this physical image into holding office, managing responsibilities, and keeping promises. The final -nya supplies a reference already understood from the conversation, making context essential to translation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=memegang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分两步记：memegang＝握住，-nya＝前面提过的对象；合起来就是“握住它／他／她”。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word及root_jawi保留词包的整词索引标记；实际词根为serap。meN-接以s开头的本族词根时，s通常脱落，鼻音实现为ny /ɲ/。

senses.zh_definition: 液体等经细小孔隙渗入某物内部。
senses.en_definition: To penetrate or seep into something through small pores.
senses.ms_definition: Masuk ke dalam sesuatu melalui liang yang halus, seperti cecair yang meresap.
senses.nuances: 此义以渗入的液体等为主语，常接masuk或ke dalam；与第4义中材料吸入液体的主客体关系不同。

senses.zh_definition: 感情、感受等深深渗入内心或身心，变得深切。
senses.en_definition: To permeate someone's feelings or being deeply.
senses.ms_definition: Meresap dengan mendalam ke dalam hati atau diri, khususnya tentang perasaan.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻用法，多见于文学或抒情叙述；日常表达感受时也常用meresap。

collocations.ms: rasa kasih menyerap ke dalam hati

etymology.historical_story: Malay connects menyerap with serap through its productive nasal prefix system. Its dictionary meanings link physical entry with less visible forms of incorporation: liquid enters a material, feelings enter the heart, and knowledge becomes part of understanding. This shared image makes the word useful across household activities, scientific explanation, education, and discussions of cultural exchange.

etymology.historical_story: MOM comes from the initials of Majlis Olimpik Malaysia. The organization began as the Federation of Malaya Olympic Council in 1953 and adopted the English name Olympic Council of Malaysia in 1964. Its official history dates the Malay translation to April 1972. Consequently, MOM and OCM reflect two language versions of the same institution's name. [Official history](https://olympics.com.my/overview-history/).

etymology.historical_story: English money came through Middle English and French from Latin moneta, associated with coinage and the mint. The name also connects with Juno Moneta, whose temple was associated with Roman coin production. Its history therefore links everyday payment to an ancient institution, although present-day money includes resources that never take the form of coins. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/money)

etymology.historical_story: MSc condenses the English degree name Master of Science: M represents Master, while Sc represents Science. Malaysian academic writing pairs this abbreviation with Sarjana Sains. The compact form lets universities identify a qualification in programme lists and thesis guidelines without repeating its full bilingual name. It is an academic abbreviation, not a Malay affixed word. [UMS abbreviation table](https://www.ums.edu.my/ppps/files/Garis_Panduan_Penyerahan_Dan_Penulisan_Tesis_Disertasi_UMS_-_UPDATED_170120-merged_1_fvbfkz.pdf)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于任务、讨论、活动等已有明确指代的事情；如果听者不知道 -nya 指什么，应先说明事项。以祈祷开场的搭配适合相应宗教活动，不是所有马来西亚活动的固定要求。

etymology.historical_story: Rather than a separate inherited word, mulakannya illustrates productive Malay word formation. The base mula supplies the idea of beginning, -kan forms a transitive verb, and the attached pronoun -nya points back to something already understood. This compact structure suits instructions and slogans: a speaker can urge someone to begin an undertaking without repeating its name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记：mula＝开始，-kan＝把某事启动，-nya＝它；合起来就是“开始做它”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇词根首辅音 p 时通常变为 mem-，同时 p 脱落：mem- + ecat → memecat。词包将 memecat 判作词根有误；词根是 pecat。

senses.zh_definition: 解除某人的职务；开除雇员，或取消某人的组织会员资格。

senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常由作出决定的机构或负责人作主语；可用 daripada 引出被解除的职位或资格。此词常带严厉、惩戒意味，但词本身不证明当事人有过错。三项义据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pecat) 整理。

senses.zh_definition: 将某人从学校等机构开除，取消其继续留在该机构的资格。

etymology.historical_story: The securely identifiable structure is Malay meN- plus pecat. The root’s initial p disappears as the prefix takes the form mem-, producing memecat. The same root remains visible in passive dipecat and action noun pemecatan. This grammatical family links the decision maker, the person dismissed, and the dismissal itself without requiring a speculative story about the root’s earlier origin. Lexical source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pecat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 pecat＝开除：meN- 遇 p，鼻音接手、p 脱落，得到 memecat。再连记 memecat＝开除别人，dipecat＝被开除。

senses.zh_definition: 覆盖；铺满。指某种物质延展到一个表面或区域之上。
senses.en_definition: To cover a surface or area, or spread over it.
senses.ms_definition: Menutupi atau memenuhi sesuatu permukaan atau kawasan.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，直接接宾语，如 meliputi permukaan bumi；被动形式为 diliputi。强调覆盖范围，不必然表示像包裹物品一样从各面围住。[DBP：meliputi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=meliputi)。

senses.zh_definition: 涵盖；包括；涉及。表示某个范围、项目或内容包含若干地区、方面或事项。
senses.en_definition: To include or encompass areas, aspects, activities, or matters within a scope.
senses.ms_definition: Melingkupi atau merangkumi beberapa perkara, aspek atau kawasan.
senses.nuances: 常用于报告、课程说明、服务范围和工作职责。通常直接说 meliputi tiga aspek，不在动词与宾语之间另加 tentang 或 kepada。并非每次使用都断言覆盖了某类别的全部成员。

senses.zh_definition: 笼罩；弥漫。比喻某种情绪、气氛或状态充满一个人或地方。
senses.en_definition: To envelop or pervade a person or place, especially with an emotion or atmosphere.
senses.ms_definition: Menyelubungi atau memenuhi seseorang atau sesuatu tempat dengan perasaan atau suasana tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这是词典比喻义的细分，常见于新闻和文学描写。主动句可说 kesedihan meliputi hatinya；被动句 diliputi kesedihan 同样自然。

etymology.historical_story: Meliputi belongs to the liput family, which connects physical covering with the inclusion of places, subjects, and experiences. Its documented senses offer a useful semantic bridge: water covers land, a programme covers districts, and sadness envelops a person. These relationships explain modern usage without requiring an unsupported story about when the figurative meanings first appeared.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 liput 想成一张“覆盖网”：盖住地面、网住议题、笼罩心情，都可用 meliputi。

senses.zh_definition: 质量：物体的一种物理量，通常以千克表示；马来语对应词为 jisim。
senses.en_definition: The physical quantity mass, conventionally measured in kilograms.
senses.ms_definition: Kuantiti fizik yang lazimnya diukur dalam kilogram; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah jisim.
senses.nuances: 这是英语科学词义。马来西亚科学语境使用 jisim；不要把质量与重量 berat 混为一谈。[DBP：jisim / mass](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=jisim)

senses.zh_definition: 聚成一团或一块、边界或结构不清晰的物质；按语境译为一团、一块或一堆。
senses.en_definition: A quantity of material forming a body or an indistinct whole.
senses.ms_definition: Sejumlah bahan yang berkumpul menjadi satu ketulan, gumpalan atau timbunan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语普通名词义，翻译取决于材料和形态；并非每处都译成物理学的 jisim。

senses.zh_definition: 聚集的大量人或事物；复数 the masses 常指普通大众。
senses.en_definition: A large number of people or things; in the plural, ordinary people collectively.
senses.ms_definition: Bilangan orang atau benda yang banyak; bentuk jamak the masses boleh merujuk kepada orang ramai atau massa.
senses.nuances: 英语的 a mass of people 可译为 sekumpulan besar orang，the masses 可按语境译为 massa 或 rakyat jelata。马来语 massa 是另一个词头。[DBP：massa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=massa)

senses.zh_definition: 涉及大量人员、产品或活动的；大规模的；面向大众的。
senses.en_definition: Involving large numbers of people or things, or occurring on a large scale.
senses.ms_definition: Melibatkan orang atau benda dalam jumlah yang banyak, atau dilakukan secara besar-besaran.
senses.nuances: 这是英语前置修饰用法。马来语按搭配使用 massa、besar-besaran 或其他具体表达，而非直接保留 mass。media massa 是已有的马来语搭配。[DBP：media massa](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=media.)

senses.zh_definition: 使大量人员或事物集中；大量聚集。
senses.en_definition: To assemble, or cause to assemble, in large numbers.
senses.ms_definition: Berkumpul atau mengumpulkan orang atau benda dalam jumlah yang banyak.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词义。标准马来语按及物性分别使用 berkumpul、berhimpun 或 mengumpulkan。

senses.zh_definition: 弥撒：天主教及部分其他基督宗派的圣体礼仪；英语通常写作 Mass。
senses.en_definition: The Eucharistic service in the Roman Catholic Church and certain other Christian traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Upacara Ekaristi dalam Gereja Katolik dan beberapa tradisi Kristian lain, yang disebut misa dalam bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 英语宗教义通常首字母大写，写作 Mass；应与小写 mass 的质量、大量等词义区分。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is one of translation rather than a verified Malay borrowing. Malaysian terminology pairs scientific English mass with jisim, while media vocabulary uses massa in media massa. These parallel choices show why an English spelling cannot establish a Malay headword: its meaning and domain must first be identified. [DBP terminology comparison](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=jisim%3B)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看语境再配对：科学 mass → jisim；mass media → media massa；mass production → pengeluaran besar-besaran。

morphology.pattern_note: 按所给直接基词分析，新增的是宾语代词附着成分 -nya，而非派生后缀；最终词根为 masuk。meN- 遇词首 m 实现为 me-，保留 m；词根末尾 k 与 -kan 的 k 均保留，形成 kk；ny 表示 /ɲ/。所给 Jawi 对应 memasukkan，完整形式可写作 مماسوقکنڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的人或物放入、带入或送入某处；也可指将已提到的数据输入系统。
senses.en_definition: Put, bring, or enter the previously mentioned person, thing, or data into something.
senses.ms_definition: Membawa atau menempatkan orang atau benda yang telah disebut ke dalam sesuatu, termasuk mengisikan data ke dalam sistem.
senses.nuances: -nya 在这里指代宾语，不表示施事者的性别，也不表示动作已经完成；完成意义需由 telah、sudah 或上下文表达。数据输入是放入义的现代延伸。[DBP：memasukkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=memasukkan)

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay's productive combination of word formation and attached pronouns. Masuk expresses entering, while memasukkan expresses causing someone or something to enter. Adding -nya refers back to an already identifiable object. The resulting long word is grammatically transparent, rather than a separate ancient root requiring an independent origin story. [DBP: memasukkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=memasukkan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: masuk＝进去；memasukkan＝把东西放进去；末尾 -nya 接住前文对象：memasukkannya＝把它放进去。

morphology.formula: meN- + sebal + -kan → menyebalkan（使人烦恼、懊恼）
morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇词根起首 s 时变为 meny-，词根 s 脱落；-kan 表示致使。已据 DBP 的 sebal 词条纠正输入中将派生词本身标为词根的结果。

senses.zh_definition: 使人烦恼、恼火或懊恼；引起不快。
senses.en_definition: To annoy or vex; to cause irritation or resentful displeasure.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan sebal, menimbulkan rasa dongkol, mengesalkan.
senses.nuances: 强调某事引起他人的不快，区别于 sebal 所表达的内心感受。虽可译为英语 annoying，构词上仍是致使动词。属于 DBP 收录用词，不宜仅因其常见于印尼语而判为非标准马来语。[DBP 词义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menyebalkan)；[词根与词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=sebal)。

etymology.historical_story: Menyebalkan illustrates Malay's productive way of turning an emotional state into a cause of that state. Its base, sebal, names inward annoyance or vexation, while meN- and -kan produce the meaning of making someone feel it. DBP lists the derivative under sebal, so the word is best understood through Malay morphology rather than an invented foreign origin. [DBP root entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=sebal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sebal＝心里烦；meN-…-kan＝使人如此。抓住“自己烦 → 让别人烦”，就能记住 menyebalkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为医疗语境中的外来词整体处理，不是 meN- + dik。数据包所引“adik 的简称”属于 dik，不能作为 medik 的释义或词源，因此修正词根归属。音节保留 null；教学分节可作 me.dik。未核实爪夷文拼写，保留 null。
