etymology.historical_story: An older Malay–Dutch dictionary pairs mil with Dutch mijl, showing that the word already belonged to the vocabulary of distance measurement. This correspondence documents historical usage, although it does not by itself establish the borrowing route. The supplied Dewan entry labels mil Indonesian and defines it through yards. [Historical dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/6c/Maleisch-hollandsch_woordenboek_%28IA_ahy2565.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mil 与英文 mile 配对记忆：意思都是英里，但马来语 mil 读 /mil/，不读英语的 /maɪl/。

morphology.formula: mengeluarkan + -nya → mengeluarkannya；基础派生：meN- + keluar + -kan → mengeluarkan

senses.zh_definition: 把前文所指的人或物带到外面、取出，或将嵌入、埋入的东西移除。
senses.en_definition: To take, bring, or extract the previously mentioned person or thing out.
senses.ms_definition: Membawa sesuatu atau seseorang yang dirujuk ke luar, termasuk mencabut benda yang tertanam.
senses.nuances: -nya 指代已经提及或语境中明确的宾语，可译为他、她或它；不编码性别。一般取出与较费力的拔除、取出异物均属此义。义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Pelajar》：keluar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=keluar) 与 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》：mengeluarkan](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=muncul+keluar) 整理。

collocations.en: take it out of the bag

senses.ms_definition: Menyingkirkan pihak yang dirujuk daripada kumpulan, keanggotaan atau jawatan.

etymology.historical_story: The image behind mengeluarkan is movement from inside to outside. Malay applies that image to public life: money leaves one's funds, opinions leave one's thoughts, and publications reach readers. Adding -nya points back to an already identified object. These connections explain the word's breadth without requiring a separate historical origin for every dictionary sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: keluar＝出来；mengeluarkan＝使它出来；再加 -nya＝把前面说的那个取出、发出或产出。

etymology.historical_story: Meragui belongs to the productive Malay family built around ragu, expressing doubt or uncertainty. Its structure reveals who doubts what: meragui places the doubter before an object, while meragukan commonly presents something as causing doubt. This contrast provides a useful window into how Malay affixes organize perspective without requiring unrelated vocabulary.

etymology.historical_story: Merasuk is formed from rasuk, the possession-related root listed separately from rasuk meaning a house beam. Its dictionary senses connect entry into the body with feelings or thoughts penetrating deeply. This creates a vivid cultural image: an outside force crosses an inner boundary. That image also helps explain its figurative force in literary writing. [Source: DBP, rasuk I and II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=36924&keyword=rasuk)

etymology.historical_story: Menempah belongs to the Malay word family built on tempah. Its dictionary senses connect advance ordering, custom manufacture, and figuratively inviting danger. A tailor making clothing to a customer's measurements provides a concrete cultural illustration. The everyday booking sense also applies to hotel rooms and tickets; it does not by itself establish that payment has occurred.

etymology.historical_story: The likely reference is Mohenjo-daro, whose archaeological remains illuminate the urban culture of the Indus civilization. UNESCO describes a settlement with orderly streets, wells and drainage. However, the isolated token mohenjo does not establish that reference by itself. Its identification and any explanation of its name require the original context and evidence beyond the supplied packet.

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 表使动，词根不变；音节为 ma.lu.kan。祈使句和第一、第二人称被动结构可使用 malukan，普通主动陈述通常用 memalukan。包内 Jawi مالو 是 malu 的拼写；完整 malukan 应写作 مالوکن。

etymology.historical_story: The root malu connects embarrassment, shame, and respectful reserve within one Malay word family. Adding the causative suffix -kan shifts attention from feeling shame to causing it. This explains the force of jangan malukan saya: the speaker asks another person to protect their dignity. The construction illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowed word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: malu＝羞；加 -kan＝让别人羞：malukan＝使人难堪。

senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan bentuk kata kerja bahasa Arab yang lazimnya menunjukkan perbuatan yang telah berlaku atau selesai, khususnya dalam istilah fi'il madhi.
senses.nuances: 此处采用马来语宗教及阿拉伯语教学中的实际用法；整个 fi'il madhi 是名词性术语，madhi 在其中起修饰作用。该形式并非在所有语境中都表示过去时间，修辞或条件语境可涉及将来。无原始语境时，不能断定输入词一定属于此义；也不应自动改作专名或 mazi。以上马来语释义为编辑整理。[马来西亚联邦直辖区宗教司署：fi'il madhi 的用法](https://www.muftiwp.gov.my/ms/artikel/irsyad-al-hadith/2930-irsyad-al-hadith-siri-ke-324-maksud-dibuka-pintu-syurga-dalam-doa-selepas-wudhuk)

etymology.historical_story: In Arabic grammar, māḍī names the past or perfective category. Malay educational and religious writing uses the expression fi'il madhi when discussing Arabic texts. A Malaysian religious explanation even illustrates its use with future reference, reminding learners that grammatical form and time are not identical. The spelling here represents a specialist transliteration, not a verified general Malay dictionary headword. [Malaysian usage](https://www.muftiwp.gov.my/ms/artikel/irsyad-al-hadith/2930-irsyad-al-hadith-siri-ke-324-maksud-dibuka-pintu-syurga-dalam-doa-selepas-wudhuk)

etymology.historical_story: Menunduk illustrates how Malay builds verbs from a familiar physical image. Its base, tunduk, describes a lowered head and also carries meanings of obedience or surrender. The prefixed verb focuses on lowering one's own head. The causative menundukkan extends the family further, covering both lowering something and defeating an opponent. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tunduk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tunduk 想成“头低下”的动作：meN- 接上去，t 让位给 n，成为 menunduk；词尾 [ʔ] 像低头时轻轻收住。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places anchor raising, unloading, dismantling, rummaging, and exposing secrets under bongkar. A useful interpretation connects these senses through removing something from its settled or concealed position. This explains the imagery of uncovering a secret, but it is a teaching interpretation, not evidence that the senses developed in that historical order.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bongkar 联想成“砰，打开”：货被卸出、机器被拆开、秘密被揭开。meN- 加在前面，表示主动做这个动作。

etymology.historical_story: Magis connects Malay descriptions of supernatural power with a wider vocabulary of magic. Its Indonesian counterpart comes from Dutch magisch; a lexical account traces Malay magis through Indonesian. In Malay storytelling, the word describes hidden powers, while figurative usage lets an extraordinary performance or atmosphere feel magical without implying actual sorcery. [Etymological account](https://wiki.rus.family/content/wiktionary_en_all_nopic_2025-07/magis).

etymology.historical_story: Mencabut is formed transparently from cabut with the active prefix meN-. Its dictionary senses connect physical removal with less tangible kinds of removal: a tooth leaves its socket, a card leaves a pack, and a proposal is taken back. This connection offers a useful semantic map, although it does not establish the chronological order in which the meanings developed. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pencabut)

etymology.historical_story: Madison has travelled from an English surname into personal names, place names, and sporting vocabulary. Surname dictionaries offer links to Matthew or medieval forms associated with Maud. The cycling event has a separate, documented naming story: it takes its name from New York's Madison Square Garden, where the race was first contested, rather than from Malay word formation. senses.zh_definition: 絮絮叨叨地说话，话语杂乱或难以理解；嘟囔。

etymology.historical_story: Membebel is transparently built from bebel with the Malay verbal prefix meN-. Dictionaries connect it both with disordered speech and with berleter, or nagging. Its everyday force comes from repeated talk: a complaint returns, then returns again. The repeated be sounds offer a useful mnemonic, although they do not prove an imitative historical origin.

senses.zh_definition: 液体因降温而冻结或凝固，变为固态。
senses.en_definition: To freeze or become solid through cooling.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi beku, khususnya apabila cecair bertukar menjadi pepejal kerana penyejukan.
senses.nuances: 核心义为 menjadi beku。主语是发生变化的物质：air membeku。表示把某物冻起来，通常用及物形式 membekukan：membekukan air。词根中的 e 发 /ə/。[DBP：beku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=beku)

senses.zh_definition: 血液等液体凝结、凝固，不再保持原有流动状态。
senses.en_definition: To coagulate or set, especially of blood.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi kental atau berketul sehingga tidak lagi mengalir seperti sebelumnya, terutama tentang darah.
senses.nuances: 不一定涉及低温；darah membeku 通常指血液凝结，不是血液结冰。在专门术语中可进一步区分凝血等具体过程。[DBP：beku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=beku)

senses.zh_definition: 比喻身体、神情或情感变得僵住、凝滞或失去反应。
senses.en_definition: To become motionless, rigid, or emotionally unresponsive.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, menjadi kaku, tidak bergerak atau tidak menunjukkan tindak balas.
senses.nuances: 常见于叙事或文学语境，是从 beku 的“僵硬、不动”义延伸而来。行政上的“被冻结”通常用 dibekukan，不宜一概替换为 membeku。[DBP：beku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=beku)

etymology.historical_story: Membeku is formed within Malay from beku, with the prefix meN- marking a change of state. Its meaning reaches beyond ice: the dictionary also uses it for blood becoming solid. That range provides a memorable cultural image, linking the kitchen and the body through one everyday idea, a liquid losing its flow. [DBP: beku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=beku)

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary connects jejas with slight wounds and visible damage to things such as clothing. Menjejaskan uses that same root in an active causative construction. Its recorded meanings also cover damaged feelings and relationships, linking concrete injury with the adverse effects discussed in contemporary public and professional life. This is a semantic connection, not a dated history of borrowing. [DBP: jejas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jejas)

etymology.historical_story: Meludah turns the noun ludah, saliva, into an action through Malay meN- morphology. Its cultural life extends into proverbial language: meludah ke langit, muka juga yang basah pictures spit falling back onto the speaker. DBP records a warning about opposing the powerful and suffering the consequences, giving an ordinary bodily action a memorable social meaning. [DBP source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=meludah).

etymology.historical_story: Mencecah is formed from cecah through the Malay active prefix meN-. Its dictionary meanings include light contact and dipping into sauces. The same contact image helps explain reaching a numerical threshold: a total figuratively touches a marked point. This connection offers a learning model without asserting when the numerical use first developed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刻度线：脚碰到地面、食物碰到酱、数字碰到刻度，都是 mencecah——“触及、达到”。

senses.en_definition: A device that converts sound waves into electrical signals for recording, transmission, or amplification.
senses.ms_definition: Alat untuk mengubah gelombang bunyi menjadi isyarat elektrik bagi tujuan rakaman, penghantaran atau penguatan bunyi.
senses.nuances: 麦克风负责拾音，扬声器负责把电信号转换成声音，两者技术功能不同。输入包中的 pembesar suara 不宜据此理解为两种设备可以互换。日常也常听到英语借用形式 mic 或 mike。

etymology.historical_story: Mikrofon belongs to an international technical vocabulary. The corresponding English word microphone combines Greek mikros, meaning small, with phōnē, meaning sound or voice. These historical components help explain the name, but they are not productive Malay affixes in this entry. For learners, the modern word names the complete sound-input device, regardless of its physical size. [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9M2083)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mikrofon 和英语 microphone 对照记：马来语开头读 mi，看到 fon 就联想到声音设备。

senses.zh_definition: 为考察、探索或游览而到各处行走、旅行；遍游。

senses.ms_definition: Pergi berjalan ke merata-rata tempat untuk menyelidik dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 比 melawat 更强调到多处走访、四处探索；不必是危险探险，也不限定徒步。可说 menjelajah dunia 或 menjelajah ke seluruh negara。数字语境中也可引申为探索网络空间，但普通“上网浏览”常用 melayari。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=menjelajah)。

etymology.historical_story: Menjelajah is formed from jelajah with the active verbal prefix meN-. Its dictionary meaning centres on travelling from place to place, including journeys made to investigate. Related forms name the explorer and the exploration itself. These connections provide a cultural picture of purposeful travel without requiring an unsupported story about an ancient borrowing or a particular first explorer. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=menjelajah)

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料保留直接基形 mengenal；最终词根是 kenal。meN- 接 kenal 时，k 脱落并出现 /ŋ/；-nya 读 /ɲa/，此处是宾语代词附着成分，不是派生词缀。资料中的 مڠنل 仅对应 mengenal，未包含 -nya；完整形式应附加 ڽ，写作 مڠنلڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 认出他、她或它；凭以前的认识或接触辨认出所指对象。
senses.en_definition: To recognize him, her, or it from previous knowledge or experience.
senses.ms_definition: Mengecam orang atau sesuatu yang dirujuk oleh -nya berdasarkan pengetahuan atau pengalaman terdahulu.
senses.nuances: 强调辨认成功，不必表示双方熟识。-nya 的指代由上下文决定，不区分男女，也不表示过去时。释义依 mengenal 的辨认义及 -nya 的宾语功能综合表述。参见 [DBP PRPM：mengenal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengenal)。

senses.zh_definition: 认识他或她；与所指的人有交往或熟悉其为人。

senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai perkenalan atau hubungan pergaulan dengan orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 表示已有的认识或交往，不一定指初次见面，也不自动表示亲密关系。日常马来西亚口语常用 kenal dia；mengenalnya 更常见于叙述或较郑重的表达。参见 [DBP PRPM：mengenal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengenal)。

senses.nuances: 属于 mengenal 的广义认识义；先行词须明确。若强调详细掌握机制、内容或原因，memahaminya 往往更准确。此处不能把 -nya 一律译为“他”。参见 [DBP PRPM：mengenal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengenal)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay can attach a short pronoun directly to a verb, making mengenalnya a compact expression for knowing or recognizing someone. Its base mengenal belongs to the kenal family, alongside words for acquaintances, introductions, and recognition. The nasal prefix changes the initial consonant of kenal, while -nya supplies the object without specifying gender. No particular ancient borrowing is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 mengenal，先抓住 kenal“认识”；末尾 nya 像一个代词小尾巴：认识＋他／她／它。

etymology.historical_story: Morpheus is associated with Greek morphē, meaning form or shape. In Ovid's Metamorphoses, he imitates human appearance, movement, and speech, entering Alcyone's dream as her drowned husband Ceyx. The name later acquired new fictional bearers, including Dream in The Sandman. Malay usage preserves the proper name rather than translating it into an ordinary word for dreaming. [Theoi: Morpheus](https://www.theoi.com/Daimon/OneirosMorpheus.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ph 发 /f/，整词约读“摩菲厄斯”；把声音连到梦神在梦中变换人的形貌，再用作品名区分现代角色。

morphology.formula: mampus + 强调附着小词 -lah → mampuslah
morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着小词，不是派生词缀，因此 affix 留空；连写后不改变 mampus 的基本音段。输入的爪夷文只对应 mampus，未包含 -lah；此处按原包保留。official 表示采用有据可查的词根与规范小词拼写，不表示该表达适合正式场合或已作为独立词条收录。[DBP 小词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=lah)

senses.zh_definition: 死去；带强调或诅咒语气时可表示“去死吧”，属于粗俗表达。
senses.en_definition: To die; emphatically, to drop dead, especially as a coarse curse.
senses.ms_definition: Mati, dengan penegasan; bahasa kasar yang juga boleh digunakan sebagai sumpahan.
senses.nuances: DBP 将 mampus 标为 bk，即 bahasa kasar。-lah 加强语气，不会消除粗俗或敌意。具体是陈述、预言还是咒骂，取决于句式与语调。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mampus)

senses.zh_definition: 完蛋了；惨了，用死亡作夸张比喻，表示将陷入严重麻烦。
senses.en_definition: To be in serious trouble; to be done for, hyperbolically.
senses.ms_definition: Menghadapi kesusahan atau akibat buruk yang besar, secara kiasan dan kasar.
senses.nuances: 常见于对自身处境的夸张感叹，如 mampuslah aku；一般不表示真的死亡。此处是语用引申释义，并非将其冒充为 DBP 独立释义。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks mampus as coarse language meaning death. Adding the attached particle -lah emphasizes the expression without making it polite. The figurative reading in mampuslah aku evokes being finished or facing trouble rather than literal death. No deeper historical origin is established here; the secure account concerns its recorded register and transparent particle attachment. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mampus)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mampus 联想“完蛋”，-lah 像重重加上的感叹号：mampuslah aku＝“我这下完蛋了！”

morphology.formula: meN- + namakan → menamakan；完整分析：meN- + nama + -kan → menamakan
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的直接基底 namakan；其底层词根是 nama。meN- 在鼻音 n 前表现为 me-，原有 n 保留；-kan 已包含在 namakan 中。

senses.zh_definition: 给人、事物或地方起名；赋予某个名称。
senses.en_definition: To give a name to a person, thing, or place.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan nama atau gelaran kepada seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 及物动词。常用结构为 menamakan + 对象 + 名称，或 menamakan + 对象 + sempena + 命名依据。此义强调赋予名称。[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=menamakan)

collocations.zh: 以某位人物的名字命名道路
collocations.en: name a road after a notable figure

senses.zh_definition: 把某人或某事称作、视为某种人或事物。
senses.en_definition: To describe or regard someone or something as a particular thing.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggap atau menyebut seseorang atau sesuatu sebagai sesuatu yang tertentu.
senses.nuances: 表示分类、评价或修辞性的称谓，常接 sebagai。称某项行为为牺牲、成功等，体现说话者的判断，并不涉及正式命名。

collocations.en: describe the action as a sacrifice
characterize the effort as a success

senses.zh_definition: 提出某人的姓名，使其成为职位、选举或其他遴选程序的候选人。
senses.en_definition: To nominate someone as a candidate for a position or selection.
senses.ms_definition: Mengemukakan nama seseorang sebagai calon untuk sesuatu jawatan, pilihan raya atau pemilihan.
senses.nuances: 表示提名；是否当选或获任命须由后续程序决定。常用 menamakan seseorang sebagai calon。

etymology.historical_story: Menamakan belongs to the Malay family built around nama, meaning name. Its dictionary senses connect giving a name, applying a description, and putting forward a candidate. A useful way to understand that connection is to picture a name moving from a child's identity to a label in discussion and finally onto a nomination list.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 nama（名字）：menamakan 就是把名字给出去，也可以把名字提交上去。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 h 前呈 meng-；词根开头的 h 保留，不发生辅音脱落。

etymology.historical_story: The word is transparently formed from hidap with the active prefix meN-. Its dictionary meaning emphasizes enduring illness over time. The same root produces penghidap, a person living with a disease. Learning these together connects an ongoing condition with the person experiencing it, a useful distinction in health reporting. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=penghidap).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 hidap 是“承受病症”：menghidap 表示“患病”，penghidap 表示“患者”；词根相同，前缀决定说的是状态还是人。

morphology.formula: meN- + ampuni → mengampuni；完整构词：meN- + ampun + -i → mengampuni
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留输入的直接基底 ampuni；更基础的词根是 ampun。meN- 接元音 a 起首的基底时变为 meng-，原有 a 保留；ampuni 中的 -i 已属于该直接基底。完整词形含 meN-...-i。

word_family.gloss: 给予宽恕或赦免的行为

senses.zh_definition: 宽恕犯错或有罪的人；在宗教或君主语境中，也指赦免其罪过。
senses.en_definition: To forgive or pardon someone for a wrong or sin.
senses.ms_definition: Memberi ampun kepada seseorang; memaafi seseorang.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，可直接接表示受宽恕者的宾语，如 mengampuni seseorang。语气较庄重，常见于祈祷、宗教论述及君主赦免语境；日常小过失通常用 memaafkan 更自然。宽恕不等于认定当事人从未犯错。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengampuni)。

collocations.en: to forgive someone who has done wrong

dah 相当于 sudah。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah bertaubat. Aku harap Allah mengampuni aku.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 普通道歉通常说 maaf 或 minta maaf；mengampuni 带有较庄重的道德、宗教或赦免色彩。不要把它当作任何小失误之后都适用的日常客套话。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在宗教交流中尊重对方的信仰和措辞，不替神明断言某个具体的人必然已经获赦。用于人际伤害时，也不宜要求受伤害者立即宽恕；祈求宽恕与承担责任可以并行。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 普通道歉通常说 maaf 或 minta maaf；mengampuni 带有较庄重的道德、宗教或赦免色彩。不要把它当作任何小失误之后都适用的日常客套话。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在宗教交流中尊重对方的信仰和措辞，不替神明断言某个具体的人必然已经获赦。用于人际伤害时，也不宜要求受伤害者立即宽恕；祈求宽恕与承担责任可以并行。

etymology.historical_story: Mengampuni is transparently built on ampun, a Malay word for pardon or forgiveness. Older bilingual vocabularies already record ampun alongside words for pardoning, showing that this vocabulary predates present-day usage. Modern dictionary examples place mengampuni in both royal and religious settings, where forgiveness carries particular moral or institutional weight. Its deeper ultimate origin is not established here. [Historical vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/32/A_vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages%3B_%28IA_anr0813.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ampun“宽恕”：ampun 加 -i，再接 meN-，遇 a 变 meng-，得到 mengampuni“宽恕某人”。

morphology.formula: menghancurkan + -nya → menghancurkannya；内部构词：meN- + hancur + -kan → menghancurkan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留输入中的直接基词 menghancurkan；其进一步词根为 hancur。meN- 在 h 前实现为 meng-，h 保留；-kan 构成使动及物动词，-nya 在此为第三人称宾语后附代词，不表示施事。输入 Jawi 缺少 -nya，完整形式补为 مڠهنچورکنڽ；音节按完整词形补出。

senses.zh_definition: 将它击碎、压碎或摧毁，使其成为碎片或失去原有结构。
senses.en_definition: To crush, smash, or demolish it, breaking it into fragments or destroying its structure.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan benda yang dirujuk itu pecah berserpihan atau remuk sehingga bentuk asalnya rosak.
senses.nuances: -nya 指回已明确的受事；物体通常译为“它”，人物则可能译为“他／她”，但不能因此把所有语境都理解为杀害。各义依据 [DBP：menghancurkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=menghancurkan) 整理。

senses.zh_definition: 将它弄碎或碾成碎屑，尤指饼干等易碎物。
senses.en_definition: To crumble it into small pieces, especially a brittle substance such as a biscuit.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan bahan rapuh yang dirujuk itu berderai atau relai menjadi cebisan kecil.
senses.nuances: 强调易碎物散成碎屑，不一定需要强力撞击。与上一义的差别主要在受事和碎裂方式，不是另一种语法结构。

senses.zh_definition: 将它捣烂、压烂或打碎，尤指把食物处理成容易食用的状态。
senses.en_definition: To mash or break it down, especially food prepared for easier eating.
senses.ms_definition: Melumatkan makanan yang dirujuk itu dengan menumbuk, menekan atau mengisarnya.
senses.nuances: 常用于料理说明；是否成为泥状、细末或小块，由食材和上下文决定。若需精确表达特定处理方式，可用 melumatkan、menumbuk 或 mengisar。

senses.zh_definition: 使它溶解或熔化，尤指糖等固体失去原有固体形态。
senses.en_definition: To dissolve or melt it, causing the referenced solid to lose its solid form.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan bahan yang dirujuk itu larut, cair atau encer melalui proses yang sesuai.
senses.nuances: 这是词典记录的用法；技术说明应区分 melarutkan“溶解”和 meleburkan“熔化”，避免将两种物理过程混为一谈。

senses.zh_definition: 毁掉它；使所指的人、关系、组织或生活遭到严重破坏。
senses.en_definition: To ruin or devastate the referenced person, relationship, organisation, or way of life.
senses.ms_definition: Merosakkan atau membinasakan orang, hubungan atau perkara yang dirujuk sehingga terjejas dengan teruk.
senses.nuances: 比喻义语气强烈。人物作受事时可能表示使其精神崩溃、事业尽毁等，具体解释取决于上下文；不是固定表示身体伤害。

collocations.zh: 在情感上将他或她击垮

senses.zh_definition: 使它彻底破灭或消失，所指通常为希望、信任或信念。
senses.en_definition: To shatter or extinguish it completely, especially hope, trust, or belief.

etymology.historical_story: This form layers Malay grammar around hancur, meaning broken down or destroyed. The construction meN-...-kan makes the action causative and transitive, while -nya supplies a previously identified object. Dictionary meanings connect physical fragmentation with ruined relationships and shattered hopes. These are related images of lost structure, rather than evidence for separate borrowed origins.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三步记：hancur＝碎了；menghancurkan＝使之粉碎；再接 -nya＝把它粉碎。

morphology.formula: menambah + -kan → menambahkan；完整构词：meN- + tambah + -kan → menambahkan
morphology.pattern_note: 按数据包保留直接基底 menambah；更底层词根为 tambah。meN- 遇词首 t 时，t 脱落，鼻音实现为 n，形成 menambah；再接 -kan。第二音节为 /nam/，数据包候选 /num/ 不采用。

etymology.historical_story: The story of menambahkan lies in Malay word formation rather than an exotic borrowed origin. Tambah supplies the idea of addition. The active prefix meN- changes its initial t through nasal substitution, producing menambah; -kan completes menambahkan. The resulting verb applies equally to adding tangible material and increasing something abstract, such as knowledge or worry.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tambah 是加；meN- 让 t 让位给 n，再接 -kan：menambahkan，就是把东西或程度往上加。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇词根开头的 t 时，t 脱落并由 n 替代：tumpu → numpu，再形成 menumpukan。输入将整个派生词标成词根有误；此处据构词关系改为 tumpu。这里的 -kan 只有一个 k，不能与 tumpuk 派生的 menumpukkan 混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Menumpukan is transparently formed from tumpu with meN- and -kan. Its dictionary senses connect bodily support, the grounding of an argument and the direction of attention. These connections provide a useful semantic picture, although they do not prove a chronological sequence of meaning changes. The deeper origin of tumpu is not established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tumpu 想成“支点”：脚踩住支点，论证立住依据，注意力落在焦点。meN- + tumpu + -kan → 把某物集中、落实到一点。

etymology.historical_story: The base maklum comes from Arabic maʿlūm, meaning known or understood. Malay combines this borrowed base with its own verbal morphology: memaklumkan makes something known to others. The word illustrates how an Arabic loan becomes fully productive in Malay, supporting the familiar language of notices, letters and workplace announcements without retaining Arabic grammatical structure. [Source: maklum etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/maklum#Malay)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 宗教义适用于伊斯兰教育和相关讨论；作为人名出现的 Malik 不应自动解释为天使。植物义须由 pokok、daun 或学名等上下文判断。

etymology.historical_story: Malik entered Malay religious vocabulary through Arabic and Islamic teaching. The Quran names Malik when describing the inhabitants of Hell addressing its guardian. In Malay, the name therefore carries a specific religious reference. Dictionaries separately record malik meaning an owner or ruler, and an unrelated-looking plant homonym whose origin should not be assumed. [JAKIM：Malik](https://emuallaf.islam.gov.my/papar_maklumat.php?ID=28)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用共同的 ma 音连接 Malaikat Malik：先记“天使马利克”，再联想到其看守火狱之门的职责；这只是记忆关联，不是构词拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入中的 dal 词根分析须纠正：medal 是整体借入的英语词，不是 me- + dal。é 表示 /e/，不是 /ə/。以下词族项目是复合词组，并非加缀派生词。[DBP：medal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=medal)

senses.zh_definition: 作为竞赛成绩、功绩或服务表现的表彰而颁发的金属奖牌或勋章。

senses.ms_definition: Bintang kehormatan; pingat.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的标准名词，意义同时涵盖竞赛奖牌和表彰功绩的勋章。马来西亚正式报道及颁奖表述通常更常使用 pingat；medal 不是由马来语动词前缀 me- 构成。

etymology.historical_story: DBP explicitly identifies English as the source language of Malay medal. The borrowing names a physical token of public recognition, whether earned in competition or awarded for service. Its initial letters happen to resemble a Malay prefix, but the dictionary treats medal as a noun, not as a verb built from dal. [DBP: medal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=medal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 medal，就想英语 medal 和领奖台上的奖牌；整词一起记，别拆成 me- 与 dal。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根起首的 /p/ 在鼻音前缀作用下脱落，meN- 实现为 mem-。数据包将 memukau 标为词根有误；DBP 将它列为 pukau 的派生词。[DBP：pukau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pukau)

word_family.gloss: 中了迷术；受骗；被深深吸引
施迷术所产生的作用或结果

senses.zh_definition: 对人施用传统观念中的迷药或迷术，使其昏睡、迷糊或失去正常意识。
senses.en_definition: To subject someone to a stupefying substance or a spell traditionally believed to impair awareness.
senses.ms_definition: Mengenakan atau membubuh pukau.
senses.nuances: 本义，涉及传统迷术或迷药叙述；不能直接等同于临床催眠，也不表示相关超自然效果已获证实。通常带宾语，指对某人施用 pukau。

collocations.zh: 对受害者施用迷药或迷术
collocations.en: to stupefy or bewitch a victim

senses.zh_definition: 以花言巧语、计谋或其他手段迷惑、蒙骗他人。
senses.en_definition: To deceive or trick someone by beguiling them.
senses.ms_definition: Memperdaya, mengakali atau menipu.
senses.nuances: 贬义比喻用法，重点在迷惑判断并使人受骗；并非所有使用 memukau 的语境都带有诈骗含义。

collocations.zh: 用甜言蜜语般的承诺迷惑人

senses.zh_definition: 强烈吸引人的注意或情感，使人着迷、赞叹。
senses.en_definition: To captivate, enchant or impress someone deeply.
senses.ms_definition: Memikat hati, mempesonakan atau mengagumkan.
senses.nuances: 现代艺术评论、旅游介绍及日常赞美中常见的褒义用法。可说 memukau penonton，也可在 persembahan yang memukau 中不明说被吸引者；赞美强度高于一般的 menarik。[DBP：memukau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=memukau+1)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect pukau with traditional accounts of stupefying preparations and spells. Memukau also carries figurative meanings involving deception and fascination. A useful way to understand this semantic range is through captured awareness: a victim becomes bewildered, while an audience becomes absorbed. This connection explains the imagery without establishing the word’s deeper historical origin. [DBP: pukau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pukau)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 pukau 的“迷住”：memukau 是“让别人着迷”，terpukau 是“自己被迷住”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，保留 b；-kan 构成使动、及物形式。betulkan 是已带 -kan 的基础形式，词根为 betul。[DBP：betul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=25872&keyword=betul)

senses.zh_definition: 纠正错误，使文字、资料、说法或理解符合正确内容。
senses.en_definition: To correct an error or make information, wording, or understanding accurate.
senses.ms_definition: Membaiki kesalahan atau menjadikan sesuatu betul.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常直接接需要纠正的对象，如 kesalahan、ejaan、maklumat。此义是把错误改正，不是认同原有说法。[DBP：membetulkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membetulkan)

senses.zh_definition: 修好损坏的物品，或调整物体、衣着、姿势等，使其恢复正常或处于合适位置。
senses.en_definition: To repair something or adjust it to its proper position or condition.
senses.ms_definition: Membaiki sesuatu yang rosak atau mengubah kedudukannya supaya betul dan teratur.
senses.nuances: 既可指修理，也可指扶正、摆正、整理。复杂维修中 membaiki 往往更明确；调整方向或位置则 membetulkan 很自然。

collocations.en: to fix or adjust a wristwatch

senses.zh_definition: 认为某种说法正确；认可或附和其内容。
senses.en_definition: To accept or affirm something as correct or true.
senses.ms_definition: Membenarkan, menganggap betul atau mengiakan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是词典收录的另一义项，较容易与“纠正”混淆。尤其 membetulkan kenyataan 可有歧义；表达认同可改用 bersetuju dengan，表达核实则用 mengesahkan。

collocations.en: to affirm what a friend says
to accept all the allegations as true

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 当面纠正别人时，可说 Boleh saya membetulkan sedikit maklumat itu?，意为“我可以稍微更正一下那项资料吗？”。把注意力放在资料或问题上，语气通常更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合编辑、教学、维修及工作沟通。公开指出长辈或同事的错误时，应避免嘲讽；涉及事实核实时，注意区分 membetulkan（纠正）与 mengesahkan（确认）。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 当面纠正别人时，可说 Boleh saya membetulkan sedikit maklumat itu?，意为“我可以稍微更正一下那项资料吗？”。把注意力放在资料或问题上，语气通常更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合编辑、教学、维修及工作沟通。公开指出长辈或同事的错误时，应避免嘲讽；涉及事实核实时，注意区分 membetulkan（纠正）与 mengesahkan（确认）。

etymology.historical_story: Membetulkan belongs to the productive Malay family built on betul, meaning correct or true. Its formation makes an everyday idea explicit: causing something to become right. The dictionary also preserves a less obvious meaning, accepting someone's words as true. The shared centre is correctness, but context determines whether the speaker changes an error or endorses a statement. [DBP: betul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=25872&keyword=betul)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 betul＝对；再加“使它变对”的 meN-...-kan：membetulkan＝纠正、调好。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着在词后的强调语气词，此处按字段归入 suffix；不改变词根读音。mereka 的第二个 e 读 /e/，首个 e 读 /ə/。输入 Jawi 保留的是 mereka 的写法；音节按完整词形补全。

senses.zh_definition: 正是他们／她们；用于突出所谈论的一群人。
senses.en_definition: They or them, with emphasis: it is they who; those very people.
senses.ms_definition: Kata ganti nama diri ketiga jamak yang menerima partikel -lah untuk menegaskan orang-orang yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 实际词类是 kata ganti nama diri（人称代词），因指定枚举没有 pronoun，归入 noun。常见结构为 merekalah yang…，表示“正是他们……”，不必然表示“只有他们”；排他义须由上下文或 sahaja 等词表达。代词 mereka 与表示“创作”的同形动词 mereka 应分开理解。基本词义参见 [DBP：mereka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mereka)；强调结构参见 [DBP：Perihal Penonjolan Maklumat](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2023/03/13/7523/)。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical rather than a speculative ancient origin. Malay combines the plural pronoun mereka with the attached emphatic particle -lah. In expressions such as merekalah yang membantu, an ordinary reference to people becomes a pointed identification. This gives the same form a natural place in public praise, explanations, and moments of recognition.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mereka 想成“他们”，再把 -lah 想成聚光灯：merekalah，就是“正是他们！”

etymology.historical_story: The relevant English word is marshal. Its history leads through French to a Germanic expression for a servant responsible for horses. Duties associated with horses and military households developed into offices of authority, and the title later extended to officials supervising public events. Malay uses the adapted spelling marsyal. [Etymonline: marshal](https://www.etymonline.com/word/marshal); [DBP: marsyal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=marsyal).

etymology.historical_story: Misalnya belongs to the misal family, connected with Arabic mithāl, meaning an example or likeness. DBP also records amsal as an Arabic plural related to misal. In Malay, the established expression misal plus -nya introduces an illustration rather than requiring a literal possessive translation. It therefore works naturally as the discourse expression for example. [DBP: amsal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=amsal), [DBP: misal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/cari1/Cari1/Cari1/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=misal)

etymology.historical_story: The word combines akibat, a Malay noun of Arabic origin associated with consequences or an outcome, with productive Malay verbal morphology. Adding meN- and -kan shifts attention from the consequence itself to whatever brings it about. This structure explains its usefulness in reports: a writer can name a cause first, then state the damaging result it produces.

etymology.historical_story: Mahasiswa combines maha-, a Sanskrit-derived element expressing greatness or higher standing, with siswa, meaning student. Malay grammar explicitly presents this formation as a designation for a higher-level learner. The word illustrates how inherited learned vocabulary supplies names for modern educational roles, while ordinary conversation can use the simpler expression pelajar universiti. [DBP morphology reference](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: The root minum belongs to an old Austronesian word family for drinking, associated with reconstructed forms containing inum. Modern Malay forms meminum through its active verbal prefix. Everyday speech commonly keeps the shorter minum, while writing often uses meminum with an expressed object, preserving a useful contrast between conversational and formal expression. etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is Malay word formation rather than a securely established ancient borrowing. Bingung names a state of mental confusion; the productive meN-...-kan construction turns that state into something a person or situation causes. This contrast lets speakers distinguish feeling bewildered from bewildering somebody else without learning an unrelated verb.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bingung 记成脑中一团乱线；加上 meN-...-kan，就变成“让别人脑中也乱起来”。

etymology.historical_story: Membawakan belongs to the everyday bawa family, built around carrying and bringing. Its benefactive use highlights the person helped by an action, as when someone brings a guest refreshments. Its presentation sense treats a song or reading as something brought before listeners. This offers a useful semantic connection, although it does not establish when either sense first appeared.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bawa 是“带”；membawakan 是“为人带来”。带来的是食物，就译“带给”；带来的是歌曲，就译“献唱”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record several homonymous tampung entries. Collecting rainwater, accommodating people, and covering expenses provide a memorable semantic network around receiving and supporting. Patching and slapping are separately recorded meanings. etymology.historical_story: English much developed from Middle English muchel, continuing Old English micel or mycel, meaning great or large. The shorter modern form expresses quantity and degree. Its presence in a Malaysian conversation can reflect English use or code-switching; its historical ancestry belongs to English rather than the Malay system of roots and affixes. etymology.historical_story: Mengemas hides an instructive ambiguity. In everyday housekeeping, it comes from kemas: the prefix meN- replaces the initial k with a nasal sound. A separate dictionary homonym comes from emas, meaning gold, and describes a golden appearance. Identical spelling therefore conceals two different derivations; context distinguishes a tidy room from golden rice.

etymology.historical_story: Manja carries two meanings that Malay dictionaries preserve together: indulgence that encourages poor behaviour, and affectionate closeness. That pairing explains why the same word can sound critical when describing an undisciplined child, yet tender when describing a child's attachment or a gentle voice. Its deeper origin is not established here. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=manja+I)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manja 想成“黏着妈妈撒娇”：核心是想要亲近和关爱；过了头，才变成娇惯。此为情景联想，并非词源。

etymology.historical_story: Memanah preserves an image familiar from both storytelling and sport: an arrow leaving a bow. DBP illustrates the verb with Seri Rama, linking its dictionary record to a literary setting. Today the same verb names an ordinary sporting skill. Its additional meanings carry the arrow's speed and striking force into descriptions of movement and lightning.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves a revealing cultural connection within undi: it covers drawing lots as well as voting, and buah undi formerly meant dice. Mengundi therefore belongs to a family of ways to settle a choice. Context tells the learner whether chance determines the outcome or people express preferences through ballots. morphology.pattern_note: -kah 是后附且连写的疑问小品词，不是改变词类的派生后缀；词根拼写不变。规范马来西亚书面语通常采用对应形式 mahukah。

senses.nuances: 整体包含表示意愿的 mau 与疑问小品词 -kah；mau 在动词前可起意愿助动作用。马来西亚正式文字优先使用 mahu、mahukah；maukah 也常见于印尼语材料，不能据此将所有出现都判断为马来西亚口语。所给材料没有独立 DBP 释义，本释义为构式说明。

etymology.historical_story: Maukah is transparent as mau followed by the question particle -kah. Malay spelling joins this particle to the preceding word. Malaysian standard writing generally favors the corresponding mahu and mahukah forms. The supplied packet establishes no earlier history for mau, so the secure explanation here is grammatical formation rather than a speculative ancient derivation. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The English family word mum is a shortened form of mummy meaning “mother”; Oxford dates this noun to the mid-seventeenth century. Its appearance inside a Malay sentence is best understood as a family naming choice or language mixing, rather than evidence of Malay affixation. The standard Malay equivalent remains ibu. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/mum_1)

etymology.historical_story: Mintak preserves the everyday sound of minta rather than introducing a new requesting verb. Its final written k represents a glottal closure in the supplied pronunciation. DBP labels the form conversational. This makes it useful for understanding dialogue and messages, while minta remains the appropriate spelling in ordinary formal prose.

senses.zh_definition: 否认某项陈述、消息或指控属实；表示不承认其真实性。
senses.en_definition: To deny the truth of a statement, report, or allegation.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak mengakui kebenaran sesuatu atau tidak mengiakan sesuatu kenyataan.
senses.nuances: 强调说话者不承认其真实性；否认本身不等于已经证明对方错误。常见于新闻、声明和争议报道。释义依据 [DBP：sangkal／menyangkal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sangkal)。

senses.zh_definition: 反驳、驳斥或反对某种观点、论证、主张或命令。

senses.ms_definition: Membantah, melawan, menentang, menolak atau menyanggah sesuatu.

etymology.historical_story: Menyangkal belongs to the Malay sangkal family, alongside sangkalan, penyangkal, and penyangkalan. Its changing initial consonant illustrates nasal substitution: the s of sangkal gives way to ny after meN-. This visible family relationship explains the modern word reliably; the available dictionary evidence does not establish a deeper historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds menghidu from hidu with its productive active prefix meN-. Its meanings connect an ordinary bodily action with detection: a person smells a flower, an animal follows a scent, and an investigator uncovers a hidden scheme. This connection makes the figurative sense memorable without requiring a separate root or an invented origin story. [DBP: hidu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=hidu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hidu 联想到 hidung（鼻子）：鼻子主动去闻，就是 menghidu。

morphology.formula: menjauh + -i → menjauhi；完整分析：meN- + jauh + -i → menjauhi
morphology.pattern_note: 依数据包保留直接基础 menjauh；最底层词根是 jauh。meN- 在 j 前实现为 men-，保留 j；加 -i 后，表示主体远离或避开后接的对象。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this verb around jauh, meaning distant. Its physical image remains visible even in moral advice: people can keep away from a dangerous place, an unhealthy habit, or an unwanted relationship. The dictionary records avoidance as its central meaning. This spatial connection explains the modern word without requiring an invented origin legend.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 jauh＝远：men-jauh-i，就是让自己与后面的对象保持距离。

senses.nuances: 着重轻微接触，不限于肘部；若要明确表示无意碰到，常用 tersinggung 或 terlanggar。

senses.zh_definition: 在讲话或文章中简略提及、触及某个话题。

senses.zh_definition: 因言语或行为伤害某人的感情，使其感到被冒犯。
senses.en_definition: To hurt someone's feelings or cause offence.
senses.ms_definition: Menyakiti hati atau perasaan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 常与 hati、perasaan 连用。menyinggung 描述造成伤害的行为；tersinggung 描述受伤或受冒犯者的感受。

senses.zh_definition: 损害或玷污某人的名誉、尊严。
senses.en_definition: To tarnish someone's reputation or affront their dignity.
senses.ms_definition: Menodai nama baik atau kehormatan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 比一般感情受伤更侧重社会评价与尊严；出现于较庄重的指责、辩护或名誉争议语境。

etymology.historical_story: Malaysia's official data portal uses MOE to identify the Ministry of Education. The letters come from its English name, while Malay uses Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia and KPM. This illustrates how bilingual administration produces parallel institutional abbreviations. It does not establish the origin of an isolated lowercase moe token without its original context.

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词根首音 /p/ 前取 mem-，词根的 /p/ 脱落：mem- + adam → memadam。这里的 adam 只是 padam 去掉首音后的部分，不是词根。输入的 Adam 释义属于错误匹配；正确词根为 padam。音节按词形补全，headword.jawi 保留输入的 null。[DBP：padam](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=padam)

senses.nuances: DBP 的一则用法说明区分 memadam papan hitam 与 memadamkan tulisan pada papan hitam：前者以被擦净的表面为宾语，后者以被清除的字迹为宾语。[DBP：memadam 与 memadamkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=padam)

senses.nuances: 常用于软件界面和操作说明。删除画面上的项目、移除记录与永久抹除底层数据并不必然相同，须看系统功能；正式机构的操作手册也使用 memadam。[政府操作手册：删除通知](https://erekod.aim.gov.my/public/manual/Manual%20e-Rekod.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 使火熄灭或使灯不再亮；此词形常见于口语，正式表达通常用 memadamkan。
senses.en_definition: To put out a fire or switch off a light, commonly expressed formally as memadamkan.
senses.ms_definition: Mematikan api atau lampu; bentuk memadamkan lazim diutamakan dalam penggunaan formal bagi maksud ini.
senses.nuances: memadam api 和 memadam lampu 在日常用语中可见；面向规范写作时优先用 memadamkan api、memadamkan lampu。相关比喻如消除希望或平息骚乱，正式表达也通常采用 memadamkan。[DBP：memadamkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memadamkan)

etymology.historical_story: Memadam belongs to the Malay family built on padam, associated with something going out or disappearing. The active prefix changes the initial p, producing memadam rather than an Adam-related word. Its modern digital use connects erasing visible marks with removing files and records. The related noun pemadam names tools such as an eraser or fire extinguisher. [DBP: pemadam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pemadam)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 padam 的“让它消失”：字迹擦掉、文件删掉、灯光灭掉。meN- 遇到 p，把 p 换成鼻音 m，就得到 memadam；不要误拆成 Adam。

etymology.historical_story: One documented history of Mack concerns the truck brand founded by Jack and Gus Mack in Brooklyn in 1900. Here, a family name became a commercial name associated with vehicles. That history explains the brand sense only: without a source sentence, the lowercase token mack cannot securely be assigned to this company rather than a person or another referent. [Mack Trucks](https://www.macktrucks.com/about-mack/)

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates Malay's productive use of affixes rather than an exotic borrowing. Lemah describes weakness; the verbal prefix and suffix build a causative expression meaning to make something weak. The same construction accommodates bodily strength and abstract effectiveness, allowing one familiar word family to describe tired muscles, damaged confidence, or an unconvincing argument. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=lemah)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lemah＝弱；meN-…-kan＝使之如此：melemahkan＝使变弱。对比 melemah“自己变弱”。

senses.zh_definition: 搅拌液体或混合物，使各部分混合。

senses.zh_definition: 打扰他人或扰乱活动、秩序及安宁。

senses.zh_definition: 使思想或情绪不安；令某人烦心。
senses.en_definition: To trouble the mind or unsettle someone's feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan fikiran atau perasaan menjadi tidak tenteram.
senses.nuances: 主语可为回忆、忧虑或事件，不一定是蓄意骚扰他人的人。

senses.zh_definition: 说梦话；在意识不清时胡言乱语。

senses.ms_definition: Mengigau ketika tidur atau ketika tidak sedar sepenuhnya.
senses.nuances: 这是词典另列的较少见用法；现代一般表达多用 mengigau。须由睡眠或意识状态的上下文识别。

etymology.historical_story: Mengacau belongs to the kacau family. Malay uses this family for mixed substances, disorder, and troubled feelings. Stirring coffee and disturbing someone's concentration therefore sit close together in the modern vocabulary. The shared image of agitation helps learners connect the senses, although it does not establish which meaning appeared first historically.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 一把勺子搅咖啡，一件烦事搅思绪：mengacau 把东西或心情“搅动起来”。

senses.zh_definition: 向某物投毒；使食物、水等受到毒物污染，或使对象受到毒害。
senses.en_definition: To poison something by introducing a poisonous substance into it.
senses.ms_definition: Membubuh racun pada sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，后接受影响的对象。meracuni makanan 指使食物带毒；keracunan makanan 指食物中毒的状态或事件，后者不必涉及蓄意投毒。义项依据 [DBP：meracuni](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=meracuni)。

senses.zh_definition: 撩动、扰乱或诱惑心神；使人心动、着迷或难以平静。
senses.en_definition: To tantalize, captivate, or unsettle someone's feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Mengganggu, mengusik atau menggiurkan hati.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，常带文学或抒情色彩，尤其见于 meracuni hati。此义未必表示伤害，也可形容微笑、眼神等令人心动；不能机械译成“毒害”。

collocations.en: to captivate or unsettle the heart

senses.zh_definition: 毒害、腐蚀或败坏思想、心灵等；施加有害影响。
senses.en_definition: To corrupt or damage someone's thoughts, mind, or inner life.
senses.ms_definition: Merosakkan atau membinasakan fikiran, jiwa dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 带强烈负面评价，常见于社会评论、教育和公共论述。以 meracuni fikiran 指责他人时，表达的是严重的有害影响判断，并非中性的“影响”。

etymology.historical_story: The noun racun supplies the concrete image of poison. Malay extends that image into emotional and intellectual life: a smile can tantalize the heart, while harmful ideas can corrupt the mind. These established dictionary senses make meracuni a useful example of how one physical image supports both alluring and destructive figurative meanings.

morphology.formula: menegak + -kan → menegakkan；完整构词：meN- + tegak + -kan → menegakkan

senses.zh_definition: 坚定心志，增强精神力量或勇气。

senses.nuances: 较偏文学表达；日常交流通常使用 menguatkan semangat 或 memberanikan diri。

etymology.historical_story: Menegakkan belongs to the Malay family built on tegak, meaning upright or erect. Its dictionary senses connect raising a physical object with sustaining justice, sovereignty, and conviction. This provides a useful cultural image: principles can be supported like pillars. The connection explains related meanings without establishing a dated sequence of historical development.

etymology.historical_story: Malaysian Malay borrowed mantan from Indonesian. An Indonesian language guide records a 1984 proposal to use a regional word meaning no longer functioning as a respectful alternative for former officeholders. DBP documents its adoption into Malay. This history helps explain its formal associations, although bekas also remains an ordinary Malay expression. [DBP language guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/pedoman%20bahasa.pdf) [Indonesian language guide](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/4377/1/Petunjuk%20Praktis%20Berbahasa%20Indonesia%201990.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 man.tan 联想成“满任”：曾经担任，如今已卸任；只是记忆联想，不是实际词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语国籍词的构词，规范拼写须大写 Malaysian；-an 不是本词中的马来语后缀。国名末尾的 a 不重复保留。

senses.zh_definition: 马来西亚的；与马来西亚及其人民、文化等有关的。
senses.en_definition: Of or relating to Malaysia, its people, or its culture.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud berkaitan dengan Malaysia, rakyatnya atau kebudayaannya.
senses.nuances: 本词是英语词形。规范马来语通常使用 Malaysia 作后置修饰语，例如 budaya Malaysia。以下搭配的 ms 字段提供马来语对应表达。英语 Malaysian 不等于表示马来族身份的 Malay。[Collins：Malaysian](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/malaysian)

senses.zh_definition: 马来西亚人；来自马来西亚或具有马来西亚国民身份的人。

senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris bagi orang Malaysia, khususnya seseorang yang mempunyai kewarganegaraan Malaysia.
senses.nuances: 强调法律国籍时，马来语宜用 warganegara Malaysia；一般身份介绍可用 orang Malaysia。该称谓不限定族群。英语可数名词单数为 a Malaysian，复数为 Malaysians。[Collins：Malaysian](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/malaysian)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 英语文本写 Malaysian，首字母大写；正式马来语文本按语义使用 Malaysia、orang Malaysia、rakyat Malaysia 或 warganegara Malaysia。

etymology.historical_story: Malaysian is an English formation from the place name Malaysia and the nationality suffix -an. It names a national connection rather than a single ethnic identity. This distinction is useful in multilingual Malaysia: a Malaysian may belong to any ethnic community. Malay normally expresses the same connection through Malaysia, orang Malaysia, or rakyat Malaysia. [Collins: Malaysian](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/malaysian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Malaysia 和 Malaysian 连起来记：国名 Malaysia，英语中的“马来西亚的／马来西亚人”是 Malaysian；国籍不等于族群。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接词首 s 时通常形成 meny-，词根的 s 脱落：meny- + erbu → menyerbu；ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入包将派生词误标为词根，此处按实际构词更正。[DBP 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=serbuan) 将 menyerbu 列于 serbu 之下。

senses.zh_definition: 冲击、突袭或攻入某个目标；亦指执法人员突击搜查某处。
senses.en_definition: To storm or attack a target; to raid premises.
senses.ms_definition: Mendatangi atau memasuki sesuatu tempat untuk menyerang atau menjalankan serbuan.
senses.nuances: 用于军事行动时强调冲击或进攻；用于警方行动时通常译为“突击搜查”。词本身不保证行动成功，也不表示现场人员已经被定罪。

senses.zh_definition: 一群人蜂拥而至、涌入或争先恐后地奔向某处。
senses.en_definition: To rush or flock towards or into a place in large numbers.
senses.ms_definition: Datang, pergi atau masuk beramai-ramai dengan meluru.
senses.nuances: 常用于顾客、群众或儿童；并不必然涉及攻击。商业报道中可生动描述顾客蜂拥购物，而非普通、平缓的到访。

senses.zh_definition: 猛冲、闯入或迅速扑向某处；行动者可以只有一人。
senses.en_definition: To charge, rush, or burst into a place.
senses.ms_definition: Meluru atau merempuh ke sesuatu tempat dengan cepat atau kuat.
senses.nuances: 强调突然、迅猛的移动，不要求多人参与。表达移动方向时可接 ke dalam、ke luar 等短语。

etymology.historical_story: Menyerbu is transparently formed from serbu through Malay's productive nasal prefixation. Its meanings connect an attacking force, a crowd rushing towards something, and an individual bursting into a room. The shared image is forceful forward movement. This explains the word's usefulness across military reporting, police news, and everyday descriptions without requiring a speculative story about its earliest origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 serbu＝冲袭；加 meN- 时 s 换成 ny，得到 menyerbu。脑中放一段“人群一下冲进去”的画面。

morphology.pattern_note: 直接构词基础为 meninggalkan，最终词根为 tinggal。meN- 与 t 开头的词根结合时，t 脱落，形成 meninggalkan；-mu 是表示第二人称单数的附着代词，此处作宾语“你”，不是所有格。保留输入包的 Jawi；该拼写仅对应 meninggalkan，完整形式应补写为 منيڠݢلکنمو。

senses.zh_definition: 离开你所在的地方，把你留在那里；可指暂时离开，并不必然表示抛弃。
senses.en_definition: To leave you behind or depart from where you are.
senses.ms_definition: Pergi dari tempat kamu berada dengan membiarkan kamu terus berada di situ.
senses.nuances: “你”已由 -mu 表达，不能把整个词仅译成“离开”。离开的时间和原因由语境决定。基础动词的相关义项见 [DBP PRPM：tinggal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=tinggal)。

senses.zh_definition: 离弃你，结束与你的关系，或不再承担对你的照顾和支持。
senses.en_definition: To abandon you or end a relationship with you.
senses.ms_definition: Memutuskan hubungan dengan kamu atau berhenti menjaga dan mendampingi kamu.
senses.nuances: 常见于爱情、家庭和抒情表达；比单纯的 pergi 更容易突出被留下者的感受。不能仅凭这个词判断离开者是否死亡。

collocations.en: have the heart to abandon you

senses.zh_definition: 在比赛、进度或成就方面超过你，把你甩在后面。

senses.ms_definition: Mendahului kamu sehingga kamu berada di belakang dari segi kedudukan, kemajuan atau pencapaian.
senses.nuances: 属于比较性或比喻性用法，通常需要 jauh di belakang 等成分明确语境，并非情感上的离弃。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 适合亲密关系、诗歌及对熟悉晚辈的表达；对客户、上司或不熟悉的长者，宜用姓名、称谓或适当的独立代词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 适合亲密关系、诗歌及对熟悉晚辈的表达；对客户、上司或不熟悉的长者，宜用姓名、称谓或适当的独立代词。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this emotionally expressive form from ordinary grammatical pieces. Tinggal concerns staying or remaining; meninggalkan shifts attention to someone left behind. Adding the attached pronoun -mu makes that person 'you'. This compact combination suits letters, songs and intimate promises because the person affected is carried inside the verb itself, rather than expressed separately.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tinggal 的“留下”，再把 -mu 当作“你”：meninggalkanmu 就是“离开，把你留下”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 saran 的首辅音 s 在 meN- 后脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/；-kan 构成及物动词。输入包将 menyarankan 标为词根有误，此处按实际构词校正。

senses.zh_definition: 提出意见、建议或推荐的做法，供他人考虑或采纳。
senses.en_definition: To suggest or recommend an idea or course of action for consideration.

senses.nuances: 通常表达建议而非命令。常见结构为 menyarankan sesuatu 及 menyarankan supaya + 分句。词根、派生关系与义项见 [DBP PRPM：saran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=saran)。

senses.zh_definition: 向公众传播、宣扬或倡导某种思想、主张或理想。
senses.en_definition: To publicize, propagate or advocate an idea or ideal.
senses.ms_definition: Menyampaikan dan menyebarluaskan sesuatu fahaman atau cita-cita kepada masyarakat.
senses.nuances: 词典收录的传播义，较常见于书面、政治或思想论述。现代一般表达中，menyebarkan 或 memperjuangkan 往往更直接；不可把所有 menyarankan 都译成“宣传”。

etymology.historical_story: The transparent Malay formation begins with saran, a proposal or opinion. Its derivatives distinguish the suggestion itself, saranan, from the act of putting it forward, menyarankan. Dictionaries also preserve a broader sense involving the public promotion of ideals. That range connects a private recommendation with the more public work of advocating a position, without establishing a particular foreign origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 saran 是“建议”；s 遇到 meN- 变成 ny：saran → menyarankan，“把建议提出来”。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按输入保留，实际词根为 uja。meN- 在元音 u 前变为 meng-，词根首元音保留；-kan 构成使动表达。输入未提供音节和爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 使人兴奋、振奋或产生强烈的兴趣与期待。
senses.en_definition: To excite someone or arouse strong interest or enthusiasm.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan rasa teruja, minat yang kuat atau semangat pada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 强调事物引起的心理反应，常带积极意味。mengujakan 表示“使人兴奋”，teruja 表示“感到兴奋”。这里的马来语释义为依据 uja 词族编写的编辑释义，不冒充该派生词的 DBP 原文；参见 [DBP：uja](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=uja)。

senses.zh_definition: 令人兴奋的；让人振奋或充满期待的。
senses.en_definition: Exciting or thrilling; arousing enthusiasm or anticipation.
senses.ms_definition: Yang menimbulkan rasa teruja, keseronokan atau keinginan yang kuat untuk mengalami sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是派生动词常见的性质描述用法，如 pengalaman yang mengujakan，并不表示它由形容词词缀构成。此义描述引发兴奋的事物，而不是体验者；释义为编辑归纳。正式出版物中可见这一用法，例如 [马来西亚国家档案馆刊物](https://www.arkib.gov.my/images/penerbitan/edaran%20awam/puspawangsa/Puspawangsa%20Bil.1.2022.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records uja in contexts including encouraging a fighting cock and stirring a person’s emotions. The same word family includes teruja, describing strong interest or excitement. Mengujakan uses Malay causative morphology to present something as producing that response. These recorded meanings illuminate the word’s imagery without establishing when its modern positive use first appeared. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=uja)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用成对句记忆：Saya teruja＝我很兴奋；Acara itu mengujakan＝那个活动令人兴奋。一个是感受，一个是引发感受。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接以 /t/ 开头的词根时，鼻音实现为 /n/，词根首辅音 /t/ 脱落：tampar → nampar。输入包将 menampar 标为词根有误；依据 DBP 的 tampar 词条更正。

senses.zh_definition: 用张开的手掌拍打，尤指打人耳光、掌掴。
senses.en_definition: To strike with the open hand, especially across the face; to slap.
senses.ms_definition: Mengenakan pukulan pada seseorang atau sesuatu dengan tapak tangan.
senses.nuances: 主动及物动词，可直接接宾语，如 menampar pipinya。与用拳头击打的 menumbuk 不同；涉及人体时，通常比轻拍的 menepuk 更具攻击性。马来语释义为依据 DBP 所作的释义性改写。[DBP：tampar 及 menampar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tampar)

senses.zh_definition: 形容风吹拂、扑打身体，或波浪拍击岸边等。
senses.en_definition: Of wind or waves, to strike, brush against, or lap against something.
senses.ms_definition: Menyentuh atau memukul sesuatu apabila angin bertiup atau ombak bergerak mengenainya.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为比喻义，多见于描写性文字。力度由上下文决定，可以是轻柔吹拂，也可以是明显拍击，不必一律译成猛烈抽打。[DBP：tampar 及 menampar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tampar)

etymology.historical_story: Menampar is built from tampar through a productive Malay prefix pattern: the initial t disappears after meN-, producing menampar. DBP illustrates its literal use with an episode involving Tun Biajid, then records wind and waves as figurative subjects. These examples connect physical contact with literary descriptions of movement. They do not establish an ultimate historical etymology. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tampar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tampar＝巴掌拍打；加 meN- 后，t 让位给鼻音 n：me-nam-par。看到 nampar，就还原到 tampar。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来专名，整词记忆；末尾 -s 不是马来语词缀，也不能当作复数标记。通常首字母大写；所列 IPA 为英语英式读音，个人姓名的实际读音以本人为准，参见 [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/moses)。

senses.zh_definition: 摩西：宗教人物穆萨的英语名称；依《圣经》叙事，他带领以色列人离开埃及。
senses.en_definition: The English name of Musa, the biblical leader who led the Israelites out of Egypt.
senses.ms_definition: Nama bahasa Inggeris bagi Musa, tokoh dalam kisah kitab suci yang memimpin Bani Israel keluar dari Mesir.
senses.nuances: 这是英语专名的对应关系，不是马来语普通名词。马来语宗教文本常用 Musa；例如马来文《圣经》的相关段落使用该形式。参见 [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/moses) 与 [Keluaran 2:10](https://www.bible.com/bible/402/EXO.2.10.BM)。原包无上下文，不能确定该次出现必指宗教人物。

senses.zh_definition: 摩西：个人名字或姓氏；在马来语文本中通常保留姓名原拼写 Moses。
senses.en_definition: A personal name or surname normally retained in its original spelling in Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi atau nama keluarga yang biasanya dikekalkan ejaannya sebagai Moses dalam bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 指现实人物时，不应自动改名为 Musa，也不能从名字推断其宗教。姓名用法与宗教人物义应按上下文区分；参见 [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/moses)。下列为姓名的常规搭配。

etymology.historical_story: English Moses reaches back through Greek and Latin forms to Hebrew Moshe. Exodus links the child's naming with his rescue from water, a memorable explanation within the biblical narrative rather than a settled linguistic derivation. The Malay Bible uses Musa in that passage. For a living person named Moses, however, translation should preserve the person's own name. Sources: [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/moses), [Keluaran 2:10](https://www.bible.com/bible/402/EXO.2.10.BM).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 Moses 读近“谋－ ziz”，宗教人物对应中文“摩西”、马来语 Musa；遇到现实人物姓名则保留 Moses，不自动替换。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为宗教借词整体记忆；词尾 -ias 不是马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为按拼写推定的马来语读法，输入没有权威音标。

senses.zh_definition: 弥赛亚，意为“受膏者”：犹太教传统中所期待的拯救者或君王；基督教将这一称号用于耶稣。
senses.en_definition: The Messiah: the anticipated deliverer in Jewish tradition, identified by Christians with Jesus.
senses.ms_definition: Tokoh penyelamat yang dinantikan dalam tradisi Yahudi; dalam kepercayaan Kristian, gelaran ini merujuk kepada Yesus Kristus.
senses.nuances: 作为特定宗教称号通常写作 Mesias。应区分不同宗教对其身份的理解。马来语《Alkitab Versi Borneo》的《约翰福音》1:41 明确使用 Mesias，并说明其与 Kristus 对应；本马来语释义为编辑综合释义，不冒称 DBP 原文。[AVB《约翰福音》1](https://www.bible.com/ms/bible/2271/JHN.1.AVB?parallel=2271)、[Merriam-Webster：Messiah](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/messiah)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合宗教文本、历史和比较宗教讨论。日常称某人为“弥赛亚”可能带有讽刺或夸大意味；在庄重宗教场合应避免随意用作玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: The title ultimately belongs to the Hebrew and Aramaic word family meaning “anointed.” Its religious history connects anointing with a specially designated figure. Malay Christian scripture preserves Mesias alongside Kristus: John 1:41 explicitly links the two titles. These connections establish the historical background, although they do not identify Malay’s precise immediate borrowing route. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/messiah), [AVB](https://www.bible.com/ms/bible/2271/JHN.1.AVB?parallel=2271)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mesias 可借声音联想“弥赛亚”；脑中配上“受膏者”的画面，记住它是宗教称号。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语整词借入，现代马来语中作为独立词根使用；memuktamadkan 中，meN- 在 m 前实现为 me-，词根的 m 保留。

senses.en_definition: Final and settled; no longer open to amendment.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak boleh dipinda-pinda lagi; pasti dan tetap.
senses.nuances: 现代最常用义，常修饰决定、结果、立场或协议。与 akhir 的区别是：akhir 可以只表示顺序上的最后，muktamad 强调已经定案。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：muktamad](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=muktamad)。

senses.zh_definition: 可信赖的；值得信任的，尤指人。
senses.en_definition: Trustworthy or dependable, especially of a person.
senses.ms_definition: Boleh dipercayai; menjadi tempat kepercayaan.
senses.nuances: 词典保留的传统义，现代一般交谈更常用 boleh dipercayai。下列是说明此义的传统搭配形式，现代使用频率低于 keputusan muktamad。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：muktamad](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=muktamad)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Keputusan muktamad mengenai cadangan tersebut akan diumumkan selepas mesyuarat lembaga pengarah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 有关该提案的最终决定将在董事会会议后公布。
dual_scenarios.en: The final decision on the proposal will be announced after the board meeting.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tarikh tu dah muktamad ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah tarikh itu sudah muktamad?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个日期已经定下来了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Is that date final?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
dah 对应 sudah。
句末 ke 构成口语疑问。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Tarikh bengkel tu dah muktamad ke? Aku nak tempah tiket.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah tarikh bengkel itu sudah muktamad? Saya hendak menempah tiket.
messages.zh: 工作坊的日期已经定了吗？我想订票。
messages.en: Is the workshop date final? I want to book my ticket.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, Jumaat depan. Tempah je, tarikh tu memang muktamad.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, tarikhnya pada hari Jumaat depan. Tempahlah tiket; tarikh itu memang sudah muktamad.
messages.zh: 定了，下周五。订吧，日期已经确定了。
messages.en: Yes, next Friday. Go ahead and book; the date is confirmed.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: muktamad 语气明确而有权威感。对客户、长辈或上级说明尚未确定的事项时，用 belum muktamad 比武断地宣布结果更妥当。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合正式决定、评审结果和协商定案。日常对人说 Itu muktamad! 容易显得强硬；若仍愿意讨论，应说明目前的决定或尚待确认。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: muktamad 语气明确而有权威感。对客户、长辈或上级说明尚未确定的事项时，用 belum muktamad 比武断地宣布结果更妥当。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合正式决定、评审结果和协商定案。日常对人说 Itu muktamad! 容易显得强硬；若仍愿意讨论，应说明目前的决定或尚待确认。

etymology.historical_story: Muktamad is an Arabic loan associated with being trusted or relied upon. Malay dictionaries preserve that older meaning alongside the now familiar sense of a settled decision. The connection offers a useful semantic bridge: something accepted as dependable can also be treated as authoritative and final. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=muktamad).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 muk-ta-mad 想成盖章的三声：决定落下三道章，事情就定案了。

morphology.formula: ∅ + melayang → melayang（按输入登记）；meN- + layang → melayang（构词分析）
morphology.pattern_note: 根形字段保留输入的独立词条登记。实际构词可分析为 meN- + layang，meN- 在 l 前实现为 me-，l 保留。切薄片义与飘浮义分属同形异义词，不能据字形认定同源。[DBP：layang 的同形异义词](https://dbp.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Buletin-MABBIM-2023.pdf)。

word_family.gloss: 使飞起；投送；寄出，属飘浮义词族

senses.zh_definition: 把芒果等水果或其他食材切成薄片。
senses.en_definition: To slice fruit or other ingredients thinly.
senses.ms_definition: Menghiris nipis-nipis, seperti buah mangga atau bawang.
senses.nuances: 输入所指的切片义。属于及物用法，在传统表达中较突出；现代日常说明通常用 menghiris nipis。它与表示飘浮的 melayang 是同形异义词。[DBP：melayang 的切片义](https://dbp.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Buletin-MABBIM-2023.pdf)。

collocations.zh: 把洋葱或小葱头切成薄片
collocations.en: to slice onions or shallots thinly

senses.zh_definition: 在空中飘动、滑翔或缓缓飘落；指鸟时强调不拍动翅膀的飞行。
senses.en_definition: To glide, drift, or float through the air, especially without flapping wings.
senses.ms_definition: Terbang tanpa mengipas-ngipaskan sayap atau terkatung-katung di udara.
senses.nuances: 现代常用义，多为不及物动词。纸张、树叶、风筝和鸟都可作主语，不限于有生命的飞行者。[DBP PRPM：layang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=layang)。

senses.zh_definition: 悬浮在水中，既不沉到底，也不浮到水面。
senses.en_definition: To remain suspended in water, neither sinking nor rising to the surface.
senses.ms_definition: Berada di dalam air tanpa tenggelam ke dasar atau timbul ke permukaan.
senses.nuances: 不能一概译作浮在水面；若强调水面漂浮，terapung 更明确。[DBP PRPM：layang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=layang)。

senses.zh_definition: 思绪飘远；走神、遐想或心神不定。
senses.en_definition: To wander or drift away, of thoughts or attention.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak tenang atau menerawang ke tempat atau perkara lain, berkenaan dengan fikiran.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，常与 fikiran 连用。可以表示回忆、幻想或注意力分散，不必然表示疾病。[DBP PRPM：melayang 的比喻用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=melayang)。

senses.zh_definition: 失去、消失或白白耗掉，常指金钱、机会等。
senses.en_definition: To be lost, disappear, or be wasted, especially of money or opportunities.
senses.ms_definition: Hilang atau lenyap, termasuk wang dan peluang dalam penggunaan kiasan.
senses.nuances: 把原本拥有或可能获得的东西想象成飞走，日常谈钱时常带懊恼语气。基本的消失义见：[DBP PRPM：layang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=layang)。

senses.zh_definition: 丧失，指生命；死亡。
senses.en_definition: To be lost, of a life; to perish.
senses.ms_definition: Hilang atau lenyap, berkenaan dengan nyawa; mati.
senses.nuances: nyawa melayang 是新闻和叙事中的固定表达，语气严肃。[DBP PRPM：layang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=layang)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam demonstrasi masakan tradisional itu, peserta mempelajari cara melayang mangga untuk menghasilkan hirisan nipis yang sekata.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该传统烹饪示范中，参与者学习把芒果切成均匀薄片的方法。
dual_scenarios.en: During the traditional cooking demonstration, participants learned to cut mangoes into thin, even slices.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nenek tengah melayang mangga kat dapur tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Nenek sedang melayang mangga di dapur itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 奶奶正在厨房里把芒果切成薄片呢。
dual_scenarios.en: Grandma's in the kitchen slicing mangoes thinly.
spoken_features: 此处特意保留输入的切片义，现代口语更常说 hiris mangga nipis-nipis。
tengah 对应表示进行的 sedang。
kat 对应地点介词 di，tu 对应 itu。

messages.speaker: Aina (孙女)
messages.ms_spoken: Nek, nenek tengah melayang mangga ke? Saya nak tolong.
messages.ms_standard: Nenek, adakah nenek sedang melayang mangga? Saya hendak membantu.
messages.zh: 奶奶，你正在切芒果薄片吗？我想帮忙。
messages.en: Grandma, are you slicing the mangoes? I'd like to help.

messages.speaker: Hajah Mariam (奶奶)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, nenek hiris nipis-nipis je. Ambilkan mangkuk kat rak tu, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, nenek hanya menghirisnya nipis-nipis. Tolong ambilkan mangkuk di rak itu.
messages.zh: 对，奶奶把它切薄一点。帮我拿一下架子上的碗吧。
messages.en: Yes, I'm just cutting them into thin slices. Pass me the bowl from that shelf, please.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: pipi bagai pauh dilayang 属传统文学式赞美。现代职场不宜随意评论他人的脸部或外貌；描述烹饪方法时没有特殊礼貌限制。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 切片义在普通交流中可用 menghiris nipis 帮助理解。谈损失时 duit melayang 带口语情绪；涉及死亡的 nyawa melayang 应保持严肃。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: pipi bagai pauh dilayang 属传统文学式赞美。现代职场不宜随意评论他人的脸部或外貌；描述烹饪方法时没有特殊礼貌限制。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 切片义在普通交流中可用 menghiris nipis 帮助理解。谈损失时 duit melayang 带口语情绪；涉及死亡的 nyawa melayang 应保持严肃。

etymology.historical_story: Traditional Malay descriptions compare full, smooth cheeks to pauh dilayang, a mango sliced thinly. This preserves the slicing sense of melayang, which can surprise learners familiar with its airborne namesake. DBP distinguishes the relevant homonyms, so their identical spelling should not become an invented story that slicing historically developed from flying. [Source: DBP, Buletin MABBIM](https://dbp.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Buletin-MABBIM-2023.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记两幅画：厨房里 melayang mangga，是切薄片；天空中 daun melayang，是叶子飘。用场景区分同形词。

morphology.formula: ∅ + menyapu → menyapu（按词包整体立目）；实际构词：meN- + sapu → menyapu
morphology.pattern_note: 依要求保留词包的 root_word、root_jawi 和 is_root；这些字段不代表正确的现代构词分析。语言学上的词根是 sapu：meN- 遇词首 s 时变为 meny-，s 脱落，ny 表示 /ɲ/。

word_family.gloss: 擦拭、涂抹的动作或痕迹
把某物涂抹上去；替人扫

senses.zh_definition: 用扫帚清扫地面等处。
senses.en_definition: To clean a floor or another area with a broom.
senses.ms_definition: Membersihkan lantai atau kawasan dengan menggunakan penyapu.
senses.nuances: 最常用义。通常直接接被清扫的地方，如 lantai、halaman。[DBP：menyapu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=menyapu)

senses.zh_definition: 用手、布等擦拭、拂拭或抹去某物。
senses.en_definition: To wipe, rub, or brush something, or wipe something away.
senses.ms_definition: Mengesat, mengusap atau menghapuskan sesuatu dengan tangan, kain dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 包括抹去液体及轻轻抚拭。反复轻拭可说 menyapu-nyapu。

senses.zh_definition: 将油漆、药膏、粉末等涂抹或敷在表面。
senses.en_definition: To apply or spread paint, ointment, powder, or another substance over a surface.
senses.ms_definition: Melumas atau melumur sesuatu permukaan dengan cat, ubat, bedak dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 表面可作宾语：menyapu dinding dengan cat。强调把材料涂到某处时，也可用 menyapukan。

senses.zh_definition: 因高度或堆叠高度达到某处而触及、挨到。
senses.en_definition: To reach or touch something because of height.
senses.ms_definition: Mencecah atau sampai ke sesuatu bahagian kerana terlalu tinggi.
senses.nuances: 较少见的描写义，常用于高堆的物品触及屋梁等处；以下为释义搭配。

collocations.en: be stacked up to the crossbeam

senses.zh_definition: 席卷、夺尽或耗尽；在比赛中包揽全部奖项或胜利。
senses.en_definition: To take, consume, or destroy everything; to win everything available.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil, menghabiskan atau membinasakan semuanya; memperoleh atau memenangi kesemuanya.
senses.nuances: 常见于 menyapu bersih。指钱财被拿光时，通常带批评意味。

senses.zh_definition: 用藤条责打，作为惩罚。
senses.en_definition: To beat with a cane as punishment.
senses.ms_definition: Memukul dengan rotan sebagai hukuman.
senses.nuances: 词包所录义确实见于《Kamus Dewan》，但非常用义。现代通常用 merotan；以下为释义组合，不标作高频搭配。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Petugas kebersihan menyapu lantai dewan sebelum majlis bermula.
dual_scenarios.zh: 清洁人员在活动开始前清扫礼堂地面。
dual_scenarios.en: The cleaning staff sweep the hall floor before the event begins.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah menyapu ruang tamu tadi. Kau nak mop sekarang?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah menyapu ruang tamu tadi. Adakah awak mahu mengemopnya sekarang?

dah 对应 sudah，nak 对应 mahu
口语可保留完整的 menyapu，也常省略前缀说 sapu
mop 作口语动词，对应标准形式 mengemop

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah menyapu ruang tamu tadi. Kau nak mop sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah menyapu ruang tamu tadi. Adakah awak mahu mengemopnya sekarang?

messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, aku mop kejap lagi. Kau rehat je dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, saya akan mengemopnya sebentar lagi. Awak berehat dahulu.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请别人打扫时可用 Boleh tolong sapu lantai?；对长辈或不熟的人，加入称呼和 tolong 比直接命令更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 日常家务、清洁和涂抹场景均适用。说某人 menyapu habis wang 带有拿光钱财的指责意味；藤条责打义须有明确上下文。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请别人打扫时可用 Boleh tolong sapu lantai?；对长辈或不熟的人，加入称呼和 tolong 比直接命令更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 日常家务、清洁和涂抹场景均适用。说某人 menyapu habis wang 带有拿光钱财的指责意味；藤条责打义须有明确上下文。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionary evidence records several meanings under menyapu: sweeping, wiping, coating, reaching and taking everything. Their shared surface-motion imagery offers a useful learning connection, although it does not establish their historical order. The dictionary also records caning separately, so that uncommon meaning should not replace the everyday household senses. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=menyapu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 sapu 的“扫过表面”动作：扫过地面是清扫，扫过皮肤是擦或涂，扫光奖牌就是包揽。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接以 k 开头的 kesan 时，k 脱落，前缀鼻音实现为 /ŋ/；不是把整词拆成 menge- 加 san。

senses.zh_definition: 在某物表面留下痕迹、印记、线条或划痕。
senses.en_definition: To leave or produce a physical mark, impression, line, or scratch.
senses.ms_definition: Menghasilkan bekas, tanda, garisan atau goresan pada sesuatu permukaan.
senses.nuances: 强调“留下痕迹”，不等于 mengesan 的“探测、查出”。此义通常需要说明留下什么，或留下痕迹的位置。

collocations.en: imprint a pattern on a surface

senses.zh_definition: 使人产生明显或深刻的心理感受；留下难忘的印象或情绪影响。
senses.en_definition: To make a strong impression or leave a lasting emotional effect.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan pengaruh atau tanggapan yang kuat dalam fikiran atau perasaan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 可用于感人、震撼或令人不快的体验，不必然是赞美。表示措施“有效”通常用 berkesan。此处按动词处理，yang mengesankan 可自然译成“令人印象深刻的”。依据：[DBP：mengesankan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengesankan)。

collocations.en: a speech that makes a strong impression

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Persembahan teater itu mengesankan kerana berjaya menonjolkan pengalaman keluarga yang terjejas oleh banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这场戏剧演出令人印象深刻，因为它成功呈现了受洪灾影响家庭的经历。
dual_scenarios.en: The theatre performance made a strong impression by vividly portraying the experiences of families affected by flooding.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Filem tu memang mengesankan, kan? Aku masih teringat babak akhir dia.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Filem itu benar-benar mengesankan, bukan? Saya masih teringat akan babak akhirnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那部电影真的让人忘不了，对吧？我现在还想着最后那一幕。
dual_scenarios.en: That film really stays with you, doesn't it? I keep thinking about the final scene.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
kan 在句末寻求认同。
aku 用于熟人之间；babak akhir dia 口语中相当于 babak akhirnya。
mengesankan 本身偏书面，但可出现在讨论电影或艺术的聊天中。

messages.speaker: Nadia (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Filem tu memang mengesankan, kan? Aku masih teringat babak akhir dia.
messages.ms_standard: Filem itu benar-benar mengesankan, bukan? Saya masih teringat akan babak akhirnya.
messages.zh: 那部电影真的让人忘不了，对吧？我现在还想着最后那一幕。
messages.en: That film really stays with you, doesn't it? I keep thinking about the final scene.

messages.speaker: Hafiz (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, aku dah tengok dua kali pun masih sebak.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, walaupun saya sudah menontonnya dua kali, saya masih berasa sebak.
messages.zh: 是啊，我都看两遍了，还是会鼻子一酸。
messages.en: Yeah, I've seen it twice and it still gets me choked up.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 评价演讲、作品或表演时语气较郑重。赞赏他人可说 Persembahan anda sangat mengesankan，并补充具体原因。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不要把它机械理解为“优秀”或“有效”；不愉快的事件同样可能留下深刻影响。表达负面感受时应交代原因，以免被误解为赞美。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价演讲、作品或表演时语气较郑重。赞赏他人可说 Persembahan anda sangat mengesankan，并补充具体原因。

etymology.historical_story: Kesan brings together a visible trace and an effect left on the mind. Mengesankan makes that connection especially clear: a tool can mark a surface, while a story can mark a listener's feelings. These linked dictionary senses offer a cultural bridge between material impressions and the emotional force of speeches, performances, and memories.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kesan 是“印痕／印象”：mengesankan 就像把印章盖到纸上或心里——留下印记，留下感受。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇词根开头的清辅音 p，通常以 m 替代 p：pihak → memihak。输入包将派生词标为词根，此处按 DBP 的 pihak 词族纠正。[DBP：pihak](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=pihak)

senses.zh_definition: 站在争议、竞争或对立关系中的某一方，支持该方或加入其阵营。
senses.en_definition: To take the side of, support, or align oneself with a particular party or group.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebelahi salah satu pihak, memasuki salah satu kumpulan atau golongan.
senses.nuances: 常用 memihak kepada seseorang/sesuatu pihak，表示支持对象；tidak memihak 表示不偏袒、保持中立。该词本身不必然指不公正，是否带有偏袒意味取决于语境。马来语定义依据输入包所载《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》。

senses.zh_definition: 形容结果、形势或条件对某一方有利。
senses.en_definition: To favor a particular party through an outcome, circumstance, or advantage.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan kelebihan atau membawa keadaan yang menguntungkan sesuatu pihak.
senses.nuances: 这是“站在某方”意义的引申用法；主语可以是 keputusan、nasib 或 keadaan，无须具有主动选择立场的意志。此处马来语释义为编写性概括。

collocations.en: the result favors the home team

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds memihak from pihak, meaning a side or party, using the productive verbal prefix meN-. The initial p gives way to m, making the relationship less obvious to beginners. Its imagery is spatial: supporting someone means standing on their side. This explains both personal allegiance and figurative expressions about favorable outcomes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pihak 是“一方”；memihak 就是“站到这一方”。记住 p → m，再用 kepada 接支持对象。

senses.zh_definition: 违反法律、规则、习俗或既定原则；与其要求相抵触。

etymology.historical_story: Menyalahi belongs to the Malay salah family, which connects error with wrongdoing. Its dictionary examples extend from adat, or customary norms, to linguistic rules, showing how the same verb can describe departures from social and technical standards. The related menyalahkan takes a different direction: it assigns fault to someone. [Source: PRPM salah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=salah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 salah＝错：menyalahi 是“做法碰上规则而出错”，menyalahkan 则是“把错归到某人身上”。

morphology.formula: mendapat + -nya → mendapatnya；底层构词：meN- + dapat → mendapat
morphology.pattern_note: 依数据包保留直接基底 mendapat，进一步的词根为 dapat。meN- 在 d 前实现为 men-，d 保留；-nya 是附着式代词，在此充当宾语，并非派生后缀。数据包所给爪夷文仅对应 mendapat，缺少 -nya；完整词形可规则转写为 منداڤتڽ。IPA 为规则推定。

senses.zh_definition: 得到、获得或收到前文提及的人或事物；-nya 指代该宾语。
senses.en_definition: To obtain or receive it, him, or her, with the object identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Menerima atau beroleh sesuatu atau seseorang yang dirujuk oleh kata ganti -nya.
senses.nuances: 通常译为“得到它／收到它”，具体译法随宾语变化。-nya 在这里不表示“从他／她那里”。official 指规范语法构成，并不表示 mendapatnya 是 DBP 独立收录的词头；马来语释义据 mendapat 的词典义改写。[DBP：mendapat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mendapat)

senses.zh_definition: 经历或遭遇前文提及的状况，尤其是不幸、困难或疾病等。
senses.en_definition: To experience or suffer the previously mentioned condition or misfortune.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalami atau menemui keadaan yang telah disebut, seperti kesusahan atau penyakit.
senses.nuances: 这一读法要求前文提供明确的状况指称。例如先提到某种疾病，随后 mendapatnya 才可表示“患上这种病”。不能把词根 dapat 的情态义“能够”直接套入此形式。[DBP：mendapat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mendapat)
