etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan separates two entries for anggap: the familiar verb of considering, and a classical verb associated with inviting someone to dance by a gesture. Their shared spelling does not establish that one meaning developed from the other. In menganggapnya, the attached pronoun identifies the person or thing being considered, while context selects the meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: menganggap＝认为、视为；-nya＝前面提到的他／她／它。记住作为补语的 sebagai：“把它视为……”

morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入的直接基底 matikan；更深层为 mati + -kan，表示使动。此处 -nya 通常回指受事“它／他／她”，不是领属“它的”。/n/ 与 /ɲ/ 相接，拼写保留 n + ny。独立使用常为祈使式；正式主动陈述通常用 mematikannya。

senses.zh_definition: 将所指的设备、引擎、电源等关闭或停止运行；将所指的火或灯熄灭。
senses.en_definition: Switch it off, stop its operation, or extinguish it.
senses.ms_definition: Hentikan operasi alat yang dirujuk, atau padamkan api atau lampu itu.
senses.nuances: 日常最常见于设备语境；-nya 回指先前提到的对象。不能用于表示“把它打开”。参见 [DBP：mematikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=mematikan)。

senses.zh_definition: 使所指的人、动物、植物或其他生物死亡；将其杀死。
senses.en_definition: Kill the person or organism referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Jadikan manusia atau organisma yang dirujuk tidak bernyawa lagi.
senses.nuances: 这是使动义，不能理解为对象自然死亡。用于人时措辞强烈；例如细菌语境中的“杀死它们”则是中性技术表达。

senses.zh_definition: 使所指的行动、希望、论点或作用停止、受阻或失效；在固定搭配中也可指使结扣等固定不动。
senses.en_definition: Stop, suppress, neutralize, or fix the thing referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Sekat gerak atau kesannya, atau tetapkan sesuatu supaya tidak berubah.
senses.nuances: 属于引申用法；具体译法取决于受事。关闭设备、压制希望与固定结扣共享“使其不再活动或变化”的概念，不能一律译成“杀死”。

senses.zh_definition: 将所指的邮票或印花注销；在文件办理语境中，指为有关文件完成印花手续。
senses.en_definition: Cancel the stamp referred to; in document contexts, have it duly stamped.
senses.ms_definition: Batalkan penggunaan semula setem itu; dalam urusan dokumen, sempurnakan penyetemannya.
senses.nuances: 这是 setem 的固定搭配，不表示把合同作废。公文中可见 mematikan setem perjanjian。用例参见 [DBP：出版资助说明](https://lamanweb.dbp.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/BROSUR-DANA-PENERBITAN-DI-BAWAH-INISIATIF-BELANJAWAN-2023.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 将所指分数的分子和分母同时除以同一个非零公因数，进行约分。
senses.en_definition: Reduce the fraction by dividing its numerator and denominator by a common factor.
senses.ms_definition: Ringkaskan pecahan itu dengan membahagikan pengangka dan penyebutnya dengan faktor sepunya.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的数学专门义，现代教学中 mempermudah pecahan 或 meringkaskan pecahan 更易理解。以下为专门搭配，日常频率低。

collocations.zh: 将分子和分母同时约去公因数
collocations.en: divide out a common factor from the numerator and denominator

etymology.historical_story: This form builds on mati through two transparent grammatical steps: -kan makes the meaning causative, and -nya supplies a contextual object. Its everyday range shows how Malay connects biological life with activity: an engine can be described as alive while running, then made inactive. DBP also records an older mathematical application to reducing fractions. See [DBP: mematikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=mematikan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mati 是“死／停”，-kan 是“使它如此”，-nya 是“它”：使它停下来 → 把它关掉。

morphology.formula: mengiring + -i → mengiringi；完整分析：meN- + iring + -i → mengiringi
morphology.pattern_note: 依输入保留 mengiring 作为直接构词基础；最底层词根是 iring I（跟随、伴随）。元音 i 前的 meN- 实现为 meng-，原词首元音保留；添加 -i 后，词尾 /ŋ/ 与后接元音构成新音节。勿与表示侧身的 iring II 混淆。[DBP 词族及释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengiring%2C+mengiringi+1)

word_family.gloss: 陪同者；护送人员；伴奏者

senses.zh_definition: 陪同、护送或随行于某人，通常为了照应、保护、引导或表示敬意。
senses.en_definition: To accompany or escort someone, especially for assistance, protection or respect.
senses.ms_definition: Menemani seseorang untuk mengawal, membantu atau menghormatinya; menyertai atau mengikuti seseorang.
senses.nuances: 属及物动词，通常直接接陪同对象，不必加 kepada。比 teman 或 temankan 更庄重，但也可用于日常陪伴；不必然表示武装护送。

senses.zh_definition: 与某事物同时出现、随之发生，或作为附随内容一同存在。
senses.en_definition: To occur alongside or following something, or to accompany it as an associated element.
senses.ms_definition: Berlaku atau terdapat berserta atau berikutan dengan sesuatu; menyertai sesuatu kejadian, keadaan atau hasil.
senses.nuances: 主语可以是掌声、声音、说明文字或其他事件。表示伴随关系，不自动表示因果；被动 diiringi 常用于叙述事件。

senses.zh_definition: 用乐器演奏，为歌手、歌唱或其他表演提供伴奏。
senses.en_definition: To provide instrumental accompaniment for a singer or performance.
senses.ms_definition: Memainkan alat muzik sebagai iringan ketika seseorang menyanyi atau membuat persembahan.
senses.nuances: 这是音乐语境中的专门用法；主语通常是乐手或乐团，宾语可为歌手或表演。DBP《Kamus Pelajar》另列这一义项。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengiring%2C+mengiringi+1)

collocations.en: provide accompaniment for a dance performance

etymology.historical_story: Mengiringi belongs to the iring family of following and accompanying. Kamus Dewan illustrates its escort sense with warriors accompanying a Bendahara, a senior office in traditional Malay government. Modern usage also accommodates accompanying notes, events and music. These connections offer a cultural picture of someone or something proceeding together with another. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengiring%2C+mengiringi+1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iring 想成一支随行队伍：人跟人是陪同，声音跟表演是伴奏，说明跟图片是附随。

morphology.pattern_note: 不按马来语词缀拆分。作为人名通常首字母大写；不同语言中的读音不同，资料包未确定所指人物，故不指定唯一音标或爪夷文拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 马里乌斯：男性人名，也见于古罗马氏族名；本资料包未确定具体所指。
senses.en_definition: Marius, a masculine personal name also attested as a Roman family name; the particular referent is unspecified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang turut ditemukan sebagai nama keluarga Rom; individu yang dimaksudkan tidak dikenal pasti dalam bahan yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 按专有名词处理，不能据此赋予马来语普通词义。人名身份及拉丁语背景可参见 [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/2015/2/name/Marius)。以下搭配和例句为教学示例，不代表已经核实的高频搭配或真实人物事迹。status 沿用用户指定的数据标签，不表示已经获得 DBP 词条认证；frequency_rank 来自资料包。

etymology.historical_story: Marius belonged to the Roman naming tradition before becoming a personal name in later European usage. The Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources identifies it as a Roman family name and treats its deeper origin as uncertain. Its appearance in Malay discourse therefore identifies a person rather than establishing a Malay common noun. [Source](https://dmnes.org/2015/2/name/Marius)

senses.zh_definition: 审理并裁断案件，判断有关人或事的是非、罪责。

senses.zh_definition: 对他人的品行、动机或行为作出是非判断，常含轻率评断或指责之意。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Awak suka menghakimi orang（你老爱评断别人）带有指责意味，容易让对方难堪。与长辈、上司或不熟的人讨论时，可说 Sebaiknya kita fahami keadaannya dahulu（我们最好先了解一下他的情况），用 kita 把自己也包含在提醒之中。

etymology.historical_story: Menghakimi is built from hakim, an Arabic loanword meaning a judge, using Malay meN- and -i. Its structure shows how Malay turns a borrowed title into a verb: the judge becomes the act of judging. The same judicial image also works in everyday relationships, where someone who menghakimi others figuratively takes the judge's seat and decides whether their conduct is right or wrong.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住词中的 hakim（法官）：menghakimi 就是“坐上法官席，判断是非”。对朋友这样做，就成了“评断别人”。

morphology.formula: meN- + bimbangkan → membimbangkan；完整构词：meN- + bimbang + -kan → membimbangkan
morphology.pattern_note: 此处 root_word 保留输入中的直接基底 bimbangkan；基本词根为 bimbang。meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，保留 b；完整形式的 meN-...-kan 表示使人产生担忧。

senses.zh_definition: 使人担心、忧虑或不安；引起对不良情况或后果的担忧。
senses.en_definition: To cause worry, anxiety, or concern.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan rasa bimbang, khuatir atau risau; mengkhuatirkan; merisaukan.
senses.nuances: 主语通常是引发担忧的事情。Keadaan itu membimbangkan 表示情况令人担忧；Saya bimbang 表示我感到担忧。常见于 amat membimbangkan 等描述性结构，核心仍是引起担忧。词义依据：[DBP：bimbang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=bimbang)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay distinguishes a person's feeling from the thing that produces it. Bimbang names being worried; membimbangkan makes something the cause of that worry. Its structure combines bimbang with meN-...-kan, and DBP records this causative relationship. The useful cultural lesson is grammatical: reports can describe a troubling situation without directly blaming a person. [DBP: bimbang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=bimbang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bimbang＝担心；加上 meN-...-kan，把担心推给别人：membimbangkan＝令人担心。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，词根开头的 b 保留；belasah 是完整词根，不拆成 belas 与其他成分。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary connects two vivid meanings: physically thrashing someone and decisively defeating an opponent. DBP marks the sporting meaning as figurative, showing how the image of a heavy beating also describes a crushing loss. Membelasah is transparently formed from belasah with meN-; this explanation does not establish a more remote historical origin. [DBP: belasah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=belasah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belasah 连成一个动作画面：狠狠地打；换到球场上，就是把对手打得惨败。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 b 前实现为 mem-，词根 b 保留；后缀 -i 接在 biaya 后。词包将完整词形标为词根，此处依据 DBP 的 biaya 词条订正。参见 [DBP PRPM：biaya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=biaya)。

etymology.historical_story: The story of membiayai is visible in its Malay word family. Biaya names an expense; membiayai turns that noun into the act of meeting an expense. Pembiaya identifies the funding party, while pembiayaan names the provision of funds. Together, these forms connect household spending with the language of education, business, and public administration. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=biaya).

etymology.historical_story: Merendahkan grows from rendah, meaning low. Its causative structure links physical lowering with social evaluation: a voice can be lowered, a person belittled, or the self humbled. Malay advice also connects knowledge with modesty through the image of rice bending as it fills. See [DBP on rendah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=rendah) and [the rice proverb](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=merendahkan+diri).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rendah 是“低”，merendahkan 是“使之低”：声音低下来、把别人看低、让自己谦逊，关键看宾语。

senses.zh_definition: 使某事晚于原定、预期或适当时间发生；延迟、推迟或耽误。
senses.en_definition: To cause something to happen later than planned or expected; to delay or postpone.

etymology.historical_story: Melewatkan is transparently formed within Malay from lewat, meaning late in this construction, with meN- and -kan. The resulting verb makes lateness something caused to another event or process. Its everyday cultural setting includes departures, appointments, and payments: the same grammatical pattern connects a late situation with the action that produces it. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=melewatkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lewat 是“晚”，meN-...-kan 表示“使……变晚”：melewatkan pembayaran，就是把付款拖晚。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat presents menentu through the expression tidak menentu, describing a lack of order, regularity, or stability. The useful learning story is therefore about a phrase, rather than a securely documented ancient origin. Weather, earnings, and feelings can all lack a steady pattern, allowing the same expression to connect practical uncertainty with an unsettled state of mind.

etymology.historical_story: Memotongnya grows from potong, the everyday Malay base for cutting. Its physical meaning provides a useful bridge to abstract uses: a salary can be cut, a conversation cut short, and a journey shortened. The ending -nya contributes a separate piece of information, identifying an object already understood from the conversation rather than creating another cutting sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 potong＝切；memotong＝进行切的动作；最后贴上 -nya＝切它。再把“切掉一部分”联想到扣薪、缩短和打断。

etymology.historical_story: Menerbangkan develops transparently from terbang, meaning to fly. Its causative structure connects familiar scenes: releasing a bird, lifting a kite, and sending an aircraft into the sky. The same verb extends naturally to transporting passengers and supplies by air. A figurative branch treats stolen money as something made to fly away from its owner.

etymology.historical_story: English mountain came through Middle English and Old French forms ultimately connected with Latin mons, meaning mountain. Its history belongs to English rather than Malay word formation. The concrete image also supports a figurative sense: work, debt, or other burdens can become an enormous mountain in ordinary English expression. Source: [American Heritage](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=mountain).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /ˈmaʊn.tɪn/ 时想象一座高山，再连成三语：mountain → gunung → 山。

etymology.historical_story: For the Nintendo referent, the relevant history is character naming rather than Malay word formation. Nintendo records that Shigeru Miyamoto created the character, who appeared as Jumpman in Donkey Kong in 1981. Mario later became the name associated with a wide range of adventures. Its use in Malay preserves a proper name rather than creating a native derivative. [Nintendo's character history](https://www.nintendo.com/us/whatsnew/wahoo-see-the-platforming-history-of-super-mario-and-even-get-a-few-fun-facts/)

etymology.historical_story: The English compound combines mother with fucker, drawing its force from sexual and family taboos. Its established uses extend to intense abuse, frustration and admiration. Etymonline records the related form motherfucking in an early twentieth-century American court account, illustrating its circulation before the noun became widely documented. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/motherfucker).

etymology.historical_story: Memetik is formed from the Malay base petik through a regular nasal-prefix pattern. Flower picking appears in Malay pantun, while the same word also describes handling strings and selecting passages from writing. These familiar settings offer a useful semantic connection: the hand, or the writer, singles something out through a small, deliberate action.

etymology.historical_story: Malay ingat supports a family of words connecting memory, attention, and caution. Mengingati focuses on keeping someone or something in mind, while the attached -nya supplies the remembered object. Remembering a teacher’s advice or a benefactor’s kindness gives this ordinary memory verb a cultural resonance: remembrance can also express gratitude and enduring respect. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengingati).

senses.nuances: 规范拼写为 Melayu，首字母大写。orang Melayu 指马来人；orang Malaysia 指马来西亚人，两者范围不同。budaya Melayu 等结构中的 Melayu 表示族群归属。词义与大小写依据 [DBP：Melayu 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kemelayuan)。

senses.zh_definition: 马来语；通常用于完整名称 bahasa Melayu，也可在语境明确时简称 Melayu。
senses.en_definition: The Malay language, normally named bahasa Melayu.
senses.ms_definition: Nama bahasa yang digunakan oleh orang Melayu dan juga oleh penutur daripada pelbagai kaum.
senses.nuances: 正式行文通常使用 bahasa Melayu，句中 bahasa 小写、Melayu 大写。会说马来语不等于属于马来族；语言能力与族群身份须分开理解。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran ini memperkenalkan seni dan budaya Melayu kepada pengunjung daripada pelbagai latar belakang.

je 对应 sahaja
cakap 在熟人交流中常替代较完整的 bercakap 或 bertutur
标准对应句补出表示语言媒介的 dalam

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak cuba cakap bahasa Melayu hari ni. Kalau salah, tegur je ya.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu mencuba bercakap dalam bahasa Melayu hari ini. Jika saya membuat kesalahan, tegurlah saya.

messages.en: Of course! Let's start by speaking Malay slowly.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 族名和语言名均应写作 Melayu。尊重当事人的身份认同，不凭外貌、姓名或语言能力替别人判断族群。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈文化、语言和族群时应明确所指。传统表达 masuk Melayu 在特定历史语境中可涉及文化融入或皈依伊斯兰教；现代交流若明确指皈依，应使用 memeluk Islam，避免混淆宗教与族群。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈文化、语言和族群时应明确所指。传统表达 masuk Melayu 在特定历史语境中可涉及文化融入或皈依伊斯兰教；现代交流若明确指皈依，应使用 memeluk Islam，避免混淆宗教与族群。

etymology.historical_story: Melayu is a historical name, not a modern derivation from layu, meaning wilted. Its cultural reach grew through regional kingdoms and the prestige of fifteenth-century Melaka, where language, custom, and identity became closely connected. Competing explanations of its ultimate origin should not be presented as settled linguistic fact. See [DBP's discussion of Malay identity](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/wacanafikrah_okt.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Melayu 整词连到三幅画面：orang Melayu（马来人）、bahasa Melayu（马来语）、budaya Melayu（马来文化）；不要拆成 layu。

headword.status_note: 这是标准派生动词 mengembalikan 加宾语附着代词 -nya 的形式。jawi 按输入保留，但输入拼写只对应 mengembalikan；加上 -nya 后为 مڠمباليکنڽ。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按输入保留直接基础词 mengembalikan；更底层词根是 kembali。meN- 接以 k 开头的 kembali 时取 meng-，词根首辅音 k 脱落。-nya 是第三人称宾语附着代词，与动词连写，不表示过去时；此处 suffix 对应最后一步附着。

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的人或物送回原处，或将其归还给原主。
senses.en_definition: To return the previously mentioned person or thing to its owner or original place.
senses.ms_definition: Memulangkan orang atau sesuatu yang telah disebut kepada pemilik atau tempat asalnya.
senses.nuances: -nya 指代前文已明确的对象，可译为“它、他、她”或按语境处理；它不表示接受者。不要再把同一个宾语直接重复接在词后。[DBP 归还义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengembalikan+1)

collocations.en: put it back in its original place

senses.zh_definition: 使前文提到的状态、能力、信心或事物恢复到原来的情形。
senses.en_definition: To restore the previously mentioned thing or condition to its former state.
senses.ms_definition: Memulihkan sesuatu yang telah disebut supaya menjadi seperti keadaan sebelumnya.
senses.nuances: 宾语可以是抽象事物，如 keyakinan“信心”或 keamanan“安宁”；不能只按实体物品的“归还”理解。[DBP 恢复义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=restore)

collocations.en: restore it to its original condition

senses.zh_definition: 使前文提到的人或来物折返，令其回到来处。
senses.en_definition: To turn the previously mentioned person or thing back toward its point of origin.
senses.ms_definition: Menyekat atau mengarahkan yang telah disebut supaya berpatah balik ke tempat datangnya.
senses.nuances: 对应基础动词的使之折返义；现代叙述中常可用 menyuruhnya kembali 或 mengarahkannya berpatah balik 表达得更直接。[《Kamus Dewan》mengembalikan 义项](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf)

collocations.en: send it back where it came from
send it back across the border

senses.zh_definition: 使前文提到的时间进程或事件倒退，回到较早的阶段。
senses.en_definition: To turn the previously mentioned course of time or events back to an earlier point.
senses.ms_definition: Mengundurkan masa atau kejadian yang telah disebut kepada suatu tahap yang lebih awal.
senses.nuances: 对应基础动词的时间倒退义，多见于比喻、文学或假设语境；不表示现实中能够撤销已经发生的事件。[《Kamus Dewan》mengembalikan 义项](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf)

collocations.en: turn it back to the past

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay's productive morphology rather than a separate borrowing story. Kembali supplies the idea of returning; meN- and -kan form a verb meaning to return or restore something. The attached pronoun -nya then points back to an already mentioned object, allowing a sentence to continue without repeating its name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三步记忆：kembali＝回来；mengembalikan＝使某物回来；加 -nya＝把前面说的“它”还回去或恢复过来。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根首音 s 在此构词中由鼻音 ny /ɲ/ 替代，形成 menyambung。输入包将派生词误标为词根；实际词根及其 Jawi 见 [PRPM：sambung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sambung)。

word_family.gloss: 连接部分；续篇；电话分机
连接器；接续某项事业的人

senses.zh_definition: 通过增添部分使物体变长或使建筑等得到延伸。
senses.en_definition: To lengthen or extend something by adding to it.
senses.ms_definition: Menambah bahagian pada sesuatu supaya menjadi lebih panjang atau luas.
senses.nuances: 强调在原有部分上增加长度或空间，与单纯把东西接起来的义项有所侧重。各义依据：[PRPM：menyambung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=menyambung)。

senses.zh_definition: 把分离、断开或折断的部分连接起来。
senses.en_definition: To join separate parts or reconnect something broken.
senses.ms_definition: Mencantumkan bahagian yang terpisah, terputus atau patah.
senses.nuances: 宾语通常是电线、管道、链条等；重点是恢复或建立连接，不一定增加总长度。

senses.zh_definition: 继续或恢复原有的活动、谈话、学习等。
senses.en_definition: To continue or resume an activity, conversation or course of study.
senses.ms_definition: Meneruskan kegiatan, percakapan atau pengajian, termasuk selepas berhenti seketika.
senses.nuances: menyambung semula 明确表示中断后恢复；menyambung pengajian 也可指升读下一教育阶段，不一定曾经休学。

senses.zh_definition: 接通或转接电话，使来电与另一条线路、分机或人员连通。
senses.en_definition: To connect or transfer a telephone call to another line or person.
senses.ms_definition: Menghubungkan panggilan telefon dengan talian, sambungan atau penerima yang lain.
senses.nuances: 常见于接线员和客服用语；menyambungkan 也可用于此类语境。

etymology.historical_story: Menyambung is formed from sambung through productive Malay verbal morphology. Its dictionary meanings connect physical joining with continuing speech, study and other activities. Telephone usage adds another familiar application: connecting a caller to another line. A useful semantic interpretation is that separated pieces, interrupted activities and distant speakers are all brought into connection. Source: [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sambung).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sambung 想成“接上”：绳子接上是连接，谈话接上是继续；加 meN- 时 s 变成 ny，得到 menyambung。

接连猛扑；闪电等接连劈下

senses.en_definition: To seize prey swiftly, especially by swooping down in flight.
senses.ms_definition: Menangkap mangsa dengan pantas, khususnya dengan paruh atau cakar ketika terbang.

collocations.en: an eagle swooping down to seize a chick

senses.zh_definition: 突然伸手抓取、夺取或迅速袭向某人某物。
senses.en_definition: To grab, snatch or attack someone or something suddenly.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil, merampas atau menyerang seseorang atau sesuatu dengan gerakan yang pantas.

collocations.en: to grab someone's hand or arm

senses.zh_definition: 火焰迅速窜向并烧及某物；闪电、弹丸等突然击中某物。
senses.en_definition: Of fire, to spread onto something rapidly; of lightning or a projectile, to strike it.
senses.ms_definition: Bagi api, menjilat atau membakar sesuatu dengan cepat; bagi kilat, peluru dan sebagainya, mengenai sesuatu secara tiba-tiba.
senses.nuances: 火焰和闪电是本义项的典型主语；词典亦收录车辆突然撞向物体的用法。

senses.zh_definition: 突然插话；迅速打断别人的发言。
senses.en_definition: Archaic: to interject abruptly or interrupt a speaker.
senses.ms_definition: Secara arkaik, mencelah dengan cepat ketika orang lain sedang bercakap.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述别人 menyambar 东西，会突出其动作突然或粗鲁。若只是礼貌取物，通常使用 mengambil；请别人递物可用 Boleh hulurkan…?
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈动物捕食、火势、雷击和迅速抓住机会时很自然。用于他人行为时须注意语气；“突然插话”义属于旧用法，现代交流宜用 menyampuk 或 mencelah。

etymology.historical_story: Menyambar is transparently formed from sambar with the Malay active verbal prefix. Its dictionary senses range from a predator's swift capture to grabbing, lightning strikes and seizing opportunities. Traditional proverbs also pair the swooping eagle with vulnerable chickens. These associations provide a cultural image of sudden, decisive action without requiring an unverified account of the root's ultimate origin. Source: [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sambar).

senses.zh_definition: 玛斯塔妮：南亚人名，亦指电影《Bajirao Mastani》中的同名人物。
senses.en_definition: Mastani, a South Asian personal name, including the character bearing that name in Bajirao Mastani.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas individu, termasuk watak bernama Mastani dalam filem Bajirao Mastani.
senses.nuances: 此义是专名，正常写作 Mastani；不能凭词频将其认定为马来语普通词。所给资料没有 DBP 释义，本条马来语释义为编辑说明。人物及电影用法见 [Eros Now](https://erosnow.com/movie/watch/1023354/bajirao-mastani)。

senses.zh_definition: 印度浦那的一种浓稠奶昔甜饮，通常配有冰淇淋，可添加水果、坚果或干果。

senses.ms_definition: Minuman pencuci mulut dari Pune yang berupa susu kocak pekat dengan aiskrim serta buah-buahan atau kekacang.

etymology.historical_story: Mastani appears both as a personal name and as the name of a celebrated Pune dessert drink. India's official tourism portal associates the drink's name with Mastani, also familiar through the film Bajirao Mastani. This cultural association does not establish a Malay etymology or prove that the item is an established Malay loanword. 来源：[Incredible India](https://www.incredibleindia.gov.in/en/maharashtra/pune/the-delectable-taste-of-pune)。

morphology.pattern_note: 依输入包保留直接基底 menyelamatkan；更深层词根为 selamat。meN- 遇词首 s 时形成 meny-，s 脱落。-kan 参与构成及物动词；-mu 是表示第二人称宾语的附着代词，并非普通派生后缀，此处依给定分类记为 suffix。headword.jawi 按输入包保留，但仅拼出 menyelamatkan，漏写 -mu；按构形补全应为 مڽلامتکنمو。

senses.zh_definition: 救你；使你脱离危险、灾难或伤害。
senses.en_definition: To save or rescue you from danger, disaster, or harm.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusahakan supaya kamu selamat atau menjauhkan kamu daripada bencana dan bahaya.
senses.nuances: -mu 是动作的第二人称宾语；本词不包含“我”这个主语，也不自带过去或将来时。完整动词加 -mu 常带书面、亲密或抒情色彩。基础动词释义参见 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》的 selamat 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penyelamatan)。本条 official 指标准构词成立，不表示已经查得该附着形式的独立词典条目。

senses.zh_definition: 在比喻意义上解救你，使你摆脱困境或避免严重的不良后果。
senses.en_definition: To save you figuratively from trouble or serious adverse consequences.
senses.ms_definition: Membantu kamu terlepas daripada kesulitan atau mengelakkan kamu daripada akibat yang buruk secara kiasan.
senses.nuances: 可以指关键证据、及时提醒或他人的援助使你摆脱困境。通常比一般的 membantu kamu 语气更强；不宜把所有轻微帮助都译作“拯救”。

collocations.zh: 使你避免犯下重大错误
collocations.en: save you from making a serious mistake

etymology.historical_story: This form combines the familiar Malay idea of selamat, being safe, with an active verb construction and the attached pronoun mu. The same family appears in everyday greetings and in public language about safety and rescue. Its personal ending makes a general act of rescue address one particular listener, a useful effect in intimate or literary speech.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: selamat＝平安；menyelamatkan＝使人平安、救下；最后接 mu＝你，所以整词就是“救你”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不作拆分。派生时 meN- 在 m 前取 me-，形成 memantapkan；词根首音 m 保留。

word_family.gloss: 起固定或稳定作用的工具、部件

senses.zh_definition: 内心坚定、意志坚毅或忠诚不移的。
senses.en_definition: Steadfast in resolve, conviction, or loyalty.
senses.ms_definition: Teguh hati, tabah dan tetap pendirian atau kesetiaannya.
senses.nuances: 着重心理、立场或忠诚的坚定，不单指外在能力强。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=mantap)

senses.zh_definition: 稳固、稳定而不易变动的；已形成可靠基础的。
senses.en_definition: Stable, firmly established, or securely developed.
senses.ms_definition: Kukuh, stabil dan tidak mudah berubah atau tergugat.
senses.nuances: 适用于制度、基础、知识掌握、语言发展等；侧重基础牢靠和状态稳定。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=mantap)

collocations.en: a solid command of a language

senses.zh_definition: 表现扎实、强劲或出色的；口语中可用来赞叹“很棒”。
senses.en_definition: Strong or impressive in quality or performance; excellent in informal praise.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan mutu atau prestasi yang kukuh dan mengagumkan; dalam percakapan, sangat bagus.
senses.nuances: 从“扎实、稳固”延伸为质量评价。persembahan mantap 可用于文艺评论；独立的 Mantap! 属口语赞叹，不能代替所有正式评价。[DBP 收录的演出评论用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=mantap)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Mantap! 是自然的简短赞美。对上级或正式嘉宾，可说 Pembentangan tuan sangat mantap，并说明具体优点。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合评价成果、能力、制度和表演。正式汇报应说明何处稳健或出色；带讥讽语调的 mantap 也可能被理解为反话。

etymology.historical_story: The available dictionary evidence establishes mantap as a Malay base describing steadfastness and stability; it does not establish a deeper historical origin. Its productive family connects a stable condition, kemantapan, with the work of strengthening something, pemantapan. Praise of acting and performance extends this image of solidity into an assessment of quality. [DBP definitions, derivatives, and usage](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=mantap).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 念 man.tap 时，想象两脚稳稳踏地：站得稳、底子扎实，表现也就 mantap！这是记忆画面，不是词源拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在浊双唇音 /b/ 前变为 mem-；词根开头的 b 保留，末尾 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。

word_family.gloss: 投掷；投出的一球或一击

senses.zh_definition: 扔；投；掷，使手中的物体离手飞向某处或某个目标。
senses.en_definition: To throw or hurl an object towards a place or target.
senses.ms_definition: Melontarkan sesuatu ke sesuatu tempat atau ke arah sasaran.
senses.nuances: 现代常用义。通常接所投掷的物体，如 bola、batu；也可把目标作为宾语，再用 dengan 引出投掷物。并不必然表示愤怒或用力猛掷。搭配为常见组合，不代表已核定的语料频次排名。参见 [DBP：membaling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=membaling)。

senses.zh_definition: 用绳索旋转后投出石块等物体。
senses.en_definition: To sling a stone or another projectile using a cord swung overhead.
senses.ms_definition: Melontarkan batu atau benda lain dengan tali yang diayunkan terlebih dahulu di atas kepala.
senses.nuances: 词典保留的器具性用法，区别于直接用手投掷。以下组合用于说明该义，不宜宣称为现代高频搭配。参见 [DBP：baling 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=balingan)。

collocations.en: sling a stone using a cord
sling a projectile towards a target

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性。对朋友可说 Baling sini!；向长辈或不熟悉的人提出请求，宜说 Boleh tolong balingkan bola itu kepada saya?
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于体育、游戏和具体动作描述。把物品扔给别人可能显得粗鲁；递交文件、礼物或贵重物品时，宜使用 hulurkan 或 serahkan 所表示的递交动作。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves an intriguing material connection: baling can name a projectile launched with a cord swung around the head. Membaling also means ordinary throwing, including an agricultural example involving rice seedlings. These records connect the word with tools and everyday work, but do not establish when its different meanings arose. [DBP: baling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=balingan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baling 想成“把球扔出去”的动作；加上 mem-，就得到主动动作 membaling。记忆链：baling → membaling bola → 投球。

headword.jawi_note: 按要求保留数据包拼写；该拼写只对应 merindukan，未含 -nya。完整形式按构词补写为 مريندوکنڽ。

morphology.formula: merindukan + -nya → merindukannya；内部构词：meN- + rindu + -kan → merindukan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留数据包给出的直接基底 merindukan；更深层词根为 rindu。meN- 在 /r/ 前实现为 me-，r 保留；-nya 是附着代词，此处通常作第三人称宾语，可指他、她或前文事物，不是所有格。

etymology.historical_story: Malay gives longing a memorable literary image in the expression comparing someone to a pungguk yearning for the moon. Merindukannya adds a small grammatical pointer to that emotional vocabulary: -nya identifies the person or thing already mentioned. This explains its modern construction and cultural resonance without assigning rindu an unverified ancient origin. [DBP: merindukan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=merindukan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 rindu＝想念；merindukan＝想念某个对象；最后的 -nya 像指向前文的箭头：merindukannya＝想念刚才说的那个人或事物。

etymology.historical_story: This form combines membina with the attached pronoun -nya. Its structure shows how Malay can package an action and a previously mentioned object into one written word. The supplied dictionary evidence connects physical construction with growth and development. That semantic connection supports figurative uses involving trust, relationships, and skills without requiring a separate invented origin story.

etymology.historical_story: Martínez is a Spanish patronymic surname historically meaning “son of Martín.” The accent marks stress on the middle syllable; Martinez is a spelling without that written accent. In Malay usage, the surname remains a person's name rather than acquiring an ordinary dictionary meaning. Its historical meaning does not identify a present-day bearer's father. See [Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/marti10nez).

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述狗叫时自然中性；把人的发言称为 menyalak 会带有把人比作狗的侮辱意味，在职场、长幼交流或争执中尤其应避免。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述犬吠、动物行为和相关谚语。向邻居反映噪声时，可说 Anjing itu kerap menyalak pada waktu malam，请求对方处理；若描述人的纠缠，宜依具体意思使用 merengek、mendesak 或 meminta berulang kali。

etymology.historical_story: Menyalak is formed from salak, the barking root, with the productive Malay prefix meN-. A cultural memory anchor is the proverb about a barking dog and an unmoved hill: hostile criticism cannot destroy a good person's merit. This proverbial association explains a traditional use; it does not establish the root's ultimate historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 s 想成被鼻音前缀替换：salak → meny-alak → menyalak；一看到 ny，就联想狗正在“汪汪”叫。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接以 t 开头的词根时，通常变为 men-，词根首音 t 脱落：tegas → menegaskan。输入包将 menegaskan 标为词根有误；真正词根为 tegas。

senses.zh_definition: 阐明；明确解释某件事，使其意思清楚。
senses.en_definition: To explain or make something clear and explicit.
senses.ms_definition: Menerangkan atau menjelaskan sesuatu perkara supaya maksudnya nyata.
senses.nuances: 侧重消除含糊，未必带有强硬语气。常用于说明立场、原则或责任。义项依据 [DBP：menegaskan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=73980&keyword=menegaskan)。

senses.zh_definition: 强调；坚定而明确地陈述，突出某项事实、要求或观点。
senses.en_definition: To state firmly or emphasize a fact, requirement, or position.
senses.ms_definition: Menyatakan sesuatu dengan tegas atau memberikan penekanan terhadapnya.
senses.nuances: 现代新闻报道中常见，可接 bahawa 引导的从句。表示说话者表达坚定，本身不保证所说内容已经证实。

senses.zh_definition: 明确判定；确认某件事的实际情况或确定性。
senses.en_definition: To establish or affirm something as definite or certain.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan kepastian atau menentukan keadaan sebenar sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 此义见于词典，现代一般表达中常用 memastikan；涉及核实真伪或正式确认时，mengesahkan 往往更明确。

collocations.en: affirm the truth of a matter

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于正式且有力度的表达。向上级说明立场时，可说 Izinkan saya menegaskan bahawa...，先取得发言空间；坚定表达不必提高音量。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合政策说明、会议和新闻引述。日常聊天也可用于转述严肃要求；反复对他人强调同一点，可能显得训话或不耐烦。

etymology.historical_story: Menegaskan is formed within Malay from tegas, meaning clear or firm, through the productive meN-...-kan construction. Its dictionary senses connect explaining clearly with speaking firmly and establishing certainty. This connection helps explain its usefulness in public statements: a speaker makes a position explicit while giving it emphasis. No particular historical first use is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住词根 tegas「明确、坚定」：menegaskan 就是把话说明白、把重点强调出来。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接 kesan 时变为 meng-，词根首音 k 脱落。-nya 在此是第三人称宾语附着成分，表示它、他、她或所指对象，不表示过去时。输入包的 mengesan 是直接词基，真正词根为 kesan；包内 Jawi مڠسن 也只对应 mengesan，完整词补为 مڠسنڽ。音节为据构词补充。

senses.zh_definition: 检测到它；通过迹象、检查或仪器发现所指对象的存在。
senses.en_definition: To detect it or identify its presence through signs, examination, or instruments.
senses.ms_definition: Mengetahui kewujudan perkara yang dirujuk melalui tanda, pemeriksaan atau alat.
senses.nuances: -nya 的指代对象须由上下文提供，如异常、烟雾或错误。本词是 mengesan 加宾语附着成分，并非独立词根。探测义及相关用法参见 [DBP：mengesan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengesan)。

senses.zh_definition: 循迹追查它或某人；利用线索查找所指对象或重建其经过。
senses.en_definition: To trace or track the referent by following clues or reconstructing its course.
senses.ms_definition: Mencari atau menjejaki pihak atau perkara yang dirujuk dengan berpandukan kesan dan petunjuk.
senses.nuances: 指代对象可为人、车辆、物品或某件事的发展过程。表示追查行动时，不一定说明已经找到；能否成功由 berjaya、dapat 等成分及上下文决定。

collocations.zh: 尝试追踪它或找到某人
collocations.en: try to trace it or locate the person

senses.zh_definition: 追踪并标示它的位置或运行轨迹。
senses.en_definition: To track and mark its position or course.
senses.ms_definition: Menandakan kedudukan atau perjalanan objek yang dirujuk pada peta, paparan atau rekod.
senses.nuances: 适用于雷达、地图和监测系统。词基 mengesan 另有「留下痕迹或影响」义，但该义的句法不能直接套用这里的宾语 -nya。

etymology.historical_story: Kesan names a trace, mark, or effect. Malay forms mengesan from this base, connecting a trace with the act of following or detecting something through evidence. Adding the object clitic -nya produces mengesannya, meaning to detect or trace the referent. The same family extends naturally to instruments and procedures through pengesan and pengesanan. See [DBP：kesan](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=kesan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kesan＝痕迹；mengesan＝循迹发现；再加 -nya「它」：mengesannya＝追踪它、检测到它。

etymology.historical_story: The story of menjaringkan begins with jaring, a net used for catching things and in games. Malay morphology turns this object into an action: causing something to enter the net. In sports reporting, the resulting verb naturally describes scoring, while menjaring retains the distinct meaning of catching with a net. See [DBP's word-family definitions](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menjaringkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jaring 是“网”，meN-…-kan 把它变成动作：让球进网 → menjaringkan gol，进球！

morphology.pattern_note: 保留资料包的直接基础词 meminta；更深一层的词根是 minta。meN- 在词首 m 前采用 me-，原来的 m 保留。-ku 是 aku 的后附着代词，此处充当宾语，并非派生后缀；接合时无音变。资料包未提供音节，故保留 null；所给 Jawi ممينتا 对应 meminta，未包含 -ku。

senses.zh_definition: 请求或要求我做某事；在特定语境中，也可指要求让本人前来或参与。
senses.en_definition: To ask or request me to do something; contextually, to request my presence or participation.
senses.ms_definition: Memohon atau menghendaki aku melakukan sesuatu; mengikut konteks, meminta supaya aku hadir atau turut serta.
senses.nuances: -ku 指被请求的“我”，不是提出请求的人，也不是“我的请求”。常见结构为某人 + memintaku + 动作短语。词形分析依据 meminta 的请求义及后附代词 -ku 的宾语功能；这里的马来文释义为综合编写，并非 DBP 对 memintaku 的独立逐字释义。参见 [DBP：minta 与 mohon](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=minta)及 [DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ku)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 带有 aku 的亲近或个人叙述色彩。向上司、客户或不熟悉的人汇报时，通常用 meminta saya；文学叙述、私人记录及保留原话的引语可以用 memintaku。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 请求的强弱由语境决定，memintaku 本身不必然表示命令。普通聊天更常说 minta aku；正式对外沟通宜根据关系选择 saya，并用明确的动作补语说明请求内容。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 带有 aku 的亲近或个人叙述色彩。向上司、客户或不熟悉的人汇报时，通常用 meminta saya；文学叙述、私人记录及保留原话的引语可以用 memintaku。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 请求的强弱由语境决定，memintaku 本身不必然表示命令。普通聊天更常说 minta aku；正式对外沟通宜根据关系选择 saya，并用明确的动作补语说明请求内容。

etymology.historical_story: Memintaku is a transparent grammatical combination rather than a separate inherited root. Its ending preserves aku in the compact form -ku, allowing the person being asked to remain attached to the verb. This compactness suits personal narration and literary dialogue. Ordinary Malaysian conversation often expands the same relationship into minta aku. See [DBP: ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ku).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meminta 想成“提出请求”，把尾巴 ku 连到 aku“我”：请求落到我身上，就是“请我……”。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 按数据包保留；实际词根为 kuat（قوات）。meN- 在 kuat 前表现为 meng-，词根首辅音 k 脱落；-kan 保留，形成“使……变强”的及物动词。数据包的 is_root: true 不符合这一构词分析。[DBP kuat 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=kuat)。

senses.zh_definition: 使身体、结构、连接或关系等更强健、更牢固或更紧密。
senses.en_definition: To make something physically stronger, firmer, or more securely connected.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan kuat, tegap, kukuh atau erat.
senses.nuances: 及物用法，通常需要宾语。可用于肌肉、结构、绳结和关系等；具体译为“增强”“加固”还是“加强”，由宾语决定。

collocations.en: to strengthen a bond or fastening

senses.zh_definition: 坚定信念、意志或精神；使某种看法、判断或怀疑得到进一步支持。
senses.en_definition: To reinforce a belief, resolve, opinion, or suspicion, or to bolster morale.
senses.ms_definition: Meneguhkan kepercayaan, sangkaan, pendapat, hati, iman atau semangat.

etymology.historical_story: Menguatkan illustrates a productive Malay pattern: kuat describes strength, while meN-...-kan expresses causing something to become strong. The initial k disappears after the nasal prefix. Its established meanings extend from bodily strength and firm bonds to conviction, morale, and louder sound, letting one familiar idea connect physical, emotional, and acoustic experiences. [DBP kuat entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=kuat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 kuat“强”：menguatkan 就是“让它变强”。身体变强、信心变强、声音变强，三个义项一起记；加前缀后词根开头的 k 消失。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无音变；semoga 添加 se-，moga-moga 通过完整重叠构成，并非添加词缀。

etymology.historical_story: Moga belongs to a Malay family of hopeful expressions that includes semoga and moga-moga. Its cultural interest lies in how a short word turns a statement into a wish: recovery, happiness, or protection becomes something sincerely hoped for. DBP records it in prayerful examples, showing the connection between ordinary goodwill and devotional language without establishing a particular ancient borrowing route. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=moga)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mo-ga 联想成轻轻说出的“愿你……”：moga berjaya，愿你成功。

morphology.pattern_note: 按所给直接词基 meledak 分析，-kan 构成使动及物动词，表示使某物爆炸或使某事爆发。词基末尾 k 与后缀开头 k 均保留，写成 kk；所给读音将词基末尾 k 实现为 /ʔ/。更基础的词族词根是 ledak。

senses.zh_definition: 使某物爆炸；引爆；炸毁。

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan meledak; meletupkan.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常说明施事者使某个对象爆炸。与 meledak 的关键区别是使动性：bom meledak 表示炸弹爆炸，meledakkan bom 表示引爆炸弹。释义依据：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=ledak)。

senses.zh_definition: 引发某种事件或强烈反应，使战争、革命、愤怒等突然爆发。

etymology.historical_story: Meledakkan belongs to the ledak word family, which links explosions with sudden outbreaks. Adding -kan to meledak makes the event something an agent causes. DBP records both physical detonation and the triggering of events such as revolution. The figurative use carries the force of a blast into social life: anger or conflict suddenly breaks through restraint. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=ledak)

morphology.formula: se- + rupa → serupa; meN- + serupa + -i → menyerupai
morphology.pattern_note: 实际词根为 rupa，直接构词基底为 serupa；meN- 遇基底首音 s 时变为 meny-，s 脱落；词尾 a 与 -i 分属两个音节。root_word 和 root_jawi 保留输入包记录。

senses.nuances: 通常表示具有相似特征，不必完全相同，也不表示有意模仿。作为及物动词直接接比较对象：menyerupai ibunya；若用 serupa，则通常说 serupa dengan ibunya。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menyerupai)。

etymology.historical_story: The family centers on rupa, meaning form or appearance, a word borrowed from Sanskrit rūpa. Malay built serupa, expressing likeness, and then menyerupai through its own productive affixes. The result joins an old Indic vocabulary item to Malay grammar: an inherited cultural layer remains active whenever speakers compare faces, buildings, or clouds. See [the historical Malay vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b9/Vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages_%28IA_afu7962.0002.001.umich.edu%29.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 rupa“样子”：serupa 是“样子相似”，menyerupai 就是“看起来像”。末尾 pa.i 分开读。

etymology.historical_story: Menakluk belongs to the Arabic-derived takluk family, whose Malay meanings include submission and dependence. Malay morphology turns this base into an active verb by replacing its initial t with the nasal element of meN-. The related tertakluk still expresses being subject to something, preserving a useful connection between conquest, authority, and obligation. See [DBP's discussion of the Arabic loan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=taakul).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: takluk 是“屈服”；加 meN-，t 被鼻音 n 替换：menakluk＝让对方屈服，也就是“征服”。

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki dalam bahasa Sepanyol, Portugis dan Galicia yang sepadan dengan nama Michael.
senses.nuances: 属于人名专有名词，不是具有普通词汇释义的马来语词。马来语正文应写 Miguel；本条保留输入的小写检索键。IPA 采用一种来源语言读法，不代表统一的马来语标准。所列搭配是称名结构示例，不是经频率验证的固定搭配；马来语释义为编辑性说明。status 按要求保留，不表示 DBP 已正式收录该人名。名称对应关系参见 [Real Academia Galega：Miguel](https://www.academia.gal/nomes/-/nome/Miguel)，发音参见 [Behind the Name：Miguel](https://www.behindthename.com/name/miguel)。

etymology.historical_story: Miguel belongs to the international Michael name family. Its Hebrew ancestor, Mikha'el, expresses the rhetorical question “Who is like God?” Greek and Latin transmitted the name before regional European forms developed. Miguel is used in Spanish, Portuguese and Galician; in Malay discourse it retains its function as a person's name. Source: [Real Academia Galega](https://www.academia.gal/nomes/-/nome/Miguel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Miguel 与 Michael 连成一张人名卡：同一家族的名字，中文常译“米格尔”；不要按马来语字母组合生拆词义。

morphology.formula: membalas + -nya → membalasnya；底层构词：meN- + balas → membalas
morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的直接基础词 membalas；其词汇词根为 balas。meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，b 保留。-nya 是第三人称附着代词，此处充当宾语，并非派生后缀；suffix 仅表示其后附位置。数据包 Jawi 为 membalas，未包含 -nya。

senses.zh_definition: 回复前文提到的信件、消息、问候等。
senses.en_definition: To reply to the previously mentioned message, letter, or greeting.
senses.ms_definition: Menjawab surat, pesanan atau sapaan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 的具体指代须由上下文确定，不表示过去时。例如收到消息后 membalasnya，即回复该消息。以下搭配展示基础动词的常用宾语；宾语已知时可用 -nya 替代。

senses.zh_definition: 对前述恩惠、付出、感情或行为作出相应回报。
senses.en_definition: To repay or reciprocate the previously mentioned kindness, effort, affection, or action.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan sesuatu sebagai imbangan bagi budi, usaha, kasih atau perbuatan yang diterima.
senses.nuances: 可以指物质回报，也可以指感情回应；本身不保证双方交换等值。回报恩情常用 membalas budi，与复仇义不同。

senses.zh_definition: 针对前述攻击、侵害或恶行予以还击或报复。
senses.en_definition: To retaliate against the previously mentioned attack, injury, or wrongdoing.
senses.ms_definition: Bertindak terhadap serangan atau kesalahan yang diterima sebagai tindak balas atau pembalasan.
senses.nuances: 须由攻击、侵害等语境触发，不能把所有 membalasnya 都译成“报复他”。基础词释义依据所给 DBP 数据包；报恩用法另见 [DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membalas)。

collocations.en: repel or retaliate against an attack

etymology.historical_story: The useful thread running through balas is an answering action: a letter receives a reply, kindness receives kindness, and an attack receives resistance. Membalas adds the active verbal prefix, while -nya points back to something already mentioned. This semantic connection explains the different meanings without requiring an invented story about the root's remote origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“来一封，回一封”：balas 是回应，mem- 标示主动动词，-nya 把回应对象接回前文；membalasnya 就是“回应它／他／她”。

senses.nuances: 重点是路线比绕行更直接；能否通行取决于实际场地规定。

senses.zh_definition: 横过道路等，从一边到另一边。
senses.en_definition: To cross a road or similar thoroughfare.
senses.ms_definition: Menyeberang jalan atau laluan dari satu sisi ke sisi yang lain.
senses.nuances: 常用于交通安全语境。melintas jalan 是自然表达；不要因为也存在 melintasi 就判它错误。

senses.zh_definition: 念头、回忆或形象在脑海中短暂闪现。
senses.en_definition: To flash briefly through the mind.
senses.ms_definition: Timbul atau terbayang sebentar dalam fikiran.
senses.nuances: 通常由念头或形象作主语。terlintas 也常用于突然想到某事，但并非所有句式都可直接互换。

etymology.historical_story: Lintas supplies the image of movement past or across a place, and melintas forms an active verb from it. The same image also works for mental events: a thought briefly passes through awareness. This connection between physical passage and a passing thought provides a useful semantic story without assigning an unsupported date or foreign source to the root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lintas 想成“横穿的一条线”：人 melintas jalan 横过马路，念头 melintas di fikiran 从脑海中一闪而过。

morphology.pattern_note: -an 构成与沐浴、浸浴有关的名词，词干 mandi 保留；快速发音时 /i.a/ 可出现滑音化。headword.jawi 按输入保留，但 مندي 实际对应 mandi，不包含 -an；按构词应写 منديان。输入释义也属于 mandi，不能直接作为 mandian 的动词释义。

senses.zh_definition: 沐浴、浸浴或某种洗浴过程，常指具有特定方式的洗浴。
senses.en_definition: Bathing or a bath, especially a particular bathing procedure.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau kaedah mandi, khususnya yang menggunakan cara atau bahan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 是名词性表达；“我要洗澡”通常说 Saya hendak mandi，不说 Saya hendak mandian。本条马来语定义是依据实际用法归纳的释义，并非输入中 mandi 词条的引文。[DBP 术语用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=mandian)。

senses.zh_definition: 供洗浴使用的水、配制液或洗浴用品；具体所指由搭配决定。
senses.en_definition: Water, a preparation, or a product used for bathing.
senses.ms_definition: Air, campuran atau sediaan yang digunakan untuk mandi.
senses.nuances: air mandian 指洗浴用水，或依语境指用过的洗澡水；cecair mandian 通常指液体沐浴用品。不能把所有 mandian 都译成“沐浴露”。

senses.zh_definition: 技术用语中的浸浴介质或浴液，用于加热、处理或加工材料。
senses.en_definition: A liquid or molten bath used for heating, treatment, or processing.
senses.ms_definition: Medium cecair atau leburan untuk merendam, memanaskan atau memproses sesuatu bahan.
senses.nuances: 用于工程和实验技术语境，与人体洗澡无关。DBP 的术语资料收录 mandian pemanas 和 mandian lebur 等用法。

senses.zh_definition: 在 mandian rimba 中，比喻置身森林、通过感官体验自然的活动。
senses.en_definition: In mandian rimba, sensory immersion in a forest environment.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam istilah mandian rimba, kegiatan menghayati suasana hutan melalui pengalaman deria.
senses.nuances: 这是固定术语 mandian rimba 的比喻用法，不涉及用水清洗身体。DBP 将它与日语 shinrin-yoku 联系起来。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 草药浴、仪式性洗浴和宗教净身须按具体传统区分，不能仅凭 mandian 就认定具有宗教意义。普通商品介绍宜采用 cecair mandian 等明确搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Mandian is transparently formed from mandi with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its vocabulary spans ordinary washing, herbal bathing and specialised immersion processes. This range makes water and immersion useful organising ideas, but does not make every bath a ritual. DBP also records mandian rimba, a figurative term for experiencing a forest through the senses rather than washing in water.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mandi 是“洗澡”，加 -an 把动作变成“浴、浴液或洗浴事物”：先看后面的搭配，再决定译法。

senses.zh_definition: 魔法；被认为能以超自然力量引发变化的能力或活动。
senses.en_definition: Supposed supernatural power used to influence events.
senses.ms_definition: Kuasa atau amalan yang dipercayai dapat menghasilkan sesuatu melalui cara luar biasa atau ghaib.
senses.nuances: 英语夹用义；马来语可按语境使用 kuasa ajaib、magik 或 sihir，三者语气及文化含义并不完全相同。马来语释义为编辑释写。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=magic)

senses.zh_definition: 魔术；通过技巧或装置制造不可思议效果的表演。
senses.en_definition: The art of entertaining audiences with conjuring tricks and illusions.
senses.ms_definition: Seni persembahan yang menggunakan kemahiran atau helah untuk menghasilkan ilusi yang mengagumkan.
senses.nuances: 日常夹语中的 buat magic 常指表演魔术。正式马来语宜用 silap mata。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=magic)

senses.zh_definition: 令人着迷的魅力；仿佛具有魔力的非凡效果。

etymology.historical_story: English magic reached its modern form through French and Latin, ultimately drawing on Greek terminology associated with a magus. Its history connects ritual power with later ideas of enchantment and performance. In Malay conversation, the English spelling may appear during language mixing; its appropriate Malay equivalent depends on whether the speaker means supernatural power, entertainment, or figurative charm. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/magic_1)

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包保留输入词根 mahluk；规范词 makhluk 在现代马来语中作为完整借词处理。kh 是表示 /x/ 的双字母，不应拆成词缀。以下词族采用规范拼写，均为复合词。

senses.zh_definition: 规范词 makhluk 的非规范拼写：生物；生命体；宗教语境中指上帝创造的存在，包括人、动物等。
senses.en_definition: A nonstandard spelling of makhluk: a creature or being, especially one understood as created by God.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi makhluk, iaitu segala yang dijadikan Tuhan, seperti manusia dan binatang.
senses.nuances: 本条是拼写纠错参见条目；status 字段不表示 mahluk 是规范拼写。DBP 收录的形式为 makhluk，因此搭配和标准例句使用 makhluk。其含义不限于鬼怪；超自然义通常由 makhluk halus 这一搭配表达。输入形式的音节、IPA 和 Jawi 缺少可靠依据，保留为 null。依据：[DBP PRPM：makhluk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=makhluk)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式文件、考试和教学使用 makhluk。谈论 makhluk halus 时应尊重对方的宗教或民俗观念，避免用它嘲弄他人；解释民俗时也不应把相关信仰直接表述为已证实的事实。

etymology.historical_story: The standard form makhluk is an Arabic loan, identified as such by [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=makhluk). Its meaning connects creatures with divine creation, while Malay also uses it in ordinary references to living beings. The missing k in mahluk obscures the standard digraph kh; it does not create a separate Malay root or a new meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 makh-luk 中的 kh 是一个组合：给输入的 mahluk 在 h 前补上 k，就找到规范词 makhluk。

senses.zh_definition: 通过言语或动作逗人发笑；说笑、开玩笑或表演搞笑内容。
senses.en_definition: To joke or do something amusing to make people laugh.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan atau membuat sesuatu yang menggelikan hati atau melucukan; berjenaka; berolok-olok.

etymology.historical_story: Melawak is formed within Malay from lawak, the word associated with jokes and humour. The same family connects an activity, melawak, with its performer, pelawak. The dictionary records both everyday joking and the professional entertainer, showing how one familiar root links conversation with comedy as a public performance. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=lawak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lawak＝笑话；meN- 让它成为动作：melawak＝开玩笑。再记 pelawak＝负责逗笑的人。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语借词在现代马来语中作为完整词根处理，不拆成 mu- 加词根。加 meN- 时，m 前采用 me-：memutlakkan；输入音标保留 /q/，常见马来西亚读音的词尾可实现为 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 绝对的；完全的；不受限制、不附条件或不容例外的。
senses.en_definition: Absolute, complete, unrestricted or unconditional.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak terbatas atau tidak bersyarat; tidak ada kecualinya; penuh atau lengkap.
senses.nuances: 常修饰权利、权力、效忠或认可，语气强于一般的 penuh。hak mutlak 表示完整或排他的权利；syarat mutlak 指不可缺少的必要条件。参见 [DBP：mutlak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mutlak)。

senses.zh_definition: 绝对的；不以其他事物为比较基准的，与“相对的”相对。
senses.en_definition: Absolute rather than relative; independent of comparison with something else.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak bergantung pada perbandingan dengan perkara lain; bukan nisbi.
senses.nuances: 用于概念讨论时与 nisbi 或 relatif 对举。数学固定术语 nilai mutlak 指数与零的距离，结果非负；不能简单理解成“把所有数都变成正数”。DBP 对 nisbi 的解释见 [DBP：相关词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mutlak)。

senses.zh_definition: 在伊斯兰净礼术语 air mutlak 中，指水本身洁净且可用于净礼的。
senses.en_definition: Pure and ritually purifying, specifically in the Islamic term air mutlak.
senses.ms_definition: Suci dan boleh menyucikan, khususnya dalam istilah air mutlak.
senses.nuances: 这是固定宗教术语中的专门义，不是一般意义上的“绝对的水”，也不等同于化学纯水或可饮用水。参见 [DBP：mutlak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mutlak)。

collocations.en: water that is pure and suitable for ritual purification

collocations.zh: 用符合净礼条件的洁净水进行小净
collocations.en: to perform ablution with ritually purifying water

etymology.historical_story: Mutlak comes from Arabic muṭlaq, associated with being unrestricted or absolute. Malay treats the borrowed form as a whole root. Its meanings connect broad claims about power and conditions with the religious expression air mutlak, where the dictionary identifies water that is pure and capable of purification. See [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mutlak) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mutlak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mutlak 连着 hak 记：hak mutlak＝完整、绝对的权利。再配 kuasa mutlak，抓住“没有限制”的核心。

senses.ms_definition: Melihat dengan bersembunyi-sembunyi untuk mengetahui gerak-geri orang dan sebagainya; mengintip; memata-matai.
senses.nuances: 核心是观察时隐藏自己或不让对方察觉；可以指军事侦察，也可以指日常偷看。普通、公开的观察通常用 melihat 或 memerhati。释义依据：[PRPM：intai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=intai)。

etymology.historical_story: Mengintai is formed from intai with the productive Malay prefix meN-. Before the vowel i, this prefix appears as meng-. Dewan's examples connect concealed observation with both everyday life and reconnaissance, showing how one ordinary action can serve very different settings. The related pengintai names the watcher, while pengintaian names the activity. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=intai)

etymology.historical_story: Melepas belongs to the family of lepas, whose meanings include freedom and being no longer attached. Dictionaries also preserve specialized conversational meanings for melepas: disappointment, bodily functions, and a Pahang use involving untruthfulness. These regional and informal meanings show how a familiar Malay word family can develop expressions that learners must recognize through context rather than affixes alone.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries organize menggigil under gigil, alongside forms describing causing or experiencing trembling. Its meanings connect bodily movement with sound: a shaking body provides a concrete image for a quavering voice or musical tone. This is a documented semantic connection, rather than evidence that the word originated as an imitation of chattering teeth. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=268332&keyword=gigil)

etymology.historical_story: Meragukan illustrates a productive Malay distinction within the ragu family. DBP explains it as causing doubt, while meragui describes feeling doubt toward something. The suffix therefore changes the relationship between the doubter and the doubtful matter. Learning that contrast gives a reliable account of the word’s formation without inventing a remote borrowing history. See [DBP PRPM: ragu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=ragu).

etymology.historical_story: The key to this word is rugi, the familiar Malay idea of loss. Adding meN- and -kan shifts attention to what causes that loss. Its dictionary meanings connect commercial losses, deliberate below-cost selling, and wider disadvantages. This makes the word useful for understanding both a trader's accounts and a discussion of unfair treatment.

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies isytihar as an Arabic borrowing. Malay builds mengisytiharkan by adding its own verbal morphology to that borrowed base. The resulting word connects public announcements with the ceremonial language of independence, while also serving everyday administration through declarations of assets and other formally reported information. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=isytihar)

etymology.historical_story: DBP groups mengalami and pengalaman under the experiential base alam. Mengalaminya adds the attached pronoun -nya to the verb, turning a general act of experiencing into experiencing something already mentioned. This small addition lets Malay connect sentences economically: the event appears once, and later references can remain inside the verb. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=168608&keyword=alam)

etymology.historical_story: Mrs began as a written abbreviation of mistress, an English title once associated with a woman's authority or social standing. Its spoken form later contracted to something like missis, while the older spelling survived. This history explains the otherwise puzzling written r, which is absent from the usual modern pronunciation. [Dictionary.com: Mrs](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/mrs).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Mrs，直接读“mis-iz”，联想“某某太太”；不要读成 M-R-S，也不要按现代 mistress 的常见含义理解这个称谓。

senses.zh_definition: 用水清洗身体部位、衣物、食材或其他物品，可配合肥皂或清洁剂。
senses.en_definition: To clean something with water, with or without soap or detergent.

senses.zh_definition: 口语中指严厉责骂、数落某人。

senses.nuances: 宾语若是人，并且语境涉及犯错或训话，可能表示责骂而非替人清洗。正式汇报宜按实际程度使用 menegur、memarahi 或 memberikan teguran keras。

senses.zh_definition: 以强烈的比喻表示彻底清除、扫除某些人或势力。
senses.en_definition: To eliminate or sweep away people or opposing forces completely.
senses.ms_definition: Menghapuskan atau menyapu bersih seseorang atau sesuatu kelompok.

etymology.historical_story: Membasuh is formed within Malay from basuh through the productive active prefix meN-. Its meanings connect physical cleaning with moral cleansing and, in conversation, a severe telling-off. Water removes dirt; figurative washing removes disgrace or confronts misconduct. The dictionary records these extensions, but they do not establish when each meaning first developed. [DBP：membasuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=membasuh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 basuh 和一盆水绑在一起记：mem- + basuh → 动手洗；“洗”的对象换成罪过或人的过错，就进入比喻义。

senses.zh_definition: 声音的延长，尤指阿拉伯语及《古兰经》诵读规则中依规定延长元音。
senses.en_definition: The prolongation of a sound, especially vowel lengthening governed by Quranic recitation rules.

senses.nuances: 这里是诵读术语，不是英语 mad 的“发怒”或“疯狂”。各种 mad 的长度须依具体规则判断，不能一概读成两拍；mad asli 通常为 dua harakat。[DBP：mad](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mad)；[JAKIM：诵读评审规则](https://www.islam.gov.my/images/muat-turun/2024/BUKU_PERATURAN_DAN_PENGHAKIMAN_MAJLIS_TILAWAH_DAN_HAFAZAN.pdf)

senses.en_definition: A mark indicating a long sound in Arabic writing; a maddah.

senses.nuances: 此义通过词典中的 maddah 互释得到支持。应区分延长这一发音现象、长音符号，以及 huruf mad 所指的相关字母，三者并非完全相同的概念。[DBP：mad](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mad)；[DBP：maddah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=maddah)

etymology.historical_story: Mad is an Arabic borrowing associated with extending or lengthening a sound. In Malay, it belongs especially to the vocabulary of Quranic reading instruction. Learners encounter it alongside harakat, the counts used to describe duration, so a short written word names the deliberate stretching of a spoken vowel. [DBP：mad](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mad)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把一个短元音拉长：a → aa，这个“延长”就是 mad；读多长则看具体规则。

morphology.formula: meN- + jimatkan → menjimatkan；完整构词：meN- + jimat + -kan → menjimatkan
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的直接基底 jimatkan；最小词根为 jimat。meN- 在 j 前变为 men-，保留 j；-kan 已包含在直接基底中。

senses.zh_definition: 节约金钱、水、电等资源，或减少完成某事所需的时间、费用和精力。
senses.en_definition: To use resources economically or reduce the money, time, or effort required.
senses.ms_definition: Menghematkan, mengeluarkan dan sebagainya dengan cermat.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常直接接所节省的资源，如 wang、air、masa。强调减少消耗或避免浪费；若强调把钱存起来，应使用 menyimpan wang。这里对应 jimat 的“节俭”义，与“护身符”义无关。马来文释义展开自输入包中的 DBP 释义。[DBP：menjimatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menjimatkan)

etymology.historical_story: Menjimatkan belongs to the Malay family built around jimat, meaning economical or careful in using resources. The proverb ingat sebelum kena, jimat sebelum habis links thrift with acting before supplies run out. That cultural association helps explain why the verb works naturally with household money, water conservation, and workplace efficiency. [DBP: jimat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jimat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 jimat“节省”：men-ji-mat-kan，把钱、时间和水都用得更省。

word_family.gloss: 管理；管理工作或管理层

senses.zh_definition: 管理它；办理或处理前文提到的事务、申请、业务或问题，使其有序进行或得到解决。
senses.en_definition: To manage it, deal with it, or handle the previously mentioned matter.
senses.ms_definition: Mengendalikan atau menyelenggarakan perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya supaya berjalan dengan baik atau dapat diselesaikan.
senses.nuances: 这是 mengurus 加宾语 -nya 的正常组合，不是另一个独立词根。-nya 在此指向前文中的事务或事物，并不表示“由他来管理”。马来文释义为依据 urus 词族义项编写的整词说明，并非 DBP 对该完整词形的逐字引文。[DBP：urus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=urus)

senses.zh_definition: 照顾、照料前文提到的人，或照管房屋、园地等对象。
senses.en_definition: To look after the previously mentioned person or take care of the property concerned.
senses.ms_definition: Menjaga atau memelihara orang, rumah, kebun atau perkara lain yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: -nya 可以指人，英语须按语境译成 him、her 或 them，也可以指物。谈照顾病人或家人时，menjaganya 往往更直接；mengurusnya 更突出安排生活和照料事务。[DBP：urus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=urus)

etymology.historical_story: Mengurusnya illustrates productive Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowing. Urus supplies the idea of arranging or managing, meN- forms the active verb, and -nya points back to an understood person or thing. This compact structure lets a speaker move from naming an application, household, or responsibility to discussing how it will be handled.

etymology.historical_story: Two dictionary histories meet in this spelling. From tanggal meaning 'come loose', menanggalkan describes making something detach, including taking off shoes. A separate tanggal meaning 'calendar date' produces an archaic verb for dating documents. Their identical spelling explains why an isolated dictionary extract can misleadingly suggest that the old administrative meaning is the main one.

etymology.historical_story: Menyedut develops transparently from sedut through the Malay active prefix meN-. Its physical image of drawing something inward supports several dictionary meanings: inhaling, extracting passages and draining money. The related noun sedutan likewise links a physical draw with an excerpt, showing how the same image serves bodily action and textual selection. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sedut)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place this expression within the ungkap family, alongside ungkapan, a phrase or expression. Its cultural interest lies in the connection between language and inward experience: feelings can take shape through speech, a face, or a gesture. Literary writing and public speeches make especially natural settings for this verb. [DBP: ungkap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=ungkap)

etymology.historical_story: Mineral belongs to the international vocabulary of earth science and nutrition. Malay uses the same whole stem for substances in rocks and nutrient elements in food, while the surrounding words identify the intended field. This makes sumber mineral and garam mineral useful contrasting expressions: one concerns geological resources, the other inorganic salts.

dulu 是 dahulu 的口语形式。
口语中可保留完整动词 mengebom，以清楚表达历史事件。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok dokumentari tu? Ada bahagian pasal pesawat mengebom bandar.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah menonton dokumentari itu? Terdapat bahagian tentang pesawat yang mengebom bandar.
messages.zh: 你看那部纪录片了吗？里面有一段讲飞机轰炸城市。
messages.en: Have you seen that documentary? There's a section about aircraft bombing cities.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Sedih lah tengok nasib penduduk kat situ.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya berasa sedih melihat nasib penduduk di situ.
messages.zh: 看了。看到那里居民的遭遇，真的很难过。
messages.en: Yes. It was heartbreaking to see what happened to the people living there.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是描述战争或袭击的严肃用词。涉及受害者时宜采用客观、克制的表达，避免把真实伤亡当作玩笑。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合历史讨论、新闻转述和明确的影视情节描述。公共场合中的炸弹威胁不能当作随意玩笑；普通消息轰炸可说 menghantar mesej bertalu-talu，以免产生歧义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是描述战争或袭击的严肃用词。涉及受害者时宜采用客观、克制的表达，避免把真实伤亡当作玩笑。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合历史讨论、新闻转述和明确的影视情节描述。公共场合中的炸弹威胁不能当作随意玩笑；普通消息轰炸可说 menghantar mesej bertalu-talu，以免产生歧义。

etymology.historical_story: Dewan's entry illustrates mengebom through wartime attacks on cities, placing the verb in the language of historical reporting. Its formation also demonstrates a distinctive Malay pattern: the one-syllable base bom takes menge-, with an extra schwa. The related noun pengeboman names the action, while pengebom can name a bomber aircraft. [DBP: bom](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=bom)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bom 是炸弹；单音节词根前用 menge-：menge- + bom → mengebom。把中间轻读的 /ə/ 也一起记住。

morphology.formula: meramal + -kan → meramalkan；完整构词：meN- + ramal + -kan → meramalkan
morphology.pattern_note: meramal是资料包指定的直接词基，底层词根是ramal。meN-在r前实现为me-，保留r；接-kan时词基不发生音变。

senses.zh_definition: 通过占卜、命书等推算某人的命运或未来遭遇。
senses.en_definition: To tell someone's fortune through divination.
senses.ms_definition: Menengok nasib orang dengan membuka kitab nujum; menenung atau menelah.
senses.nuances: 指占卜意义的推算，通常以nasib等作宾语。须由语境与科学预测义区分。[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=ramal)

senses.zh_definition: 根据资料、迹象或推测，判断并说明将发生的事情。
senses.en_definition: To predict or forecast what will happen.
senses.ms_definition: Memberitahukan sesuatu yang akan berlaku; menerka, menduga atau menelah.
senses.nuances: 常用于天气、经济、需求和比赛结果等预测。该词本身不保证预测准确，也不限定预测方法；DBP例句亦包含对他人心思的推测。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penganalisis meramalkan permintaan terhadap produk tempatan akan meningkat pada tahun hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 分析人士预测，明年对本地产品的需求将会上升。
dual_scenarios.en: Analysts forecast that demand for local products will increase next year.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Susah nak meramalkan siapa menang malam ni, dua-dua kuat lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sukar untuk meramalkan siapa yang akan menang malam ini kerana kedua-dua pasukan kuat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 今晚谁会赢很难说啦，两队都很强。
dual_scenarios.en: It's hard to predict who'll win tonight. Both teams are strong.
spoken_features: nak对应hendak或untuk，具体随句法调整
ni是ini的口语形式
dua-dua对应kedua-dua
lah加强语气；口语省略了pasukan和akan

messages.ms_standard: Sukar untuk meramalkan siapa yang akan menang malam ini kerana kedua-dua pasukan kuat.
messages.zh: 今晚谁会赢很难说啦，两队都很强。
messages.en: It's hard to predict who'll win tonight. Both teams are strong.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul tu. Kita tengok je nanti, jangan yakin sangat.
messages.ms_standard: Betul. Kita lihat sahaja nanti; jangan terlalu yakin.
messages.zh: 对啊，等着看就好，别太有把握。
messages.en: Exactly. Let's just wait and see. Don't be too sure.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于专业预测时语体中性，适合新闻和报告。说明依据或加上berdasarkan data，可使表达更审慎。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈天气、市场和赛事均自然。涉及个人命运或占卜时，应尊重对方的信仰与意愿；不要把推测说成必然发生的事实。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于专业预测时语体中性，适合新闻和报告。说明依据或加上berdasarkan data，可使表达更审慎。
