etymology.historical_story: Modern Malaysian usage gives mendiang a respectful role in remembering deceased non-Muslims. DBP also records an identical verb meaning to warm or cook something beside a fire. Their shared spelling should not encourage an invented historical explanation: the modern dictionary entries establish the two uses, but do not by themselves prove how the respectful designation originated. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mendiang)

morphology.formula: menunjuk + -kan → menunjukkan；menunjukan 是漏写一个 k 的非规范形式
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的直接基形 menunjuk；更底层词根为 tunjuk。meN- 遇词首 t，t 脱落：meN- + tunjuk → menunjuk。加 -kan 时必须保留词干末尾 k，形成 -kkan。所列 IPA 对应标准形式 menunjukkan；输入 Jawi 实际对应 menunjuk，未包含后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 给人看；展示某物，使其能够被看见或辨认。标准拼写为 menunjukkan。
senses.en_definition: Nonstandard spelling of menunjukkan: to show or display something to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi menunjukkan: memperlihatkan sesuatu supaya dapat dilihat atau dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 正式写作应使用 menunjukkan。输入释义属于 menunjuk，不能直接视为 menunjukan 的独立规范释义。以下搭配和例句采用标准拼写。[DBP 拼写检索](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menunjukan)

senses.zh_definition: 说明或示范某种方法；向人指出路线、位置或处理办法。
senses.en_definition: To demonstrate a method or show someone a route, location, or solution.
senses.ms_definition: Menerangkan atau memperagakan cara melakukan sesuatu, atau memberikan panduan tentang arah dan tempat.
senses.nuances: menunjuk ke arah sesuatu 侧重指向某处的动作；menunjukkan jalan 侧重让对方知道路线。不要与 menunjuk-nunjuk 的“炫耀”义混同。

senses.zh_definition: 显示、表明某种情况、变化、态度或性质。
senses.en_definition: To indicate a condition, change, attitude, or characteristic.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi tanda atau bukti tentang sesuatu keadaan, perubahan, sikap atau sifat.
senses.nuances: 常用于数据、调查结果和行为表现；表示“显示”时，不一定意味着已经确凿证明。

etymology.historical_story: The semantic bridge begins with tunjuk, the act of pointing. Pointing directs another person's attention; showing makes an object or idea accessible to them. The standard derivative menunjukkan extends this everyday gesture into demonstrations, evidence, and abstract indications. Its double k records the meeting of the stem menunjuk and the suffix -kan, rather than an optional spelling flourish.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象“指一下，让你看懂”：tunjuk 是指，menunjukkan 是展示或表明。记住 k + kan = kkan，两个 k 都要留。

morphology.pattern_note: 依输入保留 harungi 作为直接构词基底；DBP 收录的基础词根是 harung。meN- 在 h 前实现为 meng-，h 保留；-i 前的 ng 读 /ŋ/，不增加 /g/。[DBP：harung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=harung)

senses.zh_definition: 涉过河流或积水；穿过灌木丛等难行地带。

senses.nuances: 突出身体进入水中或障碍区域并向前穿行。普通过马路通常用 menyeberangi jalan；乘桥过河也不必用 mengharungi。[DBP：mengharungi 与 menyeberangi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menempuh)

senses.nuances: 与涉水义不同，此义可指乘船穿越深水；常见于航海报道和文学叙述。[DBP：harung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=harung)

senses.zh_definition: 经历并应对困难、考验或人生中的艰辛。
senses.en_definition: To go through and contend with difficulties, hardship, or life's challenges.

senses.nuances: 比喻把困境视为必须穿越的水域，强调经历与坚持；词语本身不保证困难已经解决。[DBP：mengharungi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengharungi)

etymology.historical_story: DBP's harung entry brings river crossings, sea voyages, and hardship into one semantic family. These meanings offer a vivid cultural image: progress requires moving through something resistant. The figurative use makes difficulty resemble water or rough terrain. This is a useful connection between the recorded senses, rather than a claim about their chronological development. [DBP: harung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=harung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 harung 记成“闯过去”：mengharungi sungai 是涉河闯过去，mengharungi cabaran 是面对挑战闯过去。

etymology.historical_story: Rekrut belongs to the European vocabulary of recruiting, alongside English recruit and Dutch rekruut. Its Malay dictionary meanings cover both military newcomers and new organizational members. Adding the productive Malay prefix meN- creates merekrut, turning the newcomer into an action: bringing newcomers in. The available packet does not establish the immediate borrowing language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 rekrut 联想到英语 recruit，再加 me- 表示动作：把新人招进来。

etymology.historical_story: Menjilat is formed from the Malay base jilat with the verbal prefix meN-. Its everyday image is a tongue touching food. Malay dictionaries also record flames spreading over a roof and people flattering superiors for advantage. These established figurative uses make one physical action a memorable bridge to fire imagery and criticism of social behaviour. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menjilat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 jilat＝舔：猫舔食物是本义，火焰像舌头般蔓延是比喻，靠“舔”讨好上级就是谄媚。

morphology.formula: mengawasi + -nya → mengawasinya；完整分析：meN- + awas + -i + -nya → mengawasinya
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的 mengawasi 作为直接构词基础；更深层词根是 awas。meN- 在元音 a 前实现为 meng-，-i 构成及物动词；-nya 是附着在动词后的第三人称宾语代词，并非派生后缀，此处依字段归入 suffix。音节为 me.nga.wa.si.nya。headword.jawi 按输入保留，但 مڠاوسي 实际只对应 mengawasi；完整词形应为 مڠاوسيڽ。[DBP：awas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=awas)；[DBP：-nya 的爪夷文写法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kamus+nya)

etymology.historical_story: The deeper base awas connects sharp sight with alertness and caution. Mengawasi turns that attentiveness into an action directed at someone or something, from watching a child to supervising a project. Adding -nya supplies the object already known from context. The word therefore packages an action and its referent together; it does not add a new tense or identify the person's gender.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: awas 是“留神”；mengawasi 是“留神看管”；再接 -nya，就把“他／她／它”一起看住。

etymology.historical_story: Menyerahlah illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate historical borrowing. Its underlying root is serah, whose family connects handing over, yielding, and entrusting. The prefix meN- produces menyerah through nasal substitution. Adding -lah gives the utterance emphasis or an urging tone, so context determines whether it sounds pleading, reassuring, or challenging. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=serah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 serah 的“交出去”：交出胜局就是认输，交出自己就是投降；加 -lah，仿佛补上一声“吧！”。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records selidik with the qualities of care and precision, then groups menyelidik and menyelidiki under investigation, thorough study, and reconnaissance. This word family connects a careful manner with the work of discovering information. The connection is useful for understanding the modern vocabulary, but it should not be mistaken for a dated account of the word’s historical development. morphology.pattern_note: ng 表示 /ŋ/，后面的 g 另读 /ɡ/。本词不含词缀；词族中的 bermangga、memangga 属于“挂锁”义，不能据此解释为芒果的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 芒果；芒果树，尤指学名为 Mangifera indica 的植物及其果实。

senses.ms_definition: Sejenis tumbuhan, termasuk pokok dan buahnya, yang juga disebut mempelam, khususnya Mangifera indica.
senses.nuances: buah mangga 明确指果实，pokok mangga 明确指树。此义与“挂锁”义分列为同形词。马来语定义据 [PRPM《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mangga)展开缩略语并改写。

senses.zh_definition: 挂锁：可将锁梁扣在门、铁栅或其他物件上的锁。
senses.en_definition: A padlock; a detachable lock fastened through a loop, staple, or similar fitting.
senses.ms_definition: Ibu kunci yang disangkutkan pada pintu atau benda lain; pedal ayam.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚马来语中的标准词义，不仅指水果。kunci mangga 常指挂锁，anak kunci 则指开锁用的钥匙。参见 [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mangga)。

senses.zh_definition: 在传统说法 sakit mangga 中，指腹股沟处通常伴有化脓的肿块或肿大的淋巴结。
senses.en_definition: In the traditional expression sakit mangga, a groin swelling or swollen lymph node, often suppurating.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan sakit mangga, bengkak pada celah kelangkang yang biasanya bernanah, atau kelenjar yang membengkak.
senses.nuances: 这是词典收录的传统病症称谓，现代日常使用较少，不能直接等同于某一种确定疾病。以下为该固定说法及其自然句法扩展，并非高频现代搭配。依据 [PRPM 的 mangga III](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mangga)。

etymology.historical_story: The fruit word mangga is commonly connected with Tamil māṅkāy and the wider movement of South Asian vocabulary into maritime Southeast Asia. Malay also has a separate mangga meaning 'padlock'; similarity of spelling alone does not establish a shared origin. [Research](https://journals.openedition.org/archipel/pdf/490)

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary family of jana connects older meanings of life and existence with modern production: generators produce electricity, while businesses generate income. This offers a useful cultural bridge between something coming into being and something being produced. The packet also preserves a separate archaic homograph meaning moderate; that sense must not replace the modern verb.

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan places merampok under rampok and illustrates it with a narrative of raiders descending from the mountains. The surrounding family names the robbers, their activity, and the stolen goods. For Malaysian learners, its strongest cultural association is often literary or regional storytelling, while merompak is the more familiar everyday counterpart.

word_family.gloss: 干扰者；造成干扰的事物

senses.zh_definition: 打扰、招惹或骚扰他人，使其不安、烦恼或无法安心做事；标准词形为 mengganggu。
senses.en_definition: To disturb, bother, tease, or harass someone; correctly spelled mengganggu.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusik atau mengacau seseorang sehingga berasa tidak tenteram atau terganggu; ejaan bakunya ialah mengganggu.
senses.nuances: menggangu 是误拼，不是独立词义或公认口语变体。正确词可指轻微打扰，也可指严重骚扰，程度由行为和语境决定。参见 [DBP ganggu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=ganggu)。

senses.zh_definition: 干扰、阻碍某项活动、过程或功能的正常进行；标准词形为 mengganggu。
senses.en_definition: To interfere with or disrupt an activity, process, or function; correctly spelled mengganggu.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalang atau menjejaskan kelancaran sesuatu kegiatan, proses atau fungsi.
senses.nuances: 主语可以是噪声、设备故障或其他情况，不必是有意作乱的人；此时英语常用 disrupt 或 interfere with。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 描述不受欢迎的行为时应说明具体情境；不要把令对方不适的骚扰轻描淡写地说成玩笑。正式和日常书写均采用 mengganggu。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Maaf mengganggu 是打断别人或开始询问时常用的礼貌表达。面对上司或陌生人，可接 Boleh saya bertanya…?。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 描述不受欢迎的行为时应说明具体情境；不要把令对方不适的骚扰轻描淡写地说成玩笑。正式和日常书写均采用 mengganggu。

etymology.historical_story: The securely documented explanation is morphological: DBP records ganggu and its derivatives, including mengganggu, gangguan, and pengganggu. The prefix does not replace or shorten the root. Remembering the intact base explains the spelling and connects everyday apologies for interruptions with descriptions of disrupted work. A deeper historical origin is not established here. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=ganggu).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先写完整 ganggu，再加 meng-：meng + ganggu = mengganggu。记住两组 ng，别漏掉后一组的 n。

headword.jawi_note: 保留数据包写法；该写法对应 menolong，未包含 -mu。

morphology.pattern_note: menolong 是直接构词基础，底层词根为 tolong。meN- 遇词首 t 时，t 脱落并形成 men-；-mu 是表示第二人称宾语的后附代词，不是派生后缀，须与前词连写。

senses.zh_definition: 帮助你，以体力、金钱、意见等协助你完成事情或解决困难。
senses.en_definition: To help you with a task or difficulty through effort, money, advice, or other assistance.
senses.ms_definition: Membantu kamu dengan tenaga, wang, fikiran atau cara lain.
senses.nuances: -mu 在此表示动作的对象“你”，并非所有关系“你的”。该形式符合标准语法，但在日常会话中，menolong awak 或 tolong kau 往往更自然，具体取决于关系。

senses.zh_definition: 救你，使你脱离危险或危急处境。
senses.en_definition: To rescue you from danger or a life-threatening situation.
senses.ms_definition: Menyelamatkan kamu daripada bahaya atau keadaan yang mengancam nyawa.
senses.nuances: 此义强于一般的帮忙；具体危险由上下文说明。

senses.zh_definition: 帮助你减轻痛苦、病情或困境；对你的状况有所帮助。
senses.en_definition: To help relieve your suffering, illness, or distress.
senses.ms_definition: Membantu meringankan penderitaan, penyakit atau kesusahan yang kamu alami.
senses.nuances: 主语可以是人、治疗或其他援助；表示有所帮助，并不必然表示治愈或完全解决问题。

collocations.zh: 能够帮助你改善状况的治疗

dual_scenarios.context: 职场培训 / 导师书面寄语
dual_scenarios.ms: Sebagai mentor, saya bersedia menolongmu mengembangkan kemahiran yang diperlukan untuk menjalankan tugas ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 作为导师，我愿意帮助你培养执行这项任务所需的技能。
dual_scenarios.en: As your mentor, I am ready to help you develop the skills needed for this task.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友间带玩笑的安慰
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jangan risau, aku kan ada untuk menolongmu!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jangan risau, aku ada untuk menolongmu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 别担心，有我帮你嘛！
dual_scenarios.en: Don't worry, I'm here to help you!
spoken_features: kan 在此加强安慰语气，相当于“不是还有我嘛”。
menolongmu 比一般朋友聊天中的 tolong kau 更有书面或歌词感，此处带轻松、夸张的语气。
dah 对应 sudah；nak 对应 hendak。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah cuba angkat kotak ni, tapi berat sangatlah.
messages.ms_standard: Aku sudah cuba mengangkat kotak ini, tetapi kotak ini terlalu berat.
messages.zh: 我已经试着搬这个箱子了，可它实在太重啦。
messages.en: I've tried lifting this box, but it's way too heavy.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jangan risau, aku kan ada untuk menolongmu! Nak letak kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Jangan risau, aku ada untuk menolongmu. Kamu hendak meletakkannya di mana?
messages.zh: 别担心，有我帮你嘛！要放哪儿？
messages.en: Don't worry, I'm here to help you! Where do you want it?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 不自动表示尊敬。面对长辈、客户或上级，通常改用 menolong tuan、membantu puan 或对方称谓；朋友间是否使用 aku、kau 取决于既有关系。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合亲密交流、文学和鼓励性寄语。正式服务场景通常使用 membantu anda，避免让不熟悉的人感到被过分亲近。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 不自动表示尊敬。面对长辈、客户或上级，通常改用 menolong tuan、membantu puan 或对方称谓；朋友间是否使用 aku、kau 取决于既有关系。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合亲密交流、文学和鼓励性寄语。正式服务场景通常使用 membantu anda，避免让不熟悉的人感到被过分亲近。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds menolongmu from the verb menolong and the attached pronoun -mu. The underlying root, tolong, also appears in requests for assistance and in expressions of mutual help. This connects the word with everyday cooperation, while its compact pronoun ending gives many modern utterances a literary, lyrical, or deliberately intimate flavour.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tolong＝帮忙，再把 -mu 看成指向“你”的箭头：menolong + mu＝帮助你。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词，须整体记忆；输入的 sso 不是有效音节划分，已改为单音节 mind。没有依据可将其标为正式马来语词或补造官方 Jawi。以下英语派生词不属于马来语词缀系统。

word_family.gloss: 英语：具有某种思想倾向的，常用于复合词

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：心智、思想或记忆等心理活动及其能力；马来语通常对应 minda、fikiran 或 ingatan。
senses.en_definition: The faculty of thought, awareness, feeling, and memory.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada minda, fikiran atau ingatan, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 此处提供英语词的马来语解释，并非声称存在同形的正式马来语词。下列 ms 字段展示夹用英语的表达，并注明标准马来语对应形式。参见 [DBP 英马词典：mind](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=mind) 与 [Cambridge：mind](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/mind)。

collocations.ms: peace of mind（英语短语；标准马来语：ketenangan fikiran）
open mind（英语短语；标准马来语：fikiran terbuka）
collocations.zh: 开放的思想；不抱成见的态度

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：介意、反对或感到不便；在马英混用口语中可见 tak mind，意为“不介意”。
senses.en_definition: To object to something or feel bothered by it.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud berasa keberatan atau terganggu oleh sesuatu.
senses.nuances: tak mind 属语码混用；正式马来语宜用 tidak kisah 或 tidak keberatan。英语 mind 另有留意、当心及照看等义，应依语境译为 berhati-hati、menghiraukan 或 menjaga。参见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mind) 和 [Cambridge 用法说明](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/mind)。

collocations.ms: tak mind（混用口语；标准马来语：tidak kisah）
mind tak kalau…（混用口语；标准马来语：adakah awak keberatan jika…）

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam dokumen rasmi ini, perkataan bahasa Inggeris 'mind' diterjemahkan sebagai 'fikiran' mengikut konteks ayat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这份正式文件中，英语词 mind 根据句子语境译为 fikiran。
dual_scenarios.en: In this official document, the English word 'mind' is translated as 'fikiran' according to the sentence context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku tak mind kalau kita makan kat sini je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya tidak kisah jika kita makan di sini sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 就在这儿吃也行，我不介意。
dual_scenarios.en: I don't mind if we just eat here.
spoken_features: mind 是夹入马来语句子的英语动词。
tak、kat、je 分别对应 tidak、di、sahaja。
aku 适用于熟悉的朋友之间。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau mind tak kalau kita makan kat sini je? Aku dah lapar.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak keberatan jika kita makan di sini sahaja? Saya sudah lapar.
messages.zh: 就在这儿吃，你介意吗？我已经饿了。
messages.en: Would you mind if we just ate here? I'm hungry already.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak mind lah. Aku pun nak makan sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Saya tidak kisah. Saya juga mahu makan sekarang.
messages.zh: 不介意呀，我也想现在吃。
messages.en: Not at all. I'd like to eat now too.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉英语的朋友之间可用 tak mind；面对长辈、公众或不熟悉英语的人，tidak kisah、tidak keberatan 更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合能理解马英混用的非正式交流。正式马来语文件应按语义翻译；本条 status 标为 foreign，避免把词频记录误当成正式马来语词资格。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉英语的朋友之间可用 tak mind；面对长辈、公众或不熟悉英语的人，tidak kisah、tidak keberatan 更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合能理解马英混用的非正式交流。正式马来语文件应按语义翻译；本条 status 标为 foreign，避免把词频记录误当成正式马来语词资格。

etymology.historical_story: Mind belongs to English in the evidence available here. DBP lists it in its English–Malay dictionary, where different contexts require fikiran, ingatan, menjaga, or keberatan. Its appearance in a Malay conversation can therefore reflect language mixing rather than an established Malay headword. This distinction prevents a familiar conversational English word from receiving an unsupported official Malay identity. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mind).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“迈恩德”，不要按马来语逐字母拼成 min。记住 tak mind ≈ tidak kisah：不介意。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留 meleset 作为本条词汇基底；这不表示所有同形义项都不可再分析。词典也把部分 meleset 义项列在 leset 下，可分析为 meN- + leset → meleset，l 保留。首音节 e 为 /ə/，后两个 e 为 /e/。

word_family.gloss: 滑倒；失足，属于滑移义词群

senses.zh_definition: 不准确；与事实、预期或目标不符，尤指预测、判断或猜测。
senses.en_definition: Inaccurate or wide of the mark, especially of a prediction or judgment.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak tepat atau tidak kena pada yang dijangkakan.
senses.nuances: 这是现代常用义之一；不应因输入只摘到“涂抹”就遗漏。依据 [DBP PRPM：meleset](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=meleset)，马来文释义为据义改写。

senses.zh_definition: 经济或商业活动衰退、低迷，呈现萧条或困顿状态。
senses.en_definition: Depressed or declining, especially of economic or business activity.
senses.ms_definition: Merosot atau mundur, khususnya tentang kegiatan ekonomi dan perniagaan.
senses.nuances: 常与 ekonomi、perniagaan、zaman 搭配；名词 kemelesetan 常用于 kemelesetan ekonomi。这里的词义说明不等于以任何单一指标判定技术性衰退。参见 [DBP 词条及经济用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=meleset)。

senses.zh_definition: 滑离应有的位置；脚步滑脱或失足。
senses.en_definition: To slip or slide out of the intended position.
senses.ms_definition: Tergelincir atau teralih daripada kedudukan yang sepatutnya.
senses.nuances: 词典有此义，但日常描述滑倒通常更常用 tergelincir 或 terpeleset。以下为帮助理解的组合，不标作高频。

senses.zh_definition: 涂抹油漆等物质。
senses.en_definition: To spread or apply paint or a similar substance.
senses.ms_definition: Menyapu cat atau bahan seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 这是输入确实包含的独立义项，不能与“不准确”或“经济低迷”混为一义。属于较少见用法；现代通用表达宜用 menyapu cat 或 mengecat。以下为释义性组合，不声称具有高频语料支持。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Ramalan jualan syarikat itu meleset kerana permintaan sebenar lebih rendah daripada jangkaan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 由于实际需求低于预期，该公司的销售预测出现偏差。
dual_scenarios.en: The company's sales forecast proved inaccurate because actual demand was lower than expected.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku ingat kedai tu buka sampai malam, rupanya tekaan aku meleset lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya menyangka kedai itu dibuka sehingga malam, tetapi ternyata tekaan saya tidak tepat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我还以为那家店开到晚上呢，结果猜错了。
dual_scenarios.en: I thought that shop stayed open until the evening, but I got it wrong.
spoken_features: ingat 在此表示原先以为，并非记住。
tu 对应 itu。
lah 表达对判断落空的感叹。
aku 适用于朋友之间。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah sampai kat kedai, tapi tutup. Tekaan kita meleset lah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah tiba di kedai itu, tetapi kedai itu ditutup. Tekaan kita tidak tepat.
messages.zh: 我已经到店了，可是没开。我们猜错啦。
messages.en: I'm at the shop, but it's closed. We guessed wrong.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Alamak, aku ingat buka lagi. Kita pergi kedai sebelah je.
messages.ms_standard: Aduhai, saya menyangka kedai itu masih dibuka. Mari kita pergi ke kedai di sebelah sahaja.
messages.zh: 哎呀，我还以为开着呢。我们去隔壁那家吧。
messages.en: Oh no, I thought it was still open. Let's just go to the shop next door.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Ramalan awak meleset 可能显得责备。职场反馈可说 Ramalan ini perlu disemak semula，表达“这项预测需要重新检视”。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于预测和经济报道时自然、正式。经济低迷义不宜随意套在人身上；涂抹义较少见，面向全国受众时采用 menyapu cat 或 mengecat 更清楚。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 Ramalan awak meleset 可能显得责备。职场反馈可说 Ramalan ini perlu disemak semula，表达“这项预测需要重新检视”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 用于预测和经济报道时自然、正式。经济低迷义不宜随意套在人身上；涂抹义较少见，面向全国受众时采用 menyapu cat 或 mengecat 更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records several meanings under the spelling meleset, including inaccurate judgment, economic decline, slipping, and applying paint. Its newspaper index already lists the word in a 1973 title, with explicitly economic titles appearing in the 1980s. These records establish historical usage, not a single origin story linking every meaning. The painting sense must therefore remain distinct. See [DBP newspaper index](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=meleset).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 me.le.set 联想成“没对准，滑离线”：预测偏离事实，经济滑向低迷。涂抹义另记，不强行串成同一词源。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在此实现为 mem-；proses 以辅音群 pr- 起首，因此保留 p，不套用单辅音 p 常见的脱落规则。前缀 e 读 /ə/，词末 sés 的 é 读 /e/。音节据词包定义中的 mem.pro.sés 补全。[DBP：Petua Pengimbuhan](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/01/01/11474/)

senses.zh_definition: 按照既定程序办理或处理申请、文件、交易等事项。
senses.en_definition: To deal with an application, document, transaction, or other matter according to an established procedure.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil tindakan tertentu terhadap sesuatu mengikut prosedur yang ditetapkan.
senses.nuances: 强调按程序执行处理步骤。正在 memproses permohonan 只表示正在办理申请，并不表示已经批准或完成。[DBP：memproses 的程序处理义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=prosedur)

senses.zh_definition: 加工原料，使其成为可用产品或制成品。
senses.en_definition: To treat or transform raw materials into usable or finished products.
senses.ms_definition: Mengolah bahan mentah menjadi barangan siap.
senses.nuances: 用于制造业、农业及食品生产，突出材料经过一系列加工步骤；不等同于单纯搬运或包装。[DBP：memproses 的加工义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=prosedur)

senses.zh_definition: 依照指定操作对数据或信息进行转换、计算、分析等处理，以获得所需结果。
senses.en_definition: To perform operations on data or information to produce a required result.
senses.ms_definition: Mengolah data atau maklumat melalui operasi tertentu untuk menghasilkan output yang diperlukan.
senses.nuances: 计算机与信息技术中的专业用法。此处依据 DBP 的计算机术语释义归纳，不另称为《Kamus Dewan》所列的第三义。不同于仅仅储存或传送数据。[DBP：信息处理术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=information)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Unit pentadbiran sedang memproses semua permohonan yang lengkap mengikut prosedur yang ditetapkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 行政部门正按照既定程序办理所有材料齐全的申请。
dual_scenarios.en: The administration unit is processing all complete applications in accordance with the established procedure.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sistem tengah memproses bayaran kau lagi, tunggu kejap ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sistem masih sedang memproses bayaran kamu. Tunggu sebentar, ya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 系统还在处理你的付款，稍等一下哈。
dual_scenarios.en: The system's still processing your payment. Give it a moment.
spoken_features: tengah 在此作进行标记，对应 sedang；句末 lagi 表示仍在继续。
kau 是熟人之间的非正式第二人称；kejap 对应 sebentar。
dah 对应 sudah；je 对应 sahaja；ya 用于缓和提醒。
memproses 作为行政及技术动词，在日常交流中也可以保留完整词形。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Sistem tengah memproses bayaran kau lagi, tunggu kejap ya.
messages.ms_standard: Sistem masih sedang memproses bayaran kamu. Tunggu sebentar, ya.
messages.zh: 系统还在处理你的付款，稍等一下哈。
messages.en: The system's still processing your payment. Give it a moment.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, aku tunggu je. Dah siap nanti, bagitahu ya.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, saya akan menunggu. Beritahu saya apabila proses itu sudah selesai.

etymology.historical_story: DBP lists proses as an English borrowing. Malay integrates it into its own grammatical system through memproses, pemproses and pemprosesan. The retained pr cluster makes this family especially memorable: the borrowed base remains recognizable even after prefixation. Its uses bring applications, factory materials and computer data under one practical idea: organized operations that produce a result. [DBP: proses word family and English origin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pemprosesan)

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，无可分析的马来语词缀；首音节的 e 读 /e/，不是 /ə/。原包未提供音节字段；常规划分为 me.mo。

senses.zh_definition: 备忘录；用于简要传达事项、通知或指示的书面文件，常用于机构内部。

senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bagi memorandum.
senses.nuances: 职场中通常指内部书面通知。不是所有个人笔记或手机提醒都叫 memo；这类内容常用 nota 或 peringatan。memorandum 的适用范围较广，也可指提交给有关方面的正式说明或陈情文件。

etymology.historical_story: Memo is a shortened form of memorandum, rather than a word assembled from Malay affixes. Its office setting helps explain its everyday meaning: a short document carries information between people in an organization. Malaysian administrative guidance describes memos as brief formal written communications, linking the familiar workplace word to established document practice. [Source: Malaysian administrative guidance](https://aplikasi.bheuu.gov.my/mbjbheuu/assets/doc/apkp_bil5_tahun2014.pdf).

morphology.formula: mempesona + -kan → mempesonakan；整体构词：meN- + pesona + -kan → mempesonakan
morphology.pattern_note: 按原包保留 mempesona 作为直接构词基础，因此本层标为后缀 -kan；更基础的词根是 pesona。此词采用 mem- 并保留 p，应记作 mempesonakan，不能机械套用 p 脱落规则。

senses.zh_definition: 对某人施加迷惑心智的法术；使其受到妖术或咒术的影响。
senses.en_definition: To bewitch someone or subject them to an enchantment.
senses.ms_definition: Mengenakan pesona atau sihir kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这是法术意义，主要见于民间故事、传统信仰叙述或文学。以下搭配为说明此义的组合，不应理解为现代日常高频表达。[参见 DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mempesonakan+)。

collocations.zh: 对受害者施加迷惑法术

senses.zh_definition: 使人深深着迷、受到吸引或赞叹；以美感、魅力或表现打动人心。
senses.en_definition: To captivate, enchant, or fill someone with admiration.
senses.ms_definition: Memikat hati, menarik perhatian dengan kuat, atau menimbulkan rasa kagum.
senses.nuances: 现代常用义，适合描写风景、艺术、歌声或人的魅力。可带宾语，如 mempesonakan penonton；也常见于 pemandangan yang mempesonakan 一类修饰结构。并不必然含有爱情或性诱惑。[参见 DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mempesonakan+)。

etymology.historical_story: The pesona family brings together literal enchantment and figurative fascination. DBP records mempesonakan both for applying a spell and for captivating or inspiring admiration. A useful cultural bridge is the image of beauty holding someone spellbound. This explains the relationship between the meanings without assuming a particular historical borrowing route or a documented chronology. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=mempesonakan+).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pesona＝魅力或迷惑；mempesonakan＝让别人被魅力吸住；terpesona＝自己已经着迷。

morphology.formula: meminum + -nya → meminumnya；整体构词：meN- + minum + -nya → meminumnya
morphology.pattern_note: 按原包保留 meminum 作为直接基础，更基础的词根是 minum。meN- 在 m 前取 me-，词根 m 保留；-nya 读 /ɲa/，此处为后附代词，按给定字段归入 suffix，并非派生词缀。原包未提供音节字段；常规划分为 me.mi.num.nya。headword.jawi 保留原包 ممينوم，但该写法仅对应 meminum；完整形式应写作 ممينومڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 喝它；把上文已经提到的水、饮料或其他液体喝下。

senses.ms_definition: Meneguk atau menelan cecair yang telah disebut atau diketahui dalam konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是 meminum 与后附成分 -nya 的组合，不能由 -nya 推断是谁在喝；主语仍须由句子或上下文确定。本义中的 -nya 回指所喝的液体，不表示“他的饮料”，也不自带完成时。原包中 meminum 的 Id 标记义涉及吸食烟或鸦片，不应当作现代马来西亚日常“喝它”的默认用法；本条马来语释义是针对完整形式的综合释义。[参见 DBP：minum](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=minum)。

etymology.historical_story: Meminumnya illustrates how a familiar Malay action word can carry a reference back to something already mentioned. Minum supplies the drinking meaning, meminum provides the prefixed verb, and -nya completes the contextual reference. DBP also preserves a separately marked Indonesian use involving smoking, a reminder that dictionary families can contain meanings unsuitable for ordinary contemporary Malaysian conversation. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=minum).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: minum＝喝；meminum＝喝这一动作；尾巴 -nya 把意思接回前面那杯东西：喝它。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节独立词，无词缀变化。mal I 指器物部位；mal II 指财产，两者是同形异源词，不应推定具有共同词源。未补造输入中缺失的音节和爪夷文资料。

word_family.gloss: 伊斯兰公共财库；与 mal II 财产义相关的复合词，并非加缀派生词

senses.zh_definition: 矛头、剑刃等的根部；用于马来短剑时，指称为 ganja 的刃根横件。

senses.nuances: 同属 mal I，重点在构件的顶部，不等于整根柱子或桌腿。此义亦属冷僻器物用语。依据 [DBP：mal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mal)。

senses.ms_definition: Harta benda atau khazanah.

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan separates two homonyms here. Mal I names parts of blades and posts, preserving vocabulary associated with traditional objects. Mal II is explicitly identified as Arabic and means property or wealth, also appearing in baitulmal. Their identical spelling does not establish a shared origin; the deeper origin of the craft term remains unconfirmed here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /mal/ 想成给器物部位贴的小标签：刀刃看根部，柱子看顶部；财产义另放进 baitulmal 的财库画面里。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 c 前变为 men-，保留 c；字母 c 读 /tʃ/，前两个音节中的 e 均为 /ə/。输入给出的 cetuskan 已含后缀 -kan，并非最底层词根；依 DBP 词条修正为 cetus。affix_type 沿用模板的 circumfix 类别，表示前后词缀组合。

word_family.gloss: 火花；迸发出的思想或情感

senses.zh_definition: 使火花或火星迸出。
senses.en_definition: To produce or emit sparks.
senses.ms_definition: Menghasilkan atau mengeluarkan percikan api.

senses.zh_definition: 引发、激起或促成某种事件、局势、情绪或灵感，常突出其突然出现或开始的时刻。
senses.en_definition: To spark, trigger or bring about an event, situation, feeling or idea.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan keadaan, peristiwa, perasaan atau ilham, lazimnya secara tiba-tiba.
senses.nuances: 可接正面或负面结果，既能引发创意，也能引发争议。它突出起因或触发作用；表达缓慢、持续的影响时，mempengaruhi 可能更合适。作为主动及物动词，通常带宾语。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan describes cetus through a sound like iron scraping stone and records expressions associated with making fire. Mencetuskan carries this spark image into events, feelings and inspiration. The connection offers a concrete way to understand its figurative uses: a small initiating action can set a much larger development in motion. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=cetus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 cetus 的“擦出火花”画面：meN- + cetus + -kan，让火花出现，也让想法、情绪或事件被点燃。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 j 前呈现为 men-；j 保留，读作 [dʒ]。jangka 中的 ng 表示 [ŋ]，其后的 k 仍发音。

senses.ms_definition: Memotong daun mengkuang menjadi jalur kecil dengan menggunakan alat jangka.

collocations.zh: 把编织用露兜树叶裁成细条

etymology.historical_story: DBP records several meanings under jangka: a measuring or leaf-cutting instrument, a span of time, and an expectation or intention. Menjangka inherits more than one of these meanings. Measurement and anticipation make a useful learning connection, but the dictionary evidence alone does not establish that one meaning historically developed from another. [DBP: jangka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=jangka)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 jangka，联想 jangka masa“时间跨度”：先在脑中量一量未来，就能记住 menjangka“预计”。这是记忆联想，不是已证实的词源演变。

word_family.gloss: 归档；正式提交登记的过程

senses.zh_definition: 把文件放入档案或按档案系统分类保存；归档。

senses.ms_definition: Memasukkan ke dalam fail; menyimpan dalam fail.
senses.nuances: 强调有组织地保存文件，可用于纸本或电子档案；不表示随意存放物品。与正式提交义的区别在于，此义关注内部保存。依据 [DBP：fail／memfailkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=67756&keyword=fail)。

senses.zh_definition: 向法院、主管机关或相关机构正式提交申请、诉讼、投诉等，以供登记处理。

senses.nuances: 强调正式提交这一程序性行为；不表示申请已获批准、指控已成立或案件已获判胜诉。具体搭配随接收机构及文书种类而定。依据 [DBP：memfailkan 的正式提交义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=67756&keyword=fail)。

etymology.historical_story: Fail is the Malay adaptation of English file in the document sense. Malay turns this borrowed noun into memfailkan using meN-...-kan, demonstrating how imported office vocabulary enters local word formation. Its dictionary meanings connect two administrative activities: keeping documents systematically and submitting them officially for registration. See [DBP's word-formation example](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/majalah/2020/db92020/files/basic-html/page15.html) and [dictionary senses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=67756&keyword=fail).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 fail 就联想英语 file「档案」，套上 mem-...-kan：把文件归档，或正式 file 一份申请。这里的 fail 不是英语「失败」。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 保留输入值；它们实际是派生词本身。语言学词根是 amal（عمل），因此 is_root 修正为 false。meN- 在元音 a 前取 meng-，ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/，不另读 /g/。

senses.zh_definition: 把学到、信奉或认可的知识、原则、制度等付诸实践；实行；践行。

senses.ms_definition: Melaksanakan, mempraktikkan, melakukan sebagai suatu kebiasaan.
senses.nuances: 常接 nilai、ajaran、dasar、sistem 等宾语，强调实际实行；单纯知道、赞同或口头倡导尚不足以构成 mengamalkan。依据 [DBP：mengamalkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengamalkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 经常进行某种行为，使之成为习惯；养成并保持某种生活方式。

senses.ms_definition: Membiasakan diri melakukan sesuatu sehingga menjadi tabiat atau kebiasaan.
senses.nuances: 强调反复与持续，常用于饮食、运动、阅读及生活方式；一次性的尝试通常用 mencuba 或 melakukan。它与实践原则的前一义相互关联。依据 [DBP：mengamalkan 的习惯义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengamalkan)。

etymology.historical_story: Amal comes from Arabic ʿamal, meaning action or work, and became established in Malay religious and ethical vocabulary. Malay affixes create mengamalkan, extending the idea of action into practising teachings, implementing principles, and maintaining habits. Its modern uses therefore range naturally from religious observance to workplace values and everyday routines. See [research on Arabic influence in Nusantara](https://eprints.uad.ac.id/38099/1/2022%20_%20Islamic%20cultural%20and%20Arabic%20linguistic%20influence%20on%20the%20languages%20of%20Nusantara_%20From%20lexical%20borrowing%20to%20localized%20Islamic%20lifestyles.pdf) and [DBP：amal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=amal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 amal「行为、善行」放进 meng-...-kan：让理念变成行动，再让行动成为习惯，就是 mengamalkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 按英语整词处理，不套用马来语词缀规则；英语非重读形式可读 /məst/。

senses.nuances: 这是英语用法；在马来语对话中出现时属于语码转换。正式马来语通常用 mesti、hendaklah 或按语境选用 wajib。must not 表示禁止，不等于“不必”。

senses.en_definition: Expresses a strong inference that something is true.

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian multilingual conversation, an English word can appear inside an otherwise Malay sentence. Must is best understood here through that possibility, rather than assumed to be an established Malay headword. English dictionaries distinguish its necessity and inference uses, as well as the informal noun a must. The packet provides no evidence identifying which use occurred in its source.

etymology.historical_story: McPhee belongs to a Scottish Gaelic surname tradition. A Gaelic naming reference connects MacPhee with the older MacDhubhshìth and the shortened Mac a' Phì, illustrating how a name can acquire different written forms across languages. In Malay, McPhee remains a personal name, with no Malay derivational family supplied by the packet. word_family.gloss: 自豪感；引以为荣的人或事物

senses.zh_definition: 把某人、事物或成就引以为荣；加以夸耀。

senses.ms_definition: Memegahkan seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 宾语是被引以为荣或夸耀的对象，如 kejayaan。membanggakan diri 常带自夸意味，但该义并非在所有语境中都含贬义。表达个人感到自豪时，berbangga dengan... 通常更直接。

senses.en_definition: To make someone proud; to inspire pride.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan rasa bangga atau rasa besar hati.
senses.nuances: 主语通常是成就、表现或某人的行为，宾语是产生自豪感的人，如 Kejayaan itu membanggakan ibu bapanya。pencapaian yang membanggakan 可译为“令人自豪的成就”，其中仍保留使人自豪的派生动词意义。不要把 Saya membanggakan kamu 与 Saya berbangga dengan kamu 当作完全相同的结构。

etymology.historical_story: Membanggakan belongs to the Malay family built around bangga, the feeling of pride. Its dictionary senses capture two perspectives: presenting something proudly and causing pride in another person. The construction therefore helps tell whose pride is involved. The consulted dictionary supports this word family but does not establish bangga's earliest historical origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=bangga)

etymology.historical_story: This form brings together the verb mengenal and the bound pronoun -mu, meaning you as its object. Its personal tone suits letters, songs and reflective speech. Recognition and acquaintance remain distinct meanings: someone may recognize your face without knowing you well. The underlying verb is documented by [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=mengenal); the complete form is compositionally understood.

etymology.historical_story: Mississippi preserves an Indigenous river name commonly traced to an Ojibwe expression meaning great river. European spellings carried the name into wider geographical use, and the state subsequently took its name from the river. Remembering that relationship explains why a single proper name can identify both a vast waterway and a southern American state. [美国印第安事务局](https://www.bia.gov/as-ia/opa/online-press-release/origin-names-us-states)

morphology.pattern_note: 这里的 root_word 按输入保留直接基形 menghubungi；最终词根是 hubung。meN- 在 h 前为 meng-，h 保留；-mu 是后附代词，不是派生词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 联系你；通过电话、信息、书信或当面交流等方式与你取得联系。
senses.en_definition: To contact you or get in touch with you.
senses.ms_definition: Berkomunikasi dengan kamu melalui panggilan, pesanan, surat atau pertemuan.
senses.nuances: -mu 指受联系的“你”，不表示动作主语；时态由 akan、telah 等成分或语境表达。释义依据 [DBP PRPM：hubung 及 menghubungi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=hubung) 转述。该词形通常不承载基础动词在其他语境中的非人称“接续”义。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报中的引语

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 可用于亲密关系、文学或带感情色彩的表达，并非一律失礼。面对客户、上司或不熟悉的人，通常选择 menghubungi tuan、menghubungi puan 或合适称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合私人书信、歌词和熟人之间的书面表达。正式业务通知通常写 Kami akan menghubungi tuan/puan；日常聊天常说 Nanti saya hubungi awak。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 可用于亲密关系、文学或带感情色彩的表达，并非一律失礼。面对客户、上司或不熟悉的人，通常选择 menghubungi tuan、menghubungi puan 或合适称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合私人书信、歌词和熟人之间的书面表达。正式业务通知通常写 Kami akan menghubungi tuan/puan；日常聊天常说 Nanti saya hubungi awak。

etymology.historical_story: Menghubungimu combines the Malay verb menghubungi with the attached second-person pronoun -mu. Its underlying root, hubung, supports a family of words concerning connection and relationships. The contact sense covers letters, telephone calls, and personal meetings, so it is broader than modern messaging. The final -mu identifies the person contacted without specifying when the contact occurs. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=hubung).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 从右往左记：mu＝你，menghubungi＝联系；合起来就是“联系你”。末尾 /mu/ 是辨认联系对象的关键。

morphology.formula: menyerang + -nya → menyerangnya；内部构词：meN- + serang → menyerang
morphology.pattern_note: 直接基词依数据包保留为 menyerang，更深层词根为 serang。meN- 遇词首 s 时通常形成 meny-，原来的 s 脱落；ny 表示 /ɲ/。-nya 通常充当第三人称宾语，不表示动作执行者或过去时。数据包所给 Jawi 仅对应 menyerang，未包含 -nya。

senses.zh_definition: 攻击、袭击他或她；也可依上下文表示攻击前文所指的目标。
senses.en_definition: To attack or assault him or her, or attack a previously identified target.
senses.ms_definition: Mendatangi atau bertindak terhadap pihak yang dirujuk untuk melawan, mencederakan, mengalahkan atau menaklukkannya.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常是受攻击的对象，而非攻击者。该词本身不标时态；sudah、sedang、akan 等词及语境决定时间。与 diserangnya 区分：后者是被动结构，其中 -nya 可表示施事者。

collocations.en: attack him or her from behind

senses.zh_definition: 疾病等侵袭他或她，使其患病或受损。
senses.en_definition: Of a disease or harmful condition, to afflict or strike him or her.
senses.ms_definition: Menimpa orang yang dirujuk sehingga menyebabkan orang tersebut sakit atau mengalami gangguan.
senses.nuances: 主语通常是疾病或其他有害因素，-nya 指受到侵袭的人。这是词义说明，不构成医学诊断。马来文释义根据 Kamus Dewan 基词义项改写。

collocations.en: the illness afflicting him or her
the virus infecting him or her

senses.zh_definition: 以尖锐言辞抨击、斥责或辱骂他或她。
senses.en_definition: To attack him or her verbally through harsh criticism, denunciation or abuse.
senses.ms_definition: Menentang, mengecam, mencela atau mencerca orang yang dirujuk melalui kata-kata.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻义，语气通常强于中性的 mengkritik。menyerangnya secara peribadi 指针对个人发动攻击。完整基词的第三义见 [DBP：menyerang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyerang)。

collocations.zh: 对他或她进行人身攻击
用粗俗言辞辱骂他或她
collocations.en: attack him or her with abusive language

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary illustrates menyerang with a royal command to attack Pahang, placing the verb in a historical military setting. Its recorded meanings also encompass illness and hostile criticism. These senses share an image of something bearing down upon a target. Menyerangnya preserves that image while attaching a pronoun identifying the target. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyerang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 serang＝“攻击”：meN- 遇 s，让 s 退场，变成 menyerang；再接 nya，把攻击目标补成“他／她”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Mukesh → Mukesh（外来人名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 按数据包作为独立词形处理，不作马来语词缀拆分。规范人名通常写作 Mukesh；词条键保留输入小写。所给 IPA 是常见印度语言姓名读法的近似表示，并非经数据包确认的马来语标准读音；具体读法尊重本人。

senses.zh_definition: 穆凯什：源自印度姓名传统的男性名字；具体指何人须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Mukesh, a masculine given name used in Indian naming traditions; its bearer is identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi lelaki yang digunakan dalam tradisi penamaan India; orang yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 表示专有名词 nama khas。数据包没有 DBP 释义，以上为编写性说明，不能称为 DBP 官方定义。单凭 mukesh 不能认定是某位企业家、演员或歌手；下列例句中的 Mukesh 为虚构人物，搭配为常见姓名句式，并非固定词汇搭配。status 沿用所要求的条目标签，不表示该姓名已获 DBP 词条认证。

etymology.historical_story: Mukesh illustrates how personal names enter Malay texts without becoming ordinary Malay vocabulary. An identifiable bearer is Mukesh Ambani, whose name appears in Reliance’s corporate biography. That attestation establishes a personal name, not the identity intended by every occurrence. The packet supplies no historical etymology, so a literal Sanskrit meaning cannot responsibly be assigned here. [Source: Reliance](https://www.ril.com/about/chairman-managing-director).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mukesh 与一个自我介绍的声音绑定：“Saya Mukesh.”＝“我叫穆凯什。”整词记人名，不从 mu- 或 -kesh 猜马来语词义。

morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包保留直接基底 menandatangani；更深层词基为 tandatangan。meN- 遇词首 t 时变为 men-，t 脱落；-nya 是附着代词，此处作宾语。资料包 jawi 实为未加 -nya 的基底拼写；完整词形应加 ڽ，写作 مننداتاڠنيڽ。

senses.ms_definition: Menurunkan atau membubuh tandatangan pada sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 回指已知的签署对象，不表示动作已经完成，也不表示签署者的性别。时态须由 telah、sudah、akan 或上下文表达。它包含宾语，通常不再紧接重复的名词宾语。基底义依据 [DBP：menandatangani](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=menandatangani)。

etymology.historical_story: The underlying compound tandatangan joins tanda, meaning a mark, with tangan, meaning a hand: a signature is literally a hand-mark. Malay builds menandatangani from this compound, then attaches -nya to refer back to the document. A dictionary example places signing in a Dutch–Johor agreement in May 1606, illustrating its longstanding documentary setting. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=menandatangani)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 tanda（记号）＋ tangan（手）：亲手留下记号就是签名；末尾 -nya 再补上“它”，整词就是“签署它”。

morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包保留直接基底 menghalang；更深层词基为 halang。meN- 在 h 前取 meng-，h 保留；加 -i 后，原词末 /ŋ/ 成为末音节 /ŋi/ 的声母。

senses.zh_definition: 反复阻挡、阻挠；使人或事物的行动、通行或进展受到阻碍。
senses.en_definition: To obstruct or hinder, especially repeatedly; to impede movement, action, or progress.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalang berkali-kali.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Pelajar》突出反复阻挡；《Kamus Dewan》在 halang 词条下也将其与 merintangi、menahan、menyekat、menegah 联系起来，因此并非每个语境都明确计数多次动作。不要把 -i 当成所有动词都具有的“反复”标记。依据 [DBP：halang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=halang)。

etymology.historical_story: Menghalangi belongs to the Malay halang family, which connects barriers with the act of blocking. Adding -i to menghalang produces a form that Kamus Pelajar explains as repeated obstruction. The wider dictionary family includes halangan, an obstacle, and penghalang, something or someone that blocks, linking physical barriers with impediments to human plans. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=halang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ha-lang 配上“横栏”的画面：前面一道栏杆挡路；menghalangi 就是不断设栏、阻挠前进。只是联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Melanie belongs to a European naming tradition associated with Greek words for darkness or blackness. Related forms include Latin Melania and French Mélanie. The Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources connects the name with two early saints and records Mellany in England in 1580. These are historical name connections, not Malay derivational relationships. [Historical reference](https://dmnes.org/name/Melanie)

etymology.historical_story: The story of mempelajarinya lies in Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowing. It belongs to the ajar family, which connects teaching, learners, lessons and study. The final -nya lets speakers refer back to something already mentioned without repeating its name. This combines a richly derived learning verb with a compact object pronoun. See [DBP PRPM: ajar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ajar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 mempelajari＝深入学习，再把 nya 当作回指箭头：mempelajari + nya＝深入学习“它”。

etymology.historical_story: Menembus belongs to the Malay tembus family, centred on passage through a barrier. Dictionary meanings connect openings and routes with inward movement, including words reaching someone's heart. An archaic sense even describes a guess as accurate. These recorded meanings offer a useful semantic connection, but they do not establish the historical order in which the senses developed. See [DBP PRPM: tembus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tembus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tembus 想成“通到另一边”：meN- 接上后，t 脱落成 menembus；既可凿通山体，也可让话语深入心里。

etymology.historical_story: Macho is a Spanish word associated with maleness that also entered English and international popular vocabulary. In Malaysian Malay, DBP directs readers from macho to maco and labels the latter conversational. The adapted spelling uses c for the affricate sound. Its appeal in talk about actors, clothing, and appearance comes from the compact image of conspicuous masculinity it evokes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 macho 当作一个完整的“硬汉造型”标签；ch 读 /tʃ/，马来语适应拼法写 maco。

etymology.historical_story: Mummyji combines English mummy with the South Asian honorific ji. The combination brings affection and respect into the same family address. Dictionary evidence identifies it with Indian English, while accounts of everyday usage also describe spouses addressing a mother-in-law this way. Its use in a Malay sentence should therefore be understood through the particular family’s linguistic habits. [Wiktionary: mummyji](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mummyji), [The Tribune: ji](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/archive/musings/no-more-excuses-ji-443666/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mummy 是“妈妈”，ji 加上一份敬意：记成“亲爱的妈妈，向您致敬”，不要与表示木乃伊的 mummy 混淆。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary family of kirim includes sending letters, conveying greetings, dispatching people, and naming both the sender and the item sent. Mengirimnya adds an attached pronoun to that established verb. Modern email fits the same transmission meaning as postal correspondence; the medium changes while the core relationship between sender, object, and recipient remains. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kirim)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分两步记：kirim 是寄送，meN- 把它变成主动动词 mengirim，接 -nya 就是“寄送它／派遣他或她”。-nya 像一张指向前文对象的小标签。

morphology.formula: mem- + peringatkan → memperingatkan；完整构词：memper- + ingat + -kan → memperingatkan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留输入包的中间基底 peringatkan；最终词根为 ingat。完整结构含复合前缀 memper- 和后缀 -kan，前缀中的 p 保留，不按普通 meN- 加 p 起首单纯词根的规则脱落。ng 表示 /ŋ/。

senses.zh_definition: 提醒、劝诫或告诫某人，使其意识到应负的责任、须遵守的事项或应防范的危险。

senses.ms_definition: Memberi ingat, memberi nasihat dan lain-lain supaya sedar akan tanggungjawab dan lain-lain.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，常用结构为 memperingatkan seseorang tentang sesuatu。可表示郑重提醒或带劝诫意味的告诫，不必然涉及处罚；普通日常提醒也常用 mengingatkan。勿与表示纪念的 memperingati 混淆。释义及区别参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memperingatkan)。

etymology.historical_story: This word belongs to the Malay family built around ingat, meaning remember or keep in mind. Its extended structure turns remembering into an action directed towards another person: making someone mindful of a duty or danger. DBP distinguishes this advisory function from memperingati, which concerns commemoration. Their similar forms make that distinction especially useful for learners. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memperingatkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ingat＝记住：memperingatkan 就是把该记住的责任或危险提醒给别人。记尾巴：-kan 提醒别人，memperingati 的 -i 则联想到纪念。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语把 mutasi 作为完整借词词基；不能拆成 mu- + tasi。末尾 -si 属于借入词形，不是本词中的能产马来语后缀。

word_family.gloss: 突变体；与 mutasi 同属相关术语，非直接加缀派生

senses.zh_definition: 生物遗传物质发生的改变，可影响其特征；突变。
senses.en_definition: A change in genetic material that may affect an organism's characteristics.
senses.ms_definition: Perubahan pada maklumat atau struktur genetik organisma yang boleh mempengaruhi sifatnya.
senses.nuances: 生物学术语。突变不必然有害，也不必然造成肉眼可见的变化；不等同于人为基因改造。词典义依据：[DBP：mutasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=mutasi)。

senses.zh_definition: 语言学中，词内语音受邻近语音影响而发生的变化。
senses.en_definition: A change in a speech sound within a word under the influence of nearby sounds.
senses.ms_definition: Perubahan sebutan sesuatu bunyi dalam perkataan akibat pengaruh bunyi berdekatan.
senses.nuances: 语言学专门义。讨论具体语言时应说明变化条件；并非所有误读、口音差异或随意缩读都属于此义。依据：[DBP：mutasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=mutasi)。

senses.zh_definition: 人员、职员等的调动或更替；属印度尼西亚用法。
senses.en_definition: A staff transfer or personnel change, in Indonesian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Pertukaran penempatan atau penggantian pegawai dan kakitangan dalam penggunaan bahasa Indonesia.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注 IB，即印度尼西亚语用法。马来西亚行政语境通常用 pertukaran pegawai、pertukaran kakitangan 或 penempatan semula；下列搭配属于印度尼西亚行政表达。依据：[DBP：mutasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=mutasi)。

etymology.historical_story: Mutasi belongs to an international terminology family associated with Latin mutatio, meaning change. Malay dictionaries preserve that broad connection across genetics, sound change, and Indonesian personnel administration. The shared idea is alteration, but each field gives it a precise meaning. This connection does not establish which intermediary language supplied the Malay form. [Botanical Latin dictionary](https://www.mobot.org/mobot/latindict/keyDetail.aspx?keyWord=mutation)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mutasi 和英语 mutation 配对记忆：共同抓住改变。生物课是遗传改变，语音学是声音改变。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入读音，ai 在此构成双元音。方言形式整词记忆；与 mari 的对应关系不应当解释成现代马来语的一般删音构词规则。

senses.zh_definition: 来；来到。用于吉打、槟城等北部马来语方言。

senses.nuances: DBP 的 mai II 标记 Kd、Pn，并以 mari 释义；方言用例也对应标准语 datang。status 为 official 表示有 DBP 收录依据，不表示适合正式标准语的一切语境。参见 [DBP PRPM：mai I、mai II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mai)。本项马来语释义为整理简释。

senses.zh_definition: 来吧；一起吧。北部方言中用于邀请、招呼或提议共同做某事。

etymology.historical_story: DBP separates mai into two entries: one associated with a coarse insult, and another marked for Kedah and Penang, meaning mari. That distinction matters culturally: a friendly invitation containing mai is not inherently offensive. The dictionary establishes these different uses, but does not by itself establish their deeper historical origins or prove that they share one source.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 mai makan，就把画面连到“来，吃饭！”；mai 的 /ai̯/ 与中文“来”的韵母相近，可辅助记忆，但不是词源关系。

etymology.historical_story: Mencatat is formed from catat with the active prefix meN-. Its dictionary meanings connect writing with achievement: someone can record information, make history, or register a victory. These uses share an intuitive image of an event entering a lasting record. This is a useful semantic connection, rather than evidence for a dated sequence of historical development. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=catat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 catat 记成“记下来”：mencatat maklumat 把资料记下来；mencatat kemenangan 把胜利写进成绩记录。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处是古典马来语完整词根，me- 不是前缀；不应按现代希腊语来源的 meta- 前缀拆解。

senses.zh_definition: 〔古典马来语〕醉狂的；发狂、凶猛或狂暴失控的，尤见于描写大象。
senses.en_definition: In Classical Malay, intoxicated, frenzied, fierce, or raging, especially of an elephant.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Melayu sastera lama, mabuk, mengamuk, ganas atau gila.
senses.nuances: DBP 的 sl 表示 sastera lama，即古典文学用语。这里的 mabuk 不必一律解释为喝酒醉倒；描写大象时可侧重狂暴失控。此义不等于现代网络用语 meta，也不等于公司名称 Meta。现有证据不足以提供现代高频搭配；下列为古典义的典型或教学性组合，非频率排名。[DBP：meta I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=meta+I)

etymology.historical_story: Historical loanword research connects Malay meta with Sanskrit matta, carrying the sense of excitement or frenzy. The classical Malay dictionary example describes Raja Suran's elephant, preserving an older literary setting for the word. This history belongs to the adjective of intoxication or rage, rather than the separately borrowed modern prefix meta-. [Loanword study](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v41.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=meta+I)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 gajah meta：一头狂暴的大象。把这个画面与古典语境绑定，避免误联想到现代网络术语。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的 root_word 检索值 meraung，但其 is_root: true 与实际构词不符，故此处更正为 false；真正的形态词根为 raung（راءوڠ）。meN- 在 /r/ 前实现为 me-，保留 r；au 为双元音。[DBP：raung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=raung)

word_family.gloss: 持续或反复地嚎叫、号哭

senses.zh_definition: 动物发出响亮而拖长的嚎叫或吼叫声。
senses.en_definition: To howl or roar with a loud, prolonged cry, especially of an animal.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan bunyi atau suara yang nyaring dan panjang, terutama tentang binatang seperti anjing atau serigala.
senses.nuances: 强调声音响亮、绵长；不是所有动物叫声的通称。狗的短促吠叫通常用 menyalak。语境中也可借喻机器或引擎的轰鸣。[DBP：raung／meraung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=raung)

senses.zh_definition: 因悲伤、疼痛、恐惧等放声号哭或大声哭喊。

senses.ms_definition: Menangis sambil menjerit dengan kuat kerana kesedihan, kesakitan atau tekanan perasaan.
senses.nuances: 强度明显高于 menangis，常与 meraung-raung 交替使用。用于成人时语气强烈，可能使人感到其情绪被公开描写；用于儿童也不必然表示故意撒泼。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place meraung under raung, the name for a loud, prolonged cry. Adding the verbal prefix produces the action of making that sound. The recorded meanings connect animal howling with human wailing, so the word is best remembered through its sustained sound and emotional force rather than as a synonym for ordinary crying.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raung 的 au 拉长，想象‘嗷——’；加 me- 成 meraung，就是发出长嚎或放声号哭。这个联想是记忆法，不是已证实的词源。

etymology.historical_story: Maine’s name was recorded in 1622, but its origin remains disputed. Proposals connect it with the French province of Maine or with the maritime distinction between the mainland and offshore islands. Maine’s own government acknowledges the uncertainty. These competing accounts should remain historical hypotheses, rather than being converted into a confident Malay root analysis.

etymology.historical_story: Memaksanya illustrates how Malay builds a complete action around a familiar base. Paksa supplies compulsion; meN- creates memaksa, with the initial p disappearing; attached -nya identifies the affected person or thing. The resulting form combines an action and its object in one written word, although ordinary conversation often uses paksa dia. [Morphological explanation](https://ppuu.upm.edu.my/upload/dokumen/20170517093256Imbuhan_dan_kekeliruan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies mistik as an English borrowing. Its European word family goes back through Latin to Greek mystikos, associated with secret religious rites and initiation. Malay gives the word two important homes: spiritual practice, including tasawuf, and accounts of uncanny phenomena. That double meaning explains why a scholarly discussion and a ghost story can use the same word. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mistik); [Historical etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/mystical)

etymology.historical_story: Malay luka denotes a wound and also emotional hurt. Melukakan builds on that familiar connection: speech can injure the heart just as something sharp injures the body. The dictionary expression melukakan hati preserves this bodily image in ordinary language, making emotional pain concrete without requiring a separate, abstract verb.

etymology.historical_story: This packet illustrates a lexicographic mismatch rather than an established word history. Its dictionary quotation and Jawi spelling identify mod, a computing term for an operating or processing mode. The additional final i has no demonstrated derivational role here. Until independent evidence establishes modi as a Malay lexical item, its origin and pronunciation must remain unassigned.

etymology.historical_story: The Malay base lihat concerns seeing. With memper-...-kan, the perspective shifts toward making something available to another person's sight or understanding. Kamus Dewan records both concrete showing and broader manifestation. That connection explains why the same verb works for displaying an object and describing progress revealed by a report. [Kamus Dewan，DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memperlihatkan+1)

etymology.historical_story: Malay mat illustrates how identical spellings can serve different cultural worlds. In familiar speech it appears in personal labels such as mat jenin and mat salih. In chess it denotes mate and supports the verb mengemat. These dictionary groupings establish distinct uses; they do not establish a single historical origin for them. [Kamus Dewan，DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=mat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 mat，先看语境：后接人物标签，多半在说“某类人”；出现在棋盘上，则想到“王被困死”。两种语境分开记，不硬凑同源故事。

etymology.historical_story: Meniduri belongs to the tidur family, although the initial t disappears during nasal substitution. Its dictionary meanings connect lying on a place with sexual intercourse. This semantic pairing should not be mistaken for a documented chronology: the available evidence establishes both meanings, but does not establish when either developed. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penidur)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tidur 是睡；menidurkan 是“让人睡”，meniduri 则是“睡卧于／与人发生性关系”。把 -kan 记作“使”，避免误用。

etymology.historical_story: Melantik is transparently formed from lantik with the Malay active prefix meN-, realized as me- before l. Its present meaning centres on formally assigning an office. The related noun pelantikan illustrates a useful administrative distinction: Malay names the appointment process with this form, and DBP explicitly identifies it as the correct spelling rather than perlantikan. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=melantik)

etymology.historical_story: The international word family behind maskot is associated with French mascotte, a good-luck figure. Edmond Audran's operetta La Mascotte, first performed in 1880, helped popularize the term. Its theatrical history connects a person who brings good fortune with today's animal and character representatives. In contemporary Malay, the word comfortably describes the friendly symbolic figures seen at sporting events and public celebrations. [Historical study](https://diagorasjournal.com/index.php/diagoras/article/download/122/72)

senses.zh_definition: 使某物消失、不复存在或不再被察觉；消除、清除。

senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan sesuatu menjadi lenyap; menghilangkan atau menghapuskan sesuatu.

etymology.historical_story: The history visible in melenyapkan is grammatical rather than a tale of foreign borrowing. Its underlying root, lenyap, describes disappearance. Malay combines that root with causative -kan and the active prefix meN- to express making something disappear. The same construction works with traces, doubts, hopes, and power, linking concrete disappearance with forceful descriptions of emotional or political loss.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lenyap＝消失；-kan＝使其如此；meN-＝主动动作。把“自己消失”变成“使它消失”，就是 melenyapkan。

etymology.historical_story: The root cat belongs to Malay's vocabulary of contact with Chinese communities and is identified as a Hokkien loan meaning paint. Malay then supplies its own grammatical machinery: the active prefix becomes menge- before this monosyllabic root. Mengecat therefore combines a borrowed material name with a productive Malay way of expressing an action. See [Singapore National Library's BiblioAsia](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/339/939a87f3-8966-4f56-9860-1f0fb5026b3b/BiblioAsia%20Jan%202011.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Mandira belongs to an Indic vocabulary of buildings and sacred places. Sanskrit mandira is associated with a dwelling, palace, or temple. Malaysia Hindu Sangam includes Mandira among the names for a Hindu temple in its Malay guide. This supports a specialist religious use in Malaysia, but does not by itself establish a common Malay dictionary headword or a particular borrowing route. [Temple guide](https://www.malaysiahindusangam.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Garis-Panduan-Kuil-Hindu-MHS.pdf); [Indic lexical reference](https://dpdict.net/?q=mandira)

etymology.historical_story: Mon appears in Malay scholarly discussion as the name of a language, rather than as a transparently derived Malay word. A DBP-published discussion places it alongside Khmer within the Austroasiatic family. This establishes a relevant naming context, but does not establish the original meaning or historical derivation of the name itself. [DBP linguistic discussion](https://dev.dbp.my/index.php/Melayu/ms/article/download/8757/4460/29941)

etymology.historical_story: The Malay drug name belongs to the international terminology represented by English morphine. Around 1804, Friedrich Wilhelm Sertürner isolated its active substance from opium. He named it Morphium after Morpheus, the Greek god of dreams, reflecting its sleep-inducing effects. This history explains the name, without making morfin a Malay affix construction. [German Pharmacy Museum](https://www.deutsches-apotheken-museum.de/sammlung/museumsobjekte/exponate-im-fokus/die-entdeckung-des-morphins-der-nachlass-von-f-w-sertuerner)

etymology.historical_story: The root simpang names a branching or junction, making menyimpang easy to picture as taking another path. Its dictionary senses connect physical movement with departures from rules, teachings, and intended meanings. A road junction therefore provides a useful image for understanding how the same verb describes both a detour and a discussion going off course. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menyimpang)

etymology.historical_story: Malay menentang brings together senses of looking, facing, and opposing. Older literary uses describe directing one's gaze toward someone, while familiar modern uses concern resistance or disagreement. For learners, facing an object provides a useful semantic bridge between these meanings, although it does not establish their historical order. The attached -nya simply identifies an object already understood from context. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=menentang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 menentang 想成“正面对上”，再接 -nya“他／她／它”：正面对上它，语境决定是直视、迎战还是反对。

etymology.historical_story: Menerusi belongs to the Malay word family built on terus. Its transparent formation combines meN- and -i with the root, whose initial t disappears after the nasal prefix. Its meanings connect physical passage with communication: a needle passes through cloth, while a message passes through a person or medium. This is a conceptual link, not a documented chronology of meaning change.

etymology.historical_story: Menyapa belongs to the Malay family built on sapa, a greeting or conversational address. Its familiar ny sound comes from productive Malay prefixation, rather than a separate root beginning with ny. Malaysian public-service guidance makes greeting visitors part of courteous service, connecting this everyday verb with institutional hospitality as well as neighbourly friendliness. [Sources: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=sapa), [JPA customer-service guide](https://docs.jpa.gov.my/docs/flipbook/PLPP/).

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合建议别人求助、申请许可或道歉。反复催促别人 mintalah maaf 可能像训斥；宗教祈求和传统提亲义应有明确语境。

etymology.historical_story: Mintalah illustrates how Malay builds interactional meaning from a familiar verb and an attached particle. Minta supplies the act of asking; lah shapes how that request or encouragement is delivered. The expression needs no separate borrowing story. Its cultural interest is that the same written form can sound reassuring, pleading, or impatient when the speaker changes the intonation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: minta 是“请求”，加 lah 像添上“吧”：mintalah bantuan → 找人帮忙吧。

morphology.formula: meN- + rahsiakan → merahsiakan; 完整分析：meN- + rahsia + -kan → merahsiakan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留 rahsiakan 为直接构词基础；基础词根是 rahsia。meN- 遇词首 r 实现为 me-，r 保留。完整形式还包含后缀 -kan，构成及物动词。

senses.zh_definition: 将某事作为秘密保存，不予透露或公开。
senses.en_definition: To keep something secret; to withhold it from disclosure.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak memperlihatkan atau memberitahukan sesuatu; menyimpannya sebagai rahsia.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常接身份、消息、计划或其他信息。merahsiakan sesuatu daripada seseorang 表示对某人保密；单说 berahsia 更着重主体不透露的行为。此词本身不判断保密是否正当。DBP 将该动词列于基础词 rahsia 下，其 Jawi 为 رهسيا；输入中的 rahsiakan 是直接构词基础，并非最底层词根。[DBP：rahsia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=rahsia)

nak 在此相当于 mahu。
ni 是 ini 的口语缩略形式。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请求保密可说 Tolong rahsiakan perkara ini，或较正式地说 Mohon perkara ini dirahsiakan。直接质问 Kenapa awak merahsiakan perkara ini? 可能带有责备意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合保护个人隐私、筹备惊喜及处理未公开信息。表达时应说明保密对象或范围；不要把对方愿意私下交谈理解为允许转述。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请求保密可说 Tolong rahsiakan perkara ini，或较正式地说 Mohon perkara ini dirahsiakan。直接质问 Kenapa awak merahsiakan perkara ini? 可能带有责备意味。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合保护个人隐私、筹备惊喜及处理未公开信息。表达时应说明保密对象或范围；不要把对方愿意私下交谈理解为允许转述。

etymology.historical_story: The underlying word rahsia is associated with Sanskrit rahasya, meaning secret or private. Malay combines this borrowed vocabulary with its own productive morphology: meN- and -kan form merahsiakan. The result expresses an action, keeping something secret, rather than merely naming a secret or describing something as confidential. [Sanskrit loanword study](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/ocr/1595120/610)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 rahsia＝秘密，再套 meN- + rahsia + -kan：把某事当秘密保存，就是 merahsiakan。

morphology.formula: ∅ + memungkinkan → memungkinkan（按输入整词记录）；内部构词：meN- + mungkin + -kan → memungkinkan
morphology.pattern_note: 输入将整词列为词根；实际构词基础是 mungkin。meN- 在词首 m 前实现为 me-，保留原有 m，再加使动后缀 -kan。

senses.zh_definition: 使某事成为可能；创造某事得以发生或实现的条件。
senses.en_definition: To make an event, outcome, or undertaking possible.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan mungkin atau menjadikan mungkin.
senses.nuances: 强调条件使结果成为可能，并不保证结果必然发生。通常以措施、资源或环境为主语，后接事件或结果。义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=memungkinkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 给予某人机会或条件，使其能够进行某项活动。
senses.en_definition: To enable someone to do something by providing the opportunity or means.
senses.ms_definition: Memberi kesempatan kepada seseorang atau membolehkannya melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常用结构为 memungkinkan + 人 + 动作，如 memungkinkan pelajar belajar。较正式；日常交流更常用 membolehkan 或 boleh。此处通常表示客观条件上的便利，不一定表示有人批准。

collocations.en: enable students to study from home

senses.zh_definition: 认为某事可能发生或并非不可能。
senses.en_definition: To regard something as possible or not impossible.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggap mungkin atau memandang tidak mustahil.
senses.nuances: 这是词典收录的判断义，现代日常用法较少。以下结构也可表示“使……成为可能”，须依上下文判断；若要清楚表达“认为可能”，通常用 menganggap bahawa ... mungkin。此义没有与前两义同等常见且完全无歧义的固定搭配。

collocations.ms: memungkinkan adanya kehidupan di planet lain
collocations.zh: 认为其他行星可能存在生命
collocations.en: consider life on other planets possible

etymology.historical_story: The base mungkin is borrowed from Arabic mumkin, meaning possible. Malay places it inside its own productive verbal construction, meN-...-kan, to express making something possible. The word therefore offers a compact example of a borrowed base functioning within Malay grammar: an expression of possibility becomes a verb about creating opportunities or enabling action. See [Wikikamus: mungkin](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/mungkin).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 mungkin＝“可能”，再把 me-...-kan 想成推动开关：memungkinkan＝“让可能变成可行”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇到本族词词首 k 时变为 meng-，原来的 k 脱落：karang → mengarang；ng 表示一个鼻音 /ŋ/。

word_family.gloss: 创作活动；作者身份及相关事务

senses.zh_definition: 将花朵、珠子、宝石等编排、串缀或组合成美观的形态。
senses.en_definition: To arrange, string, or assemble flowers, beads, or gems decoratively.
senses.ms_definition: Menyusun atau menggubah bunga, permata, manik dan sebagainya supaya kelihatan menarik.
senses.nuances: 属于实物编排义，现代常见表达也有 menggubah bunga 和 merangkai manik。固定说法 mengarang telur 则指动物含卵或产卵，不能按“编排鸡蛋”理解。义项依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=mengarang)。

senses.zh_definition: 构思并撰写故事、作文等文字作品，或创作诗歌、歌曲。
senses.en_definition: To compose a written or musical work, such as an essay, story, poem, or song.
senses.ms_definition: Mereka atau menulis cerita dan karya lain, mencipta sajak, atau menggubah lagu.
senses.nuances: 强调构思与创作，范围比单纯记录文字的 menulis 更具体。在学校语境中常指写作文；谈音乐时，menggubah lagu 也很常见。

senses.zh_definition: 凭空编造理由、消息或说法，尤其指缺乏事实根据的内容。
senses.en_definition: To invent or fabricate an excuse, report, or account.
senses.ms_definition: Mengadakan atau mereka-reka sesuatu, seperti berita yang tidak benar.
senses.nuances: 是否带贬义取决于宾语和语境。mengarang cerita 可指正常创作故事，也可指编谎话；本条按输入词根 karang 处理，同形但源自 arang、表示“变成炭或变黑”的词另属一词。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary brings flowers, beads, stories, and songs together under karang. Its meanings invite a memorable comparison: arranging beautiful objects and composing a work both involve bringing separate elements into an ordered whole. This is a useful semantic connection, rather than proof of which meaning arose first. The same verb also covers fabricating an account. See [DBP: karang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=karang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把词语想成珠子：mengarang 就是把一颗颗词语串成故事，也能把真正的珠子串成饰品。

morphology.formula: menemukan + -mu → menemukanmu；基词分析：meN- + temu + -kan → menemukan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留派生基词 menemukan；实际词根为 temu。meN- 与 temu 结合时，词首 t 脱落，由鼻音 n 接续。-mu 是后附的第二人称代词，此处作宾语“你”，并非派生后缀；在限定分类中归入 suffix。

senses.zh_definition: 找到你；发现你的所在，常含经过寻找终于找到的意思。
senses.en_definition: To find you or discover your whereabouts, especially after searching.
senses.ms_definition: Mendapati atau menjumpai kamu, khususnya selepas mencari.
senses.nuances: 这是 menemukan 加宾语代词 -mu 的组合词形。由于宾语明确为“你”，不能把基词所有“发现事物、找到合适表达”等义项直接照搬进来。马来西亚日常通常说 jumpa awak 或 jumpa kau；menemukanmu 较有文学、抒情或戏剧色彩。按要求保留输入的 jawi 字段，但 منموکن 实际只拼出 menemukan；完整 menemukanmu 按构词拼写为 منموکنمو。基词词义依据：[DBP：menemukan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=menemukan)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合私人书信、小说对白、抒情文字，以及好友故意模仿戏剧对白的聊天。一般工作沟通中，若只是表示“与您会面”，应使用 menemui tuan/puan 或 bertemu dengan tuan/puan，避免误说成“找到您”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 常带亲近、抒情或文学色彩，不宜直接用来称呼陌生长辈、客户或上司。正式交往应根据关系使用 tuan、puan、职衔或姓名。

etymology.historical_story: The temu family connects meeting with finding. Menemukan presents someone or something as found, while mempertemukan brings parties together. Adding the shortened pronoun mu turns the object into a directly addressed person: you. This compact combination suits personal storytelling and emotional messages, although everyday Malaysian conversation often expresses the same idea with jumpa awak.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 menemukan“找到”，再把 -mu 认成 kamu“你”的缩短形式：menemukanmu＝找到你。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是 laku 的派生及物动词。进一步分析为 meN- + per- + laku + -kan 时，meN- 实现为 mem-，per- 的 p 保留。数据包将整个派生词标为词根，已按 DBP 的 laku 词条更正。

word_family.gloss: 发生；生效；表现出某种行为

senses.zh_definition: 以某种方式对待某人或某物；将其看作某种身份或对象。
senses.en_definition: To treat someone or something in a particular way, or regard them as something.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan sesuatu terhadap seseorang atau sesuatu, atau menganggapnya sebagai sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，常接被对待者，再以 dengan、secara、seperti 或 sebagai 说明方式或身份。词义本身中性，是否含虐待意味由 kasar、kejam 等补语决定。马来西亚日常表达中也常用 melayan；melakukan 则主要表示做某事，不能机械互换。释义据[DBP：laku 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=laku)转述。

senses.zh_definition: 使某事得以实行或实现；准许、应允或批准某项要求。
senses.en_definition: To put something into effect, or grant or approve a wish or request.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu berlaku; memperkenankan atau meluluskan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的义项，见王命、愿望等语境。现代办事用语宜按对象选用 melaksanakan titah、meluluskan permohonan 或 memenuhi kehendak。以下搭配用于说明该义项，不宣称其为现代高频表达。参见[DBP：laku 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=laku)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论尊严、公平、服务态度及人际关系。不要把“对待某人”与 melakukan sesuatu“做某事”混淆；第二义在现代行政文本中宜换成指向更明确的动词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性，但直接说 Anda memperlakukan saya dengan buruk 带有指责意味。正式投诉宜说明具体行为，并用 Saya berasa… 引出自身感受。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论尊严、公平、服务态度及人际关系。不要把“对待某人”与 melakukan sesuatu“做某事”混淆；第二义在现代行政文本中宜换成指向更明确的动词。

etymology.historical_story: Memperlakukan belongs to the Malay family built on laku, whose dictionary meanings include conduct, validity, and saleability. Its recorded senses connect treatment of people with making something take effect or granting a wish. This illustrates how Malay affixes organize related meanings around one base; no separate foreign origin is needed to explain this formation. [DBP: laku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=laku)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laku 联到 tingkah laku“行为”：memperlakukan 就是“对别人采取某种行为”，即“如何对待别人”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇到词根首音 p 时取 mem-，并使 p 脱落；-kan 构成使动及物动词，表示使对象变热。数据包将整个派生词标为词根有误，此处更正为 panas。

senses.zh_definition: 加热；使食物、液体、物体或身体的温度升高。
senses.en_definition: To heat or warm something; to cause its temperature to rise.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan atau menjadikan sesuatu panas; menghangatkan.
senses.nuances: 是及物动词，通常带受事宾语。memanaskan semula 明确表示重新加热；memanaskan 本身不必意味着再次加热。基本义及 hati、kerusi 两个惯用语见 [《Kamus Dewan》词条](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 在运动前通过轻度活动使身体进入运动状态；热身。
senses.en_definition: To warm up the body through preparatory activity before exercise.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan pergerakan awal untuk menyediakan tubuh sebelum bersenam atau bersukan.
senses.nuances: 常以固定搭配 memanaskan badan 出现。运动语境下指热身活动；寒冷语境下同一搭配也可仅表示使身体暖和，须依上下文判断。[马来西亚卫生部的运动用法](https://sites.google.com/moh.gov.my/kospen-kkm/skop/hidup-yang-aktif)

senses.zh_definition: 激起怒气或憎恶；惹恼，尤见于 memanaskan hati。
senses.en_definition: To provoke anger or resentment, especially in the expression memanaskan hati.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan atau membangkitkan perasaan marah atau benci.
senses.nuances: 惯用语中的 panas 映射愤怒，不表示温暖或感动。修饰 hati 时不能按英语 warm someone's heart 理解。

senses.zh_definition: 徒占职位却没有实际作为或成绩；见于惯用语 memanaskan kerusi。
senses.en_definition: To occupy a position without doing useful work or achieving anything, in the idiom memanaskan kerusi.
senses.ms_definition: Memegang sesuatu jawatan atau kedudukan tanpa melakukan atau mencapai sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 是带批评意味的固定惯用语；脱离惯用语时，memanaskan kerusi 也可按字面表示加热椅子。

collocations.zh: 仅仅占着职位而无所作为
collocations.en: merely occupy a position without contributing
do nothing useful in one's post

etymology.historical_story: Memanaskan is a transparent Malay formation built from panas, meaning hot. Its everyday physical meaning extends into familiar idioms: heating the heart evokes anger, while warming a chair suggests holding office without useful achievement. These expressions reveal how concrete experiences of heat and sitting become ways to describe emotion and responsibility. [Dictionary evidence](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: panas＝热；meN-…-kan＝使它变热。p 脱落后成为 memanaskan：热饭、热水、热身；“热了心”则是惹怒。

morphology.formula: menyukai + -ku → menyukaiku；内部构词：meN- + suka + -i → menyukai
morphology.pattern_note: 沿用数据包的直接基底 menyukai；最终词根为 suka。meN- 遇词首 s 时发生鼻音替代，s 脱落，形成 meny-。-ku 是 aku 的附着代词，在此作宾语“我”，不是普通派生后缀。音节据完整词形补写；数据包的 مڽوکاءي 仅对应 menyukai，完整词形补上 کو。

senses.zh_definition: 喜欢我；对我抱有好感、欣赏或亲近之意，不一定涉及爱情。
senses.en_definition: To like me; to feel favourably disposed towards me.
senses.ms_definition: Suka akan aku atau menaruh minat dan simpati terhadap aku.
senses.nuances: -ku 明确指向说话者，作动词宾语；因此这里不能直接套用 menyukai 的“喜欢某种食物”义。该完整形式较常见于书面叙述、歌词或感情表达，日常马来西亚口语常说 suka aku 或 suka saya。释义由基底义和代词组合而来，并非独立 DBP 引文。[DBP：suka 与 menyukai](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=suka)

senses.zh_definition: 在感情上喜欢我；对我产生爱慕或恋爱方面的好感。
senses.en_definition: To be romantically interested in me; to have feelings for me.
senses.ms_definition: Menaruh perasaan kasih atau cinta terhadap aku.
senses.nuances: 恋爱含义由人物关系及语境确定；单凭这个词不能断定双方已经相爱，也不能把一般友善自动解释为爱慕。

collocations.en: begin to have feelings for me
