cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: aku 与 -ku 常见于亲密关系、私人叙述和文学表达。面对上级、陌生人或正式客户时，menyukai saya 通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合表达个人感受或讨论人际关系。公开推断同事对自己有恋爱好感可能令人尴尬，应尊重对方表达与隐私。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: aku 与 -ku 常见于亲密关系、私人叙述和文学表达。面对上级、陌生人或正式客户时，menyukai saya 通常更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合表达个人感受或讨论人际关系。公开推断同事对自己有恋爱好感可能令人尴尬，应尊重对方表达与隐私。

etymology.historical_story: The base suka is historically connected with Sanskrit sukha, expressing pleasure or happiness. Malay builds menyukai from this established base, then attaches the first-person object clitic -ku. The resulting form therefore combines an inherited borrowing with productive Malay grammar: the pleasurable feeling is directed towards the speaker, yielding the meaning “like me.” [Maxwell: A Manual of the Malay Language](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住两块：menyukai＝喜欢，-ku＝我；合起来是“喜欢我”。对比 kusukai：ku- 在前，表示“我喜欢”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词根首音 /ɡ/ 前实现为 meng- /məŋ/；词根的 g 保留。马来西亚常见读法将词尾 /k/ 实现为 [ʔ]。

word_family.gloss: 擦拭动作或结果；待熨或已熨的衣物
擦拭、磨光用具；从事擦磨的人
用某物擦拭；使物体相互摩擦

senses.zh_definition: 用手、刷子或布等来回擦、刷或搓，使物体清洁、光亮，或对其表面施加摩擦。
senses.en_definition: To rub, scrub, brush, or polish something by moving a hand or implement repeatedly over its surface.
senses.ms_definition: Membersihkan, melicinkan atau menggilapkan sesuatu dengan menggerakkan tangan, berus, kain atau alat lain berulang kali pada permukaannya.
senses.nuances: 通常是及物动词，宾语说明被擦刷的对象。menggosok gigi 表示刷牙；menggosok mata 表示揉眼睛。动作未必猛烈，力度取决于宾语和上下文。

senses.zh_definition: 用熨斗熨烫衣服或其他织物，使其平整。
senses.en_definition: To iron clothes or other fabric.
senses.ms_definition: Menyeterika pakaian atau kain supaya licin dan tidak berkedut.
senses.nuances: 这是马来西亚日常生活中的常用义。menggosok baju 通常理解为熨衣服；menyeterika 更明确地指出使用熨斗。

senses.zh_definition: 煽动、挑唆某人，使其生气、反抗或采取对抗行动。
senses.en_definition: To incite or goad someone by stirring up anger or opposition.
senses.ms_definition: Menghasut seseorang atau membangkitkan kemarahannya supaya bertindak atau melawan.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，也见重叠形式 menggosok-gosok。通常带负面评价，不等同于中性的鼓励。以下搭配用于展示该义，不能视为高频义项。

senses.zh_definition: 对宝石等进行研磨或抛光，使其表面光滑、显出光泽。
senses.en_definition: To grind or polish gemstones and similar materials.
senses.ms_definition: Mengasah atau menggilap batu permata dan bahan seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 属于工艺语境，是一般擦磨义在宝石加工中的具体用法。

senses.zh_definition: 【古旧用法】拉奏小提琴等弓弦乐器。
senses.en_definition: Archaic: to play a violin or similar instrument with a bow.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan arkaik, menggesek biola atau alat muzik seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注为古旧义。现代通常使用 menggesek biola 或 bermain biola；本义搭配用于理解旧文，不属于现代高频搭配。

collocations.en: play the violin with a bow, archaic

熟人之间常用 aku；日常口语也常将 menggosok 简化为 gosok。

etymology.historical_story: Menggosok is transparently formed from gosok with the active verbal prefix meN-. Its dictionary meanings connect surface friction with familiar activities such as cleaning, ironing, and polishing gemstones. An older musical sense concerns bowing a violin. These recorded senses support a useful semantic picture, but do not establish the root's ultimate historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: The kerah word family preserves an image of people being called together for coordinated action. Dewan’s dictionary even records gong pengerah, a gong used to summon people. Modern mengerahkan extends that organizing idea to rescue teams, troops, and personal effort: a collective summons becomes a useful image for bringing available strength into action. [DBP: pengerah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pengerah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“kerah 一声召集，力量全部到位”：mengerahkan orang 是动员人，mengerahkan tenaga 是集中力量。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates how closely related Indonesian and Malaysian Malay can remain while differing in familiar everyday words. Indonesian uses coba and mencoba, whereas Malaysian Malay normally uses cuba and mencuba. The attached -nya supplies a reference already understood from context. Recognizing the shared structure helps readers understand Indonesian messages without importing their spelling into formal Malaysian writing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三块拼起来：men-＋coba“试”＋-nya“它”＝“试试它”；转成马来西亚规范写法时，把 coba 对应为 cuba。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按包内记录保留直接基础形式 mempercayai，更深层词根是 percaya。-mu 是 kamu 的后附代词，在这里充当宾语“你”，并非领属义；suffix 为本格式中的近似分类。连接时保留 -i，无音节脱落。headword.jawi 按包保留，但该串实际只写出 mempercayai，缺少 -mu；完整形式按拼写组合为 ممڤرچاياءيمو。

etymology.historical_story: Mempercayaimu is a Malay grammatical formation rather than a separately borrowed word. Its immediate base, mempercayai, expresses belief or trust; the attached pronoun -mu identifies the person addressed. DBP's spelling guidance places this shortened form of kamu together with the preceding word. The resulting compact expression suits personal assurances, literary dialogue, and emotionally deliberate statements of confidence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kamu+nya)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 mempercayai＝相信／信任，再把 -mu＝你 接上：mempercayaimu＝相信你／信任你。

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowed origin. Tenggelam describes sinking; meN- and -kan turn that event into something an agent causes. Its physical image also supports figurative expression: just as water covers an object, powerful noise can cover a voice and a prominent issue can obscure another.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tenggelam＝沉下去，再给它套上 meN-...-kan：让别的东西沉下去。声音被盖住，也像沉到声浪下面。

morphology.pattern_note: 依输入保留直接基础词 mendengarkan；更深层词根为 dengar。meN- 在 d 前实现为 men-，d 保留。末尾 -ku 是第一人称附着代词，此处表示宾语‘我’，不是派生后缀。输入 Jawi 仅对应 mendengarkan，未包含 -ku；所列 IPA 为按拼写推定的读音。

etymology.historical_story: This form brings together the Malay base dengar, the verbal formation mendengarkan, and the attached first-person pronoun -ku. Rather than naming a separate action, the final element identifies the speaker as the person being heard or heeded. The combination suits an intimate poetic voice, while Malaysian conversation generally expresses the same relationship with a separate pronoun.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 dengar‘听’，再抓住末尾 ku‘我’：mendengarkanku，就是‘把我的话听进去’。

etymology.historical_story: The clearest documented account of memenggal is its formation from penggal, a word associated with pieces, sections, and divisions. Adding meN- produces an action verb through regular nasal substitution. Its meanings connect physical severing with dividing narratives or words, while the figurative expression memenggal lidah applies cutting imagery to interrupted speech.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: penggal 是一段、一截；memenggal 就是切成段。记住 p 被鼻音替换，词根里的 ng 仍留下。

etymology.historical_story: Mengantar transparently combines antar with the active verbal prefix meN-. A useful cultural distinction is its distribution: Indonesian commonly uses mengantar for accompanying people and delivering things, whereas Malaysian Malay generally uses menghantar. Malaysian pengantar remains familiar in expressions such as kata pengantar and bahasa pengantar, but those noun meanings must not be transferred directly to the verb.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 antar 想成送到目的地，前加 meng- 成为动作；在马来西亚说送人、送物时，联记更常用的 menghantar。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record jemput in the social world of welcoming and inviting, and separately in the physical act of taking with the fingertips. These meanings should not be forced into an invented origin story. In menjemputnya, meN- forms the active verb and -nya identifies its object; context selects the intended sense. [DBP PRPM: jemput](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=jemput)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: menjemput 是“接／请”，-nya 把对象接上：机场是接他，活动是请他。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records melancap independently and also under lancap II, supporting an analysis with the Malay verbal prefix meN-. The dictionary's traditional definition uses zina tangan, reflecting a morally framed way of naming the act. This documents lexical treatment and register; it does not establish an ancient origin or a connection with other lancap homonyms. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=lancap)

senses.zh_definition: 个人或团体用以表达信念、宗旨或行为准则的简短语句；座右铭、校训或机构口号。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies moto as an English borrowing. Its English counterpart, motto, came from Italian, where the word meant a word or saying. In Malay, the borrowed form names the compact statement through which a school, organization, or individual expresses a guiding ideal. Its institutional meaning explains the familiar combination moto sekolah. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=moto), [Oxford：motto](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/motto)

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 沿用数据包的直接基底 mengangkat；最终词根为 angkat。meN- 在元音前取 meng-，不删除词根首音；-nya /ɲa/ 是宾语附着代词，此处按模板归入 suffix。可分析为 me.ngang.kat.nya，数据包未给音节，故保留 null。包内爪夷文仅对应 mengangkat；完整词形按附写 -nya 应为 مڠڠکتڽ。

etymology.historical_story: This form combines Malay word-building and reference: angkat supplies the lifting meaning, meN- forms the active verb mengangkat, and -nya identifies its object. DBP records extensions into appointment, status, adoption, and flattery. These meanings can be remembered through the image of raising someone, although that image is a learning analogy rather than a documented chronology of semantic change. [DBP：angkat](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=angkat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 meng-ANGKAT-nya，就想象把“他／她／它”往上抬：抬物品、抬地位，也能引申为任命。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇词根首音 s 时通常变为 meny-，同时词根的 s 脱落：meny- + eludup → menyeludup；ny 表示单个鼻音 /ɲ/。据 DBP 的 seludup 词条校正输入中的整词词根标注。

senses.zh_definition: 悄悄进入或躲入某处，避免被人发现；潜入。

senses.ms_definition: Masuk secara bersembunyi atau diam-diam.
senses.nuances: 此义强调隐蔽，不一定违法；可以指躲到屋下，也可以指潜入敌方地区。DBP 将“隐蔽进入”与“悄悄进入”分列，本条合并其相近意义。依据：[DBP：seludup](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=seludup)。

senses.zh_definition: 避开正常检查或入境程序，非法进入某个国家、海域或受管制区域；偷渡进入。
senses.en_definition: To enter a country, territorial waters, or a restricted area illegally and clandestinely.
senses.ms_definition: Masuk ke sesuatu kawasan secara haram.
senses.nuances: 主语是进入者，也可以是船只；常接 masuk、ke 或 ke dalam 引出目的地。与上一义相比，此义明确包含未经许可或违法进入的意味。依据：[DBP：seludup](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=seludup)。

etymology.historical_story: The documented Malay base is seludup. With meN-, its initial s gives way to ny, producing menyeludup. DBP records secret entry, illegal entry, and an additional headfirst diving sense. The same family names the smuggler and the activity. These connections offer a reliable learning history without inventing a foreign source or an earliest date. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=seludup).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 seludup 前的 s 被 meN-“悄悄换走”，变成 menyeludup：人悄悄进去是潜入，货偷偷过关是走私。

morphology.formula: menunjukkan + -nya → menunjukkannya；完整构词：meN- + tunjuk + -kan + -nya → menunjukkannya
morphology.pattern_note: 资料包中的 root_word 是直接基词 menunjukkan；更底层词根是 tunjuk。meN- 接 tunjuk 时，词首 t 脱落，形成 menunjuk。-kan 与词干末尾 k 相接，拼写保留 kk；-nya 通常是第三人称宾语附着语素，不表示时态。音节与 IPA 按完整词形补全；资料包的 Jawi 仅写出 menunjukkan，此处补上 ڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的人或事物展示给别人看。
senses.en_definition: To show a previously mentioned person or thing to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Memperlihatkan orang atau benda yang telah disebut kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: -nya 的具体所指由上下文决定，可译为“他、她、它”或“该事物”；不能机械地一律译为“它”。这些义项根据 menunjukkan 的词典义及 -nya 的语法功能整理，并非声称完整词形有独立的官方释义。参见 [PRPM：menunjukkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menunjukkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 指出前文所述地点、方向或目标的位置。
senses.en_definition: To indicate the location or direction of something previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Memberitahu letak atau arah sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 常与地图、路线及现场指引搭配；-nya 指向已经明确的地点或目标。

collocations.zh: 在地图上指出它的位置
collocations.en: point it out on a map

senses.zh_definition: 流露或表现出前文所述的情绪、态度或内在特质。
senses.en_definition: To reveal or express a previously mentioned feeling, attitude, or quality.
senses.ms_definition: Menampakkan perasaan, sikap atau sifat yang sebelumnya disebut.
senses.nuances: 可以指有意表达，也可以指无意流露；常见于“不把某种情绪表现出来”等语境。

senses.zh_definition: 通过解释或示范，使别人明白前文提及的方法、过程或内容。
senses.en_definition: To explain or demonstrate something previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Menerangkan atau memperagakan perkara yang telah disebut supaya dapat difahami.
senses.nuances: 重点是让人理解或学会；-nya 可指操作方法、步骤或某项原理。

senses.zh_definition: 用证据证实或支持前文所述的事实或判断。
senses.en_definition: To establish or support a previously mentioned claim with evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Mengemukakan bukti yang menyokong atau mengesahkan perkara yang telah dinyatakan.
senses.nuances: 论证强度取决于证据；menunjukkan 本身并不保证已经达到严格证明的程度。

senses.zh_definition: 以迹象、读数或表现表明前文所述的情况。
senses.en_definition: To indicate a previously mentioned condition through signs, readings, or behaviour.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi tanda atau memberikan petunjuk tentang keadaan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 主语可以是数据、仪表、症状或行为；与“展示给某人看”的主动行为有所区别。

collocations.zh: 数据清楚地表明这一点
早期症状已经显示出这一点
collocations.en: the early symptoms already indicate it

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提及的手指等朝某方向伸出，用来指示。
senses.en_definition: To direct a previously mentioned finger or similar object towards something.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalakan jari atau benda yang telah disebut untuk memberikan isyarat arah.
senses.nuances: 对应 menunjukkan jari 一类结构。必须有清楚的前文指称；一般说“指向门口”时，menunjuk ke arah pintu 更直接。

senses.zh_definition: 向别人指认前文提及的人，使其知道此人是谁。
senses.en_definition: To identify a previously mentioned person by pointing them out.
senses.ms_definition: Memperkenalkan orang yang telah disebut dengan menunjuk atau memberikan isyarat kepadanya.
senses.nuances: 承接词典中“介绍、使人认识”的义项，多需具体叙事语境。现代社交场合正式介绍某人通常用 memperkenalkannya。

collocations.en: point the person out to the guests
identify the person with a gesture

etymology.historical_story: This is a productive Malay formation built on tunjuk, the base associated with pointing. Its meanings connect a visible gesture with showing an object, explaining a method, and indicating a conclusion. The final -nya links the action to an understood referent. The word therefore demonstrates how Malay combines derivation with compact reference to earlier discourse.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tunjuk 是“指”，menunjukkan 是“展示、表明”，再接 -nya 就把前文的对象接回来：menunjukkannya＝把它展示出来／表明这一点。

etymology.historical_story: Mandarin has a remarkable connection with Malay. The European term for an imperial Chinese official passed through Portuguese mandarim, with Malay mantri or menteri behind it and Sanskrit mantrin further back. The officials' language later received the same European label. This historical relationship does not make modern Malay mandarin a derivative of menteri. [Etymological source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/mandarin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 man-da-rin 与熟悉的英语 Mandarin 连起来：bahasa Mandarin 是华语，limau mandarin 是柑橘；先看前面的名词，就能选对意思。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries treat maki as the base of memaki and makian. The expressive pairings caci maki and maki hamun make abusive speech easy to recognize in everyday conversation and public reporting. This productive family explains the modern word clearly, although the available evidence does not establish its deeper historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: McKinney belongs to Gaelic patronymic naming traditions. Surname scholarship records derivations through Mac Cionaodha and, in northern Ireland, Mac Coinnigh. Their English spellings can converge despite different underlying personal names. The inherited element Mac originally indicated a son, but a modern bearer uses the whole surname; it is not a productive Malay construction. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/mckinney?geo-lang=en).

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds mudahnya transparently from mudah and -nya. The ending can emphasize a quality or turn it into something discussed as a state: ease itself. This explains the connection between an excited mudahnya! and the measured expression dengan mudahnya. These are grammatical developments, rather than evidence of a separately borrowed word. See [DBP on -nya](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/).

etymology.historical_story: Mengubati belongs to the Malay family built around ubat, medicine or a remedy. Its dictionary meanings move from treating bodily illness to comforting the heart, correcting social defects, and relieving doubt. That range illustrates a familiar cultural metaphor: troubles can be spoken of as ailments, and helpful actions as remedies. See [DBP's ubat entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=ubat).

etymology.historical_story: Mimpikan belongs to the family of mimpi, whose dictionary meanings connect experiences during sleep with imagined wishes. The suffix -kan lets the verb take a particular dream object. That connection makes the same family useful when recounting a nighttime dream or describing a hoped-for future. This is a morphological and semantic account, not a claim about an ancient donor language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 mimpi＝梦；加 -kan，就把梦对准一个对象：mimpikan rumah，梦见房子；mimpikan kejayaan，梦想成功。

etymology.historical_story: The standard word makhluk is an Arabic loan, as identified by DBP. Its meaning places humans and animals within the broader category of created beings. In Malay cultural usage, makhluk halus names unseen supernatural beings. The spelling makluk should therefore be understood as a spelling problem, rather than assigned a separate historical origin. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=makhluk).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 makhluk 的 kh 是一组：生灵可以隐形，拼写里的 h 不能消失。

senses.zh_definition: 使身体、精神或感官恢复清爽与活力；使环境或事物变得清新。
senses.en_definition: To refresh or invigorate someone, or to make something fresh and pleasant.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan segar atau sihat; menyebabkan seseorang atau sesuatu menjadi segar.
senses.nuances: 核心是“使变得 segar”，可用于身体、头脑、空气或感官体验。minuman yang menyegarkan 意为“令人清爽的饮料”，仍保留使动意义，不等同于“新鲜制作的饮料”。[DBP：menyegarkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyegarkan)

collocations.zh: 使身体恢复清爽与活力

senses.zh_definition: 使记忆或印象重新鲜明；唤起或重温已有的记忆。
senses.en_definition: To revive a memory or make an existing recollection vivid again.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan ingatan atau kenangan kembali segar dan jelas.
senses.nuances: 这是 segar“仍鲜明地留在记忆中”的比喻延伸，常与 semula 搭配；强调重温已有内容，而非首次学习。[DBP：segar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=segar)

senses.zh_definition: 使植物恢复生机或生长旺盛。
senses.en_definition: To restore vitality to plants or promote their healthy growth.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan tumbuh-tumbuhan segar atau subur.
senses.nuances: 用于植物时指恢复生机、减少萎蔫或促进健壮生长，不能自动理解为使已经腐坏的食物重新新鲜。[DBP：menyegarkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyegarkan)

collocations.zh: 使栽种的植物恢复生机

etymology.historical_story: Menyegarkan is built within Malay from segar, a word covering freshness, bodily vitality, flourishing plants, and vivid memories. The verbal construction turns those states into effects: something makes a person, plant, or recollection fresh again. Its initial ny reflects a regular sound change in Malay prefixation, rather than a separate root beginning with ny. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=segar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: segar 是“清爽有精神”，meN-...-kan 是“使变成”：menyegarkan 就是“让人重新精神起来”；s 遇 meN- 让位给 ny。

etymology.historical_story: Memainkannya illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separately borrowed word. The deeper base main supports a family covering play, performers, and games. Memainkan extends into music, recordings, and dramatic roles. Adding the enclitic -nya points back to an object already mentioned, letting context select the intended meaning. [DBP verb entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memainkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 main 的玩与演，再把 -nya 看成指回上文的小箭头：memainkannya 就是玩它、演奏它或播放它；先找它指什么，便能选对中文。

morphology.formula: meN- + kenal pasti → mengenal pasti; mengenalpasti → mengenal pasti（规范拼写修正）
morphology.pattern_note: 词根复合形式为 kenal pasti。meN- 加在 kenal 前，词首 k 脱落，鼻音实现为 ng /ŋ/，得到 mengenal。只加前缀时仍分写为 mengenal pasti；pengenalpastian 带前后缀，合写。

word_family.gloss: 识别、鉴定或查明的过程

senses.zh_definition: 识别、辨认；查明或确定某人、某物、原因、特征或情况，使之可以明确指出。
senses.en_definition: To identify or ascertain a person, thing, cause, feature, or situation with sufficient certainty to specify it.
senses.ms_definition: Mengetahui identiti atau sifat sesuatu serta menentukannya dengan jelas dan pasti.
senses.nuances: 输入的 mengenalpasti 是非规范合写形式，标准拼写为 mengenal pasti；本条 official 标签不能理解为合写形式获 DBP 认可。以下标准例句均用分写形式。该表达比单独 mengenal 更强调明确确定，但不自动表示已完成全部核实程序。释义与拼写依据 [DBP：kenal pasti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kenal+pasti)。

collocations.en: to identify the cause of a problem

etymology.historical_story: Mengenal pasti combines recognition with certainty: kenal contributes knowing or recognizing, while pasti contributes being sure. Malay adds the active prefix to the first element while retaining the space. The joined spelling is a common error; the related noun pengenalpastian follows a different formation pattern and is written together. [DBP entry and spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kenal+pasti).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kenal 是认得，pasti 是确定：认出来，还要定得准，就是 mengenal pasti。记住中间留空格；名词 pengenalpastian 才合写。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留数据包的直接基词 memukul；最终词根为 pukul。meN- 遇词首 p 时实现为 mem-，p 脱落。-ku 是 aku 的后附代词，此处作宾语，表示“我”，并非构词后缀；suffix 为本模式中的位置近似。数据包 jawi 实际仅对应 memukul；加上 -ku 的完整形式可写为 مموکولکو。按构词推定音节为 me.mu.kul.ku。

senses.zh_definition: 打我；用手或器物击打我的身体。
senses.en_definition: To hit or strike me.
senses.ms_definition: Mengenakan pukulan pada tubuh aku dengan tangan atau sesuatu alat.
senses.nuances: memukulku 等于 memukul aku；-ku 表示受事“我”，不表示施事，也不表示“我的”。是否反复殴打须看上下文，词形本身不限定次数或时态。马来文释义由 DBP 的 memukul 义项结合 -ku 编写，并非独立官方词条的逐字引文。[DBP：pukul／memukul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengikut-ngilu)

senses.zh_definition: 向我袭来；冲击或侵袭我，施事可为人或浪等自然力量。
senses.en_definition: To attack me or strike against me, including through natural force.
senses.ms_definition: Menyerang, merempuh atau melanda aku, termasuk oleh daya alam seperti ombak.
senses.nuances: 由 memukul 的攻击、冲撞义与宾语 -ku 组合而成；与实际击打义存在交叠。以下为可成立的组合例，不声称整个附代词形式具有独立高频搭配。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam kenyataan bertulisnya, pengadu menyatakan, "Lelaki itu memukulku dengan penumbuk sebelum melarikan diri."
dual_scenarios.zh: 投诉人在书面陈述中表示：“那名男子用拳头打我，随后逃走了。”
dual_scenarios.en: In a written statement, the complainant said, "The man hit me with his fist before fleeing."

dual_scenarios.en: There's a line in that novel, 'Dia memukulku', right? Does it mean he hit me?

tu → itu

etymology.historical_story: Memukulku illustrates how Malay combines an action word with a compact personal pronoun. The root pukul becomes memukul through nasal prefixation, with its initial p disappearing. The attached -ku then identifies the speaker as the person struck. This economical construction suits first-person narration, while everyday conversation often uses the separate phrase pukul aku or pukul saya.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分两步记：pukul“打”变 memukul；末尾 ku 把动作指向 aku“我”，所以 memukulku 就是“打我”。

morphology.pattern_note: 数据包中的 membenci 是直接构词基础，最底层词根为 benci。meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，b 保留；-mu 是表示第二人称宾语的附着代词，并非派生后缀，此处归入 suffix。所给爪夷文仅对应 membenci，缺少 -mu。

senses.zh_definition: 讨厌你；憎恨你。表示对第二人称对象抱有厌恶或憎恨之情，强度随语境而变。
senses.en_definition: To dislike or hate you.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa benci atau tidak suka terhadap kamu.
senses.nuances: -mu 对应 kamu，是动词的宾语，不表示时态，也不限定主语为“我”。完整词形常见于歌曲、小说和带感情色彩的书面表达；日常谈话更常说 benci awak 或 benci kau。基础动词义参见 [DBP：benci](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=benci)。

dual_scenarios.en: In the interview, the author explained that the words “I do not hate you” mark the beginning of reconciliation between the two main characters.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku tak membencimu lah, aku cuma nak ruang je.

membencimu 在随意聊天中略显文艺，谈论或引用歌词时尤其自然。

etymology.historical_story: The emotional force of membencimu comes from ordinary Malay grammar: benci supplies the feeling, meN- forms the active verb, and -mu identifies its target. The compact ending suits lyrics and intimate literary dialogue. A single written word therefore carries both the emotion of hatred and the person toward whom it is directed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按声音切成 mem-ben-ci-mu：先记 benci＝讨厌，再把最后的 mu 听成“你”；整个词就是“讨厌你”。

headword.validation_note: 输入将 menaip 判作词根有误；它是 taip 加 meN- 形成的派生动词。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接以 t 开头的词基时，此词的 t 脱落，由鼻音 n 接替；taip 中 ai 保持双元音，因此分音节为 me.naip。

word_family.gloss: 打字词基；口语或祈使句中表示打字

senses.zh_definition: 打字；使用打字机、电脑等设备的键盘输入文字或其他字符。
senses.en_definition: To type text or other characters using a typewriter, computer, or similar device.
senses.ms_definition: Menulis dengan mesin taip, komputer dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》释义以打字机为例，《Kamus Pelajar》明确包括电脑。可带宾语，如 menaip surat，也可不带宾语，如 sedang menaip。熟人交流常省去前缀，使用 taip。[DBP：menaip](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menaip)

etymology.historical_story: The history visible in DBP's definitions moves from the mechanical typewriter to the computer. Kamus Dewan describes writing with a typewriter, while Kamus Pelajar explicitly includes computers and similar equipment. The verb remains useful as the equipment changes. Its formation also demonstrates a productive Malay pattern: the initial t of taip disappears after meN-.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taip 和英语 type 的声音联系起来：meN- 加上 taip，t 换成 n，就得到 menaip——打字。

morphology.formula: meN- + bunyikan → membunyikan；完整分析：meN- + bunyi + -kan → membunyikan

etymology.historical_story: Modern membunyikan shows productive Malay word formation: bunyi denotes sound, while the surrounding verbal morphology expresses causing something to sound. The pronunciation sense applies that action to written language. Classical dictionaries also record an identical form meaning conceal. That older homonym must be distinguished from the sound word rather than explained through an invented connection between noise and secrecy.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 现代义记作 bunyi“声音”加使动结构：“让它响起来”。铃、喇叭会响，字母则被读出声音；古典“隐藏”义单独记。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 与词首 s 结合时，s 被鼻音 ny /ɲ/ 替代，形成 menyi-；后缀 -kan 保留。menyiarkan 是主动及物动词，通常带播出或传播的内容作宾语。

etymology.historical_story: Menyiarkan is built from siar through productive Malay morphology. Its dictionary meanings connect public announcements, printed material, the spread of beliefs, and even radiating light. A useful interpretive thread is outward transmission: something reaches beyond its starting point. Broadcasting gives this established word family a particularly visible role in modern Malaysian life. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=siar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 siar＝向外传播：加上 meN- 和 -kan，就把新闻、节目或文章送到公众面前；s 遇 meN- 变成 ny。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀是 -an，不是 -kan；k 属于词根 masuk，接元音后缀后成为下一音节的声母。masukan 与动词命令式 masukkan 拼写和功能不同。

etymology.historical_story: Masukan builds on masuk, the everyday idea of entering. Technical terminology gives that spatial idea a specialized role: information, signals, or power enter a system. DBP records both the input function of equipment and the electrical meaning of supplied power or signals. The connection illustrates how familiar Malay vocabulary supports scientific expression without requiring a separate foreign root. [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=masukan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: masuk＝进去；masukan＝送进去的输入，或供输入使用的部分。记住：masukan 一个 k，masukkan“放进去”两个 k。

etymology.historical_story: Memilihnya illustrates how Malay builds a precise expression from a verb and an attached pronoun. Pilih supplies the idea of selection; meN- produces the active verb memilih; -nya supplies a previously mentioned object. Its interpretation therefore depends on discourse rather than grammatical gender, allowing the same form to refer to a person, product, or proposal.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 pilih＝选：memilih 是“进行选择”，最后的 nya 把选择落到“他／她／它”身上。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 评价别人做的菜时，agak masin（有点咸）通常比直接说 masin sangat（非常咸）委婉；也可说 Boleh kurangkan garam sedikit?（可以少放一点盐吗？）。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: masin mulut 可用于熟人间谈论某句话应验，但涉及疾病、死亡或灾祸时，应避免拿对方的话开玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect masin with asin through their shared meaning of saltiness. Familiar expressions such as ikan masin and telur masin link the adjective with salted foods. Figurative expressions extend it to speech: a person's words may come true or carry influence. These associations do not establish a historical prefix m-. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=masin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ikan masin（咸鱼）：看见 masin，就想象舌尖尝到盐；再用 kemasinan 连接咸味或盐度。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇词首 p 时变为 mem-，p 脱落：mem- + enat + -kan。实际词基为 penat，输入中的整词词根标注已据 DBP 派生关系校正。

senses.zh_definition: 使疲倦；使人在身体或精神上感到疲惫。
senses.en_definition: To tire or exhaust someone physically or mentally.
senses.ms_definition: Melelahkan; meletihkan.
senses.nuances: penat 表示“累”，memenatkan 表示“使人累”。它是使役动词，也常见于 kerja yang memenatkan 等修饰结构；不等同于 membosankan“使人无聊”。[DBP：memenatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=memenatkan)；[DBP：penat 及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penat)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价任务 memenatkan 很自然；直接对别人说 Awak memenatkan saya 可能显得不耐烦或带指责，应谨慎使用。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述长途旅行、搬家、体力劳动或耗费心神的工作。职场反馈宜说明具体原因，如 jadual yang terlalu padat，而不是笼统指责某个人。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical: memenatkan belongs to the family of penat, meaning tired. Malay turns that condition into a cause with meN-...-kan. The initial p disappears after the nasal prefix, making the relationship less obvious to beginners. Dewan groups penat, memenatkan, kepenatan and berpenat-penat together, connecting tiredness, its cause and strenuous effort.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: penat＝累；meN-…-kan＝使……：memenatkan 就是“使人累”。记住 p 被前缀的鼻音替换，别把 memenat 当词根。

senses.zh_definition: 草本沼泽；经常或周期性积水、主要生长草本湿地植物的低洼湿地。
senses.en_definition: An area of wetland dominated by grasses and other nonwoody plants, with permanently or periodically waterlogged ground.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan tanah lembap yang sentiasa atau berkala ditakungi air dan ditumbuhi terutamanya tumbuhan herba seperti rumput dan rusiga.
senses.nuances: 英语普通名词；马来语说明可用 paya，专业语境须进一步说明植被和水文特征。此处马来语释义为编写释义，并非所给资料包中的 DBP 原文。status 按指定结构保留，不表示已核实为 DBP 正式马来语词条。音标采用英式英语读音，见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/marsh)。

senses.en_definition: An English surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dalam bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 专有名词应写作 Marsh。资料包未提供上下文，不能确定原始语料中的 marsh 指湿地还是某个人的姓氏。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 面向普通马来语读者时，首次出现英语 marsh 宜附马来语解释。姓氏 Marsh 保留大写，不翻译成 paya。

etymology.historical_story: Marsh descends from Old English mersc or merisc through Middle English mersh. Its history belongs to English rather than Malay word formation. The same landscape term also underlies the surname Marsh, originally identifying someone who lived near wet ground. Context therefore distinguishes an environmental term from a family name. Sources: [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/marsh), [Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/marsh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /mɑːʃ/ 联想成踩进湿草地后拖长的“嘛——嘘”：脚下积水、四周是草，就是 marsh。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.formula: mengenali + -ku → mengenaliku；底层构词：meN- + kenal + -i → mengenali
morphology.pattern_note: 保留资料包的直接基底 mengenali；词汇词根为 kenal。meN- 接 kenal 时，词首 k 脱落，鼻音实现为 /ŋ/；-ku 是表示第一人称宾语的附着代词，并非派生后缀。资料包 Jawi مڠنلي 仅对应 mengenali，缺少 -ku 的 کو；完整形式应为 مڠنليکو。

senses.zh_definition: 认识我；与我相识，或了解我的性格、特点及为人。
senses.en_definition: To know me, be acquainted with me, or know what I am like.
senses.ms_definition: Kenal akan aku atau mengetahui sifat dan peribadiku.
senses.nuances: mengenali 后的 -ku 是宾语“我”，不是主语“我”，也不是领属语“我的”。是否表示长期相识或深入了解，由上下文决定。马来语释义依据资料包所载 mengenali 义项编写；DBP 亦说明 mengenali 可表示更深入地了解外貌、性质等，见 [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengenal)。

collocations.en: to have known me for a long time
to get to know me better

senses.zh_definition: 认出我；根据外貌、声音等已知特征确认我的身份。
senses.en_definition: To recognize me from my appearance, voice, or other familiar characteristics.
senses.ms_definition: Mengecam aku berdasarkan rupa, suara atau tanda lain yang sudah diketahui.
senses.nuances: 常见于久别重逢、外貌变化或身份辨认的语境。表达“没认出我”时，tidak mengenaliku 不必然表示从未与我相识。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 相关，常用于亲近关系、独白和文学表达；面向客户、上级或陌生人时，mengenali saya 通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在歌词、私人文字或熟人交谈中自然；正式报告正文宜按身份关系选用 saya。若正式新闻引用当事人原话，可保留 mengenaliku。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 相关，常用于亲近关系、独白和文学表达；面向客户、上级或陌生人时，mengenali saya 通常更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在歌词、私人文字或熟人交谈中自然；正式报告正文宜按身份关系选用 saya。若正式新闻引用当事人原话，可保留 mengenaliku。

etymology.historical_story: Mengenaliku illustrates how Malay combines a recognition verb with a compact personal pronoun. The lexical root kenal supports mengenali, while ku is a shortened form of aku attached to the preceding word. Here it identifies the person being known: me. This grammatical history explains the form without inventing a separate ancient origin. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ku).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到末尾 /ku/ 就想起 aku“我”：mengenali 是“认识”，mengenali + ku 就是“认识我”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包的直接基底 bekalkan 分析，meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，b 保留；更深层词根为 bekal，整体也可分析为 meN- + bekal + -kan。root_jawi 未获提供，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 提供或备妥供使用的物资；供应食物、水、设备等。
senses.en_definition: To supply or provide something for use or as provisions.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan bekal, menyediakan sesuatu sebagai bekal.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，典型结构为 membekalkan sesuatu kepada seseorang：所供应的东西作直接宾语，接受者由 kepada 引出。与 membekali seseorang dengan sesuatu 的宾语安排不同。马来释义依据资料包所引《Kamus Dewan》展开缩写。[DBP：membekalkan 与 membekali](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membekalkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 提供作为工作、学习或决策准备的资料、知识、技能等非实物资源。
senses.en_definition: To provide information, knowledge, skills, or other non-material resources for use.
senses.ms_definition: Menyediakan atau memberikan maklumat, pengetahuan, kemahiran dan sebagainya sebagai persediaan atau untuk kegunaan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这是“提供所需准备”的抽象延伸，并非另一种构词。常见于培训、教育及行政语境；membekalkan maklumat 的重点是提供资料供使用，而非单纯告知消息。[DBP：membekalkan 的资料与行政用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membekalkan)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适用于合同、采购、教育及日常安排。请求供应时可说 bolehkah pihak tuan membekalkan…，或用 mohon pihak tuan membekalkan…，使语气符合正式关系。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 供应合同中应另行写明数量、规格、价格和交付时间；membekalkan 本身不表示免费、捐赠或赞助。熟人间可以使用 dah、nak 等口语形式。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适用于合同、采购、教育及日常安排。请求供应时可说 bolehkah pihak tuan membekalkan…，或用 mohon pihak tuan membekalkan…，使语气符合正式关系。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 供应合同中应另行写明数量、规格、价格和交付时间；membekalkan 本身不表示免费、捐赠或赞助。熟人间可以使用 dah、nak 等口语形式。

etymology.historical_story: The base bekal evokes provisions prepared for a journey, such as food and water. Membekalkan turns that preparation into an action: providing what someone will need. Modern usage extends naturally to supplying raw materials and information. This connection between provisions and preparedness explains the word's meanings without requiring an unverified account of its earliest historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bekal＝备好的所需物资；加 meN- 和 -kan，就成为“把所需物资供应出去”。记住 b 前用 mem-，b 不消失。

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包保留直接基础词 menggantikan；更深层词根是 ganti。meN- 在 g 前实现为 meng-，原有 g 保留。-nya 是宾语附着代词，严格说属于附着语素；此处依字段约定归入 suffix。可分节为 meng.gan.ti.kan.nya。资料包 Jawi 仅写出基础词，完整词形为 مڠݢنتيکنڽ。

senses.ms_definition: Mengambil tempat atau menjadi ganti kepada benda atau perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: -nya 指向前文的事物；应能从上下文明确识别。dengan 后可说明替代品，如 menggantikannya dengan yang baharu。此处与人称义具有相同的替代关系。[DBP：ganti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ganti)

dual_scenarios.ms: Pengurus operasi akan bersara pada akhir bulan ini, dan timbalannya akan menggantikannya mulai bulan hadapan.

dual_scenarios.en: That printer's broken; the office is planning to replace it next week.
spoken_features: tu、dah、nak 分别对应 itu、sudah、mahu。
minggu depan 是常见口语时间表达。
menggantikannya 保留完整词形；随意交谈也常把宾语另说出来，如 ganti pencetak tu。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论职位更替时可用接任日期、职责等中性信息说明情况；直接对某人说要“替换他”可能显得生硬。

etymology.historical_story: This form combines Malay word formation with a compact reference to something already mentioned. Ganti supplies the replacement meaning, menggantikan forms the verb, and attached -nya identifies its object. Malay spelling joins this shortened pronoun to the preceding word, allowing a single written form to express what English often renders as replace him, replace her, or replace it. [DBP: spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ganti＝替换，再看 -nya＝他／她／它：menggantikannya 就是“把前面说的那个替换掉或接替下来”。

morphology.formula: mengajar + -i → mengajari；完整构词：meN- + ajar + -i → mengajari
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的直接基础 mengajar；更深层词根为 ajar。meN- 在元音 a 前表现为 meng-，词根 a 保留。加入 -i 后，词尾 r 与后接元音衔接，形成 me.nga.ja.ri；ng 表示 /ŋ/，j 表示 /dʒ/。完整形式亦可分析为 meN-…-i 的构词。

senses.zh_definition: 教导、训练某人，使其掌握某种知识或技能。
senses.en_definition: To teach or train someone in a subject or skill.
senses.ms_definition: Mengajar seseorang sesuatu ilmu pengetahuan atau kemahiran; melatih seseorang.
senses.nuances: DBP 词典收录此形式。直接宾语通常是学习者，如 mengajari anak membaca；若突出所教内容，可用 mengajarkan sesuatu kepada seseorang。马来西亚日常表达通常选用更简洁的 mengajar；正式文字也可优先使用 mengajar。不能把 mengajari 一概判作仅属印度尼西亚语或无效形式。

collocations.en: to teach a child to read

dual_scenarios.en: The volunteers teach children to read and write through weekly tutoring sessions.

aku 表示朋友间的非正式第一人称。
tau 在句尾提醒对方注意，相当于“你知道吗”。
mengajari 在此带有较完整、偏书面的回忆语气；日常聊天更常说 mengajar。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Cikgu tu yang mengajari aku membaca dulu, tau.
messages.ms_standard: Guru itulah yang mengajari saya membaca dahulu.

etymology.historical_story: Mengajari belongs to the Malay ajar family, which connects teaching, learning, teachers, and lessons through different affixes. Its structure puts the learner in focus: someone teaches a person a skill. DBP records mengajari alongside related forms, while its language advice also points writers toward the familiar form mengajar in standard Malaysian usage.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ajar＝教；把 -i 想成“教学指向这个人”的箭头：mengajari anak membaca＝教孩子阅读。

morphology.formula: menanti + -kan → menantikan；进一步分析：meN- + nanti + -kan → menantikan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基底 menanti；更深层词根是 nanti。meN- 在鼻音 n 前体现为 me-，词根首音 n 保留；-kan 接在词尾，不改变基底拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 等待某人到来或某个时间、事件、结果出现；也可依语境表示期待、盼望。
senses.en_definition: To await the arrival of someone or the occurrence of something; to look forward to something.
senses.ms_definition: Menunggu ketibaan sesuatu, seperti orang atau waktu; menunggu akan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，后面直接接等待对象，如 menantikan keputusan。相较日常的 tunggu，常显得较书面或带期待感，但词义本身不保证等待者感到高兴。释义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》menantikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=228452&keyword=menantikan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak pengurusan sedang menantikan keputusan rasmi sebelum mengumumkan langkah seterusnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 管理层正在等待正式结果，之后才会宣布下一步措施。
dual_scenarios.en: Management is awaiting the official decision before announcing the next steps.

dual_scenarios.en: I've been looking forward to this day for ages. We finally get to see each other!
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah，ni 对应 ini。
aku 表示熟人之间的第一人称。
menantikan 在这里表达较强的期待感；普通日常等候也常用 tunggu。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah lama menantikan hari ni, akhirnya kita dapat jumpa juga!

messages.zh: 我盼这一天好久了，终于能见面啦！

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Kami menantikan kehadiran tuan/puan 适合邀请函，既表达期待，也尊重收件人。商务沟通可用 Kami menantikan maklum balas pihak tuan/puan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于邀请、公告、结果发布和个人期待。催促回复时可以搭配礼貌请求；仅说正在等待，并不能自动消除催促感。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Kami menantikan kehadiran tuan/puan 适合邀请函，既表达期待，也尊重收件人。商务沟通可用 Kami menantikan maklum balas pihak tuan/puan。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于邀请、公告、结果发布和个人期待。催促回复时可以搭配礼貌请求；仅说正在等待，并不能自动消除催促感。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary illustrates menantikan with a classical passage in which Radin Kelang draws his keris while awaiting an attacker. That scene shows that the word need not express happy anticipation. Its structure remains transparent: nanti underlies menanti, and the added suffix -kan introduces the person, event or time being awaited. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=228452&keyword=menantikan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 nanti 的“等”：menanti 是等待，menantikan 后面接“等什么”；把期待的对象接到词尾后面记。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处按输入保留直接基础形式 menyesali；更深层构词为 meN- + sesal + -i → menyesali，词首 s 经鼻音替换形成 ny /ɲ/。-nya 是附着代词，在此充当宾语，接合时不改变基础形式。输入 Jawi 对应 menyesali，未包含 -nya。

senses.zh_definition: 对前文提到的行为、决定或事情感到后悔或遗憾。
senses.en_definition: To regret a previously mentioned action, decision, or situation.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa sesal terhadap perbuatan, keputusan atau perkara yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常回指某件事，并不表示后悔者的性别。menyesalinya 已带宾语，一般不再直接接另一个同指宾语；可说 menyesali keputusan itu 或 keputusan itu dibuatnya dan kini dia menyesalinya。基础义项依据：[DBP：sesal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sesal)。

senses.zh_definition: 对前文提到的人或团体感到不满，并加以责怪。
senses.en_definition: To resent or blame a previously mentioned person or group.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa tidak senang kepada seseorang atau sesuatu pihak yang telah disebut, lalu mempersalahkannya.
senses.nuances: 此义重点是责怪别人，不一定是反省自己的行为。现代日常交流通常用 menyalahkannya 表达得更直接；判断此义须看 -nya 的先行词及上下文。基础义项依据：[DBP：sesal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sesal)。

dual_scenarios.en: I've sent that message, and now I regret it.

tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
aku 适用于熟人之间；menyesalinya 本身偏书面，口语更常直接说 menyesal。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 公开表达悔意时，此词适合较郑重的说明；但表示后悔并不自动等于向受影响者道歉，必要时还应明确说 saya memohon maaf。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谈自身决定或对往事的反思。提醒别人 nanti awak menyesalinya 可能带责备或警告意味；安慰对方时宜避免幸灾乐祸的语气。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 公开表达悔意时，此词适合较郑重的说明；但表示后悔并不自动等于向受影响者道歉，必要时还应明确说 saya memohon maaf。

etymology.historical_story: The form belongs to the Malay sesal family, which connects regret with recognizing a mistake. A familiar proverb, sesal dahulu pendapatan, sesal kemudian tiada berguna, encourages thinking before acting. Menyesali directs that feeling toward an object; adding -nya lets speakers refer back to an earlier decision or event without repeating its name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 menyesali 记成“后悔”，把尾部 -nya 记成“那件事”：menyesalinya＝为那件事后悔；听到 ny 时，注意它是一个 /ɲ/ 音。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 按输入保留，属于该数据包的归根标记；语言学上此词由 lancong 派生。meN- 在词首 l 前采用 me- 形式，l 保留。下列词族也以 lancong 为基础。构词关系依据：[DBP：lancong](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=lancong)。

senses.zh_definition: 为休闲、游览或观光而到其他地方旅行。
senses.en_definition: To travel for pleasure or sightseeing.
senses.ms_definition: Melawat sambil melihat-lihat untuk bersenang-senang.
senses.nuances: 强调旅游目的，并非一切出行的通称；单纯通勤或出差不能自动称为 melancong。目的地通常用 ke 引出，如 melancong ke Sabah；在某地游览可用 di。义项依据：[DBP：lancong](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=lancong)。

kita 包括听话者，适合共同出游的提议。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place melancong in the lancong family, alongside pelancong, a tourist, and pelancongan, tourism. Together these forms connect the holidaymaker, the enjoyable journey, and the services supporting it. This family offers a compact view of how Malay builds related words around an activity, whether the destination is nearby or overseas.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 lancong 这个共同核心：me-lancong 是“去旅游”，pe-lancong 是“去旅游的人”，pe-lancong-an 是“旅游这回事或行业”。

senses.zh_definition: 推、推动或推移某物。
senses.en_definition: To push or shove something.
senses.ms_definition: Menolak atau menyorong sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是词包选取的义项；现代日常交流通常用 menolak 表达“推”。应根据宾语辨义，不能把所有 menunda 都译为“推迟”。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menunda)

senses.zh_definition: 促使、催逼某人或某机构采取行动。
senses.en_definition: To urge or press someone to take action.
senses.ms_definition: Mendorong atau mendesak pihak tertentu supaya bertindak.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，语体较书面；现代马来西亚马来语通常选用 mendesak 或 mendorong，以免与“延期”义混淆。

collocations.en: to press the government to make a decision
to urge the authorities to act

senses.zh_definition: 将原定活动、执行事项或时间安排推迟至以后。
senses.en_definition: To postpone an event or defer an action until later.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalihkan pelaksanaan sesuatu kepada waktu yang lebih lewat.
senses.nuances: 常见义。只表示延后，不必然表示取消；正式通知也常用 menangguhkan。

senses.zh_definition: 用绳索或其他拖曳装置牵引船只、车辆等。
senses.en_definition: To tow a boat, vehicle, or other object.
senses.ms_definition: Menghela bot, kenderaan atau benda lain menggunakan tali atau alat penarik.
senses.nuances: 船舶与车辆语境常见；拖曳是从前方牵引，与第一义的推移方向不同。

senses.zh_definition: 跟随在后；也比喻事件接连发生。
senses.en_definition: To follow behind, or figuratively to occur in succession.
senses.ms_definition: Menyusul dari belakang atau berlaku berturut-turut.
senses.nuances: 较少见，主要用于文学叙述；日常表达“跟着”通常用 mengikut。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报

messages.ms_standard: Ketua sudah meminta kita menunda mesyuarat esok ke minggu hadapan.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record several meanings under tunda, including towing, postponing, and pushing. Their shared spelling does not establish that every meaning developed from one historical source. Menunda illustrates a regular Malay sound change: the prefix meN- absorbs the root's initial t. Context then distinguishes moving a boat, moving a date, or pressing someone to act. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menunda)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tunda 想成“挪动”：挪日期是延期，拉着挪船是拖曳，向前挪车是推；这是辨义联想，不是词源结论。

morphology.formula: 植物名：∅ + meninjau → meninjau；同形动词：meN- + tinjau → meninjau
morphology.pattern_note: 词包的词根标记适用于植物名。动词来自 tinjau：meN- 实现为 men-，首音 t 脱落；不能把动词解释为无前缀词根。

word_family.gloss: 调查、考察或其结果；属于同形动词的 tinjau 词族

考察、勘察；属于同形动词的 tinjau 词族

senses.zh_definition: 买麻藤，亦称 belinjau，一种学名为 Gnetum gnemon 的植物。
senses.en_definition: The melinjo tree, Gnetum gnemon, also called belinjau.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis tumbuhan yang juga dinamakan belinjau.
senses.nuances: 词包对应的植物名义项；与“考察、巡视”的动词同形。植物名搭配属于植物描述语境，使用频率低于动词搭配。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=meninjau)；[文莱植物资料](https://www.bkishhb-en.gov.bn/1299-2/herbal-garden-page-3/gnetum-gnemon/)

senses.zh_definition: 从高处或远处观察、眺望。
senses.en_definition: To observe something from a height or a distance.
senses.ms_definition: Mengamati sesuatu dari kedudukan tinggi atau jauh.
senses.nuances: 强调观察位置或视野；比一般的 melihat 更有主动察看之意。[DBP 的 tinjau 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=tinjau)

senses.zh_definition: 前往某地察看、巡视或实地了解情况。
senses.en_definition: To visit a place to inspect it or assess conditions.
senses.ms_definition: Mengunjungi sesuatu tempat bagi mendapatkan gambaran keadaannya.
senses.nuances: 新闻、公务巡视及看房等语境常用；并不自动表示已进行全面调查。

senses.zh_definition: 监视、侦察或暗中观察某人的行动。
senses.en_definition: To reconnoitre or keep someone's movements under observation.
senses.ms_definition: Mengawasi pergerakan pihak tertentu untuk memperoleh maklumat.
senses.nuances: 对象常为敌方或嫌疑人的活动；是否带秘密性质由上下文决定。

senses.zh_definition: 审视、研究或重新检视某项事宜。
senses.en_definition: To examine, study, or review a matter.
senses.ms_definition: Mengkaji sesuatu perkara dengan memberikan perhatian kepada butirannya.
senses.nuances: 可用于政策、问题及观点；meninjau semula 表示重新审视，不保证随后作出修改。

senses.zh_definition: 探询、调查或揣摩他人的意见、想法或感受。
senses.en_definition: To sound out opinions or ascertain someone's thoughts or feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Mendapatkan gambaran tentang pandangan, fikiran atau perasaan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 用于意见时可指正式调查，也可指初步探询；不等于取得对方同意。

etymology.historical_story: Meninjau presents a useful lexicographic trap: one spelling names a plant, while another is a verb formed from tinjau. The verb links distant observation with inspection, investigation, and sounding out opinions. These meanings share an act of attentive looking. The plant name belongs to a separate entry; spelling alone provides no evidence that it originated from that verb. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=meninjau)

headword.status_note: 此处按英语 maze 处理；不能据所给数据认定它是正式马来语词。音节与音标采用英语读法，数据包未提供爪夷文。

senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan dalam bahasa Inggeris, rangkaian perkara atau urusan yang rumit dan mengelirukan.
senses.nuances: 此比喻义属于英语用法。以下为保留英语词的马来语混语搭配；正式马来语通常直接说明程序繁复或道路纵横交错。[DBP：maze](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=maze)

etymology.historical_story: English maze once described bewilderment or confusion before it became a name for a puzzling network of paths. Its deeper origin remains uncertain. This movement from mental confusion to physical layout explains its modern metaphorical use for complicated procedures. Its appearance in Malay conversation should be distinguished from established Malay vocabulary. [Etymonline: maze](https://www.etymonline.com/word/maze)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 /meɪz/，想象自己看着迷宫地图发问：出口在哪里？这是意义联想，不是中文谐音词源。

headword.jawi_note: 依要求保留数据包的爪夷文；موسوه 对应词根 musuh，完整 musuhnya 为 موسوهڽ。音节与音标按完整词形补充。

morphology.formula: musuh + -nya → musuhnya（他／她／它的敌人；其对手）
morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常是附着于名词后的第三人称领属语素，不区分性别；此处按字段要求归入 suffix。词根不变，ny 表示单个鼻音 /ɲ/。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或它的敌人、仇敌或对手；具体领属对象由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its enemy, adversary, or opponent.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau pihak yang menjadi lawan atau seteru kepada orang atau pihak yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: -nya 不表示男性，也不自动表示复数。musuh 的敌意通常强于普通比赛中的 lawan；体育报道中也可指长期劲敌。此处完整词形的释义依据 DBP 的词根义及 -nya 的语法功能编写。[DBP：musuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=musuh)

collocations.en: make peace with his or her enemy

senses.zh_definition: 对其构成威胁、造成损害或妨碍其发展的事物；其大敌。

senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang mengancam atau merosakkan orang atau benda yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻用法，例如把疾病、害虫或不良习惯称作某人的大敌。需要上下文交代 -nya 所指。[DBP：musuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=musuh)

collocations.zh: 把疾病视为自己的敌人

senses.zh_definition: 可与之匹敌的人或事物；主要见于否定结构，表示无可匹敌。
senses.en_definition: A match or equal, chiefly in negative expressions meaning unrivalled.
senses.ms_definition: Bandingan atau tandingan bagi seseorang atau sesuatu, terutama dalam ungkapan yang menafikan adanya tandingan.
senses.nuances: 例如 tidak ada musuhnya 可表示无人能及，而不是字面上的没有仇人；必须结合语境区分。[DBP：musuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=musuh)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 把现实中的同事、邻居或竞争者称为 musuh，容易让人理解为存在敌意。一般竞争关系使用 pesaing 或 lawan 更稳妥。

etymology.historical_story: Musuh belongs to a regional vocabulary of enmity also documented in neighbouring languages. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary discusses related forms under loans, so their resemblance should not automatically be treated as proof of direct inheritance. Modern musuhnya has a transparent structure: musuh names the enemy, while -nya identifies the associated person or party. etymology.historical_story: English March, the month, ultimately comes from Latin Martius, associated with the Roman god Mars. The walking verb followed a different route through French marchier, meaning to tread or march. A third historical noun denotes a frontier district. Identical spelling therefore conceals distinct histories; none establishes march as a standard Malay headword. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/march).

etymology.historical_story: Menolongku is best understood through Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowing story. The root tolong forms the active verb menolong, while the shortened pronoun ku attaches after it to identify the person helped. This compact construction brings action and personal involvement together, which helps explain its suitability for intimate narration, gratitude and literary expression. It means helping me, not my helping someone else.

etymology.historical_story: Rakam is documented among Malay borrowings from Arabic raqm. Its Malay meanings span making patterns on cloth, embroidery, and preserving sound. These meanings provide a useful cultural connection between leaving visible marks and keeping an audible record. Modern merakamnya adds Malay verbal morphology and an object pronoun to this established borrowed base. [University of Malaya linguistic study](https://mjs.um.edu.my/index.php/JUD/article/download/4257/2103/10321).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place menyingkir under singkir, linking ordinary movement aside with withdrawal to safety. The same entry also records abandoning old practices and a rooster's circling courtship movement. These meanings offer a memorable picture of changing position or moving around something. This is a documented range of meanings, rather than proof of their historical order. [DBP: singkir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=singkir)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 singkir 的“离开原位”：自己让开是 menyingkir，把别人移走通常是 menyingkirkan。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词根首音 r 前呈 me-，r 保留；词末 k 在常见马来西亚标准发音中实现为 /ʔ/。输入包的词根标注已据 DBP 更正为 ringkuk。[DBP：ringkuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ringkuk)

senses.ms_definition: Duduk atau berbaring dengan membengkokkan badan; meromok.
senses.nuances: 描写身体姿势，可用于人或动物；寒冷、疼痛、恐惧或熟睡都可能构成语境，但这些原因并非词义的必要条件。[DBP：ringkuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ringkuk)

senses.zh_definition: 被关押在监狱或拘留场所；身陷囹圄。
senses.en_definition: To be confined in prison or detention.
senses.ms_definition: Mendekam dalam penjara; terkurung atau terpenjara.
senses.nuances: 常见于新闻和叙事，比 dipenjarakan 更有被困、难以脱身的画面感。它本身不表示具体刑期，也不能单凭此词判断是否已经定罪。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary connects meringkuk with ringkuk and records both a curled bodily posture and confinement in prison. A sleeping child and a prisoner therefore share one vivid verb, although their situations differ greatly. For learners, the useful bridge is restricted space: limbs drawn inward in one scene, personal movement restricted in the other. [DBP: ringkuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ringkuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把身体缩进一个小圈：睡觉时“蜷着”，入狱时“困着”，都是 meringkuk。

senses.nuances: 可描写建筑的宏伟气势，也可描写声名或地位的显赫；不只是体积大。ters ergam 应连写为 tersergam，常见表达为 tersergam megah。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=megah)

senses.zh_definition: 因成就、身份或受到肯定而感到自豪的。
senses.en_definition: Feeling proud of an achievement, association, or recognition.
senses.ms_definition: Bangga atau berasa besar hati.
senses.nuances: 本身可以表示正面的自豪；若强调反复炫耀或自我吹嘘，常用 bermegah-megah。日常表达自豪时，bangga 也很自然。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=megah)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect megah with both outward grandeur and inward pride. A building may appear imposing, while a person may feel honoured by recognition. The related noun kemegahan can describe splendour, fame, or something cherished with pride. These established meanings offer a useful cultural bridge between public distinction and personal feeling; they do not, by themselves, prove a particular ancient origin. [DBP dictionary entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=megah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住词尾 gah：楼宇有气势，人心有荣光。megah 既能说建筑宏伟，也能说心里自豪。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 保留首字母大写及原始拼写。Matthews、Mathews 和 Matthew 不能随意互换；不要仅凭姓氏推断国籍、宗教或家族来源。

etymology.historical_story: Matthews commonly developed as a patronymic surname from the personal name Matthew. Surname histories also record other routes, including an Irish origin for some families. A shared spelling therefore does not prove a single ancestry. In Malay text, the surname normally remains Matthews; it identifies its bearer rather than functioning as an ordinary Malay vocabulary item. Source: [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Matthews).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Matthews 对应“马修斯”：记住双 t 和末尾 s；这是姓氏，不能把 s 当作马来语词缀拆掉。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留 lengkapkan 作为直接词基；它本身不是最终词根，最终词根是 lengkap“完整”。完整构词也可分析为 meN- + lengkap + -kan。meN- 在 l 前实现为 me-，l 保留；两个 e 均读 /ə/。规则见 [DBP《Morfologi》](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf)。

word_family.gloss: 装备；所需用品；齐备状态
补充物；使整体完整的部分

senses.zh_definition: 补齐所缺内容或部分，使某物完整、齐全或完善。
senses.en_definition: To make something complete by supplying what is missing or required.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan lengkap, mencukupkan, menyempurnakan.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，重点在于使内容齐全。melengkapkan borang 是填写完整表格；melengkapkan maklumat 是补全资料。并非所有“完成工作”都宜用此词，一般完成任务常用 menyiapkan 或 menyelesaikan。官方释义见 [DBP：melengkapkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=102560&keyword=melengkapkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 为人或事物配备所需的装备、知识或能力，使其准备充分。
senses.en_definition: To equip or prepare someone or something with what is needed.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan seseorang atau sesuatu lengkap dengan menyediakan keperluan yang diperlukan.
senses.nuances: 常用 melengkapkan X dengan Y，表示为 X 配备 Y；melengkapkan diri 可指充实知识或技能。此义是官方“使完整”义在准备与配备语境中的展开，见 [DBP：melengkapkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=102560&keyword=melengkapkan)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式通知可用 Sila lengkapkan borang ini“请填写完整此表”；对客户或长辈提出要求时，加入 sila 或 mohon 更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合行政、教育、培训和工作汇报。提醒他人补资料时，可具体指出缺少哪一项；口语中的 lengkapkan 是常见简化形式，正式主动陈述通常保留 melengkapkan。

etymology.historical_story: Melengkapkan transparently builds on lengkap, meaning complete. The -kan element gives the action a causative sense: make something complete. Before initial l, meN- appears as me-, producing melengkapkan. [DBP’s morphology guide](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf) explains this sound pattern. Remembering the structure connects completing paperwork with equipping a person: both supply what is needed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lengkap＝齐全；-kan＝使之如此；melengkapkan＝把缺的补上，让它齐全。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的直接基底 menjauh；更深层词根是 jauh。meN- 在 j 前成为 men-，j 保留。末尾 -lah 是附着语气词，不是派生后缀，因此此层 affix 为 null。可分析音节为 men.jauh.lah，但输入包未提供音节。所给 Jawi 实际对应 menjauh，未标出 -lah，此处按输入保留。

senses.zh_definition: 走远些；退开；远离某人、某物或某种处境，带有劝告、请求或强调语气。
senses.en_definition: Move away or keep away, with emphasis or an urging tone conveyed by -lah.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak atau menghindar supaya menjadi jauh, dengan penegasan atau nada suruhan melalui partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: menjauh 是不及物动词，说明远离对象通常用 dari 或 daripada 引出。空间起点用 dari，人或抽象事物通常用 daripada。-lah 的具体语气取决于上下文和语调。词义依据：[DBP：menjauh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menjauh)；语气词说明：[DBP：partikel](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -lah 不保证句子客气。单独对人说 menjauhlah 可能像‘离我远点’；对长辈或陌生人可加 maaf、tolong，并说明原因。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于安全提醒、劝人避开危险或表达个人界限。涉及人际关系时应说明对象和原因，避免造成无意的排斥感。

etymology.historical_story: This form shows how Malay builds a social instruction from a distance word. Jauh expresses distance; menjauh describes becoming distant or moving away. Adding the bound particle -lah introduces emphasis or an urging tone without creating a new lexical root. The resulting expression can serve a practical safety warning or a more personal request for distance.

etymology.historical_story: Two dictionary histories meet in this spelling. Kamus Dewan distinguishes gelar I, associated with titles and nicknames, from gelar II, marked as Javanese and meaning to spread something out. Both produce menggelar through the same Malay prefix. A mat and an honorary title therefore provide memorable contrasting scenes, without requiring a single invented origin for both meanings. [PRPM: gelar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=gelar).

etymology.historical_story: Melepasinya contains several familiar Malay building blocks: lepas, the verbal formation melepasi, and the attached pronoun -nya. Its dictionary meanings range from clearing an obstacle to discharging a debt or covering expenses. A useful connection is getting beyond something that holds one back, although this is a learning interpretation rather than a documented sequence of historical change. etymology.historical_story: Memeras belongs to the Malay peras family. Squeezing coconut provides a concrete image for its literal meaning: pressure makes liquid come out. Figurative expressions apply that image to thought, effort, and exploitation. Memeras otak describes intense thinking, while memeras tenaga orang describes extracting another person's labour for one's own benefit. These connections explain the meanings without requiring an invented origin tale. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=peras)

etymology.historical_story: Menyesakkan is transparently formed from sesak, a Malay word covering crowded space, obstructed breathing, and difficult circumstances. The causative formation turns these states into effects produced by something else. Its meanings offer a memorable conceptual link: a packed room leaves little physical space, while pressure or hardship leaves little room to act. [DBP: sesak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sesak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sesak＝挤、闷、困；menyesakkan＝让别人或某处变得挤、闷、困。记住 s 遇 meN- 变成 ny。

etymology.historical_story: Mitchell does not have one origin shared by every family. English and Scottish branches can derive from medieval spoken forms of Michael, while others began as a nickname meaning big, from Middle English michel and related forms. Some Irish families adopted it as an equivalent of Mulvihill. A person's surname alone cannot establish which history applies. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=mitchell)

word_family.gloss: 愚弄；把人当傻子；使愚昧

senses.nuances: 本条解释可见用法，不将其冒充为已核实的标准词头。DBP 的英马词典材料出现过 memperbodohkan diri sendiri，而标准 membodohkan 条目明确收录欺骗义。以下搭配为释义示例，未核实其频率。[DBP：相关用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=diri+kau)，[DBP：membodohkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=membodohkan)

etymology.historical_story: The form is built around bodoh, the adjective meaning foolish or unintelligent. Its interest lies in Malay word formation rather than a securely established borrowing history: speakers combine material found in memperbodoh and membodohkan. Dictionary examples attest memperbodohkan in use, but that evidence alone does not establish it as the preferred form for edited Malaysian Malay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 bodoh＝傻：把别人当 bodoh，就是愚弄；正式写作用 membodohkan。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves an interesting connection between storytelling, paperwork, planning, and dictation. All four activities give words or actions an organised form. Merencanakan belongs to the rencana family, alongside perencana and perencanaan. This semantic connection is documented; it does not establish a chronological sequence in which the meanings developed. [Source: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=rencana+).

etymology.historical_story: Bahas comes from Arabic baḥth, associated with research and discussion. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic letters بحث, while ordinary Malay pronunciation adapts the consonants. Adding the Malay prefix meN- produces membahas. The word illustrates how an Arabic borrowing can retain a visible historical spelling while participating in productive Malay grammar. [Linguistic study](https://www.ils.unimas.my/images/pdf/v6n2/v6n2_idris.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 bahas＝辩论、研究，再加 meN-：遇到 b 变 mem-，得到 membahas＝提出理由去辩驳或审查。

etymology.historical_story: Menuruti belongs to the Malay turut family, built around following and going along with someone or something. Its dictionary meanings connect physical movement with social conduct: following behind a person, granting wishes, obeying advice, and copying an example. The form combines meN- and -i, with the initial t of turut disappearing after the prefix.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 turut 记成“跟着走”：跟着人走是跟随，跟着劝告走是听从，跟着欲望走就是顺从或迁就。

morphology.pattern_note: 双音节词根，直接使用时没有词缀或音变；memuramkan 中 meN- 在 m 前实现为 me-。

senses.nuances: 比喻义，常见于生活叙述和经济评论；比 sekadar perlahan 更带悲观色彩。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses muram for dim light, an unhappy face, and an unpromising situation. These dictionary senses offer a cultural image: brightness belongs both to the visible world and to human feeling. A face can lose its radiance just as a day loses sunlight. This explains the semantic connection without claiming an undocumented origin or chronology.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mu.ram 联想成“目暗”：天色暗、脸色暗、前景暗。只是记忆联想，并非词源。

senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常接被分开的对象；说明分离对象时用 daripada。mengasingkan sampah 可表示垃圾分类，mengasingkan diri 则表示主动离群，不必然涉及疾病。义项依据：[DBP：asing 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=asing)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places mengasingkan under asing, whose meanings include separate, foreign, and unfamiliar. Adding meN- and -kan creates an action that makes something separate. This shared family links everyday sorting with human experiences of isolation: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=asing) records both separating things and sending someone to a remote place, without requiring a speculative ancient origin story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: asing 表示不同、分开；加上使动成分 -kan，就是让它分开。想象把白衣服从彩色衣服中挑出来：mengasingkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包保留直接基式 mencium；更底层的词根是 cium。meN- 遇 c 时出现 men-，保留 c。-nya 在这里是后附宾语代词，不是派生词缀，也不标示时态或性别。资料包的 منچيوم 仅对应 mencium，完整词形补写 ڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Malay cium brings smelling and kissing into the same lexical family. The dictionary distinguishes smelling an object, affectionately sniffing a child's head, and touching someone with the lips. Menciumnya adds the object clitic -nya to mencium. The relationship between these meanings offers a useful cultural association, without proving which sense developed first. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mencium).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cium 管“闻或吻”，meN- 组成主动动词，-nya 接上“他、她、它”：menciumnya＝闻它／吻他或她。

etymology.historical_story: The surname Montgomery is traced to place names in Normandy, including Sainte-Foy-de-Montgomery and Saint-Germain-de-Montgomery. It subsequently became established in English, Scottish, and Irish naming traditions. In Malay text, it remains a proper name rather than acquiring a separate everyday meaning. A person's surname and a place called Montgomery therefore require different contextual identification. [Source](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=montgomery).

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records two meanings that illustrate variation across the Malay-Indonesian linguistic area. Malaysian readers commonly encounter melulu in criticism of reckless actions or accusations. The sense meaning merely or exclusively is marked Indonesian. This regional distinction is documented; the supplied evidence does not establish an earlier origin or justify splitting the word into a prefix and root.

etymology.historical_story: The English element name mercury is linked to Mercury, the swift messenger of Roman mythology. DBP also recounts this naming connection in its encyclopedia material. Malay uses merkuri or raksa for the metal, while the planet is Utarid. Keeping those names separate helps readers navigate English scientific labels without confusing a chemical substance with a celestial body.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“mercury 金属 → merkuri；Mercury 行星 → Utarid”。把银色液滴和天上的行星分成两幅图，就不容易混义。

senses.nuances: 新闻中可独立指人，如 seorang militan；这是名词化用法。不可自动等同于“恐怖分子”，须依据具体行为和报道语境。参见 [马来西亚皇家警察新闻用例](https://www.rmp.gov.my/arkib-berita/keratan-akhbar/2024/05/19/keratan-akhbar-pilihan-kdn-beri-jaminan-polis-sentiasa-pantau-aktiviti-babitkan-bekas-anggota-militan)。

etymology.historical_story: Militan belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English militant. The English word traces through French or Latin to militare, meaning to serve as a soldier. That military background helps explain its associations, but Malay dictionary definitions also include readiness to struggle and the use of strong pressure. The precise borrowing route into Malay is not established here. [Oxford etymology](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/militant_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mi-li-tan 与英语 militant 联系：核心画面是“准备投入斗争”，再由上下文判断是否涉及武装或暴力。

morphology.pattern_note: 与 ke muka 结合时，起首 k 脱落，meN- 呈 meng-；整体表示“带到前面、提出”。基础词为 muka。root_word 和 root_jawi 按要求保留词包值，但该值是派生词本身，故不能据此判为词根。

senses.zh_definition: 把人或事物带到前面，使其出现在众人面前。
senses.en_definition: To bring someone or something forward or to the front.
senses.ms_definition: Membawa ke hadapan atau ke muka.
senses.nuances: 这是空间上的本义，现代日常交流通常会用更直接的 membawa ke hadapan；本词更常用于后列的抽象义。以下义项及 muka 词族关系参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengemukakan)。

senses.zh_definition: 提出意见、论据或议题，供他人讨论、审议或考虑。
senses.en_definition: To put forward an opinion, argument, or issue for consideration.
senses.ms_definition: Mengetengahkan pendapat, hujah atau perkara untuk dipertimbangkan atau dibincangkan.
senses.nuances: 强调把内容带入讨论或审议程序；提出某种看法并不表示该看法已经获得接受。通常直接接名词宾语。

senses.zh_definition: 提出建议、方案或候选人，供有关方面采纳、选择或批准。
senses.en_definition: To propose a course of action or put forward a candidate for acceptance or selection.
senses.ms_definition: Mencadangkan atau mengusulkan sesuatu atau seseorang supaya diterima atau dipilih.
senses.nuances: 与单纯表达意见相比，此义包含请求采纳或选择的意图。涉及人选时可译为“提名、推举”，但不表示已经当选。

senses.zh_definition: 向有关人士或机构提出问题，或提交申请、索赔等事项。
senses.en_definition: To submit an application or claim, or address a question to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Menyampaikan pertanyaan, tuntutan, permohonan atau perkara seumpamanya kepada pihak berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 常见于行政通知、申请指南和职场沟通；可用于书面或口头提交。常用结构为 mengemukakan sesuatu kepada pihak tertentu。

senses.zh_definition: 通过叙述或作品呈现某件事情、个人经历或故事。
senses.en_definition: To recount or present a story, experience, or account.
senses.ms_definition: Menceritakan atau mengisahkan sesuatu hal atau pengalaman.
senses.nuances: 属引申义，较常见于文学评论和书面叙述；日常讲故事通常使用 menceritakan。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places mengemukakan in the family of muka, meaning face or front. Its literal sense brings something forward; its abstract senses bring ideas, candidates, and requests before other people. This spatial image provides a useful semantic bridge between physical presentation and the formal language of meetings and administration.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 muka 想成“前面”：mengemukakan 就是把意见、申请或人选“摆到大家面前”。

etymology.historical_story: The root uji connects modern testing with a concrete craft: checking the quality of gold using a touchstone. Malay dictionaries also record examinations of ability and trials of endurance. Mengujinya combines this testing verb with an attached pronoun, allowing the same form to refer to testing an object or a person. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menguji)

senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks makanan, sejenis ladu berinti daging atau sayur yang dikaitkan dengan Nepal, Tibet dan kawasan Himalaya, lazimnya dimasak dengan mengukus.

etymology.historical_story: Momo belongs to a shared Himalayan food culture rather than to native Malay word formation. A Nepal Tourism Board publication describes a tradition linking its arrival in Nepal to Newar traders travelling from Tibet. This is a reported cultural account, not proof of a single invention date or an established borrowing route into Malay. [Nepal Tourism Board](https://trade.ntb.gov.np/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/Experience_Nepal_Globalizing_Nepalese_Heritage_Cuisine_Recipe_Book.pdf)

senses.en_definition: Malloy, a surname of Irish origin; no ordinary Malay lexical meaning is established here.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal dari Ireland, lazimnya dieja Malloy dengan huruf awal besar; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 数据包没有释义或语境，因此不能认定原始词项必然指这个姓氏，也不能标为官方马来语普通词。以下是姓名的常规组合，不是固定词汇搭配。姓氏来源及其与Molloy的关系见[Dictionary of American Family Names，经Ancestry转载](https://www.ancestry.com/name-origin?surname=malloy)。

etymology.historical_story: Malloy is recorded in the Dictionary of American Family Names as an Irish variant of Molloy. Its presence in Malay writing can therefore reflect a person's name rather than a Malay vocabulary item. That distinction matters in corpus dictionaries: a frequently occurring name still needs contextual identification before it receives a common-word definition. [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/name-origin?surname=malloy)

etymology.historical_story: DBP places menetas under tetas and records both opening a seam and hatching. These meanings offer a memorable shared image: something closed becomes open. This comparison helps learners connect the senses, but it does not establish which meaning came first. The modern form also illustrates the regular loss of initial t after meN-. [PRPM: tetas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tetas)

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆作马来语词缀。马来西亚规范对应形式为mantera，读作/man.tə.ra/；其e不是词缀。下列词族均基于规范形式mantera。

senses.zh_definition: 咒语；真言：在特定传统或宗教实践中诵念、被认为具有神圣或超自然效力的词句。马来西亚规范拼写通常为mantera。
senses.en_definition: An incantation or sacred verbal formula believed to have spiritual or supernatural efficacy; normally mantera in standard Malaysian Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Kata atau rangkaian kata yang dipercayai mempunyai kuasa ghaib apabila dilafazkan; jampi. Bentuk baku Malaysia ialah mantera.
senses.nuances: 本条解释输入拼写mantra，并交叉指向mantera。DBP的马来语词条及马来西亚术语对应形式采用mantera，因此不将输入拼写标为official。音标只表示mantra这一字形的宽式读音；规范例句使用mantera。释义根据DBP改写，见[PRPM：mantera](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=mantera)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay mantera derives from Sanskrit mantra, a term associated with sacred verbal formulas. Research on Malay charms describes how the borrowed word became associated with incantations and secret prayers. DBP uses mantera as the Malaysian dictionary form. The relationship explains the familiar spelling mantra without making every occurrence of that spelling standard Malaysian Malay. [Low Kok On, Manteras](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/304722446_Manteras_An_Overview_of_a_Malay_Archipelagoes%27_Charming_Tradition)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把mantra联想到反复诵念的一串声音；写马来西亚规范马来语时，在t与r之间记得放入e：mantera。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接 tanding 时发生鼻音替代，词首 t 脱落，形成 menanding-，再接 -i。输入包把 menandingi 标为词根；此处依据 DBP 的 tanding 词族修正。[DBP：tanding](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=tanding)。

senses.nuances: 是及物动词，可直接接对手或比较对象，如 menandingi lawan、menandingi kehebatan seseorang。表示参与一场比赛通常用 bertanding；menandingi 不保证已经胜过对方。释义依据 [DBP：menandingi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menandingi)。

etymology.historical_story: Menandingi grows from tanding, a Malay base associated with a match, equal, or counterpart. Its family connects comparison with competition: setanding describes equality, bertanding names competing, and pertandingan names a contest. Menandingi focuses that relationship on an object, allowing the same vocabulary to describe sporting opponents, personal skill, and competing products.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 menandingi 和 pertandingan“比赛”一起记：tanding 是共同核心；menandingi 就是把某人或某物当作可较量的对象。

etymology.historical_story: Milton is a proper name rather than an established Malay common noun in the supplied evidence. A notable bearer is John Milton, whose Paradise Lost first appeared in 1667. Cambridge University Library documents the early editions and their changing title pages. This provides a literary association for remembering the name, without establishing which Milton the packet intends. [Source: Cambridge University Library](https://wwwe.lib.cam.ac.uk/CUL/exhibitions/Milton/captions.html).

etymology.historical_story: Makannya combines the everyday Malay base makan with -nya; it does not require a separate borrowing history. Eating supplies a natural bridge between an action and its practical support. Consequently, context can shift attention from how someone eats to who provides their meals. This is why cara makannya and makannya ditanggung belong to related but distinct uses.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: makan 是“吃”，makannya 把镜头对准“某人的吃”：cara makannya 看怎么吃，makannya ditanggung 看谁包伙食。

etymology.historical_story: Takluk belongs to Malay's Arabic loan vocabulary, but menakluki is built with Malay affixes. Its dictionary senses move from defeating and ruling a territory to commanding the mind or soul. Modern climbing reports extend the conquest image to reaching a summit, turning political domination into a metaphor for overcoming a demanding physical challenge. [DBP: Arabic loan spellings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=taksub), [DBP: takluk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=takluk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 takluk＝臣服、受控制；meN- 加上去时 t 退场，再接 -i：menakluki＝使某地臣服，即“征服”。

morphology.formula: membebaskan + -nya → membebaskannya；底层构词：meN- + bebas + -kan → membebaskan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接词基 membebaskan，真正词根是 bebas。meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，原 b 保留；meN-…-kan 构成使动及物动词。外层 -nya 是宾语代词，按所限分类记为 suffix。所给 Jawi 仅对应 membebaskan，未含 -nya。

etymology.historical_story: This form makes its meaning through productive Malay grammar. Bebas supplies the idea of freedom; meN-…-kan creates an action that makes someone free, and -nya identifies the affected person. The dictionary extends that action beyond physical release to exemption, liberation, and removal from office. No separate ancient origin is needed to explain the complete form.

etymology.historical_story: Murdoch belongs to Scottish naming history, where more than one Gaelic personal name contributed to related surname forms. Its later cultural journey includes Australia: Murdoch University was named in honour of writer and educator Sir Walter Murdoch. That institutional connection explains one educational use of the name without making it a Malay common noun. See [surname history](https://www.electricscotland.com/webclans/m/murdoch2.html) and [the university’s account](https://www.murdoch.edu.au/explore/about-murdoch/our-history/sir-walter-murdoch).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Murdoch 整体当作姓名记忆；看到 Universiti Murdoch，就联想到“莫道克大学”，不要硬拆马来语词缀。

etymology.historical_story: A useful cultural story here is the contrast between neighbouring standards. Indonesian records misterius as an adjective, while DBP records misteri and kemisterian. Readers moving between Indonesian fiction and Malaysian Malay therefore encounter closely related expressions for the unexplained. The consulted sources establish this lexical contrast, but not the precise historical borrowing route of misterius.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misterius 与英语 mysterious 联想：都表示“神秘的”。在马来西亚正式表达中，再联想 penuh misteri＝充满谜团。

etymology.historical_story: This form shows how a word for communication technology fits into Malay grammar. Telefon supplies the base; meN- turns it into the calling action, with initial t disappearing, and -nya identifies the person called. The dictionary's example already attaches -nya to menelefon, showing that the complete form follows ordinary grammar rather than naming a separate technology. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menelefon).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: telefon 是电话，menelefon 是打电话，尾巴 -nya 是他或她：menelefonnya，一口气记成“打电话给他／她”。
