etymology.historical_story: The underlying root turut means to follow or accompany. Malay builds menurut through nasal prefixation, with the initial t disappearing. Adding the attached pronoun -nya produces menurutnya. Its reporting use offers a useful semantic connection: following someone's account becomes presenting information according to that person. This explains the modern structure without assigning an unsupported historical date. [DBP: turut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=turut)

etymology.historical_story: Meletihkan illustrates a productive Malay word-building pattern rather than an opaque borrowed form. The base letih describes tiredness; meN- and -kan form a verb meaning to cause that state. This relationship connects everyday descriptions of a tired person with descriptions of tiring work, travel, or other demands on someone’s energy. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=letih)

senses.ms_definition: Memberi ingat atau nasihat kepada aku supaya tidak lupa akan sesuatu atau sedar akan tanggungjawab.
senses.nuances: -ku 指被提醒的人，即“我”；动作主体由句子中的其他成分交代。提醒内容可接 tentang、bahawa 或 supaya。马来西亚正式职场表达通常用 mengingatkan saya；连写形式较有文学或私人叙述色彩。释义依据 DBP 对 mengingatkan 的解释作人称化改写。[PRPM：mengingatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengingatkan+1)

senses.zh_definition: 使我因联想、相似之处或某种刺激而想起某人、某事或过去的经历。
senses.en_definition: To make me think of or recall someone, something, or a past experience.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan aku ingat atau terkenang kepada seseorang, sesuatu atau pengalaman yang lalu.
senses.nuances: 常用 mengingatkanku kepada...。主语可以是歌曲、气味、景物或人的神态；不一定有人刻意发出提醒。此义与“提醒我完成任务”不同。[PRPM：mengingatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengingatkan+1)

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates how Malay combines word formation with compact personal reference. The base ingat concerns remembering; meN- and -kan build the reminder verb mengingatkan, while attached -ku identifies the person reminded as the speaker. The result suits intimate narration and reflective prose, although Malaysian workplace communication generally favors the separate, respectful expression mengingatkan saya. [DBP: ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ku)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ingat“记得”和 ku“我”：mengingatkan + ku，就是“提醒到我身上”或“让我想起来”。

etymology.historical_story: Montana's name belongs to a Spanish and Latin word family associated with mountains. The name was adopted for the territory created in 1864, when Abraham Lincoln signed the establishing legislation. Its mountainous association offers a useful geographical image, but it remains a proper name in Malay rather than a Malay adjective meaning mountainous. [Montana Historical Society](https://prod-mhs.mt.gov/Research/Compass/Facts)

etymology.historical_story: Mencair is formed within Malay from cair, describing a liquid or fluid state, and the productive prefix meN-. Its structure presents becoming liquid as an event. The same family connects familiar observations, such as melting ice and heated wax, with technical vocabulary including pencairan for the process and kecairan for the property.

morphology.formula: menukar + -nya → menukarnya；底层构词：meN- + tukar → menukar
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基础词 menukar；最终词根为 tukar。meN- 接词首 t 时，t 脱落，鼻音实现为 n。-nya 在这里通常是第三人称宾语附着代词，指它、他或她，不表示时态。输入未提供音节，故保留 null；实际可分为 me.nu.kar.nya。输入爪夷文 منوکر 对应 menukar，完整 menukarnya 应加 ڽ，写作 منوکرڽ。

word_family.gloss: 更换、兑换或转换的过程

senses.zh_definition: 把前文所指的人或物换成另一个；更换它，或将它拿去交换、兑换。

etymology.historical_story: Menukarnya illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. Its lexical base is tukar, associated with replacement, exchange, and change. The active prefix meN- produces menukar through nasal substitution, while attached -nya points back to a person or thing. The dictionary also preserves a Minangkabau shopping sense under menukar, showing regional variation without establishing a particular historical origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=menukar)

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以 l 开头时，meN- 呈 me- 形式，保留词根的 l；首音节读 /mə/，词根两个 é 均读 /e/。输入将 meleleh 标为词根，与 DBP 的派生关系不符，现据其 leleh 词条修正。[DBP：leleh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=leleh)。

senses.zh_definition: 指眼泪、汗水、血液、树胶等液体缓慢流出或沿表面流下。
senses.en_definition: To trickle, ooze, or flow slowly, especially of tears, sweat, blood, or sap.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalir perlahan-lahan, seperti air mata, darah dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 通常为不及物动词，以流动的液体作主语，如 air mata meleleh；若表达某人流泪，可用 air matanya meleleh。重点是液体缓缓流动；表达冰等固体融化时，马来西亚标准语通常用 mencair。air liur meleleh 也可借指看到美食而垂涎。[DBP：meleleh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=meleleh)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 本词本身语体中性，正式报道和日常交谈均可使用。描述他人落泪时应体谅其处境，避免带有嘲笑意味。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place meleleh in the family of leleh, alongside words for allowing liquid to flow and for the liquid that emerges. Its imagery connects ordinary bodily experience—sweat and tears—with flowing sap. The recorded proverb kalau getah meleleh, kalau daun melayang uses this familiar physical world to express kinship and loyalty during hardship. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=meleleh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 me-lé-léh 时，想象一滴眼泪沿脸颊慢慢滑下；两个连续的 lé 帮你记住“缓缓流淌”。这只是记忆联想。

morphology.formula: ∅ + merosot → merosot；内部构词分析：meN- + rosot → merosot
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入词基将 merosot 作为完整单位保留；形态分析上，DBP 也在 rosot 下列出 merosot。meN- 在 r 前采用 me-，r 保留，首音节 me 读 /mə/。[DBP：rosot 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=rosot)

senses.zh_definition: 从原来的位置向下滑动或滑落。
senses.en_definition: To slide or slip down from a position.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak ke bawah secara meluncur atau tergelincir dari kedudukan asal.
senses.nuances: 表示实际的向下移动，常带有位置不稳、支撑不足或不由自主滑落的意味；不要求物体完全跌落或受到撞击。

senses.zh_definition: 价格、价值等明显下跌。
senses.en_definition: To fall markedly in price or value.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi jauh lebih rendah dari segi harga atau nilai berbanding sebelumnya.
senses.nuances: 比中性的 turun 更突出下跌趋势或幅度，但单凭 merosot 不能确定跌幅；新闻中常接 peratus、daripada 或 kepada 补充数字。

senses.zh_definition: 产量、销售额、收入、影响力等明显减少或衰退。
senses.en_definition: To decline substantially in output, sales, income, influence, or a similar measure.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi semakin sedikit atau berkurang dengan ketara dari segi hasil, pendapatan, jualan, pengaruh atau ukuran seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 主语通常是出现下降的指标或事物。jualan merosot 指销量或销售额下降，不直接说明商品降价。

senses.zh_definition: 健康、能力、表现或品质逐渐变差；衰退或退步。
senses.en_definition: To deteriorate or decline in health, ability, performance, or quality.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi semakin buruk atau mundur dari segi kesihatan, kebolehan, prestasi, mutu atau keadaan yang seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 可描述持续恶化，也可描述一次考核中的退步，常与 semakin、terus、mendadak 连用。它是不及物动词；表示“使……变差”可用 menyebabkan ... merosot。[DBP：merosot](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=merosot)

etymology.historical_story: DBP connects merosot with rosot and records both physical sliding and abstract decline. These meanings share an image: something moves from a higher position to a lower one. A child can slip down from a lap, while prices, income, health, and performance can also fall. This connection provides a semantic bridge, without establishing which sense developed first. [DBP: rosot](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=rosot)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 merosot 记成一条向右下方滑落的曲线：人往下滑、价格往下跌、成绩往下掉，都能用它；首音节 me 轻读 /mə/。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基词 menunggu；真正的词根是 tunggu。meN- 接 t 起首词根时，t 脱落并发生鼻音替代；原有 ng /ŋ/ 与后续 g 保留。-nya 在此通常为第三人称宾语附着代词，不改变基词发音。音节为补全值。输入爪夷文 منوڠݢو 仅拼出 menunggu，完整 menunggunya 应为 منوڠݢوڽ；词头字段依要求保留输入拼写。[DBP：-nya 的爪夷拼写](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kamus+nya)

守候者；看守者；传说中的驻地精灵

senses.zh_definition: 向对方索回先前已经给出的某物；-nya 指所索回的东西。
senses.en_definition: To ask for it back after previously giving it to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Meminta kembali barang yang telah diberikan; -nya merujuk barang tersebut.
senses.nuances: 对应输入所引 tunggu III 的第一义，DBP 标注 Mn，即米南加保用法。现代马来西亚通语通常用 meminta barang itu kembali。下列为此地域义的释义性组合，不是已核实的高频搭配。[DBP：tunggu III](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=tunggu)

collocations.en: to ask for previously given belongings back

senses.zh_definition: 催讨所欠款项，要求清偿；-nya 指有关债款。
senses.en_definition: To demand repayment of it, referring to a debt.
senses.ms_definition: Meminta supaya dijelaskan hutang, menagih; -nya merujuk hutang berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 对应输入的第二义，同属 Mn 地域用法。普通马来西亚语境中的 menunggunya 通常不会自动被理解为“催债”；表达催债宜用 menagih hutang。下列组合用于说明该地域义。

collocations.en: to demand repayment of a debt

collocations.zh: 向债务人催讨该笔欠款
collocations.en: to demand its repayment from the debtor

senses.zh_definition: 要求兑现某项承诺；-nya 指先前提及的承诺。
senses.en_definition: To demand that a previously mentioned promise be fulfilled.
senses.ms_definition: Menuntut janji; -nya merujuk janji yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 对应输入的第三义，同属 Mn 地域用法。须与普通语义“等待承诺兑现”区别：此义包含主动提出履约要求。现代通语可用 menuntut agar janji itu ditunaikan。下列为释义性组合。

collocations.en: to demand fulfilment of a promise

collocations.zh: 要求许诺者兑现该承诺
collocations.en: to demand its fulfilment from the person who made the promise

senses.zh_definition: 等待他、她或它到来，或等待先前提及的事情发生。
senses.en_definition: To wait for him, her, or it to arrive or happen.
senses.ms_definition: Menanti kedatangan seseorang atau berlakunya sesuatu yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 这是现代日常语境中最常见的理解，属于 tunggu I。-nya 不区分性别，所指依上下文确定；在主动动词后通常作宾语，不表示“他的等待”。[DBP：tunggu I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tunggu)

collocations.en: to wait for him or her outside
to still be waiting for him, her, or it

senses.zh_definition: 守着、照看或看护先前提及的人或事物，使其安全。
senses.en_definition: To watch over or attend to the previously mentioned person or thing.
senses.ms_definition: Menjaga atau mengawasi orang atau benda yang dirujuk oleh -nya supaya selamat.
senses.nuances: 属于 tunggu I 的照看义。例如病人已经在病床上时，menunggunya 可指陪护，不是等待其出现。此义与 menunggui 相通。

collocations.en: to keep watch at his or her bedside

senses.zh_definition: 耐心等待某事发展至预期时机；这是词典标为旧用的细分义。
senses.en_definition: Archaic: to await its development or occurrence patiently.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan arkaik, bersabar menantikan sesuatu yang akan berlaku.
senses.nuances: DBP 在 tunggu I 下将这一细分义与 menunggukan 对应并标 ark。一般“等待”义本身仍是现代常用义。下列为说明性组合。

collocations.zh: 耐心等到它的时机到来

senses.zh_definition: 居住、栖居或盘踞在先前提及的地方；-nya 指该处所。
senses.en_definition: To inhabit or occupy the previously mentioned place.
senses.ms_definition: Mendiami atau menghuni tempat yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 属于 tunggu I 的居住义，常需明确的处所语境。传说叙事中可用于精灵或鬼魅驻居某地；日常说“居住”通常用 mendiami 或 tinggal di。

collocations.zh: 居住或盘踞在该处的生灵

collocations.en: believed to be inhabited by a jinn

etymology.historical_story: Menunggunya combines menunggu with the attached third-person pronoun -nya; it is a grammatical formation rather than a separate borrowed word. Kamus Dewan records waiting, guarding, and inhabiting under tunggu I. It separately labels the reclaiming, debt-collection, and promise-enforcement meanings as Minangkabau usage under tunggu III. This distinction explains why the supplied definition differs from the everyday interpretation of waiting for someone. [DBP](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=tunggu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 tunggu“等”，再接 -nya“他／她／它”：menunggunya＝等他／她／它。输入里的“索还、催债、要求履约”另贴 Mn 地域标签记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 menang 的首音 m 属于词根，并非前缀。加 -i 后，词尾 /ŋ/ 与后接元音构成 /ŋi/。menangi 用于祈使结构及第一、第二人称被动结构；普通主动陈述通常用 memenangi。输入的 منڠ 是词根拼写，本词按后缀补写为 منڠي。

senses.zh_definition: 在比赛、竞赛或其他对抗中获胜；赢得某场比赛或某项竞争。
senses.en_definition: To win a match, contest, or other competitive encounter.
senses.ms_definition: Beroleh kemenangan dalam sesuatu perlawanan, pertandingan atau persaingan.
senses.nuances: 这是 memenangi 在特定句法中的无 meN- 前缀形式。例如 Perlawanan itu telah kami menangi 表示“那场比赛我们已经赢了”。正式主动句用 Kami memenangi perlawanan itu。此处马来文释义依据官方词条整理，并非逐字引文。[PRPM：memenangi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=memenangi)。

senses.zh_definition: 通过比赛、评选或抽奖等方式赢得奖项、奖品或奖励。
senses.en_definition: To win a prize, award, or reward.
senses.ms_definition: Memperoleh hadiah, anugerah atau ganjaran melalui pertandingan, pemilihan atau cabutan.
senses.nuances: 宾语是所得奖项或奖品。祈使式可用 menangi，也可加 -lah 成为 menangilah；正式宣传语中可见后者。DBP 曾建议使用含 menangilah 的购物宣传语。[PRPM：宣传语用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=win)。

senses.zh_definition: 赢得他人的好感、信任或支持。
senses.en_definition: To win someone's affection, trust, or support.
senses.ms_definition: Memperoleh kasih sayang, kepercayaan atau sokongan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻用法，常见于 hati 等宾语；不表示实际占有他人。普通主动表达通常用 memenangi hati，menangi 则须配合相应的祈使或被动结构。[PRPM：memenangi 的比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=memenangi)。

etymology.historical_story: Menangi belongs to the Malay family built on menang, meaning victory or success. Its suffix connects winning with a particular contest, prize, or figurative object. Modern Malaysian promotional language also uses the imperative menangilah, illustrating how the vocabulary of competition extends into shopping campaigns. This explains its contemporary cultural use without proposing an undocumented ancient origin. [DBP usage advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=win).

etymology.historical_story: Menyindir is transparently formed from sindir with the active verbal prefix meN-. Its cultural interest lies in indirect criticism: the rebuke can be understood without openly naming its target. Malay also preserves this idea in the proverb pukul anak sindir menantu, where a remark addressed to one person is intended for another. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=sindir).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect murung with sadness and sorrow, and record the related forms bermurung and kemurungan. These forms show how one emotional root supports descriptions of feeling and names for emotional states. etymology.historical_story: Colombia's Medellín received its name in honour of Pedro Portocarrero, Count of Medellín, whose title referred to the Spanish town. The Colombian city's official history links that honour to his support for its establishment. The shared name therefore connects two places across the Atlantic; it is a historical place name, not a formation from Malay affixes. [City history](https://www.medellin.gov.co/es/historia-y-simbolos-de-medellin/)

etymology.historical_story: Membelah combines the root belah with the active verbal prefix meN-. Before b, the prefix takes the form mem-, leaving the root consonant intact. Its physical image is something opening into separate parts. Malay also applies that image figuratively when a sudden sound breaks the surrounding silence, linking material division with interrupted stillness.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belah 想成“一物分开”，前加 meN- 变 membelah：正在劈开、剖开；雷声也能把寂静“劈开”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay literary culture gives merana a life beyond physical illness. PRPM records the titles Kaseh Merana from 1936 and Jiwa merana from 1948, alongside a pantun about an orphan’s suffering. These examples connect the word with love, loss, and loneliness. They document its cultural history without establishing a particular ancient borrowing route. [Source: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=merana).

etymology.historical_story: The word brings together the Malay base pandang, the active prefix meN-, and the attached pronoun -nya. Its meanings connect physical sight with social judgment: looking at someone can become regarding or respecting them. This semantic connection is reflected in [DBP's dictionary senses](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Makna.aspx?kid=254532); it does not establish which meaning developed first.

etymology.historical_story: Dewan's dictionary places this word under rangsang. Its modern meanings connect sensory stimulation with the awakening of interest and activity. A separate entry labelled Javanese records attacking and contradicting. These meanings should be distinguished when reading older writing; a modern sentence about stimulating learning need not suggest either conflict or aggression.

senses.zh_definition: 我的汽车；由 mobil（汽车）加表示“我的”的 -ku 构成，常见于印度尼西亚语。

senses.ms_definition: Kereta milik saya atau aku; bentuk mobil yang menerima kata ganti nama singkat -ku sebagai penanda pemilik.
senses.nuances: mobilku 是领属形式，不是另一个汽车种类。DBP 在 mobil 的汽车义项中标有 IB；马来西亚日常及正式表达通常使用 kereta saya，熟人间可说 kereta aku。词根的“可移动”义不能机械套用于此领属形式。马来语释义为本条编写；status 按指定格式保留，不表示 mobilku 是 DBP 独立审定词条。下列搭配为印度尼西亚语，ms 为指定字段名。参见 [DBP：mobil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=85408&keyword=mobil) 及 [印度尼西亚官方 -ku 拼写规则](https://ejaan.kemendikdasmen.go.id/eyd/penulisan-kata/kata-ganti/)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与马来西亚客户、老师或陌生人交谈，kereta saya 最稳妥；kereta aku 适合熟人。-ku 与 aku 有关联，但并不意味着所有印度尼西亚语书面用例都失礼。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合印度尼西亚语交流、引文及跨地区语言比较。面向马来西亚读者写一般通知时，通常改用 kereta saya；理解他人使用 mobilku 时，不必将地区差异当作错误纠正。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与马来西亚客户、老师或陌生人交谈，kereta saya 最稳妥；kereta aku 适合熟人。-ku 与 aku 有关联，但并不意味着所有印度尼西亚语书面用例都失礼。

etymology.historical_story: Mobilku combines the vehicle noun mobil with -ku, the shortened possessive form associated with aku. Indonesian spelling joins this pronoun to the preceding word. Dewan records mobil alongside automobil and marks its car sense as Indonesian usage. The form illustrates how closely related languages can share grammatical patterns while preferring different everyday vehicle names. [Sources: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=85408&keyword=mobil), [EYD V](https://ejaan.kemendikdasmen.go.id/eyd/penulisan-kata/kata-ganti/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mobil＝汽车，-ku 联想到 aku（我）：mobilku＝我的汽车；在马来西亚通常说 kereta saya。

morphology.pattern_note: 数据包的 root_word 是直接构词基础 mengganggu；更底层的词根为 ganggu。meN- 在 g 前变为 meng-，保留 g；-ku 是第一人称代词附着形式，在此表示宾语“我”，严格说属于后附着语素。数据包的 Jawi 仅对应 mengganggu，未包含 -ku。

senses.zh_definition: 打扰我；使我无法安静、专心或自在地进行某事。
senses.en_definition: To disturb or bother me, interrupting my peace, attention, or activity.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusik atau mengacau saya sehingga ketenteraman atau tumpuan saya terganggu.
senses.nuances: -ku 在这里是“我”这一宾语，不是“我的”。既可指他人打扰，也可指声音、念头等令人烦扰。此处马来语释义按完整词形改写，基础义项依据 [DBP：mengganggu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengganggu)。

collocations.en: disturb me while I am working

senses.zh_definition: 戏弄我、纠缠我或骚扰我，包括令人不适的调戏。
senses.en_definition: To tease, pester, or harass me, including through unwelcome advances.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusik, mempermain-mainkan atau menggoda saya, terutama dengan perlakuan yang tidak disenangi.
senses.nuances: 可能是熟人间的玩笑，也可能是严重的纠缠；必须根据行为、关系及当事人的感受判断，不能仅凭此词认定为性骚扰。该义承接 [DBP：mengganggu 的戏弄、挑逗义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengganggu)。

collocations.ms: menggangguku dengan mesej yang tidak diingini
collocations.zh: 用不受欢迎的信息骚扰我

senses.zh_definition: 妨碍我；使我的行动、工作或说话无法顺利进行。
senses.en_definition: To hinder me or interfere with the smooth progress of my actions.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalang saya daripada melakukan sesuatu dengan lancar atau meneruskan sesuatu kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 强调行动受到阻碍，未必含有故意冒犯。基础动词亦可搭配交通、安宁等事物；完整词形 menggangguku 已明确以“我”为受影响者。参见 [DBP：mengganggu 的阻碍义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengganggu)。

dual_scenarios.en: That noise outside keeps bothering me. It is so hard to focus.

tu 对应 itu；nak 对应 hendak。
je 对应 sahaja；-lah 表达说话人的情绪。
menggangguku 在聊天中带一点书面或抒情色彩；更随意的说法是 ganggu aku。

messages.ms_spoken: Bunyi kat luar tu asyik menggangguku je, susahlah nak fokus.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 对上司、长辈或不熟悉的人，mengganggu saya 通常比 menggangguku 更符合中性正式语体；-ku 常见于亲近表达、叙事、歌词或文学。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 提出安静请求可说 Maaf, boleh perlahankan suara?；需要明确表达界限时可直接要求对方停止。若对方已表示不舒服，不宜把持续纠缠解释为普通玩笑。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 对上司、长辈或不熟悉的人，mengganggu saya 通常比 menggangguku 更符合中性正式语体；-ku 常见于亲近表达、叙事、歌词或文学。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 提出安静请求可说 Maaf, boleh perlahankan suara?；需要明确表达界限时可直接要求对方停止。若对方已表示不舒服，不宜把持续纠缠解释为普通玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay's productive combination of a verb and a bound pronoun. The lexical base ganggu forms mengganggu with the active prefix meN-, and attached -ku identifies the affected person as the speaker. The dictionary records meanings ranging from teasing to obstruction, explaining why context determines whether the experience is mildly annoying or seriously disruptive. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengganggu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 ganggu“打扰”，再看末尾 ku“我”：mengganggu + ku，就是“打扰我”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，保留词根首音 b。baik 中 a、i 可分属相邻音节，词末 k 在常见马来语读音中实现为 [ʔ]。数据包 Jawi باءيق 对应词根 baik，未包含前缀。马来西亚标准语中须特别注意固定组合 membaik pulih。

senses.zh_definition: 变好；情况、局势或表现朝较好的方向发展。
senses.en_definition: To improve or become better.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi lebih baik atau menunjukkan perubahan ke arah keadaan yang lebih baik.
senses.nuances: 独立不及物用法明确见于印尼语词典。面向马来西亚标准语学习者，通常采用 bertambah baik 或 semakin baik；不能把所给 baik 的形容词释义直接冒充 membaik 的 DBP 释义。参见 [印尼教育部门《Kamus Bahasa Indonesia》](https://luk.staff.ugm.ac.id/bahasa/Indonesia/2008Depdiknas-KamusBahasaIndonesia.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 健康状况、伤口等逐渐恢复；病情好转。
senses.en_definition: To recover or improve in health or physical condition.
senses.ms_definition: Beransur pulih atau menjadi semakin baik, khususnya tentang kesihatan, penyakit atau luka.
senses.nuances: 这一独立用法同样属于印尼语中有词典依据的意义。马来西亚中性表达通常是 kesihatannya bertambah baik、lukanya semakin baik 或 keadaannya semakin pulih。参见 [《Kamus Bahasa Indonesia》：membaik](https://luk.staff.ugm.ac.id/bahasa/Indonesia/2008Depdiknas-KamusBahasaIndonesia.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于 membaik pulih：修复、整修或翻修，使设备、车辆、建筑等恢复良好功能。
senses.en_definition: In membaik pulih: to repair, restore, or overhaul something to proper working condition.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam gabungan membaik pulih, membaiki dan memulihkan sesuatu supaya dapat digunakan atau berfungsi dengan sempurna.
senses.nuances: 这是完整组合 membaik pulih 的意义，不能据此把独立 membaik 当作可自由接宾语的“修理”。DBP 明确指出 membaik 通常用于 membaik pulih。动词分写，名词 pembaikpulihan 连写。参见 [DBP：baik pulih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=baik+pulih)及 [DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memperbaiki)。

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Mereka sedang membaik pulih lif di blok kita, jadi kita perlu menggunakan tangga buat sementara waktu.

kat 对应 di。
kena 在此表示“必须、得”，标准语可用 perlu。
dulu 表示暂时先这样；lah 带解释或接受现状的语气。

messages.ms_standard: Mereka sedang membaik pulih lif di blok kita. Adakah kamu sudah sampai?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身语气中性。慰问病人时，马来西亚常说 Semoga cepat sembuh 或 Semoga kesihatan semakin baik，既自然也体贴。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来西亚文本表达“情况好转”时优先用 bertambah baik；表达修复时用 membaiki 或完整的 membaik pulih。表示双方和好通常用 berbaik semula，避免与 membaik 混淆。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身语气中性。慰问病人时，马来西亚常说 Semoga cepat sembuh 或 Semoga kesihatan semakin baik，既自然也体贴。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来西亚文本表达“情况好转”时优先用 bertambah baik；表达修复时用 membaiki 或完整的 membaik pulih。表示双方和好通常用 berbaik semula，避免与 membaik 混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Membaik is transparently built from baik with the prefix meN-, whose nasal becomes m before b. Regional dictionaries reveal a useful distinction: Indonesian records independent meanings of improvement and recovery, while DBP highlights Malaysian use in membaik pulih. The shared morphology therefore does not guarantee identical preferences across neighbouring standard varieties. [Indonesian dictionary](https://luk.staff.ugm.ac.id/bahasa/Indonesia/2008Depdiknas-KamusBahasaIndonesia.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memperbaiki)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: baik 是“好”；membaik 可理解为“变好”。在马来西亚记牢完整搭档 membaik pulih：“修好，再恢复功能”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根首音 s 在 meN- 后脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/。root_word 按资料包保留；实际构词词根为 sasar，本词不是根词。

senses.zh_definition: 把行动、注意力、宣传等指向某个对象；以某人、某群体或某物为目标。
senses.en_definition: To direct something towards a target or select someone or something as its target.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalakan atau menujukan sesuatu kepada sasaran tertentu.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，可用于实际瞄准，也可用于广告、援助或政策的对象选择。表示服务对象时通常中性，不必含有攻击意味。义项依据：[DBP：menyasarkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menyasarkan)。

collocations.ms: menyasarkan bantuan kepada keluarga berpendapatan rendah
collocations.zh: 向低收入家庭定向提供援助
collocations.en: to direct assistance towards low-income families

senses.zh_definition: 设定计划达到的成果、数量、水平或完成期限。
senses.en_definition: To set an intended result, quantity, level, or completion date as a goal.
senses.ms_definition: Menetapkan hasil, jumlah, tahap atau tempoh tertentu sebagai matlamat yang hendak dicapai.
senses.nuances: 常见于业务汇报、政策规划与体育新闻。表示目标或意向，不表示已经实现，也不等同于保证必定实现。

collocations.zh: 设定提高销售额的目标
以百分之五的增长为目标

collocations.zh: 以夺得十枚金牌为目标
collocations.en: to aim for ten gold medals

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Syarikat menyasarkan peningkatan jualan sebanyak sepuluh peratus pada tahun hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 公司将明年的销售增长目标设定为百分之十。
dual_scenarios.en: The company is targeting a ten per cent increase in sales next year.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kita menyasarkan seratus peserta je dulu, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita menyasarkan seratus orang peserta sahaja untuk peringkat awal, bukan?

dual_scenarios.en: We're aiming for just a hundred participants to start with, right?

kan 用于寻求对方确认。
dulu 在这里表示先完成当前阶段的目标。
menyasarkan 带有工作或策划语气，也可自然出现在同事聊天中。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kita menyasarkan seratus peserta je dulu, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Kita menyasarkan seratus orang peserta sahaja untuk peringkat awal, bukan?
messages.zh: 咱们先把目标定在一百人，对吧？

messages.en: Yes, seventy people have signed up already. We just need thirty more.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 语体中性偏正式，适合汇报、提案与新闻。说明团队目标时用 kami menyasarkan 或 kita menyasarkan，有助于明确责任主体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈营销受众、援助对象或业绩目标时自然。谈特定个人时，menyasarkan seseorang 可能被理解为针对或攻击某人，应交代行动目的。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 语体中性偏正式，适合汇报、提案与新闻。说明团队目标时用 kami menyasarkan 或 kita menyasarkan，有助于明确责任主体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈营销受众、援助对象或业绩目标时自然。谈特定个人时，menyasarkan seseorang 可能被理解为针对或攻击某人，应交代行动目的。

etymology.historical_story: Menyasarkan is transparently formed from sasar with the Malay verbal construction meN-...-kan. Its dictionary senses connect directing something towards a target with setting a desired result. This shared target image makes the word useful in advertising, sports and business planning. The connection explains its present meanings without requiring an unsupported story about its earliest historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sasar 和 sasaran（目标）一起记：menyasarkan 就是把箭头指向目标，或把目标数字定下来；s 遇 meN- 后变成 ny。

morphology.formula: mengunci + -nya → menguncinya；内部构词：meN- + kunci → mengunci
morphology.pattern_note: kunci 的首音 k 在 meN- 后脱落，形成 mengunci；-nya 是附着代词，不是派生后缀，此处归入 suffix。资料包 Jawi مڠونچي 仅对应 mengunci；含 -nya 的完整形式为 مڠونچيڽ。

word_family.gloss: 处于锁住状态；意外被锁住

senses.zh_definition: 把前文所指的门、箱子或其他物件锁上、扣住或闩好。
senses.en_definition: To lock, latch, or bolt the previously mentioned object.
senses.ms_definition: Menutup atau mengancing benda yang telah disebut dengan kunci, selak atau alat pengancing.
senses.nuances: -nya 在这里充当宾语，通常对应“它”，必须能从上下文识别所指对象。没有前文时，mengunci pintu 等明确表达更清楚。义项依据：[DBP：mengunci](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mengunci)。

collocations.en: to lock it from the inside
to secure it with a padlock

senses.zh_definition: 以某段话或某项内容结束前文所指的演讲、讨论或文章。
senses.en_definition: To bring the previously mentioned speech, discussion, or text to a close.
senses.ms_definition: Mengakhiri atau menyudahi ucapan, perbincangan atau tulisan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，较常见于书面语。-nya 指前述演讲等整体；mengakhirinya 或 menutupnya 在一般表达中更直接。

collocations.en: to conclude it with words of advice
to conclude it with a summary

senses.zh_definition: 将前文所指的嘴唇或嘴闭紧；引申为保持沉默、不肯开口。
senses.en_definition: To keep the previously mentioned lips or mouth firmly closed; figuratively, to remain silent.
senses.ms_definition: Mengatupkan bibir atau mulut yang dirujuk; secara kiasan, tidak mahu berkata-kata atau mendiamkan diri.
senses.nuances: 继承 mengunci 的闭口义，但孤立的 menguncinya 通常先被理解为“把它锁上”。以下列出常规搭配；只有嘴或嘴唇已成为明确宾语时，才适合以 -nya 回指。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Selepas menutup pintu bilik rekod, pegawai bertugas menguncinya sebelum meninggalkan pejabat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 值班人员关上档案室的门后，将门锁好才离开办公室。
dual_scenarios.en: After closing the records room door, the officer on duty locked it before leaving the office.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pintu stor tu aku dah tutup. Aku nak menguncinya sekarang.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah menutup pintu stor itu. Saya hendak menguncinya sekarang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 储藏室的门我关好了，现在就把它锁上。
dual_scenarios.en: I've closed the storeroom door. I'm going to lock it now.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。

etymology.historical_story: Menguncinya combines the familiar noun kunci with Malay verbal morphology and the attached pronoun -nya. The dictionary also records closing a speech and closing one's lips as meanings of mengunci. These uses make the lock a useful image for bringing activity to an end. The pronoun contributes a reference to something already mentioned, rather than a new dictionary meaning.

etymology.historical_story: Memaparkan is a Malay derivation of papar, with the initial p replaced through nasal substitution after meN-. Its documented meanings encompass presenting stories and displaying screen information. This makes it useful across print, broadcasting and computing. The dictionary separately records a flattening sense; that separation does not establish a historical path between the meanings. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=papar).

etymology.historical_story: Malay gelar connects naming with social recognition: a person may receive an honorific or acquire a nickname associated with character or circumstance. etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect ganggu with a range of experiences, from an unwanted interruption to the disruption of public peace. The form mengganggunya packages an action and its object into one written word. Its final -nya can refer to a person or a thing, so context determines whether English needs him, her or it. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=Ganggu)

senses.zh_definition: 给前文提到的马等动物套上用于驾驭的笼头或缰具。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks kendali as Javanese and gives its concrete meaning as a bridle or reins. That physical image provides a useful bridge to the dictionary's abstract senses of restraint and management. Mengendalikan can therefore describe directing an organization or operating equipment, while -nya identifies an object already introduced in the conversation. [PRPM: kendali](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kendali)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kendali 想成手里的缰绳：拉住缰绳就是控制；掌握机器就是操作；接 -nya，就是控制或操作“它”。

etymology.historical_story: Mustard is an English borrowing in Malay. The English name comes through Old French moustarde, connected with must, or unfermented grape juice, which was used in preparing the condiment. That history explains the name's association with a prepared seasoning. The Malay dictionary definition supplied here focuses specifically on mustard seeds ground into powder. [Word origin](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/mustard).

etymology.historical_story: Older Malay dictionaries record siksa alongside seksa, showing that the vowel variation predates present-day national spelling conventions. The verb adds the nasal prefix meN-, which replaces the root's initial s with ny. Modern Malaysian guidance selects seksa, making menyeksa the appropriate local teaching form rather than treating menyiksa as an unrelated root. [Historical Malay dictionary](https://deriv.nls.uk/dcn23/7945/79454630.23.pdf); [DBP spelling guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/koleksi1.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 nyiksa 与 siksa 的联系：前缀一加，s 变成 ny；意思仍围绕“使受苦”。在马来西亚写作时，把 i 换成 e：menyeksa。

etymology.historical_story: Mercedes began as a girl's name before becoming an automotive name. Emil Jellinek used his daughter Mercédès's name in racing, and an agreement with Daimler-Motoren-Gesellschaft made it a product name in 1900. The trademark was registered in 1902. The 1926 merger with Benz subsequently brought the two names together as Mercedes-Benz. [Manufacturer's brand history](https://group.mercedes-benz.com/company/tradition/mercedes-benz/120-years-mercedes-brand-name.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mercedes 的声音与车头三芒星联系起来：看到星标，想到汽车品牌。开头的 mer- 只是名字的一部分，不是马来语前缀。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为现代马来语词根整体分析；ma- 不是马来语前缀。词内 k 可读喉塞音 /ʔ/；保留阿拉伯语特点的读法可见 [maʕ.mur]。memakmurkan 中原有 m 保留。

etymology.historical_story: Makmur is an Arabic loan associated with maʿmūr, meaning inhabited or populated. Its Malay meaning centres on productive places and adequately provided lives. The Jawi spelling معمور preserves the Arabic letter ʿayn, while Malay pronunciation adapts that consonant. This makes the word a useful example of an inherited written form alongside an adapted spoken form. [University of Malaya study](https://mjs.um.edu.my/index.php/JUD/article/download/7374/5009/15771), [Hans Wehr dictionary](https://kutub.nur.nu/Arabic-Language/Hans-Wehr.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 makmur 记成“满仓、满桌、民生足”：国家富庶，百姓够用。再连记 kemakmuran＝繁荣、memakmurkan＝使繁荣。

etymology.historical_story: English marine belongs to a historical word family descending from Latin mare, meaning sea, through forms including marinus and French marin. Its meanings developed around sea life, shipping, and soldiers serving at sea. Malay uses the spelling marin. This shared history explains their resemblance without making the two spellings interchangeable. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/marine)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: marine 联想海洋，再记拼写切换：英语 marine，马来语 marin；不要把英语词尾 e 读成额外音节。

senses.zh_definition: 用拉扯的方式把纸张、布料等撕开、扯破或撕成碎片。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is morphological rather than a documented borrowing history. Malay builds mengoyakkan around koyak, the familiar idea of something being torn. The active prefix and suffix turn that damaged state into an action affecting an object. Picture an envelope opening under two pulling hands: the physical scene makes the word immediately memorable.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 koyak＝破了；加上动作框架 meN-…-kan，就想象双手把信封撕开。

etymology.historical_story: DBP places meneliti in the family of teliti, meaning careful or meticulous. Its formation illustrates a productive Malay pattern: the initial t disappears when the nasal active prefix is attached. The family connects a personal quality, teliti, with an action, meneliti, and its activity noun, penelitian. A distant historical origin is not established by the supplied evidence.

etymology.historical_story: The clearest documented story is how Malay turns syor, a recommendation, into the action mengesyorkan. Because syor has only one syllable, the active prefix takes the fuller shape menge-. In Malaysian meeting language, the resulting verb marks the moment an idea is put forward for consideration; acceptance still requires a separate decision.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: syor＝建议；用 menge-…-kan 把它变成动作：把建议提出来。

etymology.historical_story: The root suntik connects several needle-related actions recorded in Malay dictionaries: extracting thorns, engraving surfaces and administering injections. Its figurative uses extend this image to introducing ideas, money or renewed energy. This provides a useful semantic connection, although it does not establish which meaning arose first. Menyuntik itself is a regular Malay formation with the active prefix meN-.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: suntik 想成“一针注入”：药物注入身体，资金注入企业，semangat 注入团队；加 meN- 时 s 让位给 ny。

morphology.formula: menulis + -kan → menuliskan；完整构词：meN- + tulis + -kan → menuliskan
morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包保留直接词基 menulis；最终词根为 tulis。meN- 接 tulis 时，词首 t 脱落，鼻音实现为 n；在 menulis 后加 -kan 时不再发生这一变化。

senses.zh_definition: 把姓名、文字或信息写下、记下，通常写在某种载体上。

etymology.historical_story: The structure of menuliskan reveals Malay's productive way of building verbs. Its ultimate base is tulis, while menulis is the immediate base supplied in the packet. Adding -kan supports several established meanings, including recording content and writing for someone. Older dictionary senses also preserve writing with an implement and drawing, showing a wider semantic range than everyday usage suggests. See [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pensel).

senses.zh_definition: 一百万，即 1,000,000；一千个一千。
senses.en_definition: The number 1,000,000; one thousand thousands.
senses.ms_definition: Bilangan sejuta, iaitu 1,000,000 atau seribu kali seribu.
senses.nuances: 英语基数词；因指定词类选项没有 numeral，此处归入 noun。规范马来语对应 juta，one million 为 satu juta 或 sejuta。ms_definition 是马来语解释，并非 million 的 DBP 官方释义。英语在具体数目后用 million，如 two million，而非 two millions。以下 ms 搭配为马来语对应表达。参见 [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/million)。

senses.nuances: 可见于 a million times、a million things to do 等夸张表达。millions of 也可表示实际有数百万，是否夸张必须由语境判断；参见 [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/million)。

etymology.historical_story: Million entered English through French from Italian milione, historically an enlarged form of mille, meaning a thousand. Its origin evokes a great thousand, while its numerical value became one thousand thousands. English also uses it for an impressively large, unspecified quantity. Malay expresses the same exact number with juta. See [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/million).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: million = juta = 百万：1 后面六个 0。先记 one million＝satu juta，再扩展 two million＝dua juta。

senses.en_definition: An extended or regional plant name for other myrtaceous plants, periwinkle, or California laurel.
senses.ms_definition: Nama umum Inggeris yang turut digunakan untuk tumbuhan lain dalam famili Myrtaceae, periwinkle atau laurel California.

senses.nuances: 此处为专有名词，实际拼写为 Myrtle。中文音译可因人物而异；不能仅凭名字确定具体人物。参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/myrtle)。

etymology.historical_story: The English plant name travelled through French and medieval Latin from Greek myrtos. Its history also reaches beyond botany: Mediterranean traditions associated myrtle with love, and its fragrant sprigs became wedding ornaments. That cultural background helps explain why a modest evergreen appears in accounts of bridal flowers as well as in garden catalogues. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/myrtle), [Biodiversity Heritage Library](https://blog.biodiversitylibrary.org/2018/06/myrtle-the-provenance-and-meaning-of-a-plant).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“默特尔”：默默常绿，花开有香——记住香桃木。此为记忆联想，不是词源拆分。

word_family.gloss: 将词语用作隐喻；使隐喻化

senses.zh_definition: 隐喻；把词语用于其通常或字面意义以外的对象，通过类比或意义转移表达另一含义。
senses.en_definition: A metaphor: the use of a word or expression beyond its literal meaning to describe something through an implied comparison.
senses.ms_definition: Pemakaian kata-kata yang menyatakan sesuatu makna atau maksud yang lain daripada makna biasa atau makna sebenar perkataan yang berkenaan, sebagai perbandingan atau kiasan.
senses.nuances: 常见于文学、修辞和语言学。隐喻通常直接进行意义映射，例如 ilmu ialah cahaya；带 seperti 或 bagai 明示比较的结构通常分析为明喻或 simile。metafora 不等同于所有修辞手法，也不必然具有讽刺或夸张意味。音节及释义见 [DBP PRPM：metafora](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=metafora)。

etymology.historical_story: Metafora berakar pada istilah Yunani metaphora yang membawa gagasan pemindahan atau membawa sesuatu merentasi batas. Dalam bahasa, yang dipindahkan ialah makna: cahaya boleh menerangkan ilmu kerana kedua-duanya dikaitkan dengan kejelasan. Sejarah istilah ini membantu pembaca melihat bahawa metafora membina hubungan antara bidang pengalaman, bukan sekadar menghias ayat. [Rujukan etimologi: metaphor](https://www.etymonline.com/word/metaphor).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 metafora 想成“意义搬家”：cahaya 原指光，搬到 ilmu 身上，就成为“知识是光”的隐喻。

etymology.historical_story: Merancangkan illustrates a useful distinction between a possible Malay formation and the form speakers normally choose. It belongs to the rancang family, alongside rancangan and perancangan. DBP's language advisory accepts merancangkan while noting its uncommon usage. Its interest lies in productive Malay word formation, rather than an independently documented borrowing or a separate historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record langgar in contexts ranging from physical impact to attacks and disobedience. These meanings share a useful image: something meets resistance or crosses a boundary. Melanggarnya combines the active verb with an attached third-person object pronoun. This explains its present structure without claiming an undocumented ancient origin.

etymology.historical_story: The word belongs to the tukar family, which connects everyday replacement with exchange and transformation. Malay expressions such as tukar barang describe barter, while tukar cincin evokes the exchange of engagement rings. Menukarkan extends this shared idea to changing equipment, converting forms, and transferring staff. These connections illustrate its cultural range without establishing a particular ancient borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 tukar＝“换”：meN- 把 t 换成 n，再接 -kan，得到 menukarkan；想象把旧物换成新物。

morphology.formula: menemui + -ku → menemuiku；完整构词：meN- + temu + -i + -ku → menemuiku
morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着代词形式，此处作宾语“我”，并非派生后缀；suffix 是本结构中的位置分类。基础词 menemui 中，temu 的 t 在 meN- 后脱落。输入 Jawi منموءي 只对应 menemui，缺少 -ku；完整词形应补写为 منموءيکو。输入未提供音节划分，故保留 null；可分析为 me.ne.mu.i.ku。

etymology.historical_story: Menemuiku is a grammatical combination rather than a separate historical root. Its base belongs to the temu family, which also gives Malay bertemu and pertemuan. Adding the shortened pronoun aku turns a general act of meeting into an encounter with the speaker. The compact form suits personal narration, where relationships and remembered meetings often occupy the foreground.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: menemui＝“见到”，尾巴 -ku＝“我”：把“我”接在见面的终点，menemuiku 就是“见我”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接 setuju 时，词首 s 脱落并发生鼻音替代，形成 meny-。直接构词基础是 setuju，输入包将整个派生词标为词根有误；setuju 还可进一步联系 se- + tuju。

etymology.historical_story: The base setuju connects agreement with sharing a direction or purpose. Tuju supplies the image of an aim, while se- suggests commonality. Menyetujui then turns that shared position into an action directed at a proposal or request. This is a transparent word-family connection, rather than evidence for a particular date or borrowing event.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: setuju 是“同意”，menyetujui 是“同意某件事”；看见 meny-，把脱落的 s 补回去，就找到 setuju。

etymology.historical_story: Simpul names a knot, giving this word family a concrete centre. Menyimpulkan can literally secure a rope, while its abstract senses gather discussion or feeling into a compact expression. Picture loose strands brought together. This image explains the semantic connection as a mnemonic; it does not establish when the figurative meanings first developed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: simpul 是“结”：把绳头收成一个结，把讨论收成几个要点；menyimpulkan 就是“打结”或“归纳”。

etymology.historical_story: In 1852, John Crawfurd recorded marta in his Malay dictionary with meanings relating to being alive and to life itself. He marked it as Sanskrit-derived. This provides a historical record, but does not by itself establish the precise borrowing route or modern Malaysian usage. The entry is therefore treated here as historical vocabulary. Source: [Crawfurd, page 114](https://deriv.nls.uk/dcn23/7945/79454630.23.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mar-ta 配上两下心跳“扑通、扑通”，联想到“活着、生命”。这是助记联想，不是词源解释。

word_family.gloss: 使掉落、删除或终止妊娠的行为

senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan sesuatu jatuh atau luruh dari tempatnya.

etymology.historical_story: The root gugur centres on falling or becoming detached. Its derived verb menggugurkan connects that physical image with deliberate removal: something is made to fall, a player leaves a squad, or a word disappears from a sentence. This is a useful semantic connection, not a dated account of how each meaning developed. The dictionary also records pregnancy termination and abandoning a claim. [PRPM: gugur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=gugur).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gugur＝掉落；加上 meN- 和 -kan，就是“使其掉下或退出”：叶子掉、名单删、诉求撤。

etymology.historical_story: The Malay base hidup means alive or living. Productive Malay word formation gives menghidupkan the sense of causing life or activity, while attached -nya supplies a previously mentioned object. The same expression can therefore describe reviving a plant, starting an engine or animating a scene. This is a grammatical relationship, not a claim about which figurative sense developed first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hidup＝活；menghidupkan＝让它活起来；再接 -nya＝让前面提到的它活起来。机器“活起来”就是启动，气氛“活起来”就是热闹。

morphology.pattern_note: 在 c 前，meN- 变为 men-，词根 c 保留；词根末尾 a 与后缀 i 分属音节，可读出轻微喉塞音。词头分音保留数据包形式；数据包的整词词根分析已纠正。

etymology.historical_story: Mencurigai is transparently formed from curiga with meN- and -i. DBP records a family that distinguishes feeling suspicion, suspecting an object and causing suspicion. That distinction makes the morphology useful in everyday interpretation: the person who mencurigai feels distrust, while something mencurigakan prompts it. The cited dictionary does not establish a deeper borrowing history for this sense. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kecurigaan)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 curiga 记成“心里起疑”：mencurigai 是“我怀疑谁”，mencurigakan 是“谁让我起疑”。

senses.en_definition: To tarnish a reputation, dishonour someone or something, or impair its integrity.

etymology.historical_story: Cemar supplies a shared image for physical dirt and damaged reputation. Mencemarkan adds a causative construction: making an object cemar. DBP records both environmental pollution and the tarnishing of a name within this family. The connection offers a cultural image of reputation as something that can be stained, although the dictionary does not establish which meaning arose first. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=cemar)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cemar 是“脏了”，mencemarkan 是“把它弄脏”：河水被污染，名声被玷污，都套用同一幅画面。

etymology.historical_story: The jangkit family presents transmission through several grammatical viewpoints: berjangkit describes spreading, menjangkiti identifies the affected recipient, and menjangkitkan presents what is transmitted. Kamus Dewan also records moral influence spreading between people. This movement between illness and social behaviour makes the family culturally expressive, although it does not establish when either usage first appeared.

etymology.historical_story: Meenamma appears as a personal name in a 1957 Ceylon government gazette, providing a historical anchor for this spelling. It also occurs as a Tamil song title in Raaga’s catalogue. These records document its circulation in names and cultural works; the available evidence leaves its precise etymology and any adoption into Malay unresolved. Sources: [Government Gazette](https://diglib.natlib.lk/bitstream/handle/123456789/36553/046_CEYLON%20GOVERNMENT%20GAZETTE_1957-JULY-AUGUST_11157_I_SEC_I_16-08-1957_E.pdf?isAllowed=y&sequence=3), [Raaga catalogue](https://www.raaga.com/tamil/songs/meenamma-249199).

etymology.historical_story: Memutuskannya shows how Malay builds a complex expression around putus, meaning broken or ended. The derived verb memutuskan covers physical separation, termination, and decision, while -nya supplies a previously mentioned object. A useful conceptual bridge is closure: a connection ends, or an unsettled matter receives a conclusion. This is a semantic explanation, not a documented chronology of those meanings. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memutuskan+1)

etymology.historical_story: The English food name macon blends mutton and bacon. It names a familiar preparation applied to a different meat: sheep meat cured and smoked in the style of bacon. Modern producers also use the term for lamb products, while some commercial uses extend to beef. This history explains the food name, but does not establish an official Malay borrowing. [Source](https://www.foodmanufacture.co.uk/Article/2020/05/01/Asda-to-stock-lamb-macon-product/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 食品义可联想 mutton（羊肉）＋ bacon（培根）→ macon：把羊肉做成培根的样子。此法帮助记义，不用于推定马来语标准发音。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies English as the source language of muzik. Malay incorporates the borrowed noun into its own grammatical system: pemuzik names a musician, while muziknya attaches the native element -nya to express possession or reference. The form illustrates how an international arts vocabulary becomes ordinary Malay through familiar patterns of word formation.

senses.zh_definition: 用力猛扯、强行拉走或抢走某物，尤其指突然夺走别人佩戴或携带的财物。
senses.en_definition: To pull or snatch something away forcibly, especially an item someone is wearing or carrying.
senses.ms_definition: Menarik, menyentak atau mencabut sesuatu dengan paksa atau dengan kekuatan.
senses.nuances: 突出突然、有力的拉扯动作；用于财物时常涉及抢夺，但本义不限于犯罪。普通拿取用 mengambil。释义依据 [DBP PRPM：ragut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ragut)。

senses.zh_definition: 牛、羊等动物啃食生长中的青草或嫩叶。
senses.en_definition: To graze on growing grass or browse on leaves and shoots.
senses.ms_definition: Memakan rumput yang masih hidup atau tumbuh-tumbuhan seumpamanya, berkenaan haiwan seperti lembu dan kambing.
senses.nuances: 描述动物就地啃食植物，不是吃任何食物的通用动词。也可用于长颈鹿啃食树叶或嫩梢，参见 [DBP PRPM：meragut 的用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=meragut)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻突然或强行夺去生命、幸福等，使人蒙受重大丧失。
senses.en_definition: To take away life, happiness or something valued suddenly or forcibly.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, merampas sesuatu sehingga menyebabkan kehilangan; meragut nyawa bermaksud menyebabkan kematian secara tiba-tiba.
senses.nuances: meragut nyawa 是新闻中常见的沉痛表达，主语可为事故、灾难或疾病；本身不表示蓄意杀人。其他抽象宾语多带文学色彩。参见 [DBP PRPM：ragut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ragut)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place meragut under ragut and record both forceful pulling and animals feeding on growing plants. These meanings offer a useful shared image: something is pulled away from where it is attached. Figurative meragut nyawa presents death as life being abruptly taken away. This is a semantic connection, not a claim about which meaning arose first. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ragut)

The surname's deeper origin is not asserted here. [Attested usage](https://www.sinarharian.com.my/article/642210/berita/sukan/morales-buru-cabaran-baharu).

etymology.historical_story: Menghentam is formed from hentam with the productive Malay prefix meN-. Its dictionary senses connect a forceful physical blow with a forceful verbal attack. That connection offers a useful cultural image: criticism can land like a blow. This explains the modern metaphor without claiming an undocumented ancient origin for the root. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menghentam).

senses.ms_definition: Menganggap sesuatu ringan, mudah atau tidak penting.
senses.nuances: 这里指态度上的轻忽，不是实际改善问题；常见于否定或劝诫，也可用重叠形式 meringan-ringankan。参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=meringankan)。

etymology.historical_story: Meringankan grows transparently from ringan, meaning light, through Malay affixation. Its meanings make weight a model for experience: work, hardship, and punishment can become lighter. The same image also warns against treating serious matters too lightly. In meringankan kaki, lightness becomes a courteous image for making the effort to visit. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=ringan).

etymology.historical_story: The root hirup connects two familiar experiences: drawing a drink into the mouth and drawing air into the body. Malay dictionaries preserve both uses, while hirupan names a sip or an intake. This shared inward movement explains why coffee drinking and enjoying fresh air can use the same verb. [DBP: hirup](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hirup)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hirup 的 hi 想成轻轻吸气的声音：咖啡吸入口，空气吸进胸，都是 menghirup。此为联想，并非词源。

etymology.historical_story: Merajuk is formed from rajuk, a root that also produces perajuk, someone inclined to sulk. Malay expressions place rajuk within relationships where affection and disappointment meet. The proverb merajuk pada yang kasih links it with a loving relationship, while DBP explains the proverb as advising people to keep their wishes within what is possible. [DBP: rajuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=rajuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 me-ra-juk 想成“闷着脸、绕开你”：心里不高兴，暂时不理人。声音联想仅供记忆，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Meronda shows Malay word formation at work: the prefix meN- appears as me- before ronda. Its vocabulary extends beyond police and military settings into neighborhood security. Malaysian reporting on Skim Rondaan Sukarela uses meronda for community patrol work, connecting the dictionary meaning of maintaining safety with organized participation by local residents. [RTM report](https://berita.rtm.gov.my/nasional/senarai-berita-nasional/senarai-artikel/anggota-srs-bakal-guna-aplikasi-khas-ketika-meronda/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ronda 联想“绕一圈巡查”，加 me- 变成 meronda：正在执行巡逻动作。

morphology.formula: mengikuti + -ku → mengikutiku；底层构词：meN- + ikut + -i → mengikuti
morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着形式，此处作宾语“我”，不是派生后缀；affix_type 的 suffix 仅表示其后接位置。词根实际为 ikut，root_word 按输入保留直接基底 mengikuti。meN- 在元音 i 前实现为 meng-。建议音节划分为 me.ngi.ku.ti.ku；syllables 按输入保留 null。输入 Jawi مڠيکوتي 仅对应 mengikuti，缺少 -ku，不能视为完整词形的已核实拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 跟在我后面；随我同行；在特定语境下指跟踪我。

senses.ms_definition: Bergerak di belakang aku atau pergi bersama-sama aku; dalam konteks tertentu, mengekori aku.
senses.nuances: 这是 mengikuti 加宾语 -ku 的组合，不是独立词根。是否含“跟踪”之意取决于语境。以下马来语定义为依据词典义项编写的释义，并非 DBP 原文。[DBP：mengikuti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=mengikuti)；[DBP：ku 的连写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kuharapkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 以我为榜样，效仿我的做法或追随我的行动。

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan aku sebagai contoh dengan meniru tindakan atau cara yang aku lakukan.
senses.nuances: 强调“效仿我”时应有明确上下文；若直接宾语是规章或指令，通常应另用 mengikut peraturan 或 mematuhi arahan，不能把所有“遵从”义都套入本词。[DBP：mengikuti 的效仿义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=mengikuti)。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay's productive word-building rather than a separate borrowing. The base ikut develops into mengikuti, and the shortened pronoun ku attaches as its object. DBP documents this joining of shortened pronouns to neighbouring words. The compact ending gives narrative prose a personal voice: the person being followed is the speaker.

etymology.historical_story: Mahavir is a form associated with Sanskrit Mahāvīra, meaning “great hero.” In Jain tradition, the title honors a spiritual teacher whose courage concerned endurance, self-discipline, and freedom from attachment. etymology.historical_story: Maupun combines recognizable mau and pun elements but functions as a fixed conjunction. Indonesian spelling guidance lists it among fused forms, while Malay guidance lists mahupun. This regional contrast helps explain why closely related texts can express the same inclusive pairing with different spellings. See [Indonesian guidance](https://ejaan.kemendikdasmen.go.id/eyd/penulisan-kata/partikel/) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sekalipun).

senses.nuances: 常见于叙事、摄影与纪念活动；momen indah 指美好的时刻，不表示固定长度的时间单位。日常也可按语境用 saat、detik 或 ketika。[DBP：momen](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=momen)

senses.zh_definition: 【物理】力矩；力使物体绕某点或某轴转动的作用量。
senses.en_definition: The turning effect of a force about a point or axis.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran kecenderungan daya untuk menghasilkan gerakan berputar pada sesuatu jasad.
senses.nuances: 这是专业义，须结合具体术语理解。momen daya 是力矩；momen inersia 是转动惯量，两者为不同物理量。[DBP：momen](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=momen)

senses.zh_definition: 【统计】矩；用于描述分布特征的量，通常由随机变量的幂或其相对于某中心的偏差的幂的期望值定义。
senses.en_definition: An expected power of a random variable or of its deviation from a specified value, used to characterize a distribution.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam statistik, nilai jangkaan bagi kuasa pemboleh ubah rawak atau kuasa sisihannya daripada suatu nilai rujukan, untuk menghuraikan ciri taburan.
senses.nuances: 此处的马来语释义为术语解释性编写，并非 DBP 原文。统计学中的 momen pusat 与 momen mentah 分别对应中心矩和原点矩。[马来亚大学数学与统计术语表](https://ism.um.edu.my/Image/Research/Links/MATHEMATICAL%20%26%20STATISTICAL%20TERMS/bm_to_english.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Malay momen belongs to an international vocabulary associated with English moment. Its dictionary record brings together an everyday instant and a technical turning effect, while mathematical terminology also uses it for statistical moments. These meanings provide a memorable bridge between lived experience and measurement. The consulted evidence does not establish its precise borrowing route into Malay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 momen 联想到英语 moment：相机咔嚓一下，留下一个 momen。注意末音节读 /men/。

word_family.gloss: 航海者；浏览器；上网浏览者

senses.en_definition: To sail or travel by vessel across or along a body of water.
senses.ms_definition: Belayar di laut atau sungai dengan kapal atau perahu; mengharungi.
senses.nuances: 及物用法，通常直接接水域宾语，如 melayari laut。belayar 则常独立使用，或接 ke、di 等介词短语。现代用法不要求船只实际使用风帆。[DBP：melayari](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=melayari)

etymology.historical_story: Melayari is formed from layar, a sail, with verbal affixes. Its maritime meaning reflects travel through seas and rivers. The same verb now describes moving through information online, turning the Internet into a navigable space. DBP explicitly discusses this extension from sea travel to Internet use as an example of semantic change. [DBP：Perubahan Makna](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/07/14/14350/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: layar 是“帆”：船在海上 melayari，人也能在信息海洋里 melayari Internet。

word_family.gloss: 映照；镜像复制；屏幕镜像

senses.zh_definition: 通过反射形成物体影像的镜子或镜面。
senses.en_definition: A reflective surface that forms an image of objects before it.
senses.ms_definition: Cermin atau permukaan pemantul yang menghasilkan bayangan objek di hadapannya.
senses.nuances: 英语名词；标准马来语对应 cermin。mirror 出现在马来语对话中属于语码混用，side mirror 等英语组合尤其容易出现在汽车话题中。[DBP：mirror 的马来语对应词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=cermin)

senses.zh_definition: 能够真实反映某种社会状况、思想或特征的事物。
senses.en_definition: Something that faithfully represents a condition, character, or society.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menggambarkan keadaan, sifat atau kehidupan masyarakat.
senses.nuances: 英语比喻义；正式马来语通常用 cermin 或 cerminan。不能把它理解为实际的玻璃镜子。[Merriam-Webster：mirror](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mirror)

senses.zh_definition: 映照出某物；引申为反映某种状况，或与另一事物十分相似。
senses.en_definition: To reflect something or closely reproduce its characteristics.
senses.ms_definition: Memantulkan bayangan sesuatu atau mencerminkan keadaan dan cirinya.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词义。正式马来语中，实际光学反射可用 memantulkan，抽象反映常用 mencerminkan，相似则可用 menyerupai。[Merriam-Webster：mirror](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mirror)

senses.zh_definition: 在另一屏幕上显示相同画面，或在另一存储位置复制并维持相同的数据内容。
senses.en_definition: To reproduce a screen display or maintain a matching copy of data elsewhere.
senses.ms_definition: Memaparkan kandungan skrin yang sama pada peranti lain atau menghasilkan salinan data yang sepadan.
senses.nuances: 计算机语境中的英语延伸义；马来语口语可说 mirror skrin。屏幕镜像强调显示相同画面，数据镜像强调对应副本；两者均须结合具体系统理解。此义由英语的映照、复制概念延伸。[Merriam-Webster：mirror 的基本动词义](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mirror)

etymology.historical_story: English mirror came through Anglo-French from a verb meaning to look at, ultimately connected with Latin mirari, to wonder at. Its history links looking with admiration. The reflective object later supplied a verb for reflecting or resembling something. Standard Malay uses cermin for the object and mencerminkan for many figurative uses. [Sources: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mirror), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=cermin).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两块屏幕像镜子一样显示同一张脸：mirror 先记“镜子”，再联想“映照、复制”；马来语实物名称是 cermin。

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan benda yang telah disebut itu meletup atau meledak.
senses.nuances: meletupkan 表示使某物爆炸，meletup 表示某物自行或受作用后爆炸；-nya 回指已知对象，不表示施事者的性别，也不自带过去时。输入所引古典例句涉及击发 istinggar，即旧式火枪；现代常见对象为炸药、爆竹或气球。释义据输入所附 Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat 条目转述。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Dewan entry illustrates meletupkan with an istinggar, an old firearm, placing the verb in a literary world of gunfire. Its modern uses also include explosives and bursting balloons. Adding -nya packages an already mentioned object into the verb, showing how Malay combines a causative meaning with compact reference to earlier discourse.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 letup，想象一声“砰”；-kan 表示让它发生，-nya 指“它”：meletupkannya＝让它砰地爆开。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的直接基底 bandingkan；meN- 在 b 前实现为 mem-，原有 b 保留，形成 memb-。完整构词可分析为 meN- + banding + -kan；词汇根为 banding。

senses.zh_definition: 比较两个或多个对象，考察或指出它们之间的相同点和不同点。
senses.en_definition: To examine or show the similarities and differences between two or more things.
senses.ms_definition: Meneliti atau menunjukkan persamaan serta perbezaan antara dua perkara atau lebih.
senses.nuances: 常用结构为 membandingkan A dengan B，也可直接接复数宾语，如 membandingkan harga。比较不必包含优劣判断；若强调评估价值或表现，应交代比较标准。释义据输入所附 Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat 条目转述。

etymology.historical_story: Membandingkan illustrates Malay's productive word formation rather than an independently borrowed technical term. The lexical base banding supports a family that includes berbanding and perbandingan. Dewan's literary example compares Malay and European literature, demonstrating that the same verb used for everyday price checks also serves scholarly discussion of similarities and differences across cultural traditions.

etymology.historical_story: Minnesota preserves a Dakota place name associated with water reflecting the sky. The name was first applied to the Minnesota River and later became the state's name. Its Indigenous linguistic history remains visible in Mni Sóta Makoce on the state seal. Malay adopts the geographical name as a whole, without adding a native derivational pattern. See [Minnesota Secretary of State: State Seal](https://www.sos.mn.gov/about-minnesota/state-symbols/state-seal).

etymology.historical_story: Membiak belongs to the Malay word family built on biak, associated with becoming numerous. Its formation remains transparent: meN- takes the form mem- before b, producing membiak. The same family supplies membiakkan for causing reproduction and pembiakan for the process itself. This connects familiar observations of breeding animals with the language of biology. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=biak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 biak＝繁殖：生物自己繁殖用 membiak，让它繁殖用 membiakkan。

etymology.historical_story: Mesingan is recorded as a borrowing of English machine gun, with the two-word expression adapted into one Malay word. Its shape preserves a useful echo of the source expression. DBP also gives senapang mesin as an equivalent. The ending gan belongs to the borrowed word, rather than functioning as a Malay suffix. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mesingan)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是附着于名词后的代词性附着语，表示“他／她／它的”或指回已知对象，并非派生新词的后缀；nya 读 /ɲa/，词根不变。音节依据完整词形补足。输入包的 Jawi معلومت 仅写出词根，已按要求保留；包含 -nya 的完整词形为 معلومتڽ。

word_family.gloss: 掌握资料的；有信息依据的

senses.zh_definition: 他／她／它的资料或信息；有关前文所指的人、事物或事项的具体内容。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its information or details; the information concerning a previously identified person, thing, or matter.
senses.ms_definition: Keterangan atau butir-butir yang berkaitan dengan seseorang, sesuatu perkara atau sesuatu benda yang telah disebut atau diketahui.
senses.nuances: -nya 的指代由上下文决定，不标示性别。maklumatnya 可以是“他提供的信息”，也可以是“关于它的资料”，不能机械译成“他的”。口语中它还可使资料成为双方已知的话题，如 Maklumatnya ada di laman web。英语 information 通常为不可数名词。

collocations.en: update his, her, or its details

senses.zh_definition: 有关某事的通知、告知内容或公告信息，具体所指由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: The notification or announcement concerning an identified matter.
senses.ms_definition: Pemberitahuan atau pengumuman tentang sesuatu perkara yang telah dirujuk dalam konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是词根 maklumat 的“告知；公告”义在附着 -nya 后的用法。现代行政文书中，明确表示“通知”时常用 makluman 或 pemberitahuan；maklumatnya 更多时候仍理解为“相关信息”。词根的“知识；知悉”义也依语境解释，不能将 -nya 当作新的词义来源。

etymology.historical_story: Maklumat reflects Arabic maʿlūmāt, associated with information and things known. Malay treats the borrowed form as an ordinary information noun rather than requiring Arabic plural grammar. Adding the Malay enclitic -nya anchors that information to a person or previously mentioned subject, illustrating how a borrowed vocabulary item works within local grammar. Compare [IIUM's Arabic vocabulary list](https://irep.iium.edu.my/87697/1/buku%20kalimah%20syaiah%201.6.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 maklumat＝资料，再把 -nya 当作指回前文的小箭头：maklumatnya＝那个人／那件事的资料。

senses.zh_definition: 向某人给予或提出给予金钱、利益等，以不正当地影响其行为或决定；行贿。
senses.en_definition: To give or offer someone money or another benefit to influence their conduct improperly; to bribe.
senses.ms_definition: Memberi atau menawarkan wang, hadiah atau manfaat kepada seseorang untuk mempengaruhi tindakan atau keputusannya secara tidak wajar.
senses.nuances: 重点是给予或提出利益的一方；“受贿”通常说 menerima rasuah。输入的 DBP 释义列出的是 rasuah、merasuahi 和 perasuah，不能据此声称它直接收录了 merasuah；merasuah 本身可见于马来西亚官方用例。本释义为编者综合表述。[DBP：rasuah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=Rasuah)；[马来西亚皇家警察用例](https://www.rmp.gov.my/arkib-berita/kejayaan/2014/06/13/polis-tahan-orang-tengah-cuba-rasuah-rm20-000-untuk-bebaska)

etymology.historical_story: The root rasuah comes from Arabic vocabulary for bribery, commonly identified as risywah or rasywah. Malay adds the productive verbal prefix meN-, realized as me- before r. Malaysian discussions also use expressions such as duit kopi and wang pelincir, illustrating how indirect language can disguise the same improper exchange. [IKIM：Rasuah Menguji Keimanan](https://www.ikim.gov.my/en/rasuah-menguji-keimanan/)

etymology.historical_story: Mencukur combines the Malay verbal prefix meN- with cukur, the base associated with shaving. The supplied dictionary also records a striking sporting extension: a team can mencukur its opponent by winning overwhelmingly. The imagery links removing hair closely with leaving the opposition thoroughly beaten; this is a semantic interpretation, rather than a documented account of the expression's invention.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cukur 是“剃”，men- 把动作带出来：mencukur。先想剃刀把胡须剃净，再联想到球场上把对手打得惨败。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按资料包保留直接基础形式 menembak；更底层词根是 tembak。meN- 在 t 前成为 men-，起首 t 脱落。-mu 是附着于词后的第二人称代词，此处作宾语“你”，不是派生后缀；suffix 仅表示其后附位置。资料包所给 منيمبق 只对应 menembak，未包含 -mu，故保留原值并注明缺项。

senses.zh_definition: 向你开枪；朝你射击。
senses.en_definition: To shoot you or fire a shot at you.
senses.ms_definition: Melepaskan bedilan daripada senjata api ke arah kamu.
senses.nuances: -mu 表示射击的对象“你”，不表示动作执行者。该形式本身不标明时态，也不必然表示命中或死亡。适用于真实射击及游戏中的模拟射击。以下马来语释义按完整词形编写；DBP 收录其基础动词的开枪义。[DBP menembak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menembak)

senses.zh_definition: 以你为所指或针对的对象。

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan kamu sasaran atau orang yang dimaksudkan oleh sesuatu ujaran atau tindakan.
senses.nuances: 这是资料包所给“指向、意指”义加上宾语 -mu 后的解释，属较少见、依赖上下文的用法。下列搭配是说明结构的文学性示例，不应标为高频搭配；现代日常表达通常用 menyindir kamu 或 ditujukan kepada kamu。基础动词另有“闪电击中”的比喻义，但不能因此把完整词形默认解释为雷击。[DBP menembak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menembak)

senses.nuances: DBP 为 menembak 收录此比喻义，但带 -mu 的完整形式并非常见日常说法。下列短语用于说明语法组合，不代表已核实的高频搭配。需要清楚表达时，membohongi kamu 或 menipu kamu 更直接；不能把 menembak 的所有口语延伸义都等同于欺骗。[DBP menembak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menembak)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Watak lawan itu sudah melihat kamu; sebentar lagi dia mungkin menembak kamu!

messages.ms_spoken: Dalam sari kata tu dia cakap 'menembakmu'. Maksudnya tembak kau ke?
messages.ms_standard: Dalam sari kata itu, dia menyebut 'menembakmu'. Adakah maksudnya menembak kamu?

messages.ms_standard: Ya, -mu bermaksud kamu. Dalam percakapan tidak formal, kita biasanya menggunakan 'tembak kau'.
messages.zh: 对，-mu 就是“你”。我们平常聊天一般就说 tembak kau。
messages.en: Yes, -mu means 'you'. In casual speech, we'd usually just say 'tembak kau'.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 属于熟悉、亲近或文学性称呼，不是向陌生人或上级表达尊重的默认形式。正式说明宜根据关系使用 kamu、anda 或适当职衔。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 本词适合小说、对白、语言讲解及明确的游戏语境。现实交流中直接对人说 akan menembakmu 会被理解为开枪威胁，不能当作普通玩笑。印尼语中相关动词可有告白等口语用法，不能直接当作马来西亚通用义。

etymology.historical_story: Menembakmu is a grammatical combination rather than a separately borrowed word. Malay attaches the short pronoun -mu to menembak, making the addressee the object. The same verb can therefore sound more literary in dialogue when its object is attached. Recognising this pattern helps readers interpret compact forms without inventing a separate lexical origin for each one.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 menembak＝开枪，再把尾巴 -mu 贴上去：开枪的对象是“你”。记住“动作＋mu＝动作落到你身上”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + mission → mission；标准马来语对应形式：misi
morphology.pattern_note: mission 是英语词形，所列音标也是英语读音；不能按马来语字母逐一拼读，也不能拆出马来语词缀。标准马来语使用 misi。输入的分音节与爪夷文空值予以保留。

senses.zh_definition: 任务；个人或团队获派执行的特定工作或行动。
senses.en_definition: A particular task or operation assigned to a person or group.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu ialah misi: tugas khusus yang dipertanggungjawabkan kepada seseorang atau sesuatu kumpulan.
senses.nuances: mission 在马来语聊天中可作为英语语码转换，尤其见于游戏或工作闲聊；它不是标准马来语拼写，因此不标为 official。以下搭配采用规范对应词 misi。DBP 明确说明 mission 借入马来语后写作 misi。参见 [DBP 拼写说明](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ke%20arah%20bahasa%20melayu%202001.pdf)及 [PRPM：misi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=misi)。

senses.zh_definition: 使命；个人或组织据以行动的核心职责或宗旨。
senses.en_definition: The central purpose or responsibility of a person or organization.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu ialah misi: tugas atau tujuan utama yang menjadi tanggungjawab seseorang atau sesebuah organisasi.
senses.nuances: 组织语境常见 visi dan misi。misi 着重组织承担的使命及工作方向，visi 着重希望达到的未来图景。规范搭配使用 misi；保留 mission 通常表示英语标题或原文引用。参见 [PRPM：misi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=misi)。

senses.zh_definition: 使团；为执行特定事务而派往国外的代表团或代表机构。
senses.en_definition: A delegation or representative body sent abroad for a particular purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu ialah misi: perwakilan dari sesebuah negara ke negara lain untuk melaksanakan sesuatu tugas.
senses.nuances: 在外交或贸易文本中，具体可译为使团、代表团或代表机构；并非每次都指一次行动。以下采用标准马来语搭配。参见 [PRPM：misi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=misi)。

collocations.zh: 贸易代表团；贸易考察任务

senses.zh_definition: 基督教传教事业、传教团或传教机构。
senses.en_definition: An organized Christian missionary undertaking or establishment.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu ialah misi: usaha atau urusan penyebaran agama Kristian.
senses.nuances: 这是与宗教传播有关的特定义项，不能仅凭 mission 一词就认定文本涉及传教；须结合上下文。标准马来语采用 misi。参见 [PRPM：misi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=misi)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 游戏中的 mission 常指关卡任务，组织文本中常指使命，宗教文本中可能指传教事业。翻译时须按语境选择，避免把所有用法都译成“传教”。

etymology.historical_story: English mission ultimately comes from Latin missio, an act of sending, related to mittere, to send. That image links its religious, diplomatic and operational meanings: someone is sent to fulfil a purpose. Malay adopted the word as misi, while the original English spelling remains available in quotations and bilingual conversation. [Oxford word history](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/mission), [DBP spelling guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ke%20arah%20bahasa%20melayu%202001.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 mission，想到“被派出去完成任务”；切换到规范马来语，就写 misi。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 cermin，纠正输入将派生词自身标为词根的结果。meN- 在 c 前取 men-，c 保留，鼻音为 /n/；后接 -kan，构成及物动词。

senses.zh_definition: 反映；体现；通过言行、作品、数据或其他外在表现，呈现某种状况、情感、态度或内在特征。
senses.en_definition: To reflect, express, or represent a condition, feeling, attitude, or underlying quality.
senses.ms_definition: Membayangkan sesuatu yang lahir atau batin, seperti keadaan, pergolakan, perasaan atau sikap; menggambarkan.
senses.nuances: 通常是及物动词，直接接所反映的内容，如 mencerminkan keadaan sebenar。不能用来表示“思考某事”；该义通常用 memikirkan 或 merenungkan。日常照镜子则用 bercermin。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mencerminkan)；[DBP 词根及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=cermin)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay cermin means a mirror and also supports figurative meanings involving examples and representations. Mencerminkan extends that familiar image: behaviour, writing, or figures can show something less directly visible, just as a mirror shows an image. DBP records these related meanings together. This explains the semantic connection without claiming an unverified ancient borrowing or date of origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cermin 是“镜子”：mencerminkan 就像把情况照进镜子，让人看出背后的态度、感受或事实。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入中的 pergunakan 是中间形式分析，不能替代词根 guna。按现代构词，以 memper-…-kan 加于 guna 分析；词根 g 保留，memper- 中的 p 也保留。

senses.zh_definition: 使用；利用某物、时间或机会，使其发挥作用或带来益处。
senses.en_definition: To use something or take advantage of its practical benefits.
senses.ms_definition: Menggunakan sesuatu atau mengambil manfaat daripadanya untuk mencapai sesuatu tujuan.
senses.nuances: 此义可以中性，不必一律译为剥削。现代马来西亚一般表达使用时，更常选择 menggunakan；mempergunakan 在书面语中较显郑重。马来语释义依据 DBP 改写，例句为自拟。依据：[DBP mempergunakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempergunakan)。

senses.zh_definition: 把某人或某事当作达到特定目的的工具；尤其指为了自身利益而利用他人。
senses.en_definition: To use a person or thing as a means to an end, especially to exploit someone for personal advantage.
senses.ms_definition: Memperlakukan seseorang atau sesuatu sebagai alat untuk mencapai tujuan atau kepentingan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 以人为宾语时，常带操控、不公平利用或不顾对方利益的负面含义；具体是否构成剥削仍取决于语境。依据：[DBP mempergunakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempergunakan)。

senses.zh_definition: 使原本无用或废弃的材料产生用途；将其转为可利用的资源。
senses.en_definition: To put otherwise useless or discarded material to practical use.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan bahan yang sebelumnya tidak berguna atau terbuang dapat dimanfaatkan.
senses.nuances: 这是《Kamus Pelajar》记录的特定义项，适合废物利用和资源转化语境，不应强加于所有用例。依据：[DBP mempergunakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempergunakan)。

collocations.en: use waste as an energy source

etymology.historical_story: The base guna concerns usefulness, benefit, and function. Malay builds a productive family around it, including berguna, pengguna, and penggunaan. Mempergunakan can describe practical use, yet it also extends to treating someone as an instrument for a particular purpose. That shift explains why a word about usefulness can become a pointed criticism of how people treat one another.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 guna＝用处：物被使用，人被当工具使用。看见 mempergunakan orang，优先想到利用别人。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基底 memastikan；更深层词根是 pasti。meN- 遇词首 p 时形成 mem-，p 脱落。此处 -nya 是后附代词，不是派生后缀；affix_type 的 suffix 仅表示它附于词尾。

senses.zh_definition: 查明或核实前文所指的事情，确定其是否属实。
senses.en_definition: To ascertain or verify the matter previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Menentukan dengan pasti perkara yang telah disebut; mengesahkan kebenarannya.
senses.nuances: 侧重通过检查或证据消除疑问。-nya 的所指须由上下文提供，不能把它机械理解成固定的“他”。

senses.zh_definition: 采取必要措施，确保前文所指的要求或结果得到实现。
senses.en_definition: To make sure that a previously mentioned requirement or outcome is achieved.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil tindakan supaya perkara yang telah disebut benar-benar terlaksana atau berlaku sebagaimana yang dikehendaki.
senses.nuances: 侧重促成结果，而非单纯确认事实。常用于承担责任或作出保证；必须交代究竟要确保什么。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于核实消息、检查安排或承诺落实任务。正式文件若有多个可能的指代对象，宜重述具体事项，避免 -nya 所指不清。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates productive Malay grammar rather than a separate inherited dictionary root. Pasti supplies the idea of certainty; meN- and -kan form memastikan, and attached -nya refers back to an understood object or matter. Dictionary examples cover both checking facts and seeing that something happens. The longer form therefore depends on discourse as well as morphology.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pasti＝确定；memastikan＝把事情弄确定；再接 -nya＝核实或确保“前面说的那件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词首 r 前采用 me- 形式，r 保留；词尾 au 通常构成双元音，不拆为两个音节。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈到他人 merantau 时，常可表达对其独立谋生与适应异乡的理解；不要据此暗示对方抛弃家人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于跨州发展、异乡工作或求学，不要求跨越国界。米南加保文化是重要背景，但这个词不专属于米南加保人，也不限定男性使用。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈到他人 merantau 时，常可表达对其独立谋生与适应异乡的理解；不要据此暗示对方抛弃家人。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于跨州发展、异乡工作或求学，不要求跨越国界。米南加保文化是重要背景，但这个词不专属于米南加保人，也不限定男性使用。

etymology.historical_story: Merantau is formed from rantau, a word associated with regions and coastal stretches. Its dictionary meanings retain both travelling through distant places and leaving home to earn a living. Among the Minangkabau, a well-documented merantau tradition links mobility with trade, learning, and experience. That cultural association enriches the word without restricting its use to one community.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 rantau＝外地；加 meN- 变 merantau：人动身去外地生活、求学或谋生。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以浊双唇塞音 b 开头，meN- 变为 mem-；b 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 欺凌、霸凌他人，通常针对较弱者，以恐吓、羞辱、伤害或使对方害怕。
senses.en_definition: To bully someone, especially a weaker person, through intimidation, humiliation or harm.
senses.ms_definition: Mempermain-mainkan atau menganiaya seseorang, biasanya orang yang lemah, untuk menggertak, mencederakan atau menakutkannya.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，宾语通常是受害者；可用于身体、言语、社交排斥或网络欺凌。词义带明显贬义，不能把普通分歧或双方接受的玩笑一概称为 membuli。释义据 [DBP：buli](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=buli) 转述。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 seseorang membuli orang lain 是严肃指控。向老师或主管反映时，应清楚描述行为；尚未核实的情况可用 disyaki membuli，意为“涉嫌霸凌”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 seseorang membuli orang lain 是严肃指控。向老师或主管反映时，应清楚描述行为；尚未核实的情况可用 disyaki membuli，意为“涉嫌霸凌”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于校园、职场和网络伤害的讨论。不要用 gurau sahaja（只是开玩笑）淡化对方明确表示不舒服的欺凌行为。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record buli in contexts that include mistreating newcomers and intimidating weaker people. Adding the productive prefix meN- creates membuli, making the aggressor's action explicit. This cultural background explains why the word appears in discussions of school initiation practices, while its meaning also covers bullying beyond schools. [DBP: buli](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=buli).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 buli 与英语 bully 联想：mem- 标示主动动作，membuli 就是主动欺凌别人；这是记忆联想，不作为词源证明。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词首 j /dʒ/ 前采用书写形式 men-，j 保留，构成主动及物动词。输入包把完整派生词误标为词根；依据 DBP 的 jalin 词条更正词基及其爪夷文。

word_family.gloss: 编织、串联或建立关系的过程

senses.zh_definition: 把头发、藤条等细长材料交叉编结，形成辫子或编织物。

senses.ms_definition: Menyusun rambut, rotan atau bahan seumpamanya secara bersilang sehingga menjadi anyaman atau kepangan.
senses.nuances: 具体动作义；强调材料相互交织。不是缝纫 menjahit，也不等同于使用经纬线织布的 menenun。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menjalin)

senses.zh_definition: 把思想、观点或其他要素相互连接，使其形成关联的整体。

senses.ms_definition: Mengatur bahan penceritaan sehingga terbentuk cerita yang tersusun.
