senses.zh_definition: 建立友谊、合作或其他人际及机构关系。
senses.en_definition: To establish a friendship, partnership, or other relationship.
senses.ms_definition: Membentuk hubungan yang sebelumnya belum wujud, seperti persahabatan atau kerjasama.
senses.nuances: 关系建立义，常用于社交、商务及外交。menjalin hubungan 本身不一定指恋爱，须看对象及修饰语。

senses.zh_definition: 使已有的人际联系更加紧密，增进情谊。
senses.en_definition: To strengthen existing personal or social ties.
senses.ms_definition: Mengukuhkan hubungan yang sudah ada supaya menjadi lebih erat.
senses.nuances: 与建立关系义相邻，具体取义由语境决定。搭配 silaturahim 或 yang lebih erat 时，常突出亲善往来及关系深化。

etymology.historical_story: Menjalin is built from jalin, whose meanings include interlacing and linking. Its senses share the image of separate strands becoming connected: hair forms a braid, ideas form an argument, and people form relationships. This provides a useful account of the word's semantic unity, although the dictionary does not establish a dated sequence for these extensions. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jalin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 jalin＝交织：menjalin rambut 把头发编起来，menjalin cerita 把情节串起来，menjalin persahabatan 把人与人的友谊连起来。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以 /l/ 开头时，meN- 采用 me- 形式，保留 /l/。lambung 的“侧面”与“向上腾起”属于不同同形词义，不宜强行解释为同一意义的演变。

word_family.gloss: 把东西抛高；使升高；极力赞扬
抛掷；腾起的动作或幅度
在船侧等处安装构件；在旁边航行或移动，属“侧面”义词族

senses.zh_definition: 从侧面靠近、进攻或撞击。
senses.en_definition: To approach, attack, or strike from the side.
senses.ms_definition: Mendatangi sesuatu dari arah sisi, termasuk untuk menyerang atau melanggarnya.
senses.nuances: 这是输入数据包所对应的义项，源自 lambung 的“侧面、胁侧”义。不能把此处的动作理解为向上跳起。日常说明中，从侧面进攻通常用 menyerang dari sisi 表达得更直接。义项依据：[PRPM：melambung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=melambung)。

senses.zh_definition: 腾起、弹起或被抛向高处；也可指把东西向上抛。
senses.en_definition: To rise, bounce, or be thrown high into the air; also, to toss something upwards.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak tinggi ke atas, terpantul atau terangkat ke udara; juga membuang sesuatu ke atas.
senses.nuances: 球、船或物体可作主语。表达“把某物抛高”时，melambungkan 能更清楚地标明使动关系；melambung duit syiling 也见于抛硬币的表达。不要把所有用法都分析为及物动词。

senses.zh_definition: 价格、数值、运势或情绪等显著上升，达到很高程度。
senses.en_definition: To soar or rise sharply, especially in price, fortune, or intensity.
senses.ms_definition: Meningkat dengan ketara sehingga mencapai tahap yang tinggi, terutama tentang harga, nasib atau perasaan.
senses.nuances: 比 meningkat 更强调升幅大或水平高，常带惊讶、担忧或强烈感受。形容价格时，不能仅凭该词推断具体涨幅。

senses.zh_definition: 给予极高的赞扬或吹捧。
senses.en_definition: To praise or extol someone or something highly.
senses.ms_definition: Memuji atau menyanjung seseorang atau sesuatu dengan sangat tinggi.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》列有此比喻义。现代日常表达中，memuji、menyanjung 或 melambungkan nama 往往更直接；pujian melambung 则突出赞美程度很高。此义可表示真诚赞扬，也可能暗示过度吹捧。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性。谈物价时常带抱怨；正式报告宜补充数据，避免仅用 melambung 作情绪化判断。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 赞扬他人时，pujian melambung-lambung 可能暗示夸张或奉承。向上司或客户介绍成果时，具体说明贡献通常比极力吹捧更得体。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish lambung meaning a side or flank from lambung associated with upward movement. Melambung therefore covers both a sideways attack and a ball rising into the air. The upward image also supports figurative senses involving soaring prices and extravagant praise. These dictionary meanings should not be mistaken for proof of a single historical origin. [PRPM: melambung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=melambung).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读到末尾 bung /buŋ/，想象球“嘣”地弹高：球腾起，价格也飞涨。这只是记忆联想；“侧面进攻”须另记。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在此实现为 meng-；借词词首辅音群 /kr/ 保留，k 不脱落。输入将 mengkritik 标为词根有误，已依据 DBP 的 kritik 派生词条修正。

senses.zh_definition: 对文学、艺术等作品进行分析和评价。
senses.en_definition: To analyse and evaluate a literary or artistic work.
senses.ms_definition: Membuat analisis dan penilaian tentang karya seni, sastera dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 属于及物动词，可直接接作品作宾语。此义强调有依据的鉴赏与评价，可以兼谈优点和不足，并不必然表示责骂。释义依据：[DBP：kritik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kritik)。

senses.zh_definition: 指出或评论某人、某事的缺点、弱点或不当之处；批评。
senses.en_definition: To express criticism of the faults or weaknesses of someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Memperkatakan atau mengulas keburukan atau kelemahan sesuatu atau seseorang.
senses.nuances: 语气强度取决于修饰语；mengkritik secara membina 表示建设性批评，mengkritik keras 表示严厉批评。不能一概译为辱骂或诽谤。释义依据：[DBP：kritik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kritik)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 批评同事或长辈时，先说明具体问题，再提出建议，可用 Pada pandangan saya（依我看）缓和语气；称呼应符合双方关系。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合评论作品、政策和工作表现。公开评价个人时应避免羞辱性措辞；建设性批评应围绕可观察的行为和问题。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 批评同事或长辈时，先说明具体问题，再提出建议，可用 Pada pandangan saya（依我看）缓和语气；称呼应符合双方关系。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合评论作品、政策和工作表现。公开评价个人时应避免羞辱性措辞；建设性批评应围绕可观察的行为和问题。

etymology.historical_story: Mengkritik shows how Malay incorporates a borrowed base into its own grammatical system. Kritik retains its initial consonant cluster when the active prefix meN- is added. DBP records both the evaluation of literature and the discussion of faults, connecting the language of literary criticism with everyday disagreement. [DBP: kritik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kritik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kritik 与英语 critique 联系起来：加上 meN-，就从“评论”进入“进行评论、提出批评”的动作。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此为附着于名词的第三人称代词形式，严格说属于附着语素，而非派生后缀。mesin 的 n 保留，-nya 的 ny 表示 /ɲ/，形成 /n.ɲ/。输入 Jawi ميسين 仅对应 mesin，完整词形补为 ميسينڽ；音节字段保留输入的 null。

senses.nuances: 这是 mesin 与 -nya 的语法组合，不是另有专门含义的独立词根。-nya 不区分性别，须根据上下文确定指代对象；也不能机械地把所有英语 the machine 都译成 mesinnya。下列搭配是自然的语法组合，非固定成语。词根释义及代词用法依据：[DBP：mesin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=mesin)、[DBP：-nya 的连写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=khas+nya)。

etymology.historical_story: Mesinnya combines the equipment word mesin with the attached pronoun -nya. A historical study documents mesin bitjara, or talking machine, as a Malay name for early recording equipment in the Dutch East Indies. This illustrates the technological vocabulary surrounding mesin; the ending -nya simply supplies a contextual possessor or association. [Historical study](https://brill.com/view/journals/bki/162/2/article-p269_3.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mesin 听起来接近 machine；再接 -nya，就想到“他／她／它的那台机器”。

etymology.historical_story: Mariko is a Japanese feminine given name rather than an established Malay root in the supplied evidence. Its meaning depends on its Japanese spelling: different kanji combinations can share the reading Mariko. etymology.historical_story: Dayung names the implement, while mendayung names the action performed with it. This transparent relationship suits a maritime world in which boats connect riverbanks, settlements and islands. Malay proverbs also draw on paddling imagery to describe effort and achievement. The bicycle sense extends the motion to operating pedals, although Malaysian usage generally prefers mengayuh basikal.

etymology.historical_story: Merinduinya is built in layers rather than borrowed as a whole. Rindu supplies the feeling of longing; meN-...-i forms the verb merindui; attached -nya identifies its object. DBP illustrates merindui with family separation and memories of a mother's affection and cooking. Those examples show why the word extends naturally beyond romance to people, experiences, and familiar comforts. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=merindui).

etymology.historical_story: Menghafal is transparently formed from hafal with the active verbal prefix meN-. Malay dictionary examples connect this family with both technical names and Quranic recitation. That range makes it useful across classroom learning and religious study. The related hafaz is especially associated with retaining and reciting Quranic passages from memory. [DBP dictionary and usage guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hafal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: meng- 表示正在做这件事，hafal 表示记熟：menghafal 是“把它背进脑里”，sudah hafal 是“已经背会”。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际词根为 susur（سوسور）。meN- 接以 s 开头的本族词根时，s 脱落，前缀实现为 meny-；再接 -i。此处 circumfix 表示前后组合加缀。root_word 和 root_jawi 按词包保留词头形式。

etymology.historical_story: The base susur means an edge or margin. Its derivatives turn that boundary into a route: someone moves along a coast, pavement, or river. The dictionary also records a figurative extension, following and examining an account. This semantic bridge lets a reader move through history much as a traveller follows a shoreline. [DBP: susur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=susur).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ɲu.su.ri/ 想成“循着路线慢慢移”：脚步循着海岸走，思路循着历史走。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语混合表达中作为英语整词使用，不套用马来语词缀分析；字母 mm 不表示需要读成长辅音。

妈妈们；木乃伊的复数，须由上下文区分

senses.zh_definition: 妈咪；对母亲的亲昵称呼，尤见于儿童用语及受英语影响的家庭交流。
senses.en_definition: An affectionate, informal word for mother, especially used by children.
senses.ms_definition: Panggilan mesra dalam bahasa Inggeris untuk ibu, terutama dalam pertuturan kanak-kanak dan keluarga.
senses.nuances: 这是英语称呼，也可嵌入马来语句子。一般叙述可用 ibu，家庭口语也常用 mak；并非所有家庭都使用 mummy。直接称呼母亲时通常写 Mummy。[Cambridge：mummy](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/mummy)；[UiTM 收录的马来西亚家庭称呼实例](https://article.library.uitm.edu.my/9773/)

senses.zh_definition: 木乃伊；经处理而保存、防止腐烂的人或动物遗体。此为英语义，规范马来语称 mumia。
senses.en_definition: A human or animal body preserved against decay; the standard Malay equivalent is mumia.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, mayat manusia atau bangkai binatang yang diawet supaya tidak reput; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah mumia.
senses.nuances: 不能因英语 mummy 有此义，就把它当作马来语的规范拼写。博物馆说明、历史教材和正式报道应使用 mumia。以下搭配采用规范马来语对应词。[DBP：mumia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=mumia)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合亲密家庭交流及引用儿童原话。不要随意称陌生女性或女同事为 mummy；正式历史内容中的木乃伊应写 mumia。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 只在对方家庭惯用此称呼时自然沿用。正式介绍或谈论他人的母亲，优先使用 ibu 或对方认可的称呼。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合亲密家庭交流及引用儿童原话。不要随意称陌生女性或女同事为 mummy；正式历史内容中的木乃伊应写 mumia。

etymology.historical_story: English mummy carries two distinct meanings: an affectionate name for a mother and a preserved body. Malaysian family speech can place the affectionate English form inside a Malay sentence. Historical and museum writing instead uses Malay mumia for the preserved body. Learning the two contexts prevents a memorable but misleading confusion between family affection and ancient remains.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 家庭聊天里的 mummy 联想“妈咪”；看到埃及、古墓或博物馆，再判断是否是英语“木乃伊”，其马来语写作 mumia。

morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入包的独立词形标记；这不构成马来语词根认定。没有足够依据分析其马来语词缀、音变或原语言构词。

senses.zh_definition: 专有名词：见于泰米尔语电影《Puli》（2015）部分英文字幕中的人物称呼，对应影片发行平台所列的角色名 Marudheeran。
senses.en_definition: A character name occurring in some English subtitles of the Tamil film Puli (2015), corresponding to the character listed as Marudheeran.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan dalam sesetengah sari kata bahasa Inggeris filem Tamil Puli (2015), merujuk kepada watak yang disenaraikan sebagai Marudheeran.
senses.nuances: 未核实为正式马来语词条，不能标为 official；此处马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 引文。输入排名 11018 原样保留，其语料来源与统计口径未提供。音节、IPA 和爪夷文缺乏可靠依据，保留 null。以下搭配和例句为教学编写，未证实为高频表达。字幕中的具体形式与角色标准署名应加以区分。[字幕用例](https://www.subtitlecat.com/subs/13/Sub-Puliv2.html)；[Apple TV 角色资料](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/puli/umc.cmc.5lb5qci6otttqhe7il4n4zc6y)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 作为人物专名使用时通常写作 Marudheera。例句中的 kau 适合关系亲近的朋友；对不熟悉的人可用 awak，正式称呼则按关系选择 encik 或 puan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于讨论影片、字幕或角色。正式影视资料宜核对发行方所用的 Marudheeran；不要把该名称泛用于称呼泰米尔族人士，也不要将其解释为已获认可的马来语普通词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 作为人物专名使用时通常写作 Marudheera。例句中的 kau 适合关系亲近的朋友；对不熟悉的人可用 awak，正式称呼则按关系选择 encik 或 puan。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于讨论影片、字幕或角色。正式影视资料宜核对发行方所用的 Marudheeran；不要把该名称泛用于称呼泰米尔族人士，也不要将其解释为已获认可的马来语普通词。

etymology.historical_story: The available evidence points to cinema rather than an established Malay dictionary history. Marudheera appears as a character address in English subtitles of the 2015 Tamil fantasy film Puli, while a distributor lists the character as Marudheeran. This supports identifying a fictional name, but does not establish its literal etymology, original morphological structure, or adoption into Malay. [Subtitle evidence](https://www.subtitlecat.com/subs/13/Sub-Puliv2.html); [distributor listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/puli/umc.cmc.5lb5qci6otttqhe7il4n4zc6y).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 整词认人：Marudheera →《Puli》中的角色称呼。发音尚未核实，先用电影与人物建立记忆联系。

morphology.pattern_note: mempercayai 是输入包给出的直接基形，更深层词根为 percaya。-ku 是 aku 的附着形式，在此充当宾语，不是派生后缀；suffix 仅为本结构中的归类。mempercayai 保留 percaya 的 p。输入包的 Jawi 仅对应 mempercayai，未包含 -ku；此处原样保留。音节字段保留输入包的 null。

senses.zh_definition: 相信我所说的话，认为我的陈述或解释属实。
senses.en_definition: To believe me; to accept what I say as true.
senses.ms_definition: Menerima kata-kata atau keteranganku sebagai benar.
senses.nuances: -ku 明确指向说话者，不能把整个词释为不带宾语的“相信”。本义关注话语的真实性；马来文释义依据 mempercayai 的词典义加入第一人称宾语，并非 DBP 对此附着形式的逐字释文。参见 [DBP：percaya／mempercayai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=percaya)。

senses.zh_definition: 信任我的品格、能力或可靠性，相信我值得依靠。
senses.en_definition: To trust me; to have confidence in my honesty, ability, or reliability.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggap aku jujur, amanah atau dapat diharapkan.
senses.nuances: 本义关注人是否可靠，不限于某一句话是否真实。mempercayaiku 不自行表示“把某物托付给我”；明确表达托付宜用 mempercayakan sesuatu kepadaku。参见 [DBP：mempercayai 与 mempercayakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=percaya)。

collocations.en: trust me to manage the project

dual_scenarios.context: 职场致辞／个人陈述
dual_scenarios.ms: Saya berterima kasih kepada pihak pengurusan kerana mempercayaiku untuk mengetuai projek ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我感谢管理层信任我，让我领导这个项目。
dual_scenarios.en: I thank the management for trusting me to lead this project.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp／朋友之间表达信任
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau masih mempercayaiku lagi ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu masih mempercayai aku?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你还相信我吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Do you still trust me?
spoken_features: kau 是熟人之间使用的第二人称形式。
句末 ke 表示口语疑问；masih…lagi 在此加强“还”的意思。
mempercayaiku 带书面或抒情色彩，日常聊天更常说 percaya aku。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau masih mempercayaiku lagi ke? Aku dah cerita semuanya.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu masih mempercayai aku? Aku sudah menceritakan semuanya.
messages.zh: 你还相信我吗？我已经把事情都说出来了。
messages.en: Do you still believe me? I've told you everything.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku percaya kau. Aku nak dengar penjelasan kau dulu je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, aku mempercayai kamu. Aku hanya mahu mendengar penjelasan kamu terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 相信啊。我只是想先听你解释。
messages.en: Yes, I believe you. I just wanted to hear your explanation first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 带 aku 系列的人称色彩，适合熟人、文学叙述或个人情感表达。正式公函和对上级陈述时，mempercayai saya 通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 要求别人相信自己时，语气和关系很重要；反复说“你必须相信我”可能显得施压。讨论具体事实时，可补充解释或证据。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 带 aku 系列的人称色彩，适合熟人、文学叙述或个人情感表达。正式公函和对上级陈述时，mempercayai saya 通常更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 要求别人相信自己时，语气和关系很重要；反复说“你必须相信我”可能显得施压。讨论具体事实时，可补充解释或证据。

etymology.historical_story: This form brings together a dictionary verb and a personal voice: mempercayai means to believe or trust, while attached ku identifies the speaker as its object. In narrative or intimate writing, that compact ending makes trust feel personal. This explains the form's expressive effect; it does not establish a separate historical origin for the whole word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 percaya＝相信，再听结尾 ku＝我：mempercayai-ku，就是“相信我”。这是构词记忆，不是谐音词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入中的直接构词基底undurkan；更底层词根为undur。meN-在元音u前实现为meng-，原元音保留；若从undur分析，整体为meN-…-kan结构。

senses.zh_definition: 使物体向后移动；倒车；将钟表显示的时间调早。
senses.en_definition: To move something backwards, reverse a vehicle, or set a clock back.
senses.ms_definition: Menggerakkan sesuatu ke belakang atau memundurkan kedudukan jarum jam.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常须说明被移动的对象。mengundurkan jam指把显示时间调早，与把活动延后不同。义项依据[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundurkan+1)，马来语定义为据其义项整理。

senses.zh_definition: 命令或使人员、部队后撤；将其撤回或逼退。
senses.en_definition: To withdraw troops or personnel, or force them to retreat.
senses.ms_definition: Menyuruh pihak tertentu berundur atau menariknya ke kedudukan belakang.
senses.nuances: 须根据主语区分主动撤回己方人员与迫使对方后退；自身后退通常用berundur。见[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundurkan+1)。

senses.zh_definition: 将原定活动、日期或时间推迟到较晚的时候。
senses.en_definition: To postpone an event or move a scheduled time to a later date.
senses.ms_definition: Menangguhkan sesuatu hingga waktu lain yang lebih lewat.
senses.nuances: 表示延期，不表示取消。公文也常用menangguhkan；应注明新的日期或时间。见[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundurkan+1)。

senses.zh_definition: 在mengundurkan diri结构中，指退出活动、竞选或组织，或辞去职务。
senses.en_definition: With diri, to withdraw from participation or resign from a position.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan mengundurkan diri, menarik diri daripada penyertaan atau meletakkan jawatan.
senses.nuances: 此义依赖diri，不能直接用mengundurkan jawatan表示辞职。职位、组织及活动前通常用daripada。见[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundurkan+1)。

senses.zh_definition: 在mengundurkan diri结构中，指离开某个场所或聚会。
senses.en_definition: With diri, to leave a place or take one's leave.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan mengundurkan diri, pergi meninggalkan sesuatu tempat atau majlis.
senses.nuances: 可表示礼貌告辞，未必涉及辞职或永久退出。离开地点通常用dari，退出组织或职位用daripada。见[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundurkan+1)。

to ask permission to take one's leave

etymology.historical_story: DBP groups mengundurkan with undur, alongside berundur and pengunduran. Its recorded meanings connect backward movement with troop withdrawal and postponed events; the expression mengundurkan diri also covers resignation and departure. This provides a useful spatial image for learning the senses, although it does not establish when each meaning developed. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundurkan+1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住undur的“退”：车往后退、部队后撤、日期后移；加diri就是自己退出或告辞。

etymology.historical_story: The international sporting name recalls Marathon in Greece and the traditional story of a messenger carrying news to Athens. The modern Olympic race began in 1896, but its distance was not initially uniform. The international federation fixed 42.195 kilometres in 1921. Malay maraton carries this sporting reference and also supports extended expressions for lengthy activities. Source: [Athens Marathon](https://www.athensauthenticmarathon.gr/files/athensauthenticmarathon/42os_texn_odigies_en5.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: The connection between a grave and a vanished hope is built into this word family. Kubur names the burial place; menguburkan describes burying someone. Malay also extends the action metaphorically to extinguishing hopes or ambitions. The dictionary records both meanings, making the physical act a useful bridge to the figurative sense. [DBP: kubur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=kubur).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住声音中的 kubur＝坟墓：menguburkan 是“把人安葬”，接 harapan 或 impian 就是“把希望或梦想埋葬”。

etymology.historical_story: Madrid preserves a place-name recorded in medieval forms such as Mayrit and Magerit. Its name is commonly associated with watercourses and the settlement's water supply, although the precise derivation remains debated. Malay uses the modern Spanish name as an unchanged geographical proper noun. See [Madrid's official tourism history](https://www.esmadrid.com/en/history-madrid).

etymology.historical_story: The base rahmat is an Arabic loan associated with mercy and divine favour. Malay combines this borrowed noun with its own verbal affixes to form merahmati. The word therefore connects Arabic religious vocabulary with Malay grammar, while retaining both compassion and blessing as established meanings. See [DBP's rahmat entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=rahmat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 rahmat“恩典”：me- + rahmat + -i，把“恩典”变成“向某人施恩、赐福”。

senses.en_definition: To take an examination or course.

collocations.zh: 已经完成学校教育阶段

senses.zh_definition: 进入并经历新的生活、工作或人生阶段。
senses.en_definition: To embark on a new life phase.
senses.ms_definition: Memasuki dan mengalami kehidupan atau pekerjaan baharu.

senses.zh_definition: 着手做艰难或复杂的事情。
senses.en_definition: To undertake something difficult.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan sesuatu yang sukar atau sulit.
senses.nuances: 强调行动的艰难程度，与单纯承受磨难的第八义不同。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan penyelamat terpaksa menempuh hutan tebal untuk sampai ke lokasi kejadian.
dual_scenarios.zh: 救援队不得不穿越茂密森林，才能抵达事发地点。
dual_scenarios.en: The rescue team had to trek through dense forest to reach the scene.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah banyak cabaran kita tempuh. Yang ni pun kita boleh hadap sama-sama.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sudah banyak cabaran yang kita tempuh. Cabaran ini juga boleh kita hadapi bersama-sama.
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱们都经历过那么多难关了。这次也一起面对吧。
dual_scenarios.en: We've been through so much already. We can face this together too.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式；ni 是 ini 的口语形式。
hadap 在这里对应标准语 menghadapi。
kita tempuh 是第一人称复数代词配合词根构成的被动结构，不能简单视为随意删掉 men-。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku risau nak mula kerja baru. Banyak cabaran kena hadap nanti.
messages.ms_standard: Saya bimbang hendak memulakan pekerjaan baharu kerana banyak cabaran perlu saya hadapi nanti.
messages.zh: 我有点担心开始新工作，之后肯定有很多挑战。
messages.en: I'm nervous about starting the new job. There'll be a lot to deal with.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah menempuh macam-macam sebelum ni. Kali ni pun kau boleh, lah. Aku ada kalau kau nak cerita.
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah menempuh pelbagai cabaran sebelum ini. Kali ini juga awak mampu menghadapinya. Saya sedia mendengar jika awak mahu bercerita.
messages.zh: 你以前都熬过那么多事了，这次也可以的。想聊的话，我都在。
messages.en: You've been through so much before. You can handle this too. I'm here if you want to talk.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论他人的艰难经历时，可说 Beliau telah menempuh pelbagai cabaran，语气尊重而郑重。安慰朋友时，应承认其困难，避免把承受能力当成理所当然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合救援报道、人生叙事、励志表达和正式汇报。攻击、灾祸降临等义较旧或偏文学；现代普通交流宜按具体意思选择 menyerang、ditimpa 或 menghadapi。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论他人的艰难经历时，可说 Beliau telah menempuh pelbagai cabaran，语气尊重而郑重。安慰朋友时，应承认其困难，避免把承受能力当成理所当然。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合救援报道、人生叙事、励志表达和正式汇报。攻击、灾祸降临等义较旧或偏文学；现代普通交流宜按具体意思选择 menyerang、ditimpa 或 menghadapi。

etymology.historical_story: Menempuh is formed within Malay from tempuh, with the productive meN- prefix replacing the initial t with a nasal. Its dictionary meanings connect physical movement and impact with lived experience: one can traverse a forest, brave a storm, or endure hardship. This provides a memorable semantic link, without establishing which meaning historically developed first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把困难想成一片必须穿过去的森林：menempuh hutan 是穿林，menempuh cabaran 是闯过挑战。词根 tempuh 的 t 遇 meN- 后让位给 n。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接词基 menafikan；其进一步构词为 meN- + nafi + -kan，meN- 在 n 前实现为 me-。-nya 是附着的第三人称宾语代词，此处通常指前文的说法或事情，不表示过去时。输入 Jawi 对应 menafikan，未包含 -nya；完整形式为 منافيکنڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 否认前文所指的事情、说法或指控；不承认其真实性、存在或成立。
senses.en_definition: To deny it; to reject the truth, existence, or validity of something previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak mengakui atau menerima perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya; menidakkan atau menyangkalnya.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常回指已经提到的消息、指控或事实。tidak dapat menafikannya 表示无法否认，并非否认。该词适合正式回应；口语也常说 nafi benda itu。释义依据 [DBP：menafikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menafikan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dakwaan bahawa syarikat itu akan ditutup telah tersebar, namun pihak pengurusan menafikannya melalui kenyataan rasmi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 有关该公司即将关闭的说法已经传开，但管理层通过正式声明否认了此事。
dual_scenarios.en: Claims that the company would close had circulated, but management denied them in an official statement.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia dah menafikannya dalam grup tadi, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dia sudah menafikannya dalam kumpulan perbualan tadi, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 他刚才已经在群里否认了，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: He already denied it in the group chat earlier, right?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
grup 是聊天中常见的借词，标准表达可用 kumpulan perbualan。
句末 kan 用于寻求对方确认；完整动词形式也可出现在较认真的聊天回应中。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Orang kata Amir nak berhenti kerja. Dia dah menafikannya dalam grup, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Ada orang mengatakan bahawa Amir hendak berhenti kerja. Dia sudah menafikannya dalam kumpulan perbualan, bukan?
messages.zh: 有人说 Amir 要辞职。他已经在群里否认了，对吧？
messages.en: People are saying Amir wants to quit. He already denied it in the group chat, right?

messages.speaker: Hana (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, dia kata dia nak ambil cuti je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia mengatakan bahawa dia hanya hendak mengambil cuti.
messages.zh: 对，他说只是想请个假而已。
messages.en: Yes, he said he just wants to take some time off.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 回应上司、客户或公开指控时，可说 Kami ingin menjelaskan bahawa…，再陈述否认内容，语气较平稳。直接说 Anda menafikannya 容易带有质问意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于澄清传言、回应指控或否定某项判断。使用前应确保 -nya 的指代清楚；否认本身不等于已经提出反证。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 回应上司、客户或公开指控时，可说 Kami ingin menjelaskan bahawa…，再陈述否认内容，语气较平稳。直接说 Anda menafikannya 容易带有质问意味。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于澄清传言、回应指控或否定某项判断。使用前应确保 -nya 的指代清楚；否认本身不等于已经提出反证。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies nafi as an Arabic borrowing associated with rejection and denial. Malay builds menafikan from this base using its own verbal morphology, then attaches -nya to refer back to an already mentioned matter. The resulting form illustrates how a borrowed base participates in ordinary Malay word formation and connected discourse. [DBP: nafi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=nafi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 nafi＝否认：menafikan 是“否认”，加 -nya 就是“否认那件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接词基 mengesahkan；进一步构词为 meN- + sah + -kan。单音节词根 sah 取 menge-，s 保留。-nya 是宾语代词，回指前文事项或文件。输入 Jawi 未包含 -nya；完整形式为 مڠصحکنڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 确认前文所指的消息、说法或事情属实；承认其真实性。
senses.en_definition: To confirm that something previously mentioned is true.
senses.ms_definition: Mengakui bahawa perkara yang dirujuk itu benar; membenarkannya.
senses.nuances: 常用于确认消息或作出正式回应。-nya 指前文内容。三项核心义依据 [DBP：sah／mengesahkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=sah)。

senses.zh_definition: 通过检查、证据或调查，核实前文所指的情况或确定相关事实。
senses.en_definition: To verify or establish something previously mentioned through examination or evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Memastikan atau menetapkan perkara yang dirujuk itu.
senses.nuances: 侧重查证或确定，常涉及身份、数据及调查结果；与公开宣布属实的第一义有所重叠。

senses.zh_definition: 以签署、盖章等方式，认证前文所指的文件、支票或协议有效。
senses.en_definition: To authenticate or validate a previously mentioned document, cheque, or agreement.
senses.ms_definition: Mengakui dokumen, cek atau perjanjian yang dirujuk itu sah dengan menurunkan tandatangan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 侧重认可文件或手续的效力。具体行为可能译为认证、核证或确认有效，应根据对象判断。

collocations.en: authenticate it with an official stamp

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pegawai yang diberi kuasa hendaklah membandingkan salinan itu dengan dokumen asal sebelum mengesahkannya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 获授权的官员须先将该副本与原件核对，再予以核证。
dual_scenarios.en: The authorised officer must compare the copy with the original document before certifying it.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Berita tu betul ke? Penganjur dah mengesahkannya?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah berita itu benar? Adakah pihak penganjur sudah mengesahkannya?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个消息是真的吗？主办方已经确认了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Is that news true? Has the organiser confirmed it?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。
句末 ke 标记是非疑问。
dah 对应 sudah；聊天中可省略正式疑问结构 adakah。

messages.speaker: Hana (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Orang kata acara esok batal. Penganjur dah mengesahkannya ke?
messages.ms_standard: Ada orang mengatakan bahawa acara esok dibatalkan. Adakah pihak penganjur sudah mengesahkannya?
messages.zh: 有人说明天的活动取消了。主办方已经确认了吗？
messages.en: People are saying tomorrow's event is cancelled. Has the organiser confirmed it?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Aku nak tanya urus setia dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Belum. Saya hendak bertanya kepada urus setia terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 还没有。我先问问秘书处。
messages.en: Not yet. I'll check with the secretariat first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请求上司或工作人员确认时，可说 Boleh pihak tuan mengesahkannya?。熟人之间常用 Boleh sahkan?，正式文件则使用完整形式。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于消息核实、行政手续与文件认证。谈论认证时应说明具体对象和执行者；聊天中的口头确认与文件核证具有不同的实际作用。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请求上司或工作人员确认时，可说 Boleh pihak tuan mengesahkannya?。熟人之间常用 Boleh sahkan?，正式文件则使用完整形式。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于消息核实、行政手续与文件认证。谈论认证时应说明具体对象和执行者；聊天中的口头确认与文件核证具有不同的实际作用。

etymology.historical_story: Sah links two ideas: being valid and being true. Malay develops mengesahkan from this base, allowing the same verb to confirm news, establish a fact, or authenticate a document. Adding -nya brings the object into the word itself, making the form useful when a report or conversation has already identified the matter. [DBP: sah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=sah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 sah＝确实／有效：mengesahkan＝确认或认证，-nya＝它，所以 mengesahkannya 就是“确认它”。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语首字母缩写，通常写作 MC，按英文字母名称逐字母读出；不按普通马来语词根拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 病假证明；医生出具的、证明某人在指定期间因病不宜工作或上学的文件。
senses.en_definition: A medical certificate documenting that a person is unfit for work or school for a specified period.
senses.ms_definition: Sijil cuti sakit yang dikeluarkan oleh doktor untuk mengesahkan bahawa seseorang tidak sihat untuk bekerja atau bersekolah bagi tempoh tertentu.
senses.nuances: 来自 medical certificate，规范书写通常为 MC。指证明文件时常与 beri、dapat、hantar 连用；正式马来语可写 sijil cuti sakit。此处马来语释义为释写，非 DBP 原文。[CIDB 用语](https://cimsdev.cidb.gov.my/ApprenticeV2/home/program11.my.aspx?lang=M)

senses.zh_definition: 病假；口语中借病假证明指凭医生证明休病假的状态或期间。
senses.en_definition: Medically certified sick leave, referred to informally by the certificate supporting it.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa percakapan, cuti sakit atau tempoh tidak hadir bekerja atau bersekolah yang disokong oleh sijil doktor.
senses.nuances: 属于由文件转指休假状态的口语用法。Saya MC hari ini 意为“我今天休病假”；不是把 MC 当作疾病名称。正式表达用 saya bercuti sakit。

collocations.en: two days of certified sick leave

senses.zh_definition: 司仪；在典礼或活动中介绍环节、宣布节目并衔接流程的主持人。
senses.en_definition: A master of ceremonies who introduces speakers or performances and guides an event.
senses.ms_definition: Pengacara majlis yang memperkenalkan acara atau pembicara serta mengendalikan perjalanan majlis.
senses.nuances: 来自 master of ceremonies，与病假证明义是不同英语短语的同形缩写。活动语境中的 MC majlis、jadi MC 指司仪；正式马来语可用 pengacara majlis。[马来亚大学用例](https://umexpert.um.edu.my/fazliana.html)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场病假通知
dual_scenarios.ms: Sila kemukakan sijil cuti sakit (MC) kepada Bahagian Sumber Manusia untuk rekod.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请向人力资源部提交病假证明（MC），以供存档。
dual_scenarios.en: Please submit your medical certificate (MC) to Human Resources for their records.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事说明病假
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku MC hari ni, doktor dah suruh rehat.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya bercuti sakit pada hari ini kerana doktor telah menasihati saya supaya berehat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我今天休病假，医生叫我休息。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm on sick leave today. The doctor told me to rest.
spoken_features: MC 直接表示休病假的状态。
hari ni 是 hari ini 的口语形式。
dah 对应 sudah 或 telah；aku 用于熟悉的同辈之间。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku MC hari ni, doktor dah suruh rehat.
messages.ms_standard: Saya bercuti sakit pada hari ini kerana doktor telah menasihati saya supaya berehat.
messages.zh: 我今天休病假，医生叫我休息。
messages.en: I'm on sick leave today. The doctor told me to rest.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, rehat dulu. Aku dah beritahu ketua pasukan.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, berehatlah dahulu. Saya telah memaklumkan perkara ini kepada ketua pasukan.
messages.zh: 好，先休息吧。我已经告诉组长了。
messages.en: Okay, get some rest. I've already let the team lead know.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向主管说明病假时，使用 saya、礼貌称呼及清楚的休假日期；与不熟悉的人交流时，优先说 cuti sakit 或 sijil cuti sakit。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 病假语境中避免用拿 MC 开玩笑来暗示同事装病。活动语境中，正式介绍司仪可用 pengacara majlis，并按主办方要求使用姓名和头衔。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向主管说明病假时，使用 saya、礼貌称呼及清楚的休假日期；与不熟悉的人交流时，优先说 cuti sakit 或 sijil cuti sakit。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 病假语境中避免用拿 MC 开玩笑来暗示同事装病。活动语境中，正式介绍司仪可用 pengacara majlis，并按主办方要求使用姓名和头衔。

etymology.historical_story: MC illustrates how English initials function inside Malaysian Malay. In workplace conversation, medical certificate can name both the doctor's document and, by extension, the sick leave it supports. At an event, the same letters expand to master of ceremonies. These meanings come from separate English expressions; the surrounding conversation supplies the distinction. [Medical usage](https://cimsdev.cidb.gov.my/ApprenticeV2/home/program11.my.aspx?lang=M), [event usage](https://umexpert.um.edu.my/fazliana.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作“em-si”：诊所里的 MC 是病假证明，舞台上的 MC 是司仪；先看场景再选义。

morphology.formula: ∅ + meluru → meluru（按输入整词收录）；meN- + luru → meluru（语言学构词分析）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的整词词根字段；DBP 实际将 meluru 列于 luru 下。构词时 meN- 在 l 前采用 me-，l 保留。[DBP：luru](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=luru)

word_family.gloss: 构词基础；分别关联急冲义与霹雳方言磨光义

senses.zh_definition: 迅速冲向某处或某人；为了接近、取得或追赶某个目标而急速移动。
senses.en_definition: To rush or dash towards someone or something, often to reach or pursue a target.
senses.ms_definition: Datang dengan cepat kerana hendak mendapatkan sesuatu; mengejar dengan cepat.
senses.nuances: 强调迅速而直接的移动，常用 meluru ke、meluru masuk、meluru keluar。并不必然表示攻击。此义与下列磨光义应分开理解。[DBP：meluru](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=meluru)

senses.zh_definition: 擦磨物体表面，使其发亮；磨光、抛光，如擦磨葫芦表面。
senses.en_definition: To rub or polish an object's surface until it shines.
senses.ms_definition: Menggosok supaya bercahaya, seperti labu dan sebagainya; menggilap.
senses.nuances: DBP 在 luru II 下标为霹雳方言 Pr，属于地方性用法。以下为适配此义的工艺搭配，不代表全国通行的高频表达；一般交流更常用 menggilap。[DBP：luru II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=luru+II)

collocations.en: polish the surface of a gourd

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 救援报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Anggota bomba itu meluru ke arah mangsa sebaik sahaja laluan disahkan selamat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 通道一经确认安全，那名消防员便迅速冲向受困者。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two meanings behind this spelling. Under luru I, meluru describes rapid movement towards a target. Under luru II, marked as Perak usage, it means polishing something such as a gourd. This regional craft sense shows why an unfamiliar dictionary meaning need not replace the everyday one: identical forms can belong to distinct lexical entries. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=luru).

etymology.historical_story: Mendatang is formed from datang, meaning “come,” with the Malay prefix meN-. Its dictionary senses connect arrival with unexpected events, people from elsewhere, and approaching time. An archaic sense also describes derived words. The image of something coming thus links physical movement with abstract change: an obstacle appears, a community arrives, or the future approaches. These connections illustrate its meanings without establishing their historical sequence.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 datang＝“来”：aral mendatang 是“阻碍来了”，orang mendatang 是“从外地来的人”，masa mendatang 是“将要来的时间”。

etymology.historical_story: The root tuai names a traditional rice-cutting knife. Adding the active prefix meN- produces menuai, with the initial t replaced by n. The action therefore recalls the implement used to gather ripe rice. Harvesting also supplies a productive metaphor: effort is sowing, while its eventual results are the harvest. [DBP：tuai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tuai)

etymology.historical_story: The meanings of pecah connect physical breakage with abstract boundaries: silence, secrecy, unity and records can all be broken. This provides a useful semantic bridge, rather than a claim about the chronological order of those meanings. Memecahkannya adds Malay verbal morphology and an attached object pronoun, allowing the same form to describe breaking it or solving it.

etymology.historical_story: Batal belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of invalidity, a connection reflected in its religious uses. Malay morphology makes this borrowed base productive: membatalkan means to cause or declare invalidity, while pembatalan names the cancellation. Adding -nya supplies the object. The Arabic connection is discussed in this [university conference paper](https://conference.uis.edu.my/npreus/2024/images/dokumen-npreus-2024/6th-npreus.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 batal＝作废，再读 membatalkan＝使作废，最后加 -nya＝把它取消；batal 的 b 始终保留。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records rekam as Kedah vocabulary and associates merekam with anger held silently in the heart. etymology.historical_story: Masalah comes from Arabic masʾalah, a question or matter requiring consideration. Malay uses the borrowed noun for everyday difficulties as well as problems to solve. Adding the Malay clitic -ku makes that shared vocabulary personal: the issue becomes mine. The form illustrates how an established borrowing participates in Malay grammar. [IKIM](https://www.ikim.gov.my/en/questions-curiosity-and-the-scientific-culture/)

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowed word. The verb mengejar combines the root kejar with the active prefix meN-, while the attached pronoun -mu identifies the person pursued. Malay spelling joins that pronoun to its host. Its compact shape makes it useful in direct address, including literary dialogue, without creating a new lexical root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 mengejar“追赶”，再接 mu“你”：追赶 + 你 = mengejarmu。不要把 -mu 当作所有格“你的”。

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies Majmudar as a variant of Majumdar. It traces Majumdar to an administrative title meaning record keeper or archivist, combining an Arabic element meaning collection with Persian -dar, possessor. This history concerns the surname, not Malay word formation; a modern bearer need not have any connection with archival work. [Majmudar](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/majmudar), [Majumdar](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/majumdar)

morphology.pattern_note: 相对包内直接基底 memandu，-nya 是后附代词，不是派生词缀；suffix 为本格式中的位置归类。更深层词根为 pandu：meN- 遇词首 p，p 脱落并形成 mem-。-nya 读 /ɲa/，此处通常作宾语。包内爪夷文 ممندو 仅对应 memandu，按要求保留；附加 -nya 后完整词形为 ممندونڽ。音节可分析为 me.man.du.nya，但包内 syllables 未提供，保留 null。

etymology.historical_story: The lexical connection behind memandunya is guidance: DBP records pandu for a guide and memandu for leading or operating a vehicle. Adding -nya makes the object recoverable from context. A separate homonymous entry means trying or testing, explaining the packet's unexpected reference to clothing and weapons without making that the normal interpretation of driving conversations. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=pandu).

etymology.historical_story: Melodi belongs to an international family of musical terms associated with European forms such as French mélodie and English melody. Its deeper history connects music with song. The precise intermediary into Malay is not established by the supplied packet, so a direct borrowing route should not be asserted. Compare [CNRTL's account of the Greek musical element](https://www.cnrtl.fr/definition/m%C3%A9l-).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 melodi 和英语 melody 连起来：听到 mé-lo-di，就想起能随口哼出的旋律。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 r 前实现为 me-，词根开头的 r 保留；由形容词 reput 构成表示“变得腐朽”的不及物动词。两个 e 均读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 逐渐腐烂、腐朽或分解；尤指木材、植物残体等有机物发生败坏。
senses.en_definition: To rot, decay or decompose.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi reput.
senses.nuances: 不及物动词，主语是正在腐烂或分解的事物；若强调使某物分解，可用 mereputkan。描述一般食品变质时，具体语境也可能更适合 basi、busuk 或 rosak。派生名词 pereputan 指这一过程，参见[PRPM：pereputan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pereputan)。

etymology.historical_story: The secure explanation here is Malay word formation: reput describes a decayed condition, while mereput presents the process of becoming decayed. The related noun pereputan names that process. These forms connect everyday observations of rotting wood and fallen leaves with scientific descriptions of decomposition. The supplied evidence does not establish an earlier source-language origin for reput. [PRPM: pereputan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pereputan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: reput 是“腐朽的”，前面加 me-，画面开始变化：木头正在慢慢腐朽，就是 mereput。

senses.zh_definition: 占卜；算命；以占卜方法推断人的命运或未来。

senses.zh_definition: 预测；推测尚未发生的事情或未来的发展。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies ramal as an Arabic borrowing and records an older meaning, sand, alongside materials used for divination. This preserves a historical link between sand and attempts to read the future. Malay adds its productive verbal prefix to form meramal; related words now also serve ordinary forecasting, without necessarily suggesting occult practice. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ramal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ramal 联想“预测”，me- 让它动起来：meramal＝做预测；ramalan＝预测出来的结果。

etymology.historical_story: Italian maestro descends from Latin magister, meaning a master or teacher. Italian musical practice used the title for instructors and directors of singers or instrumentalists. That association helps explain its international musical meaning. Malay uses the same recognizable form for an accomplished musical figure; the precise route and date of borrowing are not established here. [Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/maestro1/)

etymology.historical_story: Dewan's dictionary places the peeping sense under sibuk II and marks it as Minangkabau usage. This matters because another sibuk describes being busy and taking an intrusive interest in others. Contemporary conversational menyibuk is familiar as a rebuke against meddling. The dictionary distinction prevents learners from treating every occurrence as simply “being busy.”

etymology.historical_story: The base jelma is connected with Sanskrit janma, meaning birth, an origin reflected in its incarnation sense. Malay adds the productive prefix meN- to form menjelma. The modern word also describes memories appearing and situations taking shape. This semantic range links the older image of embodiment with familiar experiences of something becoming perceptible. [Gonda's study of Sanskrit influence](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v19-p1-38.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jelma)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 men-jel-ma 三拍想象一个轮廓逐渐清晰：记忆浮现、形象出现、事物变成新形态，都抓住“显出形来”。

etymology.historical_story: Modern electrical vocabulary makes a useful Malay word-building pattern visible: the short base cas takes menge- to form an active verb, while pengecas names the charging device. DBP also records an unrelated meaning involving tripping someone. The shared spelling therefore connects two dictionary meanings, rather than one continuous story about electricity. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=mengecas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cas 与电池的电量联系起来：mengecas 是充电，pengecas 是执行充电的器具。

senses.zh_definition: 需要它、他或她；所需对象由上下文确定。此为印尼语用法，马来西亚通常说 memerlukannya。
senses.en_definition: To need it, him, or her; an Indonesian usage normally expressed as memerlukannya in Malaysian Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Memerlukan orang atau sesuatu yang dirujuk oleh -nya; penggunaan bahasa Indonesia yang lazimnya dipadankan dengan memerlukannya dalam bahasa Melayu Malaysia.

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates how neighbouring language varieties can attach different associations to the same spelling. DBP labels the need-related butuh as Indonesian, while recording a separate coarse Malay homonym referring to male genitalia. Membutuhkannya belongs to the need-related family; Malaysian usage normally selects memerlukannya to express that meaning without the regional ambiguity. [DBP: butuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=butuh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 membutuhkan 整块记成印尼语“需要”，再接 -nya＝需要它；在马来西亚表达同义时换成 memerlukannya。

morphology.formula: merayakan + -nya → merayakannya；底层构词：meN- + raya + -kan → merayakan
morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是宾语代词附着成分，指前文所说的节日或事件。meN- 在 r 前实现为 me-，r 保留；ny 读 /ɲ/，与前面的 n 分属相邻音节。所给 Jawi 对应 merayakan，未包含 -nya。

word_family.gloss: 盛大；大；口语中也指佳节

senses.zh_definition: 庆祝或隆重纪念前文所指的节日、纪念日或重要事件。
senses.en_definition: To celebrate or commemorate the previously mentioned occasion or event.
senses.ms_definition: Memuliakan, memperingati atau meramaikan hari besar atau peristiwa penting yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 在此通常相当于“它／该事件”，使宾语不必重复；没有明确先行对象时，宜直接写出所庆祝的事件。merayakan 不限于开斋节，也可用于生日、独立日及其他重要日子。[DBP：merayakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=merayakan)

etymology.historical_story: Raya means great or large, a meaning still visible in expressions such as jalan raya. Its association with major festive days makes the formation merayakan, to celebrate, memorable. Adding -nya points back to an occasion already mentioned. This explains the word through established Malay meanings and morphology, without assigning raya an unsupported distant origin. [DBP on raya](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/04/07/12886/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: raya 联想到“盛大日子”，merayakan 就是庆祝；尾巴 -nya 把前面提过的“那个日子”接回来：merayakannya，庆祝它。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 接以 t 开头的 terus 时，t 脱落，鼻音实现为 n，形成 menerus；两个 e 均读 /ə/。root_word 与 is_root 依原包保留；语言学上的构词词根是 terus。

etymology.historical_story: Menerus belongs to the terus family, which connects direct movement, penetration, and continuation. Its formation follows a regular Malay sound pattern: the initial t disappears after meN-. The supplied dictionary quotation places light extending skywards in a narrative about Bendahara and Tun Mutahir, illustrating a literary use alongside the practical example of stitching through cloth.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 terus 的“一直通过去”：meN- 加上去，t 让位给 n，成为 menerus；想象针脚穿过布，光束直达天。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 /u/ 开头，meN- 采用 meng-；词根完整保留，不发生 k 脱落。输入包将 mengukir 标为词根有误，现据 DBP 的 ukir 词条修正。

senses.zh_definition: 通过凿、刻、划或削，在木材等材料上制作图案、文字或装饰。

etymology.historical_story: Mengukir is transparently formed from ukir with the active prefix meN-. Malay woodcarving provides its concrete cultural setting: an artisan cuts a surface to reveal a pattern. The dictionary also records the figurative expression mengukir senyuman, in which a smile takes shape like a carved design. This explains the imagery without claiming an undocumented origin date.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ukir 想成刻刀留下的纹路：mengukir kayu 是在木头上刻花，mengukir senyuman 是让笑容在脸上成形。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 /b/ 前变为 mem-，词根的 b 保留。输入将 membasmi 标为词根有误；[DBP 的词根条目是 basmi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=basmi)。

etymology.historical_story: Research on Sanskrit loanwords in Malay identifies basmi with a Sanskrit form associated with reduction to ashes. The older burning sense remains recorded in Malay dictionaries, alongside the broader meaning of eradication. This connection makes the modern vocabulary of eliminating disease or illiteracy especially memorable. See the [linguistic study](https://oer.ums.edu.my/bitstream/handle/oer_source_files/2231/Full%20e-Prosiding%20PERSEP%20II.pdf?isAllowed=y&sequence=1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 basmi 想成“烧成灰、清到底”；加上 meN- 变 membasmi，就是主动去根除。联想只辅助记忆，不是中文音译词源。

etymology.historical_story: Mampukah illustrates how Malay builds questions by attaching -kah to an existing word. Its meaning comes from ordinary mampu, concerning ability or financial means, rather than the unrelated administrative acronym MAMPU. The attachment changes the utterance into a question without creating a new lexical root. The deeper origin of mampu is not established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mampu 是“有能力”，-kah 是“吗”：mampukah＝“有能力吗／办得到吗／负担得起吗”。

etymology.historical_story: Metropolis ultimately comes from Greek mētropolis, combining words for mother and city. In ancient Greek usage, it could identify the mother city from which a colony originated. The historical image helps learners understand the modern meaning: a principal city around which regional activity is organised. Malay uses it for a leading urban centre. Sources: [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/metropolis), [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=metropolis).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 metropolis 想成“母城”：周边地区围着这座主要大都市运转。母城来自历史词源，不是说 metro 在马来语里表示母亲。

etymology.historical_story: Missouri preserves the name of the Indigenous Missouria people. Historical accounts connect that name with dugout canoes, and it became attached to both the river and the state. Malay retains the established geographical spelling. The name therefore carries Indigenous history rather than a meaning that can be recovered through Malay affixes. [National Park Service history](https://home.nps.gov/jeff/learn/historyculture/missouri.htm).

etymology.historical_story: This form brings together two familiar Malay resources: the verb suruh, expressing an instruction, and the attached pronoun -mu, meaning you here. The active prefix produces menyuruh through a regular sound change. In literary dialogue, the compact ending can make an instruction feel personal or dramatic; everyday conversation often uses a separate pronoun instead.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 suruh＝‘叫人做事’，再把 -mu 当作指向‘你’的小箭头：menyuruhmu＝叫你做。

etymology.historical_story: The English fish name marlin shortened marlinspike fish, named for its resemblance to a sailor's pointed rope-working tool. The comparison centres on the fish's projecting upper jaw. Malay also records marlin as a fish name, although the supplied dictionary evidence does not establish when it entered Malay. A practical maritime object thus provides a memorable image for the animal. [Etymonline: marlin](https://www.etymonline.com/word/marlin)

etymology.historical_story: Makasih shortens the familiar expression terima kasih rather than adding a productive prefix to a root. Indonesian teaching materials present it as casual speech. The full expression remains the appropriate Malaysian Malay choice in formal writing. This illustrates conversational compression: a frequent social expression becomes shorter while retaining its function of acknowledging help or kindness. [Source](https://www.indonesianpod101.com/lesson/survival-phrases-1-thank-you).

senses.ms_definition: Menyamun atau membegal dengan mengambil wang atau barang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.

senses.nuances: 执法报道中的 merampas 可表示查扣，并不必然表示非法抢夺；是否属于最终没收须看具体语境。词典以 menyita 释此义，见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=merampas)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places merampas in the rampas family, alongside rampasan, perampasan, and perampas. Its meanings connect forcible taking, robbery, and official seizure. etymology.historical_story: McCoy appears in the English idiom the real McCoy, meaning a genuine person or thing. Merriam-Webster connects this form with the earlier expression the real Mackay, while leaving its ultimate origin uncertain. The expression should therefore be learned as an established idiom, without presenting a colourful inventor or boxer story as proven history. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/McCoy)

etymology.historical_story: Morgana belongs to the naming tradition associated with Morgan le Fay in Arthurian legend. The atmospheric name Fata Morgana recalls this legendary enchantress and stories of seemingly floating buildings. Malay records fatamorgana as a complete word. That history does not establish morgana alone as a standard Malay synonym for a mirage. [Météo-France](https://meteofrance.com/meteo-a-z/enquete-sur-5-phenomenes-atmospheriques-non-identifies).

senses.zh_definition: 用鞭子抽打；鞭打，尤指驱赶牲畜。
senses.en_definition: To strike with a whip, especially to drive an animal forward.
senses.ms_definition: Memukul dengan menggunakan pecut atau cambuk, lazimnya untuk menggerakkan haiwan.
senses.nuances: 本义为及物用法，宾语是受鞭打者。这里描述的是动作，不表示“奔跑”。以下各义依据 DBP 列出的义项综合表述。[PRPM：memecut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memecut)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻催动、激励或刺激，使活动、发展等更加积极或迅速。
senses.en_definition: To spur, stimulate, or intensify an activity or development.
senses.ms_definition: Mendorong sesuatu kegiatan atau usaha supaya menjadi lebih giat atau berkembang dengan lebih cepat.
senses.nuances: 由鞭子催动牲畜的意象引申而来。用于经济、发展或工作时带有推动力度；日常礼貌建议可用 menggalakkan 或 mendorong，语气较柔和。

senses.zh_definition: 加速前进；突然加快跑动或行驶速度。
senses.en_definition: To accelerate, speed up, or put on a burst of speed.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak atau berlari dengan kelajuan yang meningkat dengan ketara berbanding sebelumnya.
senses.nuances: 可作不及物动词，主语可以是跑者或车辆。体育语境常译为“冲刺”；交通语境不必然表示超速，是否违法取决于实际车速和道路限制。

collocations.en: to sprint towards the finish line
to accelerate out of a bend

senses.zh_definition: 使车辆等加速；加快所驾驶车辆的速度。
senses.en_definition: To make a vehicle move faster; to accelerate a vehicle.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan kenderaan atau sesuatu yang dikendalikan bergerak dengan lebih laju.
senses.nuances: 及物用法，宾语通常是车辆。须区分 kereta memecut（车在加速）与 pemandu memecut kereta（司机使车加速）。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于冲刺、车辆加速或推动发展。描述道路行为时，应根据事实区分加速、快速行驶和超速；超速可明确说 melebihi had laju。

etymology.historical_story: Malay pecut names a whip. Its active verb memecut links the physical act of whipping with the resulting increase in movement. Dictionary senses extend this connection to runners, vehicles, and figurative stimulation. The relationship provides a memorable semantic bridge from an implement to an action and then to acceleration, without requiring an invented historical borrowing story. [PRPM: pecut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=pecut).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pecut 是鞭子：想象挥鞭后马突然加速。meN- 吃掉 p，变成 memecut：鞭打 → 催动 → 加速。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Meg → Meg（人名用法，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 作为姓名，不属于马来语加缀构词；与 Margaret、Megan 的昵称关系不是马来语词缀关系。IPA 为英语姓名读音。

senses.zh_definition: 梅格：英语女性名字，传统上为 Margaret 的昵称，也可作 Megan 的简称。
senses.en_definition: A feminine personal name, traditionally a diminutive of Margaret and also a short form of Megan.
senses.ms_definition: Nama perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris, secara tradisinya nama timangan bagi Margaret dan juga bentuk pendek bagi Megan.
senses.nuances: 此处提供可核实的人名义，写作 Meg；输入中的小写 meg 缺少上下文，不能确定一定属于该用法，也不能自动排除缩略语等其他解释。该义项并非 DBP 官方马来语释义，status 标为 unverified。以下组合为教学示例，未验证搭配频率。[姓名来源](https://www.behindthename.com/name/meg)；[英语读音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/meg)

etymology.historical_story: Meg developed as a familiar form of Margaret in medieval English naming traditions and is also used for Megan. This is a history of personal naming rather than Malay word formation. When Meg appears in Malay conversation, the speaker may simply be using someone's chosen name; the name alone does not establish that person's full legal name. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/meg)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Meg /mɛɡ/ 短短一拍，联想朋友间简短亲切的昵称；不要因此认定每位 Meg 的全名都是 Margaret。

morphology.formula: menjejaki + -nya → menjejakinya；底层构词：meN- + jejak + -i → menjejaki
morphology.pattern_note: 依输入包保留root_word为直接基底menjejaki；实际词根为jejak。meN-在j前采用men-，j保留；-nya在此为第三人称宾语附着形式，指他、她、它或前述对象。输入Jawi仅对应menjejaki，缺少-nya，完整形式可写作منججقيڽ；headword.jawi仍忠实保留原包。音节字段原为null，保持不变。

senses.zh_definition: 踏上或踩到前文所指的地面、土地或地方。
senses.en_definition: To tread on it or set foot on the previously mentioned ground or place.
senses.ms_definition: Menginjak tanah, permukaan atau tempat yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 对应DBP对menjejaki所列的menginjak义；具体宾语由-nya回指。此义受宾语限制，不能套用于所有人或物；日常表达踏足某地时也常用menjejakkan kaki。[义项依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menjejaki)。

collocations.en: to set foot on it for the first time
to have never set foot there

senses.zh_definition: 沿着足迹、留下的痕迹或行进路线追踪前述的人或动物。
senses.en_definition: To track the previously mentioned person or animal by following footprints, traces, or a route.
senses.ms_definition: Mengikuti jejak atau kesan perjalanan orang atau haiwan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya可指男性、女性或动物，不标示性别；本身也不表达过去时。强调循迹追踪，不保证已找到对象。[义项依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menjejaki)。

senses.zh_definition: 依据线索、记录或行为信息查找前述对象的下落，或追查其活动与来历。
senses.en_definition: To trace or investigate the whereabouts, activities, or history of the previously mentioned person or thing.
senses.ms_definition: Mengesan atau menyiasat kedudukan, pergerakan, kegiatan atau riwayat seseorang atau sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 由实体足迹扩展为抽象线索，可涉及人物、包裹、记录或历史对象。-nya在这里通常是宾语，不能机械译成“他的追踪”。[义项依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menjejaki)。

collocations.zh: 通过交易记录追查该对象

etymology.historical_story: The semantic starting point is jejak, a footprint or trace. Malay builds menjejaki around that noun, turning a visible mark into the act of following it. Adding -nya identifies an already mentioned target. The same image extends naturally from tracking a person through a forest to tracing someone through records: physical footprints become informational clues.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住jejak“足迹”：menjejaki是循迹追踪，再接-nya，就是“追踪他／她／它”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + maybe → maybe；英语历史来源：(it) may be → maybe
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包视为整体词项；英语首音节重读。不分析为马来语前后缀结构。英语may be为两个词，与副词maybe的现代语法不同。输入包未提供音节及Jawi，保留null。

word_family.gloss: 若干不确定的可能性或含糊答复

senses.zh_definition: 也许；可能；表示事情有发生或属实的可能，但尚未确定。
senses.en_definition: Perhaps; used to indicate that something is possible but uncertain.
senses.ms_definition: Mungkin atau barangkali; menyatakan sesuatu yang belum pasti.
senses.nuances: 英语副词，在英马语码混用中可出现；标准马来语通常使用mungkin、barangkali或boleh jadi。ms_definition为马来文释义，不冒称DBP对maybe的官方定义。headword.status按指定格式保留official，不代表该英语形式已被认可为标准马来词；排名来自输入包。[英马词义参考：Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/maybe)。

senses.zh_definition: 或许可以；用来委婉提出建议、请求或不同看法。
senses.en_definition: Used to soften a suggestion, request, or opinion.
senses.ms_definition: Digunakan untuk melembutkan cadangan, permintaan atau pandangan; sepadan dengan mungkin dalam konteks tersebut.
senses.nuances: 主要功能是缓和语气，不一定表示说话者对建议本身缺乏信心。以下搭配为英马混用；正式马来语改用mungkin。[用法参考：Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/maybe_1)。

collocations.zh: 或许我们可以先讨论一下
collocations.en: maybe we could discuss it first

senses.zh_definition: 大约；约莫；置于数量前表示估计。
senses.en_definition: Approximately; used before an estimated number or amount.
senses.ms_definition: Kira-kira atau lebih kurang, apabila digunakan sebelum bilangan atau kuantiti.
senses.nuances: 这是数量估计义，翻译时通常采用kira-kira或lebih kurang，不能一律替换为mungkin。以下例子仍属于语码混用。[用法参考：Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/maybe)。

senses.zh_definition: 不确定的可能性；含糊的“也许”答复。
senses.en_definition: An uncertainty, possibility, or noncommittal answer.
senses.ms_definition: Kemungkinan yang belum pasti atau jawapan yang tidak memberikan kepastian.

collocations.zh: 太多不确定因素或含糊答复

etymology.historical_story: Maybe developed in late Middle English from the expression it may be. A phrase about possibility became a single adverb, while the separate words may be retained their grammatical role as a verb construction. The history offers a useful reading clue: Maybe she is here and She may be here express similar uncertainty through different structures. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/maybe).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作“梅比”：记住may be原本就是“可能是”，合成maybe便是“也许”；标准马来语对应mungkin。

etymology.historical_story: DBP groups menyampuk under sampuk, alongside senses involving collision, deflection, spirit affliction and conversational interruption. These meanings offer a useful image of something entering another's space, but their order does not establish a historical sequence. The secure morphological fact is simpler: meN- attaches to sampuk, replacing its initial s with ny. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=sampuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 meN- + sampuk：s 让位给 ny。想象别人的话还没说完，你的声音就“撞进去”了——这就是 menyampuk。

senses.zh_definition: 出价；说出自己愿意为购买或租用某物而支付的金额。

collocations.en: to bargain over the price of goods

senses.zh_definition: 在传统疗法或民间信仰语境中，解毒、消除毒性，或以咒语等方式化解被认为有害的力量。
senses.en_definition: In traditional healing contexts, to counteract poison or harmful potency, sometimes through incantations.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks perubatan tradisional, menghapuskan kesan bisa atau racun, antaranya melalui jampi atau amalan seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 这是词典记录的传统文化义，不表示相关做法的医疗效果已经得到证实。现代具体医疗说明通常使用更明确的中和、抗毒或治疗术语。[PRPM：menawar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menawar)。

senses.ms_definition: Yang telah ditempah terlebih dahulu, khusus dalam ungkapan bidan menawar.

etymology.historical_story: Menawar illustrates two dictionary traditions within the tawar family. One concerns prices: a buyer states an amount or asks for a reduction. Another concerns removing harmful potency in traditional healing. Related penawar can name an antidote or a figurative comfort. These recorded meanings should not be turned into an invented story that bargaining historically developed from healing. [PRPM: tawar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tawar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住构词时 t 消失：meN- + tawar → menawar。看到 harga 想讲价；看到 bisa 或 racun 想传统解毒义。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包中的直接基底 mainkan；更底层词根为 main。-kan 是动词后缀，-nya 在这里通常是指代宾语的附着代词，二者不能视为一个派生后缀。/ɲ/ 对应 ny，前面的 /n/ 保留。mainkannya 可用于祈使句；普通主动陈述句通常使用 memainkannya。status 表示该构形符合标准语法，不表示它已作为独立词条获 DBP 收录。

etymology.historical_story: The base main belongs to the established Malay vocabulary of play and entertainment. Its derivatives connect games, music and theatre: bermain describes playing, permainan names a game, and memainkan introduces something performed or played. Mainkannya combines the transitive base with enclitic -nya, allowing an already mentioned object to remain understood rather than repeated.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: main＝玩，-kan＝把对象拿来玩或演奏，-nya＝它：mainkannya，记成“把它放来听／拿来玩”。

etymology.historical_story: Moreau belongs to French surname history rather than Malay derivation. Surname dictionaries associate it with the medieval personal name Morel and with an older descriptive nickname referring to dark colouring. Such historical explanations describe naming traditions; they do not identify a modern bearer's appearance, ancestry or the intended person in an isolated corpus token.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 法语 eau 合读 /o/：Moreau 约读“莫罗”；把它作为完整姓氏记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语屈折形式，不是马来语词根。输入的词根分析已更正为 make。动词 -s 标记一般现在时第三人称单数；名词 -s 标记复数。清辅音 /k/ 后的 -s 读 /s/，词尾 e 不发音，全词一个音节。

senses.zh_definition: 制作、制造或准备某物；英语 make 的第三人称单数现在时形式。
senses.en_definition: Produces, creates, or prepares something.
senses.ms_definition: Menghasilkan, mencipta atau menyediakan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 英语词形，不能当作标准马来语动词直接使用。此处及以下搭配的 ms 栏提供马来语对应表达，en 栏保留英语搭配。英语义项依据 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/make)；马来语释义为编写的对应释义。

senses.zh_definition: 使某事发生，或使某人、某物处于某种状态。
senses.en_definition: Causes an event, action, or state.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan sesuatu berlaku atau menjadi demikian.
senses.nuances: 可接宾语加形容词，或宾语加不带 to 的动词原形；使人发笑不一定含强迫意味。

senses.zh_definition: 强迫或要求某人做某事。
senses.en_definition: Compels someone to do something.
senses.ms_definition: Memaksa seseorang melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 主动结构为 makes + 人 + 动词原形。与单纯表示引起反应的使役义不同，此义包含外在要求或压力。参见 [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/make)。

senses.zh_definition: 与名词搭配，表示作出、进行或实施相应行为。
senses.en_definition: Performs the action expressed by a following noun.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan tindakan yang dinyatakan oleh kata nama selepasnya.
senses.nuances: 属于英语轻动词用法，不能把每个 makes 都机械译成制造。makes sense 是固定表达，意思为有道理或说得通。行为搭配参见 [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/make)。

senses.zh_definition: 赚取收入、利润或生计所需的钱。
senses.en_definition: Earns money or a profit.
senses.ms_definition: Memperoleh wang atau keuntungan.
senses.nuances: 强调所得，不一定表示亲手制造商品。

senses.zh_definition: 具有成为某种人或充当某种事物的适当条件。
senses.en_definition: Proves suitable as a particular person or thing.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuai menjadi seseorang atau berfungsi sebagai sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常用于评价某人的表现或某物的用途，如称某人是位好老师。

senses.zh_definition: 合计为；构成某个总数。
senses.en_definition: Amounts to a specified total.
senses.ms_definition: Berjumlah sebanyak nilai tertentu.
senses.nuances: 用于计算或说明加上当前项目后的总数。参见 [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/make)。

senses.zh_definition: 成功到达、赶上，或获得进入某名单、队伍等的资格。
senses.en_definition: Successfully reaches, catches, or qualifies for something.
senses.ms_definition: Berjaya sampai, sempat menaiki sesuatu atau terpilih menyertainya.
senses.nuances: 部分用法偏口语；makes it 表示成功或顺利抵达，具体解释取决于上下文。参见 [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/make)。

senses.zh_definition: 产品的品牌或厂牌；英语名词 make 的复数形式。
senses.en_definition: Manufacturers' brands or types of products.
senses.ms_definition: Jenama atau jenis keluaran pengilang.
senses.nuances: 此处 -s 表示名词复数，与前述动词形式同形；汽车与机械语境尤其常见。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/make)。

etymology.historical_story: English make descends from Old English macian and belongs to the same Germanic family as German machen and Dutch maken. Its meanings extend from creating objects to causing events and performing actions. Makes is an inflected English form; its appearance in a Malay corpus does not establish Malay borrowing. Source: [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/make).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 make＝做或造成，再听末尾 /s/：he makes；若前面是 different，makes 则可能是复数“厂牌”。

headword.verification_note: 输入的 ڤمباچ 对应 pembaca，不能用作 membacakan 的爪夷文；此处按构词规则更正。

morphology.formula: membaca + -kan → membacakan；完整构词：meN- + baca + -kan → membacakan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留 membaca 作为直接构词基底；最底层词根是 baca。meN- 在 b 前变为 mem-，b 保留；-kan 在本词中表示为别人读。

senses.zh_definition: 为某人朗读或念出文字内容；读给某人听。
senses.en_definition: To read something aloud to or for someone.

senses.nuances: 重点是朗读的受益者或听众，而非单纯自己阅读。可说 membacakan adik cerita，也可说 membacakan cerita kepada adik。正式场合可用于宣读致辞、声明或决定，不必拆成独立义项。[DBP：baca／membacakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=baca)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于故事、信件、致辞和公告等。为别人朗读私人信息前应征得同意；宗教诵读则须尊重相应场合的规范。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向长辈或不熟悉的人提出朗读请求，可说 Bolehkah tuan membacakan petikan ini?，并按关系选用适当称呼。

etymology.historical_story: Membacakan illustrates how Malay builds a social relationship into a verb. Baca supplies the act of reading, meN- forms the active verb, and -kan gives the established meaning of reading for somebody. The same word therefore connects intimate bedtime storytelling with public readings of prepared speeches: written words are delivered for another person's benefit. [DBP：baca／membacakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=baca)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 baca“读”，再记住这里的 -kan“为别人”：membacakan＝把文字读给别人听。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中按完整词根处理，不能拆成 me- + rdeka。第二音节的 é 为 [e]，首音节 e 为 [ə]；词尾 a 在部分马来西亚口音中读作 [ə]。

senses.zh_definition: 国家或民族摆脱殖民统治、外部支配或保护关系而独立自主的。
senses.en_definition: Independent and free from colonial rule or external domination.
senses.ms_definition: Bebas daripada penjajahan atau naungan; berdiri sendiri dan tidak bergantung pada pihak lain.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 核心释义在国家政治领域的用法，常与 berdaulat 连用。merdeka 表示独立这一性质或状态，kemerdekaan 则是表示“独立、自由”的派生名词。这里的马来文释义为依据词典整理的分义表述。[DBP：merdeka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=merdeka)

senses.zh_definition: 个人或群体摆脱奴役、拘束、控制或其他束缚而自由的。
senses.en_definition: Free from bondage, confinement, control, or other restrictions.
senses.ms_definition: Bebas daripada kurungan, perhambaan atau kongkongan; lepas daripada ikatan atau tuntutan.
senses.nuances: 不限于国家独立，也可用于人的自由。在日常表达“今天有空”时通常用 lapang 或有具体语境的 bebas，不能直接把 merdeka 当作通用的“有空”。以考试结束等事情为背景说 merdeka，属于轻松的比喻。[DBP：merdeka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=merdeka)

senses.zh_definition: 思想、判断或机构立场不受他人或特定集团控制而独立自主的。
senses.en_definition: Independent in thought, judgment, or institutional allegiance.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak terikat pada pihak tertentu dan bebas menentukan pendirian sendiri.
senses.nuances: 用于思想、媒体或立场，强调自主判断，不自动等于客观、公正或反政府。DBP 的 akhbar merdeka 特指不依附任何政党的报纸；以下另一搭配为教学示例。[DBP：merdeka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=merdeka)

collocations.zh: 不依附政党的独立报纸
collocations.en: a newspaper independent of political parties

etymology.historical_story: Merdeka traces ultimately to Sanskrit maharddhika, associated with prosperity and elevated status, before developing its familiar sense of freedom. [Indonesian cultural encyclopedia](https://esi.kemenbud.go.id/wiki/Merdeka). In Malaya, the word acquired an enduring public voice when Tunku Abdul Rahman called out Merdeka seven times at the independence proclamation on 31 August 1957. [National Archives of Malaysia](https://pustakailmu.arkib.gov.my/index.php/ms/pustaka-ilmu/jendela-sejarah/pengisytiharan-kemerdekaan-tanah-melayu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象高举双手喊“mer-de-ka！”：从受人控制到自己作主，便是“独立、自由”。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借入，不拆作马来语词根与词缀；规范马来语对应拼写为 mufin。所列 IPA 为英语原词读音。

senses.zh_definition: 玛芬；通常以面糊放入小杯形模具烘成的单份糕点，可加入巧克力、香蕉或莓果等。
senses.en_definition: A small, usually sweet, cup-shaped cake or quick bread baked in an individual mould.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis kek kecil yang dibakar dalam acuan berbentuk cawan, biasanya dengan tambahan seperti coklat, pisang atau buah beri; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah mufin.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚咖啡馆菜单常保留英语 muffin；正式马来文宜用 mufin。此处释义为编写性释义，并非所给数据中缺失的 DBP 原文。English muffin 通常指另一种扁圆酵母面包，不宜与杯形玛芬混同。[DBP 英马词典对应词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=muffin)。

etymology.historical_story: English muffin has an uncertain deeper origin: proposed connections include Low German words for a small cake and French words associated with softness. Its culinary meaning also developed differently in Britain and America. Malay distinguishes the borrowed English spelling muffin from the adapted spelling mufin. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/muffin); [DBP equivalent](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=muffin).

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves two branches of this word: sending something onwards and laying something down. That distinction offers a useful glimpse of Malay vocabulary beyond today's familiar delivery messages. The supplied base, menghantar, already contains a verbal prefix; adding -kan produces menghantarkan. This is a morphological explanation, not evidence of a particular ancient donor language or a dated historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记 meng-hantar-kan：看到 hantar，先想“送到”；遇到手、肩膀、地面等放置语境，再切换成“搁下、搭放”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词首 d 前变为 men-，d 保留；词尾 k 通常实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。输入未提供音节字段，故保留 null；可参考划分 men.di.dik。root_jawi 按输入保留，但其中 ديديقبر 含多余字符，didik 的规范写法为 ديديق。

etymology.historical_story: Mendidik is transparently formed from didik with the active verbal prefix meN-. Its educational meaning connects caring for a learner with teaching and training. The same base supports pendidik, an educator, and pendidikan, education. Together, these familiar forms help learners see education as an ongoing practice of developing people rather than merely delivering lessons.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 didik＝教养培养：men-didik 是实施教育，pen-didik 是教育者，pen-didik-an 是教育。

etymology.historical_story: Mahishmati represents the Sanskrit place-name Māhiṣmatī. Historical accounts associate it with the Narmada valley, while its precise identification has been debated. Modern viewers may instead recognise the name from Baahubali, whose fictional kingdom gives an ancient name a new cinematic life. Neither context establishes it as an ordinary Malay vocabulary item. [Historical discussion](https://mospace.umsystem.edu/bitstreams/13279bbf-ba91-4cef-b0be-0b7dd3dd1d2e/download); [cinematic usage](https://baahubali.fandom.com/wiki/Mahishmati).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mahishmati 整体联想为《巴霍巴利王》的王国名；这是专名记忆线索，不是词根解释。

senses.zh_definition: 把已经做过的事情再做一次，或把已经说过的话再说一遍。

etymology.historical_story: Mengulang belongs to the Malay word family built on ulang, whose meanings include returning and doing something again. The same family connects classroom revision, repeated actions, and annual remembrance through ulang tahun. Its dictionary-recorded visiting sense also links the word with going to see someone. These meanings offer a cultural bridge between returning to people and returning to lessons.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ulang 的“再来一次”：mengulang 就是主动把动作、话语或功课再过一遍。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 /l/ 前实现为 me-，保留 l；-nya 读 /ɲa/，此处是第三人称宾语附着代词，并非派生后缀。按数据包保留 root_word=melatih，它是直接基底；更底层词根为 latih。完整形式可分为 me.la.tih.nya。数据包的 ملاتيه 对应 melatih，未包含 -nya；完整形式写作 ملاتيهڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 通过反复练习，使所指的人逐渐习惯某种行为、程序或要求。

etymology.historical_story: This form carries its story in Malay word formation: latih supplies the training concept, meN- builds the active verb melatih, and -nya identifies the person receiving the training. The same base connects latihan, berlatih, and terlatih. In classrooms, workshops, and sports settings, this family distinguishes the practice itself, the learner's activity, and the proficiency gained. [DBP: latih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=latih)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 latih＝练；me- 把它变成主动训练，-nya 把对象接上：melatihnya＝训练他／她。

senses.en_definition: Mako, a shark-name element attested in Malay names for the shortfin mako shark, Isurus oxyrinchus.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama jerung yang terdapat dalam nama jerung mako sirip pendek atau yu mako sirip pendek, iaitu Isurus oxyrinchus.

etymology.historical_story: Mako is a Māori shark name that became internationally familiar. Māori communities valued mako teeth as ornaments and trading items, connecting the animal with skilled seafaring and fishing traditions. Malaysian biodiversity records also use mako in Malay shark names. The historical route and date by which this name entered Malay have not been established here. [Te Ara](https://teara.govt.nz/en/sharks-and-rays/page-5), [Māori shark traditions](https://teara.govt.nz/en/sharks-and-rays/page-2), [MyBIS](https://www.mybis.gov.my/sp/27015)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mako 与完整名称 jerung mako 一起记：看到 mako，联想到灰鲭鲨；这是联想提示，不是词源拆分。

morphology.formula: 规范构词：meN- + yakin + -kan → meyakinkan；menyakinkan 为非规范形式。
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的直接基底 yakinkan；其基础词根是 yakin。meN- 接以 y 开头的基底时实现为 me-，保留 y，不产生 ny。规范形式分音节为 me.ya.kin.kan，宽式音标为 /mə.ja.kin.kan/。

senses.zh_definition: 对应规范形式 meyakinkan：使某人相信某事，或使其消除疑虑、建立信心。
senses.en_definition: For standard meyakinkan: to convince or reassure someone; to make someone confident that something is true.
senses.ms_definition: Bagi bentuk baku meyakinkan: membuat seseorang percaya atau berasa pasti tentang sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 本义属于规范形式 meyakinkan；不得将 menyakinkan 标为官方拼写。DBP 对两种拼写的直接答复选择 meyakinkan。[DBP 拼写答疑](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=meyakinkan)

senses.zh_definition: 对应规范形式 meyakinkan：有说服力的；足以使人相信或产生信心的。
senses.en_definition: For standard meyakinkan: convincing, persuasive, or confidence-inspiring.
senses.ms_definition: Bagi bentuk baku meyakinkan: bersifat dapat menimbulkan kepercayaan atau keyakinan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 yang meyakinkan，修饰论据、解释、表现等；词形虽带动词词缀，在这些结构中具有形容词功能。[DBP 英马词典用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=meyakinkan)

senses.zh_definition: 对应规范形式 meyakinkan 的较少见用法：亲自察看或核实，以确认某事属实。
senses.en_definition: For standard meyakinkan: to ascertain something through personal observation or verification.
senses.ms_definition: Bagi bentuk baku meyakinkan: memeriksa atau menyaksikan sendiri untuk memperoleh kepastian.
senses.nuances: 这是词典记录的用法；现代日常表达通常可用 memastikan 或 mengesahkan sendiri 说得更明确。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=meyakinkan)

collocations.ms: meyakinkan sama ada perkara itu benar

senses.zh_definition: 对应规范形式 meyakinkan 的词典所录用法：认真地、郑重地做某事。
senses.en_definition: For standard meyakinkan: seriously or earnestly, rather than casually.
senses.ms_definition: Bagi bentuk baku meyakinkan: melakukan sesuatu secara serius dan bersungguh-sungguh.
senses.nuances: 此义见于《Kamus Dewan》，现代学习者宜优先使用 dengan bersungguh-sungguh；以下列出释义替代表达，不冒称原词的高频搭配。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=meyakinkan)

etymology.historical_story: The reliable starting point is the Malay base yakin, meaning certain or confident. Malay morphology builds meyakinkan from that base to express causing confidence or belief. The supplied spelling menyakinkan inserts an unwarranted nasal element. DBP explicitly selects meyakinkan when asked to choose between the two forms. [DBP spelling advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=meyakinkan)

etymology.historical_story: DBP places melangkaui under langkau and illustrates its concrete meaning with passage beyond Japanese fortifications. Its learner’s dictionary also records skipping portions and exceeding boundaries. Together, these meanings offer a useful conceptual bridge from physical passage to omitted text and abstract limits. This connection is a teaching interpretation, not a documented chronology of semantic change. [DBP: langkau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=langkau)

etymology.historical_story: The base aum names the sound associated with a tiger or lion; mengaum turns that sound into an action. Malay pantun preserved in DBP’s reference collection place roaring big cats in compact scenes of strength and intimidation. These attestations establish a cultural setting for the word, while its resemblance to an animal call offers a sound-based mnemonic. [DBP: mengaum and pantun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=mengaum)

senses.zh_definition: 从屋内下来或出屋迎见、迎接某人，也可指下去捉拿或追赶某人。

senses.ms_definition: Keluar dari rumah untuk menghadap, menangkap atau mengejar seseorang, atau turun untuk menyambut kedatangannya.

etymology.historical_story: The basic root turun belongs to an old Austronesian family of words for descending, reconstructed as Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *tuRun. Related forms occur across languages including Acehnese, Balinese and Tetun. Malay builds menuruni from this inherited material through ordinary affixation. The ancient downward-motion meaning remains visible whenever someone descends a staircase, slope or well. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/30696).
