etymology.historical_story: The standard word masalah comes from Arabic masʾalah, meaning a question or matter. In Malay, it covers everyday difficulties as well as problems requiring a solution. The submitted spelling masaalah does not create a separate word or meaning: DBP explicitly lists it as incorrect and gives masalah as the correct spelling. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/koleksi1.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: “问题”是 masalah；别让多余的 a 再制造一个拼写问题。整词记忆，不拆成 masa（时间）＋alah。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词首 m 前实现为 me-，保留词根的 m；-kan 表示使成某种状态，词根末尾 k 与后缀开头 k 在拼写中均保留。输入包将整词误标为词根，此处按实际构词纠正；音节划分由包内读音补全。参见 [DBP 词根条目](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=mabuk)及 [DBP 构词说明](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/01/01/11474/)。

etymology.historical_story: Memabukkan is transparently formed within Malay from mabuk, with meN- and causative -kan. The dictionary records mabuk for both physical intoxication and figurative absorption. This connection helps explain how the derived verb can describe a drink that clouds the mind or success that overwhelms judgment, without requiring a separate borrowed origin. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=mabuk).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 mabuk（醉）：me-…-kan 把“醉”变成“使人醉”；memabukkan 就是“让人醉起来”。

etymology.historical_story: Membelanjakan is built from belanja, the base used in Malay expressions for expenses, shopping and treating someone. Its modern formation adds meN- and -kan, producing an active verb that takes money or an amount as its object. The related forms show how everyday purchasing vocabulary also serves the language of household budgets, company accounts and public expenditure.

etymology.historical_story: The form brings together two familiar Malay resources: the verb membenci and the shortened pronoun ku, from aku. The emotional force comes from placing the speaker directly inside the verb's object position. In literary dialogue, that compact ending can make an appeal feel especially personal; its structure needs no invented foreign origin.

senses.nuances: DBP百科使用 moose 这一名称；此处马来语释义为说明性综合，并非资料包所缺的《Kamus Dewan》原文。指驼鹿，不是麋鹿或驯鹿。英国英语 elk 可指同类动物，但北美英语 elk 通常指另一种鹿。IPA采用英语读音。[DBP百科相关条目](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=elk)，[Oxford词条](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/moose)。

etymology.historical_story: English borrowed moose in the early seventeenth century from an Abenaki word for the animal. The name travelled beyond its North American setting through English, eventually appearing in Malay reference writing. Its journey preserves an Indigenous animal name rather than a descriptive Malay compound, which is why it should be remembered as a whole. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/moose).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 /muːs/，一个音节：想象一头巨大驼鹿顶着两把宽宽的掌状鹿角。不要照字母拆读成多个音节。

word_family.gloss: 融化、稀释或资产变现的过程

senses.zh_definition: 使固体或凝固物融化，变成液体。
senses.en_definition: To cause a solid or congealed substance to melt.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu cair.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，宾语是被融化的物质；mencair 表示物质自身融化。冰、蜡和凝固油脂均适用。[DBP：cair 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=cair)

senses.zh_definition: 使液体变稀或降低其浓度，通常通过加入水或其他溶剂。
senses.en_definition: To dilute a liquid or make it less thick.
senses.ms_definition: Mengencerkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 强调由浓变稀，不一定涉及固液状态变化。需要明确表示降低浓度时，也可用 mengencerkan；表示溶质溶入溶剂时通常用 melarutkan。

senses.zh_definition: 将资产出售或转换为现金；使资产变现。
senses.en_definition: To convert assets into cash; to liquidate assets.
senses.ms_definition: Menukarkan aset kepada wang tunai.
senses.nuances: 经济用语。mencairkan aset 指资产变现，不必然意味着企业清盘；企业清盘通常用 penggulungan syarikat 表达。

senses.zh_definition: 使愤怒、情绪或精神力量减弱；消解或软化某种感受。
senses.en_definition: To lessen or weaken a feeling, emotion, or resolve.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan perasaan, semangat dan sebagainya berkurang atau lemah.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法。消解愤怒通常具有正面效果，削弱斗志则通常带负面意味；褒贬取决于宾语。该义见于 DBP，不能只理解成浪漫语境的“融化芳心”。

etymology.historical_story: Mencairkan belongs to the Malay cair family, whose meanings connect flowing liquids with things becoming less concentrated. Its causative morphology turns a change of state into an action performed on something. The dictionary also records financial conversion into cash and the weakening of feelings, linking physical fluidity with economic availability and emotional softening. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=cair)

word_family.gloss: 希望；所寄望的人或事物
期待；寄望的行为或状态

senses.zh_definition: 希望或期望获得某物，或期待某种结果发生。
senses.en_definition: To hope for or expect to obtain something or achieve a particular outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Menginginkan sesuatu atau menjangka akan memperolehnya.
senses.nuances: 强调对所盼结果的期待，不表示结果必然实现，也不等于提出要求。DBP 将 mengharap 与 mengharapkan 并列释义；接直接宾语时可见 mengharap balasan 等结构。[DBP：harap 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=harap)。

senses.zh_definition: 信赖某人或某种支持，并将事情的成败、生活或处境寄托其上；指望、依靠。
senses.en_definition: To count on someone or something and depend on their support or reliability.
senses.ms_definition: Menaruh kepercayaan kepada seseorang atau bergantung pada sokongan yang diharapkan.
senses.nuances: 此义突出依靠关系，与单纯希望得到某物有所区别；具体搭配仍可能因上下文而兼具两个义项。Jangan terlalu mengharap 可表达提醒，也可能让对方感到被冷落。义项依据 [DBP 的 mengharap／mengharapkan 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=harap)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records harap in older literary usage for a wish or desire. Modern mengharap builds on that base through the productive verbal prefix meN-. Its two meanings connect wanting a favourable outcome with trusting the person who might provide it. This documented relationship explains the word without requiring an unsupported claim about its ultimate origin.

etymology.historical_story: The root tampil means coming or stepping forward. Malay morphology turns that movement into a transitive action: menampilkan brings someone or something forward. DBP illustrates it with both a royal elephant being advanced and literary work being presented. These examples connect physical movement with the modern language of festivals, publicity, and artistic presentation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=tampil)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tampil 是自己上前；menampilkan 是把别人或作品推到台前。抓住 -kan 的推动感。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身中性，但用来评价他人住房可能带有夸张、羡慕或炫富意味；正式介绍宜客观描述建筑。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语一般用 rumah agam。旅游景点或建筑名称中的 Mansion 应保留官方拼写，不应仅凭名称推断建筑用途或现任住户的财富。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性，但用来评价他人住房可能带有夸张、羡慕或炫富意味；正式介绍宜客观描述建筑。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语一般用 rumah agam。旅游景点或建筑名称中的 Mansion 应保留官方拼写，不应仅凭名称推断建筑用途或现任住户的财富。

etymology.historical_story: Mansion entered English through French and ultimately belongs to the Latin family associated with staying or dwelling. Its earlier meanings included a place of residence, before the grand-house sense became familiar. The related French maison still means house. In Malay translation, rumah agam captures the scale and grandeur conveyed by the usual modern English meaning. [Oxford English Dictionary: mansion](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/8670723691)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mansion 读近“曼申”；想象门前慢慢伸展开一座大宅，记住 rumah agam＝豪宅。此联想仅用于记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入并作为词根使用；mo- 不是前缀，-ul 不是后缀。

word_family.gloss: 多个模块；多个学习单元
模块化的；相关借词，并非马来语后缀派生

senses.zh_definition: 模块；具有完整组成部分、承担特定功能，并可与其他单元组合成更大系统的独立单元。
senses.en_definition: A self-contained functional unit that can be combined with others to form a larger system.
senses.ms_definition: Unit lengkap yang menjalankan fungsi tertentu dan boleh digabungkan dengan unit lain untuk membentuk sistem yang lebih besar.
senses.nuances: 用于设备、电子系统、软件等领域。重点是功能上的独立性和组合性，并非任何零件都适合称为 modul。马来语释义依据输入的 DBP 释义整理。

senses.zh_definition: 课程模块；可独立实施、具有特定学习目标的教学或培训单元。
senses.en_definition: A self-contained unit of teaching or training within a course or programme.
senses.ms_definition: Unit pengajaran, pembelajaran atau latihan yang mempunyai tujuan tertentu dan boleh dilaksanakan secara tersendiri dalam sesuatu program.
senses.nuances: 教育语境中也常用来指承载该单元内容的教材或练习资料；不一定等于整门课程或整本课本。参见 [MQA 课程标准中的术语表](https://www2.mqa.gov.my/qad/PS/PS%20CMM%20%28BM%29.pdf)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 交代任务时应明确是阅读模块、完成其中的练习，还是提交作业，避免只说 siapkan modul 而让参与者误解要求。

etymology.historical_story: Modul belongs to an international vocabulary represented by English module, whose ancestry leads to Latin modulus, a small measure. The useful connecting idea is a bounded unit within a larger arrangement. In modern Malay, that idea serves both technical systems and education: a machine can contain modules, and a training programme can contain learning modules. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/module).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: modul 联想英语 module，再连到中文“模块”：系统的一块、课程的一单元。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的直接基项 mengajak；更深层词根为 ajak。meN- 在元音前表现为 meng-。-ku 是 aku 的后附形式，此处作宾语“我”，并非领属语；拼写保留词基末尾 k，因而出现 kk。输入的 Jawi 对应 mengajak，未包含 -ku。

senses.zh_definition: 邀请我、约我或提议让我一同前往某处或参与某项活动。
senses.en_definition: Invite me, ask me along, or suggest that I join an activity.
senses.ms_definition: Mempelawa aku supaya turut pergi ke sesuatu tempat atau turut melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 重点是一同前往或参与；不能笼统理解为“问我”。-ku 指被邀请的“我”，时态由上下文确定。正式机关邀请有时用 menjemput 更合适。[DBP：ajak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ajak)

senses.zh_definition: 激起我的参与意愿；向我发出辩论、打斗等挑战。
senses.en_definition: Urge me to take part, or challenge me to a contest or confrontation.
senses.ms_definition: Membangkitkan hatiku untuk melakukan sesuatu atau mencabar aku supaya melakukannya.
senses.nuances: 与 berdebat、bertumbuk 等搭配时，可表示挑战，而非友善邀请。mengajakku berdebat 的语气仍须结合上下文判断。[DBP：ajak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ajak)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 属于 aku 系列，适合熟人交流、个人叙述和文学表达。向上级或陌生人正式自述时，mengajak saya 通常更合适。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 属于 aku 系列，适合熟人交流、个人叙述和文学表达。向上级或陌生人正式自述时，mengajak saya 通常更合适。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 普通邀约可自然使用；mengajakku keluar 不一定表示约会。公文中若保留 mengajakku，宜用于个人引语等符合 aku 语体的部分。

etymology.historical_story: Mengajakku brings together the verb mengajak and the short first-person pronoun -ku. The dictionary connects ajak with both invitations and challenges, so the same grammatical shape can introduce a shared meal or a confrontation. The ending identifies the speaker as the person being approached; it does not itself express possession, past time, or politeness. [DBP：ajak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ajak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 ajak“约、邀”，再看末尾 ku＝aku“我”：mengajakku 就是“邀我”。遇到 bertumbuk，友善的“邀我”就变成了“找我打架”。

morphology.formula: menanggung + -nya → menanggungnya；内部构词：meN- + tanggung → menanggung
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按词包保留直接基式 menanggung；更底层词根是 tanggung。meN- 接 tanggung 时，词首 t 脱落，形成 menanggung；-nya 是第三人称附着代词，不是派生后缀，此处按字段归入 suffix。音节为补充分音；词包 jawi 实际只写了 menanggung，完整 menanggungnya 应写作 منڠݢوڠڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 把它扛在肩上；肩负该重物。
senses.en_definition: To carry it on the shoulder.
senses.ms_definition: Membawa barang yang dimaksudkan di atas bahu; memikulnya.
senses.nuances: -nya 的具体所指由上下文决定，可对应它、他、她或他们。以下搭配用基式 menanggung 展示常见搭配；接 -nya 后通常不再重复同一个宾语。[DBP 基式释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menanggung)

senses.zh_definition: 承受它；遭受所指的痛苦、损失、困难或情绪煎熬。

senses.ms_definition: Mengalami atau menahan kesusahan, kerugian, kesakitan atau penderitaan yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 强调负面经历落在主体身上；不一定出于自愿。menanggung rindu 还可描写相思煎熬。

senses.zh_definition: 【比喻，较少见】把它藏在心里；保守所指的秘密。

senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, menyimpan rahsia yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 偏文学语体；日常表达保密通常用 menyimpan rahsia。[DBP 比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menanggung)

senses.zh_definition: 负担所指的费用；供养所指的人。
senses.en_definition: To pay the expense concerned or financially support the person concerned.
senses.ms_definition: Membiayai perbelanjaan atau menyara orang yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 前文若提到 kos，menanggungnya 指承担该费用；若提到受供养者，则指供养该人。

senses.zh_definition: 背负所指的债务、风险或其他负担。
senses.en_definition: To bear the debt, risk, or burden concerned.
senses.ms_definition: Memikul hutang, risiko atau beban yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 可描述现有负债或所承受的风险，并不自动表示已经付款或已经发生损失。

senses.zh_definition: 保障所指对象的安全、安宁或相关利益。
senses.en_definition: To safeguard or guarantee the safety or welfare concerned.
senses.ms_definition: Menjamin keselamatan atau kesejahteraan yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 属于保障义；现代正式表达中，menjamin keselamatan 通常更直接。

senses.zh_definition: 为所指的人或事物作保；保证其品质、真实性或某事的确定性。
senses.en_definition: To vouch for the person or thing concerned, or assure its quality, authenticity, or certainty.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan akuan tentang kebaikan, keaslian atau kepastian perkara yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 这是作出保证，不等于支付费用；具体保证内容须由上下文明确。

collocations.en: vouch for the quality of goods
be prepared to vouch for something

senses.zh_definition: 为所指的贷款或他人义务提供担保，承诺在对方不履行时承担。
senses.en_definition: To guarantee the loan or another person's obligation concerned.
senses.ms_definition: Menjamin pemenuhan kewajipan orang lain jika orang itu tidak menunaikannya.
senses.nuances: 涉及替他人担保的语境；与单纯供养某人不同。

senses.zh_definition: 为所指的事情负责；承担其责任或后果。
senses.en_definition: To take responsibility for the matter or bear its consequences.
senses.ms_definition: Memikul tanggungjawab atau akibat perkara yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 常用于决定、行为及其后果；既可主动承诺，也可强调责任不能推卸。

etymology.historical_story: The underlying Malay base is tanggung. Its meanings connect a load carried on the shoulder with burdens carried through life: expenses, hardship, debts, and responsibility. Menanggung adds the active verbal prefix, while -nya points back to an understood object. This semantic connection explains the word's range without requiring an invented foreign origin or an unsupported historical date.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住肩上的担子：tanggung 是担，menanggung 是承担，-nya 是前面提过的它或他；menanggungnya 就是把那份担子承担下来。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 /d/ 前采用 men- 形式，词根首辅音 d 保留。IPA 采用保留 r 和词尾 /a/ 的宽式读音。

senses.zh_definition: 自愿捐献金钱、物品、血液或个人劳力等，以帮助他人或支持公益。

etymology.historical_story: The noun derma names a voluntary gift, and Malay builds menderma from it with the productive prefix meN-. The dictionary includes giving one's effort to care for sick people, showing that generosity need not involve money. Modern blood donation campaigns provide another familiar setting for the same verb, linking personal contribution with community welfare.

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在双唇辅音 b 前变为 mem-；词根起首的 b 保留，形成 /mb/。

etymology.historical_story: Membungkus joins the active verb prefix meN- to bungkus, whose dictionary meanings include wrapping material and a wrapped parcel. The dictionary mentions paper, cloth and leaves, grounding the word in familiar material practices. Its further meanings extend physical enclosure into concealment and capture; these are semantic connections, not a dated account of their historical development. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=membungkus+1)

etymology.historical_story: The pinjam family presents borrowing from different viewpoints. Meminjam normally follows the person receiving temporary use, while meminjamkan follows the person providing it. The dictionary's illustration involves lending rice or money to neighbours, placing the word in a familiar setting of practical help. Its structure offers a reliable explanation without requiring a speculative origin story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住方向：meminjam 是“借进来”，meminjamkan 是“借出去”；看到 -kan，就想把东西交到别人手上。

etymology.historical_story: Menular belongs to the tular word family. Malay dictionaries record its use for diseases spreading and for undesirable influences extending through society. Contemporary discussion also uses tular for viral online content. The shared image is movement from one person or place to another, making an established vocabulary of transmission useful in digital communication.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 tular 的 t 被鼻音 n 接替：tular → menular。想象消息或病原体从一个点接着传到下一个点。

etymology.historical_story: The base doa comes from Arabic duʿāʾ, meaning supplication. Malay builds mendoakan with its own verbal morphology, turning the borrowed noun into an action directed toward a person or desired outcome. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic base, while everyday pronunciation often simplifies the consonant heard between the two vowels in Arabic. [Wiktionary: doa](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/doa), [DBP/PRPM: mendoakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mendoakan)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 doa＝祈祷：berdoa 是“在祈祷”，mendoakan 则把祈祷指向具体的人或愿望——为谁祈求、祈求什么。

etymology.historical_story: Institutional initials often travel unchanged into Malay educational writing. Malaysia's higher-education glossary lists MIT for Massachusetts Institute of Technology, illustrating how an English institutional name can appear inside Malay prose. However, a lowercase corpus token loses useful capitalization. The packet alone cannot establish whether this occurrence is that initialism, another abbreviation or an unrelated form.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若确认指该校，就把 M、I、T 对应 Massachusetts、Institute、Technology；先查全称，再记简称，不把 mit 猜读成普通马来语单词。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves two strikingly different uses of melaksanakan: a classical literary sense involving comparison, and the familiar modern sense of carrying out work or plans. Melaksanakannya adds the attached pronoun -nya to that verb. This lets a speaker refer back to an entire previously mentioned plan without repeating its name; the dictionary does not establish a direct historical transition between the senses.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 melaksanakan，想起“落实”；尾巴 -nya 指回“那件事”：melaksanakan + -nya → 把它落实。

etymology.historical_story: DBP marks ingkar as an Arabic borrowing. Malay builds mengingkari from that borrowed base using its own productive affixes, while related nouns name refusal or denial. The resulting verb connects several everyday moral situations: rejecting a truth, disobeying an instruction and breaking a promise. These uses explain its often serious tone without making every occurrence a religious statement.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ingkar 联想到“硬抗”：对事实硬是否认，对命令硬是不从，对承诺则是违背；meN-…-i 把它构成及物动词。

morphology.pattern_note: c 前 meN- 写作 men-，c 保留；-nya 是附着式宾语代词，不是派生后缀，因此不是环缀。受枚举限制，affix_type 按派生前缀标为 prefix。输入的 mencipta 是直接基础形式，真正词根为 cipta；输入爪夷文漏写 -nya，此处补为 ڽ。

senses.ms_definition: Menghasilkan sesuatu yang dirujuk oleh -nya dengan menggunakan daya fikiran atau imaginasi.
senses.nuances: 这是 mencipta 加宾语 -nya 的形式，不是新的独立词义。-nya 不表示动作执行者是“他”，也不标示过去时；主语与时间由句子提供。语义可涵盖设计、发明及艺术创作；神学语境中也可指创造某个生命或事物。[DBP 基础词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=cipta)

etymology.historical_story: The deeper history of cipta connects creative activity with thought. Research on Sanskrit loans traces Javanese cipta to Sanskrit citta, meaning mind or thought, and describes its extension toward creation. Malay mencipta expresses producing through imagination. Adding -nya supplies a contextual object; it does not create a separate historical root. [Linguistic research](https://doi.nrct.go.th/ListDoi/Download/180309?Resolve_DOI=10.14457%2FMU.the.2010.169)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 cipta＝创造，再套公式：mencipta＝创造，menciptanya＝把它创造出来；nya 把前文对象接回来。

etymology.historical_story: Mengutus is formed from utus, which Malay dictionaries record in the classical sense of a messenger or representative. The same family includes utusan, an envoy, and perutusan, a delegation or formal message. This links sending a person with sending words: both carry something on another person's behalf. [DBP: utus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=utus)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 utus 想成一位领命出发的使者：mengutus wakil 派人，mengutus surat 寄信，核心都是“替我把人或话送过去”。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 g 前实现为 meng-，原有 g 保留，形成 /ŋɡ/。输入的 gandakan 是已带 -kan 的形式，基础词根为 ganda。[DBP：ganda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ganda)

senses.zh_definition: 使数量、程度或强度达到原来的两倍；在概括性表达中也指成倍提高或加强。
senses.en_definition: To double an amount, degree, or intensity; more broadly, to multiply or intensify.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan jumlah atau kadar sesuatu dua kali nilai asal; secara umum, meningkatkan sesuatu secara berlipat.
senses.nuances: 严格数量语境中的基本义是变为原来的两倍，即增加百分之一百。menggandakan usaha 常表示加强努力，不一定精确计量；需要更大倍数时宜明确说明。

senses.zh_definition: 重复已有的话语或形式；在文件、材料等语境中指制作副本。
senses.en_definition: To repeat an utterance or form, or to reproduce something as a copy.
senses.ms_definition: Mengulang perkataan atau bentuk tertentu, atau menghasilkan salinan sesuatu bahan.
senses.nuances: 这是使原有内容再次出现的引申义，不一定表示总数恰好变为两倍。一般口语中的“再说一次”更常用 ulang；文件复制也常用 menyalin 或 membuat salinan。

etymology.historical_story: Menggandakan is built from ganda, a Malay word expressing doubling and multiples. Its dictionary examples connect measurable change, such as doubled pressure, with repeating words. The shared idea is making an original occur again or in greater quantity. Modern document copying and grammatical reduplication fit this same productive word family. [DBP: ganda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ganda)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ganda＝倍，再把 meN-…-kan 看作“使它变成”：menggandakan 就是把一份变两份，或让原有内容再出现。

morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包保留直接基词 mengganggu，最底层词根是 ganggu。meN- 在 g 前成为 meng-，保留 g；-mu 是表示第二人称宾语的附着代词，并非派生词缀，此处 suffix 仅表示其后接位置。资料包的 مڠݢڠݢو 只对应 mengganggu；完整词形补写 -mu 为 مو。

word_family.gloss: 干扰者；造成干扰的事物

senses.zh_definition: 打扰你；使你不能安静、专心或自在地做事。
senses.en_definition: To disturb or bother you, interrupting your peace or attention.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusik atau mengacau kamu sehingga ketenteraman atau perhatian kamu terganggu.
senses.nuances: -mu 在这里相当于 kamu，作宾语“你”，并非物主“你的”。可用于礼貌道歉，也可描述令人烦扰的行为。义项依据 mengganggu，并结合附着代词解释：[DBP：mengganggu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=mengganggu)；[DBP：mu 的连写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mu)。

senses.zh_definition: 逗弄你、纠缠你或骚扰你；具体轻重由行为及语境决定。
senses.en_definition: To tease, pester, or harass you.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusik, mempermain-mainkan atau menggoda kamu, termasuk dengan perlakuan yang tidak kamu senangi.
senses.nuances: 既可指熟人之间的逗弄，也可指不受欢迎的纠缠；本词本身不必然表示性骚扰。不能仅因施事称其为玩笑，就推定对方愿意接受。

senses.zh_definition: 妨碍你，使你的行动、工作或其他活动无法顺利进行。
senses.en_definition: To hinder you or prevent you from carrying out an activity smoothly.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalang kamu daripada melakukan sesuatu dengan lancar atau sebagaimana yang sepatutnya.
senses.nuances: 着重活动受到阻碍，主语可以是噪声、疼痛或其他情况，不一定是有意打扰的人。与第一义的区别在于强调行动受阻，而非仅感到烦扰。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Saya memohon maaf kerana mengganggumu ketika kamu sedang menyediakan laporan tahunan.

dual_scenarios.en: Sorry to bother you; I just have a quick question.

je 对应 sahaja。
aku 适用于熟人关系。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Maaf mengganggumu 可用于熟悉的人。面对上司、客户或不熟悉的长辈，通常用 Maaf mengganggu, puan/tuan 或姓名、职衔更稳妥；-mu 本身不表示尊称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合个人通信、熟人对话和文学表达。描述持续纠缠时，应区分双方接受的玩笑与不受欢迎的骚扰。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Maaf mengganggumu 可用于熟悉的人。面对上司、客户或不熟悉的长辈，通常用 Maaf mengganggu, puan/tuan 或姓名、职衔更稳妥；-mu 本身不表示尊称。

etymology.historical_story: This form brings together two productive Malay resources: the active verb mengganggu and the attached pronoun -mu. The pronoun lets a writer address someone directly within a single written word. Such compact address is familiar in personal writing and songs, while everyday conversation often uses a separate pronoun. No specific ancient origin for ganggu is asserted here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mengganggu＝打扰，词尾 mu＝你：mengganggumu 就是“打扰你”。

morphology.formula: memburu + -nya → memburunya；基础构词：meN- + buru → memburu
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基础 memburu；更底层词根为 buru。meN- 在 /b/ 前取 mem-，保留 b；-nya 读 /ɲa/，是附着代词，此处通常充当宾语。完整音节为 mem.bu.ru.nya。输入 Jawi ممبورو 对应 memburu，尚未包含 -nya。

word_family.gloss: 猎物；追捕或追求的对象

senses.zh_definition: 追捕他、她或它；追赶前文提及的人或动物，意图将其捕获。
senses.en_definition: To hunt or pursue him, her, or it with the aim of capture.
senses.ms_definition: Mengejar orang atau haiwan yang telah disebut untuk menangkapnya.
senses.nuances: -nya 不区分性别，具体指谁须由上下文判断；本词本身不表示已经捕获，也不必然表示杀死。通常用于追捕、狩猎或叙事，不等同于普通的寻找。基础义参见 [PRPM：memburu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=memburu)。

collocations.en: still be hunting him or it

senses.zh_definition: 竭力追求它；努力取得前文提及的机会、成就、财富或其他目标。
senses.en_definition: To strive eagerly to obtain or achieve something previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Berusaha bersungguh-sungguh untuk memperoleh atau mencapai sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 此处 -nya 指代所追求的目标，例如 kejayaan 或 peluang，语气比 mencarinya 更突出主动追求。memburu 的基础词还可表示奔赶或催促，但这些用法不能自动套入带宾语 -nya 的本义。参见 [PRPM：memburu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=memburu)。

etymology.historical_story: Memburunya illustrates how Malay builds meaning around the hunting root buru. The active prefix produces memburu, while attached -nya identifies the person, animal, or goal being pursued. Dictionary usage connects literal hunting with the pursuit of wealth and position, making the hunter’s movement a useful image for ambition. See [PRPM: memburu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=memburu).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 buru＝追猎，mem- 让动作展开，-nya 把目标指出来：memburunya＝追捕他／它，或追求那个目标。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整植物名称记忆，不拆成 mau 与 ra；未据现有材料确认常用派生词，故词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 一种树的马来名称，所给词典将其对应为 Mastixia rostrata；此处以学名明确所指。
senses.en_definition: A Malay vernacular name for the tree identified in the supplied dictionary entry as Mastixia rostrata.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis tumbuhan berupa pokok, Mastixia rostrata.
senses.nuances: 罕见植物俗名，不是所有树木的统称，也不是 muara（河口）的异体。下列搭配是实用植物描述短语，不代表已有高频语料证据。学名所指植物见 [PROSEA：Mastixia rostrata](https://prosea.prota4u.org/view.aspx?id=5810)。

etymology.historical_story: Maura belongs to the vocabulary of local tree names rather than a transparent productive word family. PROSEA records several other regional names for Mastixia rostrata across its Southeast Asian range, illustrating how one botanical species can carry different community names. The supplied dictionary preserves maura, but the evidence consulted does not establish the name's original linguistic source or literal meaning. [PROSEA: Mastixia rostrata](https://prosea.prota4u.org/view.aspx?id=5810)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mau-ra 与一张树木标签绑定：maura → Mastixia rostrata。另记 mu-a-ra 才是“河口”，不要把字母次序看反。

morphology.formula: ∅ + menyendiri → menyendiri（保留输入的整词归根方式）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入将本词作为整词词根；实际派生关系为 meN- + sendiri → menyendiri：词首 s 脱落，前缀实现为 meny-，ny 表示 /ɲ/。不能据输入归根方式理解为语言学上的不可分析词根。

word_family.gloss: 自己；独自；本词的实际派生基底

senses.zh_definition: 独处；独自待着或生活，避开他人的陪伴或交往。
senses.en_definition: To spend time or live alone, or to withdraw from other people's company.
senses.ms_definition: Duduk seorang diri atau mengasingkan diri daripada orang lain.
senses.nuances: 可指短暂主动独处，也可指持续离群，褒贬取决于语境；不必然表示孤独、抑郁或讨厌别人。与 sendiri 表示“自己做某事”不同，menyendiri 本身表示独处或疏离交往。参见 [DBP：menyendiri](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=menyendiri)。

etymology.historical_story: Menyendiri belongs to the Malay sendiri family, which includes words for being alone, privacy, and a person who keeps to themselves. Its formation follows a regular sound pattern: meN- replaces the initial s of sendiri with ny. The resulting verb turns the idea of being by oneself into an activity or way of living. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=menyendiri)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 sendiri＝独自，再把 s 换成 ny 并加 me-：menyendiri＝让自己独自待着。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 保留数据包索引值；实际词根为 lantun（لنتون）。meN- 在 l 前采用 me- 形式，l 保留，不发生词根首辅音脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 反弹；物体碰到地面或其他表面后弹起、弹回。
senses.en_definition: To bounce or rebound after striking a surface.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak semula menjauhi sesuatu permukaan selepas mengenainya; memantul atau menganjal.
senses.nuances: 通常是不及物动词：bola melantun。若主语使另一个物体反弹，可用 melantunkan bola。不要混同印尼语中 melantunkan lagu 的演唱用法；本条采用马来西亚 DBP 所列反弹义。参见[DBP：lantun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lantun)。

senses.zh_definition: 反过来落到某人身上；问题、指责等转而指向原先提出它的人。
senses.en_definition: To rebound figuratively upon someone, especially the person who raised a question or accusation.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, berbalik mengenai seseorang, khususnya pihak yang mengemukakan persoalan atau tuduhan.
senses.nuances: 常与 balik、semula 或 kepada 连用，通过弹回的空间意象表达言论反过来指向提出者；并非所有失败都适合称为 melantun。此比喻义见[DBP：lantun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lantun)。

etymology.historical_story: Melantun is transparently formed from lantun with the Malay verbal prefix meN-, appearing here as me-. DBP records both a physical rebound and a figurative return upon someone. The second meaning turns an ordinary bouncing movement into a social image: a question sent outward can come back to confront its original asker. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lantun)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lan-tun 读成球落地后的两拍：落下、弹回；问题也能这样 melantun，绕回来问到自己。

morphology.formula: meN- + pedulikan → mempedulikan；完整分析：meN- + peduli + -kan → mempedulikan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 沿用数据包中的直接构词基础 pedulikan；更深层词根为 peduli（ڤدولي）。meN- 在此表现为 mem-，但词首 p 保留；应整体记住马来西亚规范形式 mempedulikan，不可机械地套用 p 脱落规则。-kan 已包含在 pedulikan 中。

senses.zh_definition: 关注、理会或把某人、某事放在心上；对其给予注意。
senses.en_definition: To care about, pay attention to, or take notice of someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Mengambil perhatian akan sesuatu atau seseorang; mengendahkan.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常直接接宾语，如 mempedulikan nasihat。常出现在 tidak、tanpa 或 enggan 等否定、缺失语境中，但词本身没有否定意义。根据宾语可译为“关心”“在意”或“理会”，不一定表示实际照料。两项基本义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=peduli)。

collocations.en: without regard for one's own safety

senses.zh_definition: 介入、过问或插手别人的事情；是否带有负面意味取决于语境。
senses.en_definition: To involve oneself in or interfere with other people's affairs.
senses.ms_definition: Turut campur dalam hal orang lain dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 此义的重点是介入事务，不只是表达关怀。用于 hal orang lain 或 urusan orang lain 时，常有“多管闲事”的暗示；若明确要批评干涉，mencampuri 更直接。

collocations.en: involve oneself in other people's affairs

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论他人私事时，应区分关怀与干涉。若只是表达愿意提供帮助，mengambil berat 更温和；指责别人不关心时，最好说明具体行为，避免把一次疏忽说成人格缺陷。

etymology.historical_story: Peduli is traced to Arabic fuḍūlī, associated with curiosity or inquisitiveness. In Malay, attention can mean either caring about something or involving oneself in another person’s affairs. Mempedulikan preserves that useful distinction: concern and meddling may involve similar attention, while context determines whether the involvement is welcome. Source: [Uni’s study of Arabic-origin Malay vocabulary](https://oarep.usim.edu.my/server/api/core/bitstreams/b38963e9-99b5-417c-af79-7f0f570e28db/content).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 peduli 记成“心里有放着”：mempedulikan 是“把事情放在心上、去理会”；前面一加 tak 或 tidak，就成了“不理会”。注意 /pə/ 中的 e 读轻短的 /ə/。

morphology.formula: ∅ + matriks → matriks（作为完整借词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根使用，不拆成 ma-、trik 或复数 -s；结尾 /ks/ 属于词干。音节为 ma.triks，tr 和 ks 均保留辅音群。Jawi 字段依数据包保留原有空格。

senses.zh_definition: 某种社会、思想、生命体或其他事物得以产生和发展的环境、背景或孕育框架。
senses.en_definition: An environment or context within which something originates or develops.
senses.ms_definition: Persekitaran atau konteks tempat sesuatu, seperti masyarakat, organisma atau fahaman, berkembang.
senses.nuances: 这是数据包所引《Kamus Dewan》的抽象义，常见于学术分析。在一般交流中，konteks、persekitaran 或 kerangka 往往更容易理解。此义与数学上的数字排列应区分。词典同时收录抽象义和数学义，见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=matriks)。

collocations.zh: 文化环境；文化孕育框架

senses.zh_definition: 数学中的矩阵：按行和列排列成矩形结构的数或其他数学元素。
senses.en_definition: A rectangular array of numbers or other mathematical elements arranged in rows and columns.
senses.ms_definition: Susunan nombor atau unsur matematik yang teratur dalam baris dan lajur.
senses.nuances: 这是《Kamus Pelajar》及数学术语中的常用义；定义在词典“有序数字排列”的基础上展开。矩阵本身是数学对象，penentu 指行列式，两者不能互换。单复数由上下文或数词体现，如 satu matriks、dua matriks。

senses.zh_definition: 按两个或多个维度组织、比较或对应信息的矩阵表，常用于风险评估、任务分工和决策。
senses.en_definition: A structured table that relates or compares information across dimensions, especially for assessment or planning.
senses.ms_definition: Jadual berstruktur yang memadankan atau membandingkan maklumat mengikut beberapa dimensi untuk penilaian atau perancangan.
senses.nuances: 这是矩阵结构在管理和信息组织中的应用，不一定涉及矩阵代数。例如风险矩阵将发生可能性与影响程度交叉对应。马来西亚官方用例见 [公共工程局风险管理指南](https://jpak.jkr.gov.my/documents/garispanduan/GARIS%20PANDUAN%20PELAN%20PENGURUSAN%20RISIKO%20ASET%20TAK%20ALIH%20%28GP%20PPRATA%29.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 材料科学中的基体：包围、结合并支撑增强材料或其他分散成分的连续材料相。
senses.en_definition: The continuous material phase that surrounds, binds, and supports reinforcement or other dispersed components.
senses.ms_definition: Fasa bahan berterusan yang mengelilingi, mengikat dan menyokong bahan pengukuh atau komponen terdispersi dalam sesuatu bahan.
senses.nuances: 这是材料科学专门义，中文通常译为“基体”，不译为数学意义的“矩阵”。例如聚合物基复合材料中的树脂可充当 matriks。术语使用见 [DBP《Pembuatan Produk Komposit Berasaskan Matriks Polimer》](https://jendeladbp.my/ujana/pembuatan-produk-komposit-berasaskan-matriks-polimer/)。

senses.zh_definition: 生物学中的基质：为细胞或组织提供结构支持和相互作用环境的物质，尤其见于细胞外基质。
senses.en_definition: A biological material that provides structural support and an environment for cells or tissues, especially an extracellular matrix.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan asas yang memberikan sokongan struktur serta persekitaran interaksi kepada sel atau tisu, khususnya matriks ekstrasel.
senses.nuances: 这是生物学专门义，中文通常译为“基质”。matriks ekstrasel 指细胞外的支持性物质体系，并非数字表格。马来西亚研究用语见 [《Sains Malaysiana》相关论文](https://www.ukm.edu.my/jsm/pdf_files/SM-PDF-52-6-2023/13.pdf)。

collocations.zh: 细胞外基质的组织构建

etymology.historical_story: Matriks belongs to an international word family ultimately connected with Latin matrix, meaning womb. In 1850, James Joseph Sylvester used matrix for a mathematical array from which determinants could be generated. The image of a nurturing container helps connect the modern meanings: a context supports development, a material matrix holds components, and an array organizes mathematical elements. Source: [IMPA on mathematical terminology](https://impa.br/notices/in-folha-de-s-paulo-the-origins-of-mathematical-terms/?lang=en).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ma-triks，联想英语 matrix：把数字放进格子是“矩阵”，把成分包在材料里是“基体”，让思想生长的背景是“孕育环境”。结尾读 /ks/，不是 /kis/。

etymology.historical_story: Mikasa is documented as a commercial name rather than an ordinary Malay vocabulary item. The sports manufacturer's history records sales under the name Mikasa Balls in 1935 and adoption of the corporate name Mikasa Corporation in 2001. This explains one route by which the name appears in discussions of sporting equipment. [Company history](https://mikasasports.co.jp/e/company/history/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mi-ka-sa 当作球面上的三拍品牌名来记：看到 Mikasa，先识别专名，再靠上下文确定对象。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留输入包的直接基底 memerlukan，最终词根是 perlu。meN- 遇词首 p 时实现为 mem-，p 脱落；-mu 是后附的第二人称代词，此处作宾语“你”，并非派生后缀。输入包的 ممرلوکن 仅对应 memerlukan；完整词形按规则补为 ممرلوکنمو。

senses.zh_definition: 需要你；需要你的陪伴、支持、能力或参与。
senses.en_definition: To need you, whether for your presence, support, abilities, or participation.
senses.ms_definition: Memerlukan kamu atau menghendaki kehadiran, bantuan, kebolehan atau penglibatan kamu.
senses.nuances: 这是 memerlukan 与宾语代词 -mu 的组合，不是一个具有独立新增词义的词根。既可表达感情依赖，也可表达实际需要；不能一律译为“爱你”。输入包中 memerlukan 的其他释义不能机械套到这个带有人称宾语的形式上。释义为依照基词义项综合转述。[DBP：perlu 与 memerlukan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=perlu)、[DBP：附着代词的连写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+terima)。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates how Malay packages an action and its personal object into one written word. Perlu supplies the idea of necessity; meN- and -kan form memerlukan; attached -mu identifies the person needed. The resulting expression can sound intimate or rhetorical, although its meaning also permits entirely practical dependence. [DBP clitic guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+terima).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 perlu“需要”，再看词尾 -mu“你”：memerlukanmu＝需要你。-mu 在动词后是宾语，不要译成“你的需要”。

morphology.pattern_note: merak 是完整词根，不能拆成 me- + rak；输入包的 rak 分析有误。首音节 e 为央元音 /ə/，词末 /k/ 在常见马来西亚读法中实现为 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 孔雀；尤指绿孔雀，雄鸟羽色鲜艳，展开尾屏时形似扇面。也用于其他孔雀类的名称。
senses.en_definition: A peafowl, especially the green peafowl, whose male displays a colourful, fan-shaped train.
senses.ms_definition: Burung besar, khususnya Pavo muticus, yang jantannya mempunyai bulu berwarna-warni dan mengembangkan ekor seperti kipas.
senses.nuances: 泛指鸟类时不必然限定雄性；明确性别可说 merak jantan 或 merak betina。merak pongsu 指孔雀雉类，不应直接等同于 Pavo 属孔雀。各义项的马来语释义均为转述。[DBP：merak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=merak)。

senses.zh_definition: 植物名称用语：bunga merak 指开红、黄等色花的观赏植物洋金凤；bunga merak hutan 则指另一种植物。
senses.en_definition: A plant-name element: bunga merak denotes the peacock flower, Caesalpinia pulcherrima; bunga merak hutan denotes Ixora pendula.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam nama tumbuhan, bunga merak ialah Caesalpinia pulcherrima, manakala bunga merak hutan ialah Ixora pendula.
senses.nuances: 日常园艺语境宜用完整名称 bunga merak。bunga merak hutan 是不同植物，不能仅凭共同名称将两者视为同一种。[DBP 植物义项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=merak)。

collocations.zh: 野生孔雀花，指 Ixora pendula

senses.zh_definition: 和蔼而亲切的；用于带爪哇语标记的表达 merak hati。
senses.en_definition: Pleasant and friendly, in the Javanese-marked expression merak hati.
senses.ms_definition: Manis dan peramah, dalam ungkapan merak hati yang bertanda penggunaan Jawa.
senses.nuances: 这是受限于特定表达的少见用法，不能当作现代通用形容词随意替换 ramah。第二项搭配是展示句法的组合，不声称属于高频固定搭配。[DBP：merak III](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=merak)。

senses.zh_definition: 傲慢的；自负、爱摆架子的。用于槟城方言。
senses.en_definition: Arrogant or conceited, in Penang dialect.
senses.ms_definition: Sombong atau berlagak, dalam dialek Pulau Pinang.
senses.nuances: 这是地区方言义，不代表标准马来语中 merak 的一般含义；merak buih 表示程度更强的傲慢、摆架子。所列搭配据方言词汇记录，不代表全国通用高频搭配。[DBP 槟城方言词汇](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=merak)。

etymology.historical_story: Peafowl occupy a vivid place in Malay verbal culture. DBP records merak in pantun and in a proverb about a peacock displaying in the forest, where its performance finds an unappreciative audience. This cultural history explains a memorable image, but does not establish a foreign etymon or justify splitting merak into affixes. [DBP cultural examples](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=merak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mə-rak 的两个音节连成一只完整孔雀，看到它啪地展开扇形尾屏；整词记 merak，不拆成 me- 和 rak。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 i 起首，meN- 采用 meng-，词根保留；加 -i 后，末尾 ng 与 i 连读为 /ŋi/。输入包将整个派生词判作词根，此处依据实际构词关系更正。[DBP：imbang 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=imbang)

word_family.gloss: 平衡；起平衡作用的事物

senses.zh_definition: 对某事物起平衡、抵消或补偿作用，使其影响得到调节。
senses.en_definition: To counterbalance or offset something.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi sebagai imbangan kepada sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，宾语通常是需要抵消的影响、成本或不足。mengimbangi 着重某因素起到的平衡作用；mengimbangkan 更直接表示使事物达到平衡。

senses.zh_definition: 以相应的能力、力量或作用抗衡另一方；与之匹敌。
senses.en_definition: To match or counter an opposing force, ability, or effect.
senses.ms_definition: Menandingi atau melawani sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 强调力量或作用能否与对方相抗衡，不表示一定胜过对方。常见于体育、竞争和对抗性环境。

senses.zh_definition: 以相应的善意、感情或行动回报他人的恩惠、爱意等。
senses.en_definition: To reciprocate kindness, affection, or a similar benefit.
senses.ms_definition: Membalas budi, cinta atau perkara yang seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 此义较书面，日常表达更常使用 membalas budi 或 membalas kasih sayang。重点是回应他人的付出，不必涉及金钱偿还。

etymology.historical_story: The Malay root imbang connects physical balance with matching strength and returning kindness. Mengimbangi applies that relationship to an object: one thing answers the weight, effect, or generosity of another. This provides a useful cultural bridge between practical balance and reciprocal social relationships, without requiring a separate origin for each meaning. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=imbang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住词根 imbang“平衡”：想象天平另一端放上配重，mengimbangi 就是“用相应力量把它抵住”。

headword.status_note: PRPM 所核实的是英语形容词 mere，并非普通马来语词。输入包中的 syllables 值 n 不是有效音节划分，故更正为 null。以下限定为该英语形容词；输入缺少语境，不能据此排除其他语言或同形词。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不可把开头 me- 误拆为马来语前缀；英式非卷舌读法通常为单音节 /mɪə/。下列词族属于英语，不属于马来语派生系统。

word_family.gloss: 极微小的；哪怕一点点的，用于特定英语强调结构

senses.zh_definition: 仅仅的；只不过是的，强调数量少、程度低或重要性有限。
senses.en_definition: Being only the amount or thing specified, often implying that it is small or unimportant.
senses.ms_definition: Kata sifat bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud hanya atau sekadar, untuk menekankan jumlah yang kecil atau kepentingan yang terbatas.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项的马来文说明，不是官方马来语释义。英语 mere 一般放在名词短语前；翻译成马来语时常用 hanya、cuma 或 sekadar。以下搭配明确标示为英语原短语。[DBP：mere](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mere)

collocations.ms: a mere formality — bahasa Inggeris; BM: sekadar formaliti
a mere coincidence — bahasa Inggeris; BM: hanya suatu kebetulan

senses.zh_definition: 单单的；仅凭其本身就足以产生某种作用的，强调无需进一步行动或条件。
senses.en_definition: Being sufficient in itself to produce an effect, without anything further.
senses.ms_definition: Kata sifat bahasa Inggeris yang menekankan bahawa sesuatu itu sahaja sudah cukup untuk menimbulkan kesan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 如 the mere mention 表示“单单提起就……”，并不表示提及的内容不重要。马来语通常通过 hanya、sahaja 或 cukup dengan 表达，而不是直接插入 mere。[Cambridge：mere](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/mere)

collocations.ms: the mere thought — bahasa Inggeris; BM: hanya dengan memikirkannya

etymology.historical_story: The English adjective mere traces back to Latin merus, meaning pure. Its modern uses invite a helpful connection: something considered by itself can be presented as only that thing, or as sufficient on its own. This explains a learning contrast between a mere formality and the mere thought, without making it a Malay derivative. [Merriam-Webster word history](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/mere)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mere 和“仅此而已”绑定：a mere formality＝只是手续；the mere thought＝光想到就……。记住英语单音节读法，不按马来语 me.re 拆读。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基础词 mengulangi，最底层词根是 ulang。meN- 在元音 u 前取 meng-，词根首音不脱落；末尾 -nya 是宾语代词，ny 读 /ɲ/。所给 Jawi 对应 mengulangi；完整词形为 مڠولڠيڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 再次或反复做前文所指的事情；重说、重演或重犯它。
senses.en_definition: To do, say, or perform the previously mentioned thing again or repeatedly.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan atau menyatakan semula perkara yang telah disebut, sama ada sekali lagi atau berulang kali.
senses.nuances: -nya 是宾语，可回指动作、话语、步骤或错误；它不表示动作的执行者，也不标记时态。具体重复次数由语境决定。参见 [DBP：mengulangi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengulangi)。

senses.zh_definition: 重新温习前文所指的功课、知识或学习内容。
senses.en_definition: To revise or rehearse previously learned material referred to in context.
senses.ms_definition: Mempelajari, membaca atau menghafaz semula bahan pelajaran yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 须有明确的学习内容作为先行对象，例如 pelajaran、nota 或 hafalan。日常也常用 mengulang kaji 来表达复习。

collocations.en: rehearse it until it is memorized

senses.zh_definition: 经常前往、反复探访前文所指的地方或对象。
senses.en_definition: To visit or go to the previously mentioned place or person repeatedly.
senses.ms_definition: Kerap mendatangi atau menziarahi tempat atau orang yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 这是基础词 mengulangi 的词典义，现代一般会话中较少见；常可换成 kerap mengunjunginya。不能把所有 mengulanginya 都译为探访。

collocations.en: visit it or them every week

etymology.historical_story: The word is built through Malay morphology around ulang, the idea of doing something again. Its dictionary meanings connect repeated actions, repeated visits, and renewed study. Adding nya lets a speaker refer back to something already mentioned, turning a general act of repetition into repeating that particular thing. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengulangi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ulang＝再来一次；mengulangi＝重复做；加 -nya，就成“把那件事再做一次”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根首音 /s/ 在 meN- 派生中脱落，前缀实现为 meny- /məɲ/。输入包将 menyita 标为词根有误；DBP 将它列为 sita 的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 由警方或其他有权机关依法查扣、扣押物品或查封财产。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records menyita under sita, alongside words for seized goods and the person carrying out a seizure. This family connects an official action with its objects and agents. It illustrates how Malay builds administrative vocabulary through affixation. The consulted entry establishes this morphological relationship but does not establish the root’s ultimate historical origin. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sita).

morphology.formula: memasang + -nya → memasangnya；底层构词：meN- + pasang → memasang
morphology.pattern_note: meN- 遇词首 p 时变为 mem-，p 脱落；-nya 是第三人称宾语附着形式，意为把它装上、点燃等，具体意义由先行词决定。此处按给定字段归入 suffix，并非派生后缀。音节可分析为 me.ma.sang.nya；所给 Jawi 记录的是 memasang，未包含 -nya。

word_family.gloss: 已装好；处于开启或安装状态

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的物件安装、装配或固定到适当位置。
senses.en_definition: To assemble, install, or fit the previously mentioned item.
senses.ms_definition: Mencantumkan bahagian atau menempatkan benda yang dirujuk oleh -nya supaya lengkap atau terpasang pada tempatnya.
senses.nuances: 现代常用义。-nya 已充当宾语：memasang kipas 可改为 memasangnya，不能直接写成 memasangnya kipas。以下搭配以基础动词展示其常见宾语。[DBP：pasang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=pasang)

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的灯具点亮，或把某物点燃。
senses.en_definition: To light or ignite the previously mentioned object.
senses.ms_definition: Menyalakan lampu atau membakar benda yang dirujuk oleh -nya dengan mengenakan api padanya.
senses.nuances: 可用于油灯、蜡烛等，也可指开灯。与安装灯具的意义可能重叠，须凭上下文判断。

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的发动机或设备启动、开启。
senses.en_definition: To start or switch on the previously mentioned engine or device.
senses.ms_definition: Menghidupkan enjin atau alat yang dirujuk oleh -nya supaya mula berfungsi.
senses.nuances: 强调开始运转，而非安装设备；正式技术说明也常用 menghidupkan。

senses.zh_definition: 把前文提到的捕捉工具布设好，以捕获动物或鱼类。
senses.en_definition: To set the previously mentioned trap or fishing net.
senses.ms_definition: Meletakkan jerat, jaring atau alat tangkapan yang dirujuk oleh -nya di tempat tertentu untuk menangkap haiwan.
senses.nuances: 指布设、张开或安放捕捉工具，不表示制造该工具。

senses.zh_definition: 安装前文提到的软件，或把相关硬件接入计算机系统。
senses.en_definition: To install the previously mentioned software or connect the hardware to a computer system.
senses.ms_definition: Memasukkan perisian atau menyambungkan perkakasan yang dirujuk oleh -nya ke dalam sistem komputer.
senses.nuances: 计算机领域的专门用法。安装软件与运行软件是不同操作，memasangnya 本身不表示打开程序。

senses.zh_definition: 使前文提到的枪炮等武器开火。
senses.en_definition: To fire the previously mentioned gun or cannon.
senses.ms_definition: Melepaskan tembakan daripada senapang atau meriam yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 多见于旧文学、历史叙述或礼炮语境；现代一般叙述常用 menembak 或 melepaskan tembakan。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places cannon firing, lamp lighting, assembling objects, setting traps, and starting engines under memasang. That range offers a useful cultural picture: the same verb serves activities involving lamps, fishing gear, and machinery. Memasangnya adds the object clitic -nya, allowing a speaker to refer back to the item already mentioned. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=pasang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 me-ma-sang-nya：先抓住 memasang 的“装上、开启”，再把尾部 nya 想成手指指向“它”。整词就是“把它装上／开启”。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的整词借用形式，不拆作马来语词缀。/mob/ 为马来语适应读音；尚无可靠依据列出常用马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 行为失序、容易受群体情绪驱动的人群，尤指具有威胁性或参与骚乱的人群。

senses.ms_definition: Sekumpulan orang yang bertindak tidak terkawal, khususnya secara agresif atau ganas; kelompok rusuh.
senses.nuances: 带明显负面评价，不宜用来泛指普通人群。DBP 的术语资料列有 kelompok rusuh/mob；一般马来语行文通常使用 kumpulan perusuh 或 gerombolan。此处马来语释义为综合释义，并非《Kamus Dewan》独立词条的逐字引文。[DBP 术语资料](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=rusuh)

etymology.historical_story: English mob emerged in the late seventeenth century as a shortening associated with the Latin expression mobile vulgus, describing an excitable or changeable populace. Its history helps explain why the word suggests collective disorder rather than a neutral gathering. Malay terminology records mob alongside kelompok rusuh, retaining that negative association. [Sources: English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/mob), [DBP terminology](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=rusuh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mob 想成一团拥挤、起哄的人群：重点是“群体失控”，不是单纯“人很多”。

etymology.historical_story: Mengorat belongs to everyday Malaysian speech about romantic attention. The corresponding dictionary spelling is mengurat, while an archived Malaysian oral history uses mengorat in a question about courtship. These records document a difference between conversational usage and dictionary spelling; they do not establish a separate historical root or an exact date of origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=Mengurat), [UiTM oral history](https://ir.uitm.edu.my/id/eprint/85451/1/85451.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mengorat 连到“开口搭讪，想让对方心动”的画面；再配对记：聊天常见 mengorat，规范拼写用 mengurat。

etymology.historical_story: One established English and Scottish origin of Morton is a place name combining Old English mōr, meaning moor, with tūn, meaning farmstead or estate. A surname could thus preserve a family's association with a landscape. The surname dictionary also records other origins, so this explanation should not be assigned automatically to every bearer. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/morton).

senses.ms_definition: Nama ibu negara Rusia; bentuk Moskow lazim dalam bahasa Indonesia, manakala penggunaan bahasa Melayu Malaysia lazimnya memakai Moscow.

etymology.historical_story: Moskow illustrates how one city can acquire different conventional spellings across neighbouring languages. Indonesian news commonly uses Moskow, while Malaysian Malay reporting commonly uses Moscow. Both identify the Russian capital. For learners, the useful cultural lesson is to match the spelling to the publication's language variety rather than interpret the final letters as a Malay suffix. [Indonesian usage](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5720760/moskow-komitmen-perkuat-kerja-sama-wisata-ekraf-dengan-jakarta), [Malaysian usage](https://www.bernama.com/bm/news.php?id=2424081).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Moskow 就联想“莫斯科”；再记一组对应：印尼语常见 Moskow，马来西亚文本常见 Moscow。

morphology.affix: meN-...-kan，作用于 ke tepi 基底
morphology.pattern_note: 资料包误把整词标为词根。词汇词根是 tepi，派生基底包含 ke tepi；meN- 在基底初始 k 前实现为 meng-，k 脱落，内部 t 保留。因此是 mengetepikan，不是 mengenepikan。参见 [DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menepikan)。

senses.zh_definition: 把某人或某物移到边上。

etymology.historical_story: The word's meanings are connected by the image of moving something towards an edge. Its lexical root tepi means an edge or side, while ke tepi supplies the directional base used in this formation. Setting an object aside provides a useful bridge to setting aside interests, excluding people, eliminating opponents, and setting aside decisions. This is a semantic explanation, not a dated history of each sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 tepi“边”：把东西推到边上，也能把私心、分歧或对手放到一边。记住 ke tepi 中的 t 要保留，写 mengetepikan。

etymology.historical_story: The computer sense grew from a visual nickname in Douglas Engelbart’s research team during the 1960s. The small pointing device resembled an animal, while its cable suggested a tail. Engelbart later recalled that nobody remembered who first supplied the name. The metaphor survived even when wireless models lost their cable tails. [Computer History Museum](https://www.computerhistory.org/revolution/story/350)

etymology.historical_story: Meratapi is transparently formed from ratap, the Malay noun for lamentation. Dictionary examples connect this family with grief expressed through crying and words, including scenes of sorrow in literary narration. Adding the verbal prefix and suffix directs the lament towards an object. That object may be a loved one's death, a painful loss or one's unfortunate fate. [Dictionary reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ratap)

etymology.historical_story: Kipling invented Mowgli as a literary name. Within the stories, the wolf family associates it with a frog, fitting a human child without fur. That fictional explanation is not a translation from a real language: Kipling explicitly described the name as made up. [The Kipling Society](https://www.kiplingsociety.co.uk/readers-guide/rg_mowglibros_notes.htm) records this distinction in its annotations.

etymology.historical_story: Minho illustrates how identical Roman spellings can conceal unrelated naming histories. Korean entertainment uses Minho as a personal or stage name, while Portuguese geography uses it for a river and region. Without the original sentence, these histories cannot be merged into one etymology, and a Korean name's meaning cannot be recovered from Roman letters alone. [Korean-name example](https://world.kbs.co.kr/service/contents_view.htm?board_seq=431490&lang=e&menu_cate=artist), [river-name history](https://www.pecriominho.org/pt/el-rio-mino)

etymology.historical_story: Mohor belongs to Malay's Persian loanword heritage. Its meaning evokes the world of authenticated letters, royal authority, and identifying impressions: a seal makes an issuer recognizable. Modern Malay retains that association in royal and company terminology, while cincin mohor preserves the image of a ring used to seal correspondence. Persian classification: [Malay Language Centre of Singapore](https://mlcs.moe.edu.sg/files/dian_bahasa_6.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: The underlying root timbang connects physical weighing with mental evaluation. In mempertimbangkan, that familiar image becomes the act of weighing a matter before deciding. Adding -nya supplies an already understood object. The resulting long word therefore packages a simple action and its object together: “consider it,” rather than naming an entirely separate concept.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 timbang＝称一称、衡量；mempertimbangkan＝权衡考虑，末尾 nya＝它：把“这件事”放上脑中的天平。

etymology.historical_story: Menjemput connects welcoming an arriving guest with inviting someone to come, two closely related acts of hospitality. Adding the attached pronoun -mu makes the addressee the object: you are the person welcomed, collected, or invited. This is transparent Malay word formation, not a separate ancient root. DBP also records a specifically Minangkabau marriage-related sense under the base verb.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jemput 是“请来、接来”，-mu 是“你”：menjemputmu 就是“请你来”或“把你接来”。

morphology.formula: meN- + gunakan → menggunakan; 等价分析：meN- + guna + -kan → menggunakan; mengunakan → 使用中的误拼
morphology.pattern_note: 保留词包的直接基底 gunakan；其词根为 guna。meN- 在 g 前呈 meng-，词根首音 g 保留，形成 /ŋɡ/，写作 ngg。mengunakan 少了一个 g，没有独立的标准发音；标准 menggunakan 的音位式为 /məŋɡunakan/。

senses.zh_definition: 【误拼，规范形式为 menggunakan】使用某种工具、方法、语言或其他手段来做事。

senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi menggunakan, iaitu melakukan sesuatu dengan memakai alat, kaedah atau cara tertentu.
senses.nuances: mengunakan 不是与 menggunakan 并列的规范变体。这里的词义和搭配均属于纠正后的 menggunakan；马来语释义为编辑性转述，不是误拼形式的官方词典释义。[DBP：menggunakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=menggunakan)；[UKM 研究：保留词根 g 的拼写分析](https://ejournal.ukm.my/jmelayu/article/download/47707/11815)

senses.ms_definition: Bagi bentuk baku menggunakan: mengambil faedah atau manfaat daripada sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 侧重发挥资源或机会的用途，不必然带有剥削意味。不能因中文译为“利用”，就把所有语境都理解为负面的操控。[DBP：guna I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Guna)

etymology.historical_story: Mengunakan has no separately established word history: it is a misspelling of menggunakan. The standard formation preserves guna inside meng- and -kan. Its adjacent letters ng and g represent a nasal followed by the root's consonant, explaining why the correct spelling contains ngg. Treating the shortened spelling as an independent historical form would obscure this useful morphological connection.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: meng + guna + kan：前缀的 ng 后面还要保留 guna 的 g，因此是 menggunakan，记住 ngg。

etymology.historical_story: Monty belongs to English personal naming rather than Malay word formation. It is associated with longer names such as Montgomery and Montague, although an individual's registered name may simply be Monty. The separate expression the full monty means the complete package, but its historical origin remains uncertain. [Name history](https://nameberry.com/name/monty); [idiom history](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/full-monty).

etymology.historical_story: Mengalahkanmu is a grammatical combination rather than a separate historical root. DBP lists mengalahkan in the kalah word family. Adding the attached pronoun -mu identifies the opponent as “you”. The family also contains mengalah, meaning to yield, so the presence of -kan creates a memorable distinction between conceding and causing defeat. [DBP: kalah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kalah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kalah＝输；mengalahkan＝让对手输；-mu＝你。合起来就是“让你输”，即“击败你”。

etymology.historical_story: An Iban teaching text records meri’ with the meanings give and donate. That evidence identifies a possible regional-language counterpart, but it does not establish the origin or intended meaning of the bare token meri in this packet. Without an original sentence or identified source language, a more specific historical account would be conjecture.

morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的直接词基 menembak；进一步分析的词根是 tembak。meN- 遇 t 时发生鼻音替代，t 脱落；-ku 是附着代词 aku，在这里作宾语‘我’，并非普通派生后缀。标准拼写保留相接的两个 k。实际分音为 me.nem.bak.ku，常见语音实现为 [mə.nɛm.baʔ.ku]。输入 Jawi منيمبق 仅对应 menembak，未包含 -ku；此处按要求保留，不能视作完整词形的 Jawi。

etymology.historical_story: Menembakku brings together the verb menembak and the attached pronoun ku, meaning me in this construction. Its compact shape suits dialogue and first-person storytelling: the action and its target appear in one written word. Malay dictionaries also preserve figurative branches of menembak, including directing something towards a target, deception, and a lightning strike. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menembak).

etymology.historical_story: The secure starting point is the Malay base lontar, meaning to throw, with the active prefix meN-. Its cultural reach extends from athletics to the Hajj expression melontar jamrah. Modern public discourse also sends ideas outward through melontar idea. That comparison explains the metaphor; it does not establish when the figurative usage first arose.

etymology.historical_story: Mendatangi illustrates how Malay morphology turns datang, meaning come, into an action directed at a destination or person. Its dictionary senses range from visiting to arriving for enforcement, and figuratively to illness befalling someone. These meanings share the image of something reaching a target; this is a learning interpretation, not a documented chronology of semantic change. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mendatangi)

etymology.historical_story: English matter came through French from Latin materia, referring to material or substance. Its history connects what something is made from with what speech or thought is about, helping explain its physical and abstract senses. In Malaysian mixed-language conversation, the English word may be inserted directly into Malay speech. That conversational use does not establish a separate Malay root. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/matter).

etymology.historical_story: DBP separates two entries spelled ungkap. One concerns opening the mouth for breath; the other concerns expression. This distinction matters when reading stories: a character may be struggling to breathe rather than revealing a secret. The dictionary evidence establishes the separate meanings, but does not by itself establish a shared historical origin for them.

etymology.historical_story: Mekap reflects English make-up adapted to Malay spelling and pronunciation. Its dictionary meanings preserve an interesting connection between two crafts: arranging a face with cosmetics and arranging a printed page with text and pictures. Malay then integrates the borrowing into its own morphology through forms such as bermekap and memekap. No precise borrowing date is established here.

etymology.historical_story: Mordor belongs to Tolkien's invented geography rather than to an established Malay word family. Readers encounter it as Sauron's realm in Middle-earth, and Malay discussion can retain the original place name. Its appearance in a word list therefore need not indicate a Malay common noun. The packet provides no evidence identifying a different intended referent.

etymology.historical_story: The key to this word is daya in its sense of a stratagem, not merely strength or ability. DBP illustrates the related memperdaya through Sang Kancil, the clever mouse-deer who tricks other forest animals. That familiar storytelling context makes the modern meaning memorable: ingenuity becomes deception when it is used to mislead someone.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tipu daya＝诡计，再把 memperdayakan 理解成“对人施展诡计”。看见 daya，别一律联想到能力或赋能。

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 /b/ 前变为 mem-，词根的 /b/ 保留。词根末尾 k 与后缀 -kan 的 k 均保留在拼写中，形成 kk；原包音标将前一个 k 标作喉塞音 /ʔ/。

senses.zh_definition: 使事物变坏、损坏或腐败；使原有状况进一步恶化。

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan buruk, rosak atau busuk; menyebabkan keadaan menjadi lebih buruk.
senses.nuances: 使动、及物用法，后面可接物体、病情或局势等。memburuk 表示主体自身恶化；memburukkan 表示某因素使对象恶化。

senses.zh_definition: 说某人或某事的坏话，贬低、辱骂或损害其名声。
senses.en_definition: To speak ill of, disparage, or damage the reputation of someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Mengatakan atau menganggap buruk; mengata-ngata, mencela, mencaci atau mencerca.
senses.nuances: 也可用 memburuk-burukkan 强调反复或着意贬损。该词本身不必然表示内容虚假，因此不能在所有语境中都译为“造谣”或“诽谤”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay buruk connects physical deterioration with negative judgement: an object can be worn out, a situation can deteriorate, and conduct can be bad. Memburukkan turns that quality into an action affecting something else. Its reputational sense extends the same pattern to social standing: words can make another person appear worse. No deeper historical derivation is asserted here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: buruk＝坏；meN-...-kan＝使对象变成某种状态。memburukkan 就是“使其变坏”：可以坏了局面，也可以坏了名声。

etymology.historical_story: Malay ikat connects physical fastening with several cultural activities: securing bundles, arranging verse, tying traditional headwear, and establishing agreements. These meanings share an image of separate elements being brought into an ordered connection. Mengikat adds the active verbal prefix, while -nya identifies a previously mentioned person or object; it does not create a separate historical root. [DBP: mengikat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=mengikat)

morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 g 前取 meng-，原有 g 保留，形成 /ŋɡ/。数据包将整词标成词根，应订正为 geletar；其早期内部构形不影响这里的直接派生分析。依据：[DBP：geletar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=geletar)。

senses.zh_definition: 身体或身体部位因恐惧、寒冷、发热等而不由自主地发抖。

senses.nuances: 通常是不及物动词，主语可以是人，也可以是 tangan、badan 等身体部位。描述的是抖动现象，本身不说明具体病因；使某物发抖可用 menggeletarkan。

senses.zh_definition: 声音、琴弦等出现颤动或震颤。

senses.nuances: 声音的颤抖可表现紧张、悲伤或激动，不能一概译成“害怕”。描写乐器振动时带有描写色彩，技术语境通常更常见 bergetar。

etymology.historical_story: DBP places menggeletar under geletar, alongside the causative menggeletarkan. The family connects bodily trembling with the quivering of voices and musical sounds, giving one motion several expressive uses. Its transparent modern formation is meng- plus geletar. The packet's root label therefore needs correction; treating the entire prefixed form as an indivisible root would conceal a useful grammatical relationship.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 geletar 的连续音节想成手指一阵阵抖动；meng- 接上去，就是“正在发抖”。这是动作联想，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Marcel continues the Roman name Marcellus, historically a diminutive of Marcus. The name developed forms across several European languages, so identical spelling does not guarantee identical pronunciation. French cultural figures such as Marcel Proust and Marcel Duchamp illustrate its use as a personal name, rather than a Malay descriptive word. [Marcel](https://www.behindthename.com/name/marcel), [Marcellus](https://www.behindthename.com/name/marcellus)

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates how Malay expands a familiar base through productive affixes. Bahagi connects division, shares, and distribution; related forms carry those ideas into administration and arithmetic. Membahagikan can therefore describe allocating duties, separating regions, or dividing numbers. These linked meanings make the word useful across classrooms, offices, and everyday arrangements.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 bahagi＝分，再看 membahagikan＝把东西分开或分出去：分区域、分任务、分食物，算除法也是在分。

etymology.historical_story: The unit maxwell commemorates James Clerk Maxwell, the Scottish physicist associated with the electromagnetic theory of light. His surname became a technical common noun, illustrating how scientific names enter international vocabulary without acquiring ordinary Malay affixes. The lowercase unit name must be distinguished from the capitalized personal name and its symbol Mx. [Dictionary.com: maxwell](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/maxwell)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Maxwell 与电磁学联系起来，再记住换算锚点：1 Mx = 10⁻⁸ Wb。它测磁通量，不表示“最大值”。

Portuguese forms of the place name developed through contact with local Chinese names. etymology.historical_story: Morning developed in English from morn with an ending modelled on evening. Its use as a greeting is a shortening of good morning. This gives learners two connected pictures: a time of day and the greeting exchanged then. In a Malay conversation, the English form can retain that greeting function while selamat pagi supplies the standard Malay equivalent. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/morning)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 morning 的 /mɔː/，想象早晨见面挥手；整词对应 pagi，单独招呼别人时对应 selamat pagi。

etymology.historical_story: One documented cultural bearer of this name is Marcie in Peanuts, whose named debut was on July 20, 1971. The Schulz Museum explains that the cartoonist named her after a friend of his two youngest daughters. This establishes the character’s naming story, rather than the ultimate etymology of the personal name or the identity intended by this input. Sources: [Peanuts](https://www.peanuts.com/about/marcie), [Schulz Museum](https://schulzmuseum.org/celebrating-peanuts-online/).

etymology.historical_story: Megatron enters Malay conversation chiefly as a name carried by Transformers entertainment and merchandise. Hasbro's character material identifies an Armada version as a Decepticon leader, illustrating why the name evokes power and robotic conflict. That cultural association is documented; the precise original naming process is not established here. Apparent name components should therefore remain mnemonic clues rather than asserted etymology.

senses.zh_definition: 不理会我；任由我处于某种状态而不加照顾或干预。
senses.en_definition: To ignore or neglect me, or leave me in a particular condition without intervening.
senses.ms_definition: Mengabaikan atau tidak mempedulikan aku; tidak memberikan perhatian atau penjagaan kepadaku.
senses.nuances: 常暗含失望、被冷落或责备；并不必然表示永久抛弃。这里的 -ku 是宾语“我”，不是施事者。马来文释义根据 [DBP 的 membiarkan 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membiarkan)针对该合成词形改写。

senses.zh_definition: 允许我做某事；不阻止我的行动，或任由某事发生在我身上。

senses.ms_definition: Mengizinkan atau tidak melarang aku melakukan sesuatu, atau merelakan sesuatu berlaku terhadap diriku.
senses.nuances: 可表示尊重自主，也可表示消极放任，须看后续动作和语境。正式表达明确许可时，mengizinkan saya 往往更清楚。义项依据 [DBP 的 membiarkan 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=membiarkan)。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing: biar supplies the idea of letting, membiarkan forms the verb, and attached ku identifies the speaker as its object. The compact ending can sound intimate or literary. Its meaning ranges from welcome freedom to painful neglect, depending on what follows.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三块记：mem-biarkan-ku；biarkan 是“任由”，末尾 ku 把对象锁定为“我”。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述寻找后发现某人的情境。主动去拜访别人通常选 menemui；不要把“找到我”误解为“我找到了”。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. The temu family connects meeting with finding; a nasal prefix and -kan produce menemukan. Adding -ku brings the speaker into the event as the person found. Its compact shape suits personal narration, while everyday Malaysian conversation often expresses the same situation with jumpa aku.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记：menemukan“找到”＋尾巴 ku“我”＝“找到我”；ku 在后面，我就是被找到的人。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: nikah 在马来西亚常见于穆斯林婚姻及婚约仪式语境。跨宗教或一般性讨论中，berkahwin、perkahwinan 往往更中性；谈具体个人时应尊重其称呼与隐私。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谈正式结婚意愿、婚姻叙事及新闻声明。不要仅凭 -nya 判断对方性别；也不要把 menikahinya 用来表示主持别人的婚礼。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: nikah 在马来西亚常见于穆斯林婚姻及婚约仪式语境。跨宗教或一般性讨论中，berkahwin、perkahwinan 往往更中性；谈具体个人时应尊重其称呼与隐私。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈正式结婚意愿、婚姻叙事及新闻声明。不要仅凭 -nya 判断对方性别；也不要把 menikahinya 用来表示主持别人的婚礼。

etymology.historical_story: Nikah comes from Arabic nikāḥ, a word associated with marriage and the marriage contract. In Malay, that borrowed base participates in a productive family of words about marrying and arranging marriages. Menikahi takes the spouse as its object; attaching -nya identifies that person through context, without specifying whether the referent is male or female.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nikah“婚姻”→ menikahi“与某人结婚”→ 尾巴 nya“他／她”：把结婚对象接在词后。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，无可分析的现代马来语词缀；普通名词 mamat 与人名 Mamat 须按语境区分。

word_family.gloss: 那些家伙；几个男的（口语）

senses.zh_definition: 男的；家伙；小子。口语中用来指称某个男性，语气可随上下文显得随意、亲昵或轻蔑。
senses.en_definition: An informal term for a male person; a guy, fellow, or bloke.
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan tidak rasmi bagi seorang lelaki, lazimnya ketika bercakap tentang lelaki tersebut.
senses.nuances: 通常用于第三人称，如 mamat tu；不一定表示对方年轻，也不必然含贬义。并非 mamak 的同义词。本包未提供 DBP 释义，此处马来语释义为编辑性概括；status 按指定格式保留，不表示已获 DBP 审定。

senses.zh_definition: 马马特：男性人名或昵称；作为人名时首字母大写。
senses.en_definition: Mamat, a male personal name or familiar name used in Malay-speaking communities.
senses.ms_definition: Nama atau nama panggilan lelaki dalam masyarakat berbahasa Melayu, ditulis dengan huruf awal besar.
senses.nuances: Mamat 是人名时不应译成“家伙”。部分人的 Mamat 是与 Muhammad 相关的熟称，但不能据此推定每位使用者的正式姓名。参见 [Malaysian names](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysian_names)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 朋友间可以随口说 mamat tu，但评价性的语气容易使它带有轻蔑意味。称呼名为 Mamat 的人时，应依关系使用 Encik Mamat、Pak Mamat 或其本人接受的称呼。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与熟人谈论第三者时可以使用；直接称陌生人、长辈或客户为 mamat，可能显得不尊重。正式场合宜用 lelaki tersebut、姓名或合适称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 朋友间可以随口说 mamat tu，但评价性的语气容易使它带有轻蔑意味。称呼名为 Mamat 的人时，应依关系使用 Encik Mamat、Pak Mamat 或其本人接受的称呼。

etymology.historical_story: Mamat belongs both to Malay personal naming and to everyday informal reference. It is recorded as a familiar form associated with Muhammad, while lowercase mamat can refer to an otherwise unnamed man. This offers a useful cultural connection, although the packet does not establish the precise historical development from personal name to common noun. See [Malaysian names](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysian_names).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 mamat tu＝“那家伙”；看到大写 Mamat，先想到一个人的名字。

morphology.pattern_note: 按包保留直接基底 mendengarkan；最终词根为 dengar：meN- + dengar + -kan → mendengarkan，d 前 meN- 实现为 men- 且保留 d；再接宾语附着代词 -nya，读 /ɲa/。此处 suffix 是给定分类中对 -nya 的近似归类。

senses.zh_definition: 专心听它、他或她；认真听取前文提到的声音、话语或说话者。
senses.en_definition: To listen attentively to it, him, or her, with the object identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Memasang telinga untuk mendengar; mendengar dengan sungguh-sungguh. Dalam bentuk ini, -nya merujuk kepada orang atau perkara yang didengarkan.
senses.nuances: 前两小句展开包内 Kamus Pelajar 对 mendengarkan 的定义；最后一句说明 -nya 的作用。-nya 在这里是宾语，不表示“他的听力”，也不标示时态。马来西亚日常口语常用 dengar 或 dengar dia，完整形式更偏书面。包内 headword.jawi 实为 mendengarkan，缺少 -nya；已按要求保留原值，完整形式应为 مندڠرکنڽ。参见 [DBP PRPM：dengar 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memasang+telinga)。

collocations.en: listen to it, him, or her carefully
listen to it, him, or her through to the end

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于听录音、发言或谈话。应让 -nya 的指代清楚；要表达“播放给别人听”，应使用 memperdengarkan 等形式，不能把 mendengarkannya 当作“让人听见它”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 形容认真倾听通常得体；命令对方听话时，语气可能显得强硬，可使用 Sila dengar dahulu 或 Boleh dengar sebentar?。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于听录音、发言或谈话。应让 -nya 的指代清楚；要表达“播放给别人听”，应使用 memperdengarkan 等形式，不能把 mendengarkannya 当作“让人听见它”。

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowed origin. The base dengar belongs to the vocabulary of hearing; mendengarkan specifies attentive listening, and attached -nya supplies an object recoverable from context. A single written word can therefore express what English often distributes across a verb, a preposition, and a pronoun. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memasang+telinga).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dengar＝听，mendengarkan＝认真听，末尾 -nya 把“它／他／她”接上：认真听它。

morphology.formula: Member of Parliament → MP（首字母缩写）
morphology.pattern_note: 若指国会议员，规范写法为 MP，逐字母读作 em pi，而非拼读成一个词。is_root 仅沿用数据包的独立词形标记，不表示它是马来语本族词根。

senses.zh_definition: 在政治语境中，英语 Member of Parliament 的首字母缩写，意为国会议员；马来西亚日常政治报道中通常指下议院议员。
senses.en_definition: In political contexts, an initialism of Member of Parliament, usually referring in Malaysian usage to a member of the Dewan Rakyat.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks politik, singkatan bahasa Inggeris bagi Member of Parliament, iaitu Ahli Parlimen; dalam penggunaan lazim di Malaysia, biasanya merujuk kepada ahli Dewan Rakyat.
senses.nuances: 数据包未提供上下文，不能确定 mp 的展开式；这里暂按政治用法解释，音标也仅适用于此解释。MP 还可用于其他专业缩写，不能据此条穷尽。马来语正式行文宜用 Ahli Parlimen；不要与 ADUN（州议员）混淆。以下例句为自拟。[马来西亚学术文献中的 MP 缩写表](https://etd.uum.edu.my/4469/1/s91727.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报

dual_scenarios.zh: 在这份英文报告中，MP 是“国会议员”的缩写。
dual_scenarios.en: In this English-language report, MP stands for Member of Parliament.

nak 对应 mahu；pasal 在此对应 tentang。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论职务可用 MP；正式马来语文件宜写 Ahli Parlimen。直接称呼议员时，通常依场合使用 Yang Berhormat 或 YB，并配合姓名及适当称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于国会政治、选区事务及议员服务讨论。MP 是职务缩写，不是直接称呼所有政治人物的通用敬语；技术文件中必须另查其展开式。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论职务可用 MP；正式马来语文件宜写 Ahli Parlimen。直接称呼议员时，通常依场合使用 Yang Berhormat 或 YB，并配合姓名及适当称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于国会政治、选区事务及议员服务讨论。MP 是职务缩写，不是直接称呼所有政治人物的通用敬语；技术文件中必须另查其展开式。

etymology.historical_story: MP is formed from the initial letters of the English title Member of Parliament. It accompanies the English terminology of parliamentary institutions and appears in Malaysian writing alongside Ahli Parlimen. Its structure is abbreviation rather than Malay affixation, so the letters should not be interpreted as a native root with a hidden lexical meaning. [Malaysian academic abbreviation list](https://etd.uum.edu.my/4469/1/s91727.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: M = Member，P = Parliament：议会里的成员，就是国会议员；马来语对应 Ahli Parlimen。

morphology.formula: ∅ + musibah → musibah（阿拉伯语整词借入）
morphology.pattern_note: 在现代马来语中作为完整词根使用；mu- 不是此词的马来语前缀，不按马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 造成痛苦、损失或不幸的灾祸、灾难或厄运，可指个人遭遇或群体灾害。
senses.en_definition: A calamity, disaster or misfortune that causes suffering or loss.
senses.ms_definition: Bencana, celaka atau malapetaka.
senses.nuances: 语气通常比一般麻烦或小挫折更沉重，可指火灾、洪灾、事故及丧失亲人等遭遇。常见于慰问及宗教谈话，但词义本身不限定宗教，也不表示受灾者有过错。例句为自拟。[DBP：musibah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=128916&keyword=musibah)

senses.zh_definition: 该死的；可恶的。用于咒骂或辱骂的粗俗表达。
senses.en_definition: Damned or wretched, used abusively as a curse or insult.
senses.ms_definition: Celaka atau sial, digunakan sebagai kata makian dalam bahasa kasar.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为 bk（bahasa kasar，粗俗语）。这里按其评价性用法标为 adjective，并非断言 DBP 提供了该词性标注。以下组合展示辱骂结构，不代表适宜使用或经证实的高频搭配。[DBP：musibah 的第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=128916&keyword=musibah)

dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak syarikat menyalurkan bantuan kecemasan kepada pekerja yang ditimpa musibah kebakaran.
dual_scenarios.zh: 公司向遭遇火灾的员工提供紧急援助。
dual_scenarios.en: The company provided emergency assistance to employees affected by a fire.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Keluarga dia baru ditimpa musibah, kita tolong apa yang boleh lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Keluarganya baru sahaja ditimpa musibah. Marilah kita membantu sedaya upaya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他家刚遭了难，咱们能帮多少就帮多少吧。

baru 在此对应 baru sahaja。
lah 在这里缓和建议语气，不表示辱骂。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Keluarga Amir baru ditimpa musibah. Rumah dia terbakar semalam.
messages.ms_standard: Keluarga Amir baru sahaja ditimpa musibah. Rumah keluarganya terbakar semalam.
messages.zh: 阿米尔家刚遭了难，他家昨晚失火了。

messages.ms_standard: Saya sedih mendengarnya. Saya mahu menghantar makanan kepadanya pada petang ini.
messages.zh: 听了真难过。我想今天傍晚给他送点吃的。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 慰问时可说 Semoga tabah menghadapi musibah ini（愿你坚强面对这场灾祸）。语气宜温和，避免把对方的不幸说成其应得的惩罚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 灾祸义适合慰问、援助及新闻报道；与不熟悉的人交流时，可直接表达关心并提供具体帮助。辱骂义属于粗俗语，不宜用于职场、长辈交谈或慰问。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 慰问时可说 Semoga tabah menghadapi musibah ini（愿你坚强面对这场灾祸）。语气宜温和，避免把对方的不幸说成其应得的惩罚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 灾祸义适合慰问、援助及新闻报道；与不熟悉的人交流时，可直接表达关心并提供具体帮助。辱骂义属于粗俗语，不宜用于职场、长辈交谈或慰问。

etymology.historical_story: Musibah is an Arabic loanword, identified as such by DBP. Its source, muṣībah, also occurs in the Quran with the meaning of misfortune. This helps explain its familiarity in religious reflection on suffering. Malay nevertheless uses the word for disasters and personal adversity more broadly, without requiring a religious interpretation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=128916&keyword=musibah), [Quranic Arabic Corpus](https://corpus.quran.com/search.jsp?q=lem%3Am~uSiybap+pos%3An&s=3)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mu-si-bah，近似“目睹事变吧”：想到突然降临的灾祸。只是记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根记忆；开头的 mer- 不是可拆出的前缀。e 读央元音 /ə/。加 ke-...-an 构成 kemerduan 时保留词根。

word_family.gloss: 声音悦耳的特质；动听程度

senses.zh_definition: 声音、歌声或音乐悦耳动听，具有优美和谐的听觉效果。
senses.en_definition: Melodious or sweet-sounding; pleasant to hear, especially of a voice, song, or musical sound.
senses.ms_definition: Enak atau sedap didengar, berkenaan suara, nyanyian dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调听觉上的优美，不等于音量大、音调高或发音清晰；也不用于形容食物好吃。与 lembut 不完全同义：声音可以柔和却不悦耳，也可以洪亮而悦耳。依据 [DBP：merdu](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=merdu)。
